B3275: 5.3.4Initial AS security activation
B3276: 5.3.4.1General
B3278: Figure 5.3.4.1-1: Security mode command, successful
B3280: Figure 5.3.4.1-2: Security mode command, failure
B3281: The purpose of this procedure is to activate AS security upon RRC connection establishment.
B3282: 5.3.4.2Initiation
B3283: The network initiates the security mode command procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED. Moreover, the network applies the procedure as follows:
B3284: -when only SRB1 is established, i.e. prior to establishment of SRB2, multicast MRBs and/ or DRBs.
B3285: 5.3.4.3Reception of the SecurityModeCommand by the UE
B3286: The UE shall:
B3287: 1>derive the KgNB key, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B3288: 1>derive the KRRCint key associated with the integrityProtAlgorithm indicated in the SecurityModeCommand message, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B3289: 1>request lower layers to verify the integrity protection of the SecurityModeCommand message, using the algorithm indicated by the integrityProtAlgorithm as included in the SecurityModeCommand message and the KRRCint key;
B3290: 1>if the SecurityModeCommand message passes the integrity protection check:
B3291: 2>derive the KRRCenc key and the KUPenc key associated with the cipheringAlgorithm indicated in the SecurityModeCommand message, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B3292: 2>derive the KUPint key associated with the integrityProtAlgorithm indicated in the SecurityModeCommand message, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B3293: 2>configure lower layers to apply SRB integrity protection using the indicated algorithm and the KRRCint key immediately, i.e. integrity protection shall be applied to all subsequent messages received and sent by the UE, including the SecurityModeComplete message;
B3294: 2>configure lower layers to apply SRB ciphering using the indicated algorithm, the KRRCenc keyafter completing the procedure, i.e. ciphering shall be applied to all subsequent messages received and sent by the UE, except for the SecurityModeComplete message which is sent unciphered;
B3295: 2>consider AS security to be activated;
B3296: 2>submit the SecurityModeComplete message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends;
B3297: 1>else:
B3298: 2>continue using the configuration used prior to the reception of the SecurityModeCommand message, i.e. neither apply integrity protection nor ciphering.
B3299: 2>submit the SecurityModeFailure message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B3300: 5.3.5RRC reconfiguration
B3301: 5.3.5.1General
B3303: Figure 5.3.5.1-1: RRC reconfiguration, successful
B3305: Figure 5.3.5.1-2: RRC reconfiguration, failure
B3306: The purpose of this procedure is to modify an RRC connection, e.g. to establish/modify/release RBs/BH RLC channels/Uu Relay RLC channels/PC5 Relay RLC channels, to perform reconfiguration with sync, to setup/modify/release measurements, to add/modify/release SCells and cell groups, to add/modify/release conditional reconfiguration configuration, to add/modify/release LTM configuration, and to add/modify/release MP configuration. As part of the procedure, NAS dedicated information may be transferred from the Network to the UE.
B3307: RRC reconfiguration to perform reconfiguration with sync includes, but is not limited to, the following cases:
B3308: -reconfiguration with sync and security key refresh, involving RA to the PCell/PSCell, MAC reset, refresh of security and re-establishment of RLC and PDCP triggered by explicit indicators;
B3309: -reconfiguration with sync but without security key refresh, involving RA to the PCell/PSCell, MAC reset and RLC re-establishment and PDCP data recovery (for AM DRB or AM MRB) triggered by explicit indicators;
B3310: -reconfiguration with sync for DAPS and security key refresh, involving RA to the target PCell, establishment of target MAC, and
B3311: -for non-DAPS bearer: refresh of security and re-establishment of RLC and PDCP triggered by explicit indicators;
B3312: -for DAPS bearer: establishment of RLC for the target PCell, refresh of security and reconfiguration of PDCP to add the ciphering function, the integrity protection function and ROHC function of the target PCell;
B3313: -for SRB: refresh of security and establishment of RLC and PDCP for the target PCell;
B3314: -reconfiguration with sync for DAPS but without security key refresh, involving RA to the target PCell, establishment of target MAC, and
B3315: -for non-DAPS bearer: RLC re-establishment and PDCP data recovery (for AM DRB or AM MRB) triggered by explicit indicators.
B3316: -for DAPS bearer: establishment of RLC for target PCell, reconfiguration of PDCP to add the ciphering function, the integrity protection function and ROHC function of the target PCell;
B3317: -for SRB: establishment of RLC and PDCP for the target PCell.
B3318: -reconfiguration with sync for direct-to-indirect path switch or indirect-to-indirect path switch, not involving RA at target side, involving re-establishment of PDCP /PDCP data recovery (for AM DRB) triggered by explicit indicators;
B3319: -reconfiguration with sync for LTM cell switch, and
B3320: -depending on a network indication, involving or not involving security key refresh;
B3321: -involving or not involving RA to the target LTM candidate SpCell according to a network indication;
B3322: -MAC reset;
B3323: -depending on a network indication, involving or not involving re-establishment of RLC and PDCP data recovery (for AM DRB), or re-establishment/release of RLC and re-establishment of PDCP.
B3324: In (NG)EN-DC and NR-DC, SRB3 can be used for measurement configuration and reporting, for UE assistance (re-)configuration and reporting for power savings, for IP address (re-)configuration and reporting for IAB-nodes, to (re-)configure MAC, RLC, BAP, physical layer and RLF timers and constants of the SCG configuration, to reconfigure PDCP for DRBs associated with the S-KgNB or SRB3, to reconfigure SDAP for DRBs associated with S-KgNB in NGEN-DC and NR-DC, to add/modify/release conditional PSCell change configuration or subsequent CPAC configuration, and to add/modify/release the LTM configuration associated with the SCG (only in NR-DC), provided that the (re-)configuration does not require any MN involvement, and to transmit RRC messages between the MN and the UE during fast MCG link recovery. In (NG)EN-DC and NR-DC, only measConfig, radioBearerConfig, conditionalReconfiguration, ltm-Config (only in NR-DC), bap-Config, iab-IP-AddressConfigurationList, otherConfig, appLayerMeasConfig and/or secondaryCellGroup are included in RRCReconfiguration received via SRB3, except when RRCReconfiguration is received within DLInformationTransferMRDC.
B3325: When a clause of 5.3.5 is executed due to an LTM cell switch execution (i.e., as specified in 5.3.5.18.6) or due to a conditional reconfiguration execution for subsequent CPAC (i.e., as specified in 5.3.5.13.8), every appearance of "the received" before RRCReconfiguration message, before a field name, or before an IE name, refers to the RRCReconfiguration message that the UE applies, as specified in 5.3.5.18.6, 5.3.5.13.8, or the field or IE in that RRCReconfiguration message.
B3326: 5.3.5.2Initiation
B3327: The Network may initiate the RRC reconfiguration procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED. The Network applies the procedure as follows:
B3328: -the establishment of RBs (other than SRB1, that is established during RRC connection establishment) is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3329: -the establishment of BH RLC Channels for IAB is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3330: -the configuration of NCR-Fwd and the configuration of NCR-RNTI is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3331: -the establishment of Uu Relay RLC channels and PC5 Relay RLC channels (other than SL-RLC0 and SL-RLC1) for L2 U2N Relay UE in case of single hop or for L2 Last U2N Relay UE is performed only when AS security has been activated, and the establishment of PC5 Relay RLC channels for L2 U2N Remote UE or for L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE (other than SL-RLC0 and SL-RLC1) is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3332: -the establishment of PC5 Relay RLC channels for L2 U2U Relay UE and L2 U2U Remote UE is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3333: -the addition of Secondary Cell Group and SCells is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3334: -the reconfigurationWithSync is included in secondaryCellGroup only when at least one RLC bearer or BH RLC channel is setup in SCG;
B3335: -the reconfigurationWithSync is included in masterCellGroup only when AS security has been activated, and SRB2 with at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, have been setup and not suspended;
B3336: -the conditionalReconfiguration for CPC is included only when at least one RLC bearer is setup in SCG;
B3337: -the conditionalReconfiguration for CHO, CPA, or subsequent CPAC is included only when AS security has been activated, and SRB2 with at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB, SRB2, are setup and not suspended;
B3338: -the addition of indirect path for MP is performed only when AS security has been activated;
B3339: -the ltm-Config for LTM on the MCG is included only when AS security has been activated, and SRB2 with at least one DRB are setup and not suspended;
B3340: -the ltm-Config or ltm-ConfigNRDC for LTM on the SCG is included only when at least one RLC bearer is setup in SCG.

B3805: 5>remove the entry with the matching measId from the measIdList within the VarMeasConfig;
B3806: 2>if reconfigurationWithSync was included in masterCellGroup or secondaryCellGroup:
B3807: 3>if the UE initiated transmission of a UEAssistanceInformation message for the corresponding cell group during the last 1 second, and the UE is still configured to provide the concerned UE assistance information for the corresponding cell group; or
B3808: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message is applied due to a conditional reconfiguration execution or an LTM cell switch procedure, and the UE is configured to provide UE assistance information for the corresponding cell group, and the UE has initiated transmission of a UEAssistanceInformation message for the corresponding cell group since it was configured to do so in accordance with 5.7.4.2:
B3809: 4>initiate transmission of a UEAssistanceInformation message for the corresponding cell group in accordance with clause 5.7.4.3 to provide the concerned UE assistance information;
B3810: 4>start or restart the prohibit timer (if exists) associated with the concerned UE assistance information with the timer value set to the value in corresponding configuration;
B3811: 4>start or restart the leave without response timer (if exists) with the timer value set to the value in the musim-LeaveAssistanceConfig or the wait timer (if exists) with the timer value set to the value in musim-CapabilityRestrictionConfig;
B3812: 3>if SIB12 is provided by the target PCell, and the UE initiated transmission of a SidelinkUEInformationNR message indicating a change of NR sidelink communication/discovery related parameters relevant in target PCell during the last 1 second preceding reception of the RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync in spCellConfig of an MCG; or
B3813: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message is applied due to a conditional reconfiguration execution and the UE is capable of NR sidelink communication/discovery and SIB12 is provided by the target PCell, and the UE has initiated transmission of a SidelinkUEInformationNR message since it was configured to do so in accordance with 5.8.3.2:
B3814: 4>initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message in accordance with 5.8.3.3;
B3815: 3>if any application layer measurement report container has been received from upper layers for which the successful transmission of the MeasurementReportAppLayer message or at least one segment of the message via SRB4 (if reconfigurationWithSync was included in masterCellGroup) or SRB5 (if reconfigurationWithSync was included in secondaryCellGroup) has not been confirmed by lower layers:
B3816: 4>if RRC segmentation was used for the MeasurementReportAppLayer message:
B3817: 5>if RRC segmentation is enabled based on the field rrc-SegAllowedSRB4 or rrc-SegAllowedSRB5 for the reportingSRB (or SRB4 if reportingSRB is not configured):
B3818: 6>re-submit all segments of the MeasurementReportAppLayer message to lower layers for transmission via the reportingSRB (or SRB4 if reportingSRB is not configured);
B3819: 5>else:
B3820: 6>discard all segments of the MeasurementReportAppLayer message;
B3821: 4>else:
B3822: 5>re-submit the MeasurementReportAppLayer message to lower layers for transmission via the reportingSRB (or SRB4 if reportingSRB is not configured);
B3823: 2>if reconfigurationWithSync was included in masterCellGroup and SRB4 is configured in the target cell:
B3824: 3>for each application layer measurement configuration in the UE:
B3825: 4>if the RRCReconfiguration message is applied due to a conditional reconfiguration execution, if transmissionOfSessionStartStop is set to true for the application layer measurement configuration and if the session status has changed since the UE was configured with the conditional reconfiguration:
B3826: 5>initiate transmission of a MeasurementReportAppLayer message including appLayerSessionStatus, via SRB4 for the application layer measurement in accordance with 5.7.16.2;
B3827: 2>if reconfigurationWithSync was included in masterCellGroup and the target cell provides SIB21 or provides SIB1 including nonServingCellMII:
B3828: 3>if the UE initiated transmission of an MBSInterestIndication message during the last 1 second preceding reception of this RRCReconfiguration message; or
B3829: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message is applied due to a conditional reconfiguration execution, and the UE has initiated transmission of an MBSInterestIndication message after having received this RRCReconfiguration message:
B3830: 4>initiate transmission of an MBSInterestIndication message in accordance with clause 5.9.4;
B3831: 2>the procedure ends.
B3832: NOTE 3:The UE is only required to acquire broadcasted SIB1 if the UE can acquire it without disrupting unicast or MBS multicast data reception, i.e. the broadcast and unicast/MBS multicast beams are quasi co-located.
B3833: NOTE 4: The UE sets the content of UEAssistanceInformation according to latest configuration (i.e. the configuration after applying the RRCReconfiguration message) and latest UE preference. The UE may include more than the concerned UE assistance information within the UEAssistanceInformation according to 5.7.4.2. Therefore, the content of UEAssistanceInformation message might not be the same as the content of the previous UEAssistanceInformation message.
B3834: 5.3.5.4Secondary cell group release
B3835: The UE shall:
B3836: 1>as a result of SCG release triggered by E-UTRA (i.e. (NG)EN-DC case) or NR (i.e. NR-DC case):
B3837: 2>reset SCG MAC, if configured;
B3838: 2>for each RLC bearer that is part of the SCG configuration:
B3839: 3>perform RLC bearer release procedure as specified in 5.3.5.5.3;
B3840: 2>for each BH RLC channel that is part of the SCG configuration:
B3841: 3>perform BH RLC channel release procedure as specified in 5.3.5.5.10;
B3842: 2>release the SCG configuration;
B3843: 2>for each application layer measurement configuration that is part of the SCG configuration:
B3844: 3>forward the measConfigAppLayerId and inform upper layers about the release of the application layer measurement configuration;
B3845: 3>release the application layer measurement configuration including its fields in the UE variables VarAppLayerIdleConfig and VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig, if stored;
B3846: 3>discard any application layer measurement reports which were not yet fully submitted to lower layers for transmission;
B3847: 3>consider itself not to be configured to send application layer measurement reports for the measConfigAppLayerId;
B3848: 2>discard any application layer measurement reports which were configured to be reported via SRB5 and which were not yet fully submitted to lower layers for transmission;
B3849: 2>remove all the entries within the SCG VarConditionalReconfig, if any;
B3850: 2>if SCG release was triggered by NR (i.e. NR-DC case):
B3851: 3>remove all the entries in the condReconfigList within the MCG VarConditionalReconfig for which subsequentCondReconfig is not present and the RRCReconfiguration within condRRCReconfig does not include the masterCellGroup with reconfigurationWithSync, if any;
B3852: 3>remove the servingSecurityCellSetId within the VarServingSecurityCellSetID, if any;
B3853: 3>for each entry in the condReconfigList within the MCG VarConditionalReconfig for which subsequentCondReconfig is present:
B3854: 4>remove the condExecutionCondSCG, if stored;
B3855: 2>else (i.e. EN-DC case):
B3856: 3>perform VarConditionalReconfiguration CPC removal as specified in TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.3.5.9.7;
B3857: 2>stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B3858: 2>stop timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B3859: 2>stop timer T304 for the corresponding SpCell, if running.
B3860: NOTE:Release of cell group means only release of the lower layer configuration of the cell group but the RadioBearerConfig may not be released.
B3861: 5.3.5.5Cell Group configuration
B3862: 5.3.5.5.1General
B3863: The network configures the UE with Master Cell Group (MCG), and zero or one Secondary Cell Group (SCG). In (NG)EN-DC, the MCG is configured as specified in TS 36.331 [10], and for NE-DC, the SCG is configured as specified in TS 36.331 [10]. The network provides the configuration parameters for a cell group in the CellGroupConfig IE.
B3864: The UE performs the following actions based on a received CellGroupConfig IE:
B3865: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the spCellConfig with reconfigurationWithSync:
B3866: 2>perform Reconfiguration with sync according to 5.3.5.5.2;
B3867: 2>resume all suspended radio bearers except the SRBs for the source cell group, and resume SCG transmission for all radio bearers, and resume BH RLC channels and resume SCG transmission for BH RLC channels for IAB-MT, if suspended;
B3868: NOTE 1:If the SCG is deactivated, resuming SCG transmission for all radio bearers does not imply that PDCP PDUs can be transmitted or received on SCG RLC bearers.
B3869: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the rlc-BearerToReleaseList or rlc-BearerToReleaseListExt:
B3870: 2>perform RLC bearer release as specified in 5.3.5.5.3;
B3871: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the rlc-BearerToAddModList:
B3872: 2>perform the RLC bearer addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.5.4;
B3873: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the mac-CellGroupConfig:
B3874: 2>configure the MAC entity of this cell group as specified in 5.3.5.5.5;
B3875: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the sCellToReleaseList:
B3876: 2>perform SCell release as specified in 5.3.5.5.8;
B3877: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the spCellConfig:
B3878: 2>configure the SpCell as specified in 5.3.5.5.7;
B3879: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the sCellToAddModList:
B3880: 2>perform SCell addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.5.9;
B3881: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList:
B3882: 2>perform BH RLC channel release as specified in 5.3.5.5.10;
B3883: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList:
B3884: 2>perform the BH RLC channel addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.5.11;
B3885: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the uu-RelayRLC-ChannelToReleaseList:
B3886: 2>perform Uu Relay RLC channel release as specified in 5.3.5.5.12;
B3887: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the uu-RelayRLC-ChannelToAddModList:
B3888: 2>perform the Uu Relay RLC channel addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.5.13;
B3889: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the ncr-FwdConfig:
B3890: 2>perform the NCR-Fwd configuration as specified in 5.3.5.5.14;
B3891: 1>if the CellGroupConfig contains the autonomousDenialParameters:
B3892: 2>consider itself to be allowed to deny any transmission in a particular UL slot if during the number of slots indicated by autonomousDenialValidity, preceding and including this particular slot, it autonomously denied fewer UL slots than indicated by autonomousDenialSlots within the same cell group;
B3893: NOTE 2:When counting the number of denied UL slots, the UE sums up the denied UL slots across all serving cells within the same cell group. When counting the number of slots indicated by autonomousDenialValidity, the UE sums up the UL slots across all serving cells within the same cell group.
B3894: NOTE 3:When multiple denied UL slots across all serving cells partially or fully overlap in the time domain, the number of denied UL slots across all serving cells is counted as one denied UL slot, based on the longest slot.
B3895: 5.3.5.5.2Reconfiguration with sync
B3896: The UE shall perform the following actions to execute a reconfiguration with sync.
B3897: 1>if the AS security is not activated, perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11 with the release cause 'other' upon which the procedure ends;
B3898: 1>stop timer T430 if running;
B3899: 1>if no DAPS bearer is configured:
B3900: 2>stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B3901: 1>if this procedure is executed for the MCG:
B3902: 2>if timer T316 is running;
B3903: 3>stop timer T316;
B3904: 3>if the UE supports RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure as specified in TS 38.306 [26]:
B3905: 4>set the elapsedTimeT316 in the VarRLF-Report to the value of the elapsed time of the timer T316;
B3906: 4>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B3907: 3>else:
B3908: 4>clear the information included in VarRLF-Report, if any;
B3909: 2>resume MCG transmission, if suspended.
B3910: 1>stop timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B3911: 1>if sl-PathSwitchConfig is included:
B3912: 2>apply the value of the newUE-Identity as the C-RNTI;
B3913: 2>if sl-IndirectPathMaintain is not included in reconfigurationWithSync:
B3914: 3>if the UE is L2 U2N remote UE at source side:
B3915: 4>indicate to upper layer to trigger PC5 unicast link release with the source L2 U2N Relay UE;
B3916: 3>consider the target L2 U2N Relay UE to be the one indicated by the targetRelayUE-Identity in the sl-PathSwitchConfig;
B3917: 3>start timer T420 for the corresponding target L2 U2N Relay UE with the timer value set to t420, as included in the sl-PathSwitchConfig;
B3918: 3>indicate to upper layer (to trigger the PC5 unicast link establishment) with the target L2 U2N Relay UE indicated by the targetRelayUE-Identity;
B3919: 3>apply the default configuration of SL-RLC1 as defined in 9.2.4 for SRB1;
B3920: 2>else:
B3921: 3>consider the connected L2 U2N Relay UE on the indirect path as the target L2 U2N relay UE, and maintain the PC5 connection with the L2 U2N Relay UE;
B3922: 1>else (sl-PathSwitchConfig is not included):
B3923: 2>if this procedure is executed for the MCG or if this procedure is executed for an SCG not indicated as deactivated in the E-UTRA or NR RRC message in which the RRCReconfiguration message is embedded:
B3924: 3>start timer T304 for the corresponding SpCell with the timer value set to t304, as included in the reconfigurationWithSync;
B3925: 2>if the frequencyInfoDL is included:
B3926: 3>consider the target SpCell to be one on the SSB frequency indicated by the frequencyInfoDL with a physical cell identity indicated by the physCellId;
B3927: 2>else:
B3928: 3>consider the target SpCell to be one on the SSB frequency of the source SpCell with a physical cell identity indicated by the physCellId;
B3929: 2>if this procedure is performed due to an LTM cell switch execution:
B3930: 3>perform LTM cell switch execution conditions modification as specified in 5.3.5.18.1a;
B3931: 3>start synchronising to the DL of the indicated LTM candidate cell, if no DL synchronization for the indicated LTM candidate cell has been already acquired;
B3932: 2>else:
B3933: 3>if the target SpCell is different from current SpCell:
B3934: 4>if VarLTM-ExecutionConditionList is not empty:
B3935: 5>perform LTM cell switch execution conditions modification as specified in 5.3.5.18.1a;
B3936: 3>start synchronising to the DL of the target SpCell;
B3937: 2>apply the specified BCCH configuration defined in 9.1.1.1 for the target SpCell;
B3938: 2>acquire the MIB of the target SpCell, which is scheduled as specified in TS 38.213 [13];
B3939: 2>if NTN-Config is configured for the target cell:
B3940: 3>start timer T430 with the timer value set to ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime, according to the target cell NTN-Config;
B3941: NOTE 1:The UE should perform the reconfiguration with sync as soon as possible following the reception of the RRC message triggering the reconfiguration with sync, which could be before confirming successful reception (HARQ and ARQ) of this message.
B3942: NOTE 2:The UE may omit reading the MIB if the UE already has the required timing information, or the timing information is not needed for random access, or if not needed for RACH-less initial UL transmission.
B3943: NOTE 2a:A UE with DAPS bearer does not monitor for system information updates in the source PCell.
B3944: 2>If any DAPS bearer is configured:
B3945: 3>create a MAC entity for the target cell group with the same configuration as the MAC entity for the source cell group;
B3946: 3>for each DAPS bearer:
B3947: 4>establish an RLC entity or entities for the target cell group, with the same configurations as for the source cell group;
B3948: 4>establish the logical channel for the target cell group, with the same configurations as for the source cell group;
B3949: NOTE 2b:In order to understand if a DAPS bearer is configured, the UE needs to check the presence of the field daps-Config within the RadioBearerConfig IE received in radioBearerConfig or radioBearerConfig2.
B3950: 3>for each SRB:
B3951: 4>establish an RLC entity for the target cell group, with the same configurations as for the source cell group;
B3952: 4>establish the logical channel for the target cell group, with the same configurations as for the source cell group;
B3953: 3>suspend SRBs for the source cell group;
B3954: NOTE 3:Void
B3955: 3>apply the value of the newUE-Identity as the C-RNTI in the target cell group;
B3956: 3>configure lower layers for the target SpCell in accordance with the received spCellConfigCommon;
B3957: 3>configure lower layers for the target SpCell in accordance with any additional fields, not covered in the previous, if included in the received reconfigurationWithSync.
B3958: 2>else:
B3959: 3>reset the MAC entity of this cell group;
B3960: 3>consider the SCell(s) of this cell group, if configured, that are not included in the SCellToAddModList in the RRCReconfiguration message, to be in deactivated state;
B3961: 3>apply the value of the newUE-Identity as the C-RNTI for this cell group;
B3962: 3>configure lower layers in accordance with the received spCellConfigCommon;
B3963: 3>if rach-LessHO is included:
B3964: 4>configure lower layers in accordance with rach-LessHO for the target SpCell;
B3965: 3>configure lower layers in accordance with any additional fields, not covered in the previous, if included in the received reconfigurationWithSync.
B3966: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2N Remote UE at the source side:
B3967: 3>if the sl-IndirectPathMaintain is not included in reconfigurationWithSync:
B3968: 4>indicate upper layer to trigger PC5 unicast link release.
B3969: Upon L2 U2N Relay UE receiving reconfigurationWithSync, it either indicates to upper layers (to trigger PC5 unicast link release with the connected L2 U2N Remote UE(s) or with its child UE(s)) or sends NotificationMessageSidelink message to the connected L2 U2N Remote UE(s) or to the child UE(s) in accordance with 5.8.9.10.
B3970: NOTE 4:The MP direct path release is realized by direct-to-indirect path switch procedure (i.e. sl-PathSwitchConfig and sl-indirectPathMaintain included in RRCReconfiguration message), where MP is configured in source side.
B3971: 5.3.5.5.3RLC bearer release
B3972: The UE shall:
B3973: 1>for each logicalChannelIdentity/LogicalChannelIdentityExt value included in the rlc-BearerToReleaseList/rlc-BearerToReleaseListExt that is part of the current UE configuration within the same cell group (LCH release); or
B3974: 1>for each logicalChannelIdentity value that is to be released as the result of an SCG release according to 5.3.5.4; or
B3975: 1>for each logicalChannelIdentity value that is to be released as the result of LTM cell switch execution according to 5.3.5.18.6:
B3976: 2>release the RLC entity or entities as specified in TS 38.322 [4], clause 5.1.3;
B3977: 2>release the corresponding logical channel.
B3978: 5.3.5.5.4RLC bearer addition/modification
B3979: For each RLC-BearerConfig received in the rlc-BearerToAddModList IE the UE shall:
B3980: 1>if the UE's current configuration contains an RLC bearer with the received logicalChannelIdentity/LogicalChannelIdentityExt within the same cell group:
B3981: 2>if the RLC bearer is associated with an DAPS bearer, or
B3982: 2>if any DAPS bearer is configured and the RLC bearer is associated with an SRB:
B3983: 3>reconfigure the RLC entity or entities for the target cell group in accordance with the received rlc-Config;
B3984: 3>reconfigure the logical channel for the target cell group in accordance with the received mac-LogicalChannelConfig;
B3985: 2>else:
B3986: 3>if reestablishRLC is received:
B3987: 4>re-establish the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 [4];
B3988: 3>reconfigure the RLC entity or entities in accordance with the received rlc-Config;
B3989: 3>reconfigure the logical channel in accordance with the received mac-LogicalChannelConfig;
B3990: 3>if servedMBS-RadioBearer is received:
B3991: 4>associate this logical channel with the PDCP entity identified by servedMBS-RadioBearer;
B3992: NOTE 1:For DRB and SRB, the network does not re-associate an already configured logical channel with another radio bearer. Hence, servedRadioBearer is not present in this case. For MRB, the network does not re-associate an already configured logical channel with DRB or SRB or another MRB (i.e. MRB with another PDCP entity). Hence multicastRLC-BearerConfig is not present in this case. If a radio bearer is released and another is added with the same radio bearer identity, it is considered as a new (different) radio bearer. Hence, the network also releases the RLC bearer(s) associated with the released radio bearer.
B3993: NOTE 2:In DAPS handover, the UE may perform RLC entity re-establishment (if reestablishRLC is set) for an RLC bearer associated with a non-DAPS bearer when indication of successful completion of random access towards target cell is received from lower layers as specified in TS 38.321 [3].
B3994: 1>else (a logical channel with the given logicalChannelIdentity/LogicalChannelIdentityExt is not configured within the same cell group, including the case when full configuration option is used):
B3995: 2>if the servedRadioBearer associates the logical channel with an SRB and rlc-Config is not included:
B3996: 3>establish an RLC entity in accordance with the default configuration defined in 9.2 for the corresponding SRB;
B3997: 2>else:
B3998: 3>establish an RLC entity in accordance with the received rlc-Config;
B3999: 2>if the servedRadioBearer associates the logical channel with an SRB and if mac-LogicalChannelConfig is not included:
B4000: 3>configure this MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance to the default configuration defined in 9.2 for the corresponding SRB;
B4001: 2>else:
B4002: 3>configure this MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance to the received mac-LogicalChannelConfig;
B4003: 2>associate this logical channel with the PDCP entity identified by servedRadioBearer or servedMBS-RadioBearer.
B4004: 5.3.5.5.5MAC entity configuration
B4005: The UE shall:
B4006: 1>if SCG MAC is not part of the current UE configuration (i.e. SCG establishment):
B4007: 2>create an SCG MAC entity;
B4008: 1>if any DAPS bearer is configured:
B4009: 2>reconfigure the MAC main configuration for the target cell group in accordance with the received mac-CellGroupConfig excluding tag-ToReleaseList and tag-ToAddModList;
B4010: 1>else:
B4011: 2>reconfigure the MAC main configuration of the cell group in accordance with the received mac-CellGroupConfig excluding tag-ToReleaseList and tag-ToAddModList;
B4012: 1>if the received mac-CellGroupConfig includes the tag-ToReleaseList:
B4013: 2>for each TAG-Id value included in the tag-ToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration:
B4014: 3>release the TAG indicated by TAG-Id;
B4015: 1>if the received mac-CellGroupConfig includes the tag-ToAddModList:
B4016: 2>for each tag-Id value included in tag-ToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration (TAG addition):
B4017: 3>add the TAG, corresponding to the tag-Id, in accordance with the received timeAlignmentTimer;
B4018: 2>for each tag-Id value included in tag-ToAddModList that is part of the current UE configuration (TAG modification):
B4019: 3>reconfigure the TAG, corresponding to the tag-Id, in accordance with the received timeAlignmentTimer.

B4036: The UE shall:

B4045: 2>else if rlf-TimersAndConstants is not configured for this cell group:
B4046: 3>if any DAPS bearer is configured:
B4047: 4>use values for timers T301, T310, T311 and constants N310, N311 for the target cell group, as included in ue-TimersAndConstants received in SIB1;
B4048: 3>else
B4049: 4>use values for timers T301, T310, T311 and constants N310, N311, as included in ue-TimersAndConstants received in SIB1;
B4050: 2>if the SpCellConfig contains spCellConfigDedicated:
B4051: 3>configure the SpCell in accordance with the spCellConfigDedicated;
B4052: NOTE:CSI report configurations including reportConfigType set to periodic and configurationForBM-PredictionAndDataCollection with reportQuantity-r19 set to p-CRI or p-SSB-Index or p-CRI-RSRP or p-SSB-Index-RSRP are submitted to lower layers only if they are applicable and included in the RRCReconfiguration message or RRCResume message that invoked the procedure.
B4053: 3>consider the bandwidth part indicated in firstActiveUplinkBWP-Id, if included in the spCellConfigDedicated, to be the active uplink bandwidth part;
B4054: 3>if the firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id is included in the spCellConfigDedicated:
B4055: 4>if the SpCellConfig is included in an RRCReconfiguration message contained in an NR or E-UTRA RRC message indicating that the SCG is deactivated:
B4056: 5>consider the bandwidth part indicated in firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id to be the bandwidth part for Radio Link Monitoring, Beam Failure Detection and measurements;
B4057: 4>else:
B4058: 5>consider the bandwith part indicated in firstActiveDownlinkBWP-Id to be the active downlink bandwidth part;
B4059: 3>if csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList is included within csi-MeasConfig in spCellConfigDedicated:
B4060: 4>perform logging of measurements for network-side data collection as specified in 5.5c;
B4061: 3>if any of the reference signal(s) that are used for radio link monitoring are reconfigured by the received spCellConfigDedicated:
B4062: 4>stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B4063: 4>stop timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell, if running;
B4064: 4>reset the counters N310 and N311.
B4065: 1>if the SpCellConfig contains the lowMobilityEvaluationConnected:

B4305: NOTE 1:Void.
B4306: NOTE 2:When determining whether a drb-Identity value is part of the current UE configuration, the UE does not distinguish which RadioBearerConfig and DRB-ToAddModList that DRB was originally configured in. To re-associate a DRB with a different key (KeNB to S-KgNB, KgNB to S-KeNB, KgNB to S-KgNB, or vice versa), the network provides the drb-Identity value in the (target) drb-ToAddModList and sets the reestablishPDCP flag. The network does not list the drb-Identity in the (source) drb-ToReleaseList.
B4307: NOTE 3:When setting the reestablishPDCP flag for a radio bearer, the network ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity. It does that e.g. by triggering a reconfiguration with sync of the cell group hosting the old RLC entity or by releasing the old RLC entity.
B4308: NOTE 4:In this specification, UE configuration refers to the parameters configured by NR RRC unless otherwise stated.
B4309: NOTE 5: Ciphering and integrity protection can be enabled or disabled for a DRB. The enabling/disabling of ciphering or integrity protection can be changed only by releasing and adding the DRB.
B4310: NOTE 6:In DAPS handover, the UE may perform PDCP entity re-establishment (if reestablishPDCP is set) or the PDCP data recovery (if recoverPDCP is set) for a non-DAPS bearer when indication of successful completion of random access towards target cell is received from lower layers as specified in TS 38.321 [3]. In this case, the UE suspends data transmission and reception for all non-DAPS bearers in the source MCG for duration of the DAPS handover.

B4312: The UE shall:
B4313: 1>for each mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration; or
B4314: 1>for each mrb-Identity value that is to be released as the result of full configuration according to 5.3.5.11:
B4315: 2>release the PDCP entity and the mrb-Identity;
B4316: NOTE 1:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the mrb-ToReleaseList includes any mrb-Identity value that is not part of the current UE configuration.
B4317: NOTE 2:Whether or not the RLC and MAC entities associated with this PDCP entity are reset or released is determined by the CellGroupConfig.
B4318: 5.3.5.6.7Multicast MRB addition/modification
B4319: The UE shall for each element in the order of entry in the list mrb-ToAddModList:
B4320: 1>if mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToAddModList is part of the UE configuration:
B4321: 2>if mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToAddModList for which mrb-IdentityNew is included (i.e., multicast MRB ID change):
B4322: 3>update the mrb-Identity to the value mrb-IdentityNew;
B4323: 2>if the reestablishPDCP is set:
B4324: 3>if drb-ContinueROHC is included in pdcp-Config:
B4325: 4>indicate to lower layer that drb-ContinueROHC is configured;
B4326: 3>if drb-ContinueEHC-DL is included in pdcp-Config:
B4327: 4>indicate to lower layer that drb-ContinueEHC-DL is configured;
B4328: 3>re-establish the PDCP entity of this multicast MRB as specified in TS 38.323 [5], clause 5.1.2;
B4329: 2>else, if the recoverPDCP is set:
B4330: 3>trigger the PDCP entity of this MRB to perform data recovery as specified in TS 38.323 [5];
B4331: 2>if the pdcp-Config is included:
B4332: 3>reconfigure the PDCP entity in accordance with the received pdcp-Config;
B4333: 1>else if mrb-Identity value included in the mrb-ToAddModList is not part of the UE configuration (i.e., multicast MRB establishment including the case when full configuration option is used):
B4334: 2>establish a PDCP entity and configure it in accordance with the received pdcp-Config;
B4335: 2>associate the established multicast MRB with the corresponding mbs-SessionId;
B4336: 2>if an SDAP entity with the received mbs-SessionId does not exist:
B4337: 3>establish an SDAP entity as specified in TS 37.324 [24] clause 5.1.1;
B4338: 3>if an SDAP entity with the received mbs-SessionId did not exist prior to receiving this reconfiguration:
B4339: 4>indicate the establishment of the user plane resources for the mbs-SessionId to upper layers.
B4340: NOTE 1:When setting the reestablishPDCP flag for a radio bearer, the network ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity. The network does that e.g. by triggering a reconfiguration with sync of the cell group hosting the old RLC entity or by releasing the old RLC entity.
B4341: NOTE 2:In this specification, UE configuration refers to the parameters configured by NR RRC unless otherwise stated.
B4342: NOTE 3:When updating the mrb-Identity, the network ensures new MRBs are listed at the end of the mrb-ToAddModList if they have the same MRB ID as in the existing UE configuration.
B4343: 5.3.5.7AS Security key update
B4344: The UE shall:
B4345: 1>if UE is connected to E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC:
B4346: 2>upon reception of sk-Counter as specified in TS 36.331 [10]:
B4347: 3>update the S-KgNB key based on the KeNB key and using the received sk-Counter value, as specified in TS 33.401 [30] for EN-DC, or TS 33.501 [11] for NGEN-DC;
B4348: 3>derive the KRRCenc and KUPenc keys as specified in TS 33.401 [30] for EN-DC, or TS 33.501 [11] for NGEN-DC;
B4349: 3>derive the KRRCint and KUPint keys as specified in TS 33.401 [30] for EN-DC or TS 33.501 [11] for NGEN-DC.
B4350: 1>else if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the masterKeyUpdate:
B4351: 2>if the nas-Container is included in the received masterKeyUpdate:
B4352: 3>forward the nas-Container to the upper layers;
B4353: 2>if the keySetChangeIndicator is set to true:
B4354: 3>derive or update the KgNB key based on the KAMF key, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4355: 2>else:
B4356: 3>derive or update the KgNB key based on the current KgNB key or the NH, using the nextHopChainingCount value indicated in the received masterKeyUpdate, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4357: 2>store the nextHopChainingCount value;
B4358: 2>derive the keys associated with the KgNB key as follows:
B4359: 3>if the securityAlgorithmConfig is included in SecurityConfig:
B4360: 4>derive the KRRCenc and KUPenc keys associated with the cipheringAlgorithm indicated in the securityAlgorithmConfig, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4361: 4>derive the KRRCint and KUPint keys associated with the integrityProtAlgorithm indicated in the securityAlgorithmConfig, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4362: 3>else:
B4363: 4>derive the KRRCenc and KUPenc keys associated with the current cipheringAlgorithm, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4364: 4>derive the KRRCint and KUPint keys associated with the current integrityProtAlgorithm, as specified in TS 33.501 [11].
B4365: NOTE 1:Ciphering and integrity protection are optional to configure for the DRBs.
B4366: 1>else if this procedure was initiated due to an LTM cell switch execution procedure which requires updating the master key, as specified in section 5.3.5.18.6:
B4367: 2>derive or update the KgNB key based on the current KgNB key or the NH, using the NCC value indicated by lower layer, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4368: 2>replace the nextHopChainingCount with the NCC value indicated by lower layers;
B4369: 2>derive the keys associated with the KgNB key as follows:
B4370: 3>derive the KRRCenc and KUpenc keys associated with the current cipheringAlgorithm, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4371: 3>derive the KRRCint and KUpint keys associated with the current integrityProtAlgorithm, as specified in TS 33.501 [11].
B4372: 1>else if this procedure was initiated due to reception of the sk-Counter (UE is in NE-DC, or NR-DC, or is configured with SN terminated bearer(s)) or if the procedure was initiated due to selection of an sk-Counter as specified in clause 5.3.5.13.8 or clause 5.3.5.18.6 (UE is in NR-DC):
B4373: 2>derive or update the secondary key (S-KgNB or S-KeNB) based on the KgNB key and using the received or selected sk-Counter value, as specified in TS 33.501 [11];
B4374: 2>derive the KRRCenc key and the KUPenc key as specified in TS 33.501 [11] using the ciphering algorithms indicated in the RadioBearerConfig associated with the secondary key (S-KgNB or S-KeNB) as indicated by keyToUse;
B4375: 2>derive the KRRCint key and the KUPint key as specified in TS 33.501 [11] using the integrity protection algorithms indicated in the RadioBearerConfig associated with the secondary key (S-KgNB or S-KeNB) as indicated by keyToUse;
B4376: NOTE 2:If the UE has no radio bearer configured with keyToUse set to secondary and receives the sk-Counter or an sk-Counter is selected for subsequent CPAC or LTM without any RadioBearerConfig with keyToUse set to secondary, the UE does not consider it as an invalid reconfiguration.

B4380: NOTE 00:The UE behaviour specified in this clause does not apply to the following, and the UE ignores, i.e. does not take an action on and does not store, the fields that it does not support or does not comprehend:-The fields in ServingCellConfigCommon that are defined in Rel-16 and later.-The fields of searchSpaceMCCH and searchSpaceMTCH in PDCCH-ConfigCommon that are defined in Rel-17 and later.

B4400: NOTE 0:This case does not apply in NE-DC.

B4402: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message was received as part of ltm-Config:

B4411: NOTE 0a:The compliance also covers the SCG configuration carried within octet strings e.g. field mrdc-SecondaryCellGroupConfig. I.e. the failure behaviour defined also applies in case the UE cannot comply with the embedded SCG configuration or with the combination of (parts of) the MCG and SCG configurations.

B4413: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message was received as part of ConditionalReconfiguration; or,
B4414: 3>if the RRCReconfiguration message was received as part of ltm-Config or ltm-ConfigNRDC:

B4428: NOTE 2:If the UE is unable to comply with part of the configuration, it does not apply any part of the configuration, i.e. there is no partial success/failure, except for the MUSIM case (i.e. the UE is configured to provide MUSIM assistance information for temporary capability restriction and is unable to apply (part of) the configuration resulting from RRCReconfiguration message due to UE temporary capability restriction for MUSIM operation). If UE does not perform RRC reconfiguration failure in this case, UE will provide MUSIM assistance information for temporary capability restriction as specified in 5.7.4 and still considers the configuration resulting from RRCReconfiguration message as the current configuration and baseline for delta configuration for future reconfigurations.

B4809: 5.3.5.13Conditional Reconfiguration
B4810: 5.3.5.13.1General
B4811: The network configures the UE with one or more candidate target SpCells in the conditional reconfiguration. The UE evaluates the condition of each configured candidate target SpCell. The UE applies the conditional reconfiguration associated with one of the target SpCells which fulfils associated execution condition.
B4812: The network can also configure the UE with one or more candidate target PCells associated with one or more candidate target PSCells. The UE evaluates the conditions for the candidate target PCells and the associated candidate target PSCells in parallel and applies a target configuration that include PCell and PSCell for which the associated execution conditions are fulfilled. If there are multiple candidate PSCells associated with one candidate target PCell, the network provides multiple conditional configurations for the same candidate target PCell, i.e., each configuration contains one MCG configuration (for the same candidate target PCell) and one SCG configuration (for one of the multiple associated candidate PSCells). For this case, the network may also provide a complementary CHO only configuration, i.e., there is execution condition only for candidate PCell.
B4813: The network provides the configuration parameters for the target SpCell(s) in the condRRCReconfig.
B4814: In NR-DC, the UE may receive two independent conditionalReconfiguration:
B4815: -a conditionalReconfiguration associated with MCG, that is included in the RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1; and
B4816: -a conditionalReconfiguration, associated with SCG, that is included in the RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB3, or, alternatively, included within a RRCReconfiguration message embedded in a RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1.
B4817: In this case:
B4818: -the UE maintains two independent VarConditionalReconfig, one associated with each conditionalReconfiguration;
B4819: -the UE independently performs all the procedures in clause 5.3.5.13 for each conditionalReconfiguration and the associated VarConditionalReconfig, unless explicitly stated otherwise;
B4820: -the UE performs the procedures in clause 5.5 for the VarConditionalReconfig associated with the same cell group like the measConfig.
B4821: In EN-DC, the VarConditionalReconfig is associated with the SCG.
B4822: In NE-DC and when no SCG is configured, the VarConditionalReconfig is associated with the MCG.
B4823: The UE performs the following actions based on a received ConditionalReconfiguration IE:
B4824: 1>if the ConditionalReconfiguration contains the condReconfigToRemoveList:
B4825: 2>perform conditional reconfiguration removal procedure as specified in 5.3.5.13.2;
B4826: 1>if the ConditionalReconfiguration contains the condReconfigToAddModList:
B4827: 2>perform conditional reconfiguration addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.13.3;
B4828: 1>if the ConditionalReconfiguration contains the scpac-ReferenceConfiguration:
B4829: 2>perform subsequent CPAC reference configuration addition/removal as specified in 5.3.5.13.6;
B4830: 1>if the ConditionalReconfiguration contains the sk-CounterConfiguration:
B4831: 2>perform sk-CounterList addition/modification/removal as specified in 5.3.5.13.7;
B4832: 1>if the ConditionalReconfiguration contains the servingSecurityCellSetId:
B4833: 2>if the current VarServingSecurityCellSetID includes servingSecurityCellSetId:
B4834: 3>replace the servingSecurityCellSetId value within VarServingSecurityCellSetID with the received servingSecurityCellSetID;
B4835: 2>else:
B4836: 3>store the received servingSecurityCellSetId within VarServingSecurityCellSetID.
B4837: 5.3.5.13.2Conditional reconfiguration removal
B4838: The UE shall:
B4839: 1>for each condReconfigId value included in the condReconfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE conditional reconfiguration in VarConditionalReconfig:
B4840: 2>remove the entry with the matching condReconfigId from the VarConditionalReconfig;
B4841: NOTE 1:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the condReconfigToRemoveList includes any condReconfigId value that is not part of the current UE configuration.
B4842: NOTE 2:Void.
B4843: 5.3.5.13.3Conditional reconfiguration addition/modification
B4844: For each condReconfigId received in the condReconfigToAddModList IE the UE shall:
B4845: 1>if an entry with the matching condReconfigId exists in the condReconfigToAddModList within the VarConditionalReconfig:
B4846: 2>if the entry in condReconfigToAddModList includes an condExecutionCond, condExecutionCondSCG, or condExecutionCondPSCell;
B4847: 3>replace condExecutionCond, condExecutionCondSCG, or condExecutionCondPSCell within the VarConditionalReconfig with the value received for this condReconfigId;
B4848: 2>if the entry in condReconfigToAddModList includes subsequentCondReconfig containing condExecutionCondToAddModList:
B4849: 3>for each condReconfigId received in condExecutionCondToAddModList:
B4850: 4>if an entry with the matching condReconfigId exists in the condExecutionCondToAddModList within VarConditionalReconfig;
B4851: 5>replace the entry in condExecutionCondToAddModList within VarConditionalReconfig with the value received for this condReconfigId;
B4852: 4>else:
B4853: 5>add a new entry in condExecutionCondToAddModList within VarConditionalReconfig with the value received for this condReconfigId;
B4854: 2>if the entry in condReconfigToAddModList includes subsequentCondReconfig containing condExecutionCondToReleaseList:
B4855: 3>for each condReconfigId received in condExecutionCondToReleaseList that is part of current stored condExecutionCondToAddModList within VarConditionalReconfig:
B4856: 4>remove the entry in condExecutionCondToAddModList within VarConditionalReconfig with the value received for this condReconfigId;
B4857: NOTE 1:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the condExecutionCondToReleaseList includes any condReconfigId value that is not part of the current UE configuration.

B5060: 5.3.5.13aSCG activation
B5061: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B5062: 1>if the UE is configured with an SCG after receiving the message for which this procedure is initiated:
B5063: 2>if the UE was configured with a deactivated SCG before receiving the message for which this procedure is initiated:

B5065: 3>resume performing radio link monitoring on the SCG, if previously stopped;
B5066: 3>indicate to lower layers to resume beam failure detection on the PSCell, if previously stopped;
B5067: 3>indicate to lower layers that the SCG is activated.
B5068: 5.3.5.13bSCG deactivation
B5069: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B5070: 1>consider the SCG to be deactivated;
B5071: 1>indicate to lower layers that the SCG is deactivated;
B5072: 1>if bfd-and-RLM is configured to true:
B5073: 2>perform radio link monitoring on the SCG;
B5074: 2>indicate to lower layers to perform beam failure detection on the PSCell;
B5075: 1>else:
B5076: 2>stop radio link monitoring on the SCG;
B5077: 2>indicate to lower layers to stop beam failure detection on the PSCell;
B5078: 2>stop timer T310 for this cell group, if running;
B5079: 2>stop timer T312 for this cell group, if running;
B5080: 2>reset the counters N310 and N311;
B5081: 1>if the UE was in RRC_CONNECTED and the SCG was activated before receiving the message for which this procedure is initiated:
B5082: 2>if SRB3 was configured before the reception of the RRCReconfiguration or of the RRCConnectionReconfiguration and SRB3 is not to be released according to any RadioBearerConfig included in the RRCReconfiguration or in the RRCConnectionReconfiguration as specified in TS 36.331[10]:
B5083: 3>trigger the PDCP entity of SRB3 to perform SDU discard as specified in TS 38.323 [5];
B5084: 3>re-establish the RLC entity of SRB3 as specified in TS 38.322 [4].
B5085: 5.3.5.13b1SCG activation without SN message
B5086: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B5087: 1>if the SCG was deactivated before the reception of the RRCReconfiguration message or the E-UTRA RRCConnectionReconfiguration message for which the procedure invoking this clause is executed:
B5088: 2>consider the SCG to be activated;
B5089: 2>indicate to lower layers that the SCG is activated;
B5090: 2>resume performing radio link monitoring on the SCG, if previously stopped;
B5091: 2>indicate to lower layers to resume beam failure detection on the PSCell, if previously stopped;
B5092: 2>if bfd-and-RLM was not configured to true before the reception of the RRCReconfiguration message or the E-UTRA RRCConnectionReconfiguration message for which the procedure invoking this clause is executed; or
B5093: 2>if lower layers indicate that a Random Access procedure is needed for SCG activation:
B5094: 3>initiate the Random Access procedure on the PSCell, as specified in TS 38.321 [3].
B5095: 5.3.5.13cFR2 UL gap configuration
B5096: The UE shall:
B5097: 1>if ul-GapFR2-Config is set to setup:
B5098: 2>if an FR2 UL gap configuration is already setup, release the FR2 UL gap configuration;
B5099: 2>setup the FR2 UL gap configuration indicated by the ul-GapFR2-Config in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B5100: SFN mod T = FLOOR (gapOffset/10);
B5101: if the UGRP is larger than 5ms:
B5102: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B5103: else:
B5104: subframe = gapOffset or (gapOffset +5);
B5105: with T = CEIL(UGRP/10).
B5106: 1>else if ul-GapFR2-Config is set to release:
B5107: 2>release the FR2 UL gap configuration.
B5108: NOTE 1:For ul-GapFR2-Config configuration with synchronous CA, the SFN and subframe of a serving cell on FR2 frequency is used in the gap calculation. For ul-GapFR2-Config configuration with asynchronous CA, the SFN and subframe of a serving cell on FR2 frequency indicated by the refFR2-ServCellAsyncCA in ul-GapFR2-Config is used in the gap calculation.
B5109: 5.3.5.13dApplication layer measurement configuration
B5110: The UE shall:
B5111: 1>if measConfigAppLayerToReleaseList is included in appLayerMeasConfig within RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume:
B5112: 2>for each measConfigAppLayerId value included in the measConfigAppLayerToReleaseList:
B5113: 3>forward the measConfigAppLayerId and inform upper layers about the release of the application layer measurement configuration;
B5114: 3>discard any application layer measurement reports received from upper layers;
B5115: 3>release the application layer measurement configuration including its fields in the UE variables VarAppLayerIdleConfig and VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig, if stored;
B5116: 3>consider itself not to be configured to send application layer measurement reports for the measConfigAppLayerId.
B5117: 1>if measConfigAppLayerToAddModList is included in appLayerMeasConfig within RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume:
B5118: 2>for each measConfigAppLayerId value included in the measConfigAppLayerToAddModList:
B5119: 3>if measConfigAppLayerContainer is included for the corresponding MeasConfigAppLayer configuration:
B5120: 4>forward the measConfigAppLayerContainer, the measConfigAppLayerId and the serviceType to upper layers considering the serviceType;
B5121: 3>consider itself to be configured to send application layer measurement report for the measConfigAppLayerId in accordance with 5.7.16;
B5122: 3>forward the transmissionOfSessionStartStop, if configured, and measConfigAppLayerId to upper layers considering the serviceType;
B5123: 3>if ran-VisibleParameters is set to setup:
B5124: 4>forward the measConfigAppLayerId, the ran-VisiblePeriodicity, if configured, the numberOfBufferLevelEntries, if configured, and the reportPlayoutDelayForMediaStartup, if configured, to upper layers considering the serviceType;
B5125: 3>else if ran-VisibleParameters is set to release:
B5126: 4>forward the measConfigAppLayerId and inform upper layers about the release of the RAN visible application layer measurement configuration;
B5127: 4>discard any RAN visible application layer measurement reports received from upper layers;
B5128: 3>if pauseReporting is set to true:
B5129: 4>if at least one segment, but not all segments, of a segmented MeasurementReportAppLayer message containing an application layer measurement report associated with the measConfigAppLayerId has been submitted to lower layers for transmission:
B5130: 5>submit the remaining segments of the MeasurementReportAppLayer message to lower layers for transmission;
B5131: 4>suspend submitting application layer measurement report containers to lower layers for the application layer measurement configuration associated with the measConfigAppLayerId;
B5132: 4>store any previously or subsequently received application layer measurement report containers associated with the measConfigAppLayerId for which the successful transmission of the message or at least one segment of the message has not been confirmed by lower layers;
B5133: 4>if the memory reserved for storing application layer measurement report containers becomes full while the reporting is paused:
B5134: 5>if the reports are associated with a configuration including appLayerMeasPriority:
B5135: 6>discard reports in priority order where reports with the lowest priority are discarded first, and among reports with equal associated priority, discard reports in the order they were received, where older reports are discarded first;
B5136: 5>else:
B5137: 6>discard reports in the order they were received, where older reports are discarded first;
B5138: 3>else if pauseReporting is set to false and if transmission of application layer measurement report containers has previously been suspended for the application layer measurement configuration associated with the measConfigAppLayerId:
B5139: 4>submit stored application layer measurement report containers to lower layers, if any, for the application layer measurements configuration associated with the measConfigAppLayerId;
B5140: 4>resume submitting application layer measurement report containers to lower layers for the application layer measurement configuration associated with the measConfigAppLayerId;
B5141: 3>if appLayerIdleInactiveConfig is set to setup:
B5142: 4>store the received qoe-Reference, measConfigAppLayerId, serviceType, qoe-MeasurementType, qoe-AreaScope, mce-Id, availableRAN-VisibleMetrics and appLayerMeasPriority (if included) in VarAppLayerIdleConfig;
B5143: 4>if the qoe-AreaScope includes plmn-IdentityList:
B5144: 5>set plmn-IdentityList in VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig to include the RPLMN as well as the PLMNs included in plmn-IdentityList;
B5145: 4>else:
B5146: 5>set plmn-IdentityList in VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig to include the RPLMN;
B5147: 3>else if appLayerIdleInactiveConfig is set to release:
B5148: 4>release appLayerIdleInactiveConfig.
B5149: NOTE 1:The UE may discard reports when the memory reserved for storing application layer measurement report containers becomes full. If no or equal appLayerMeasPriority is configured, older reports are discarded first.
B5150: NOTE 2:The transmission of RAN visible application layer measurement reports and appLayerSessionStatus is not paused when pauseReporting is set to true.
B5151: NOTE 3:The UE may discard an application layer measurement configuration and associated unsent reports after 48 hours in RRC_IDLE. The time duration stops incrementing and is reset to zero if the UE is transferred to RRC_CONNECTED.
B5152: NOTE 4:Release of a previously configured value in ran-VisibleParameters is needed (independently of its RRC Need code) before a new value is forwarded to upper layers.

B5320: 5.3.5.17MP configuration
B5321: 5.3.5.17.1Introduction
B5322: In case of MP, a MP remote UE is configured with one direct path (i.e. MCG) and one indirect path. The MP remote UE connects to network on the direct path using NR Uu, and connects to network on the indirect path via a MP relay UE.
B5323: On indirect path, for the hop between the MP remote UE and the MP relay UE, when the MP remote UE connects to a L2 U2N Relay UE, i.e. the MP remote UE is acting as a L2 U2N Remote UE, the network provides the configuration of SL indirect path to the MP remote UE and the L2 U2N Relay UE as specified in 5.3.5.17.2; when the MP remote UE connects to one or more N3C relay UE(s) using non-3GPP connection, the network provides the configuration of N3C indirect path to the MP remote UE and the N3C relay UE as specified in 5.3.5.17.3.
B5324: 5.3.5.17.2Configuration of SL indirect path
B5325: 5.3.5.17.2.1General
B5326: For SL indirect path:
B5327: -the L2 U2N Remote UE is provided with sidelink dedicated configuration as specified in 5.3.5.14, L2 U2N Remote UE configuration as specified in 5.3.5.16, and SL indirect path specific configuration as specified in 5.3.5.17.2.2;
B5328: -the L2 U2N Relay UE is provided with sidelink dedicated configuration as specified in 5.3.5.14, L2 U2N Relay UE configuration as specified in 5.3.5.15, as well as Uu Relay RLC channel configuration as specified in 5.3.5.5.12 and 5.3.5.5.13.
B5329: 5.3.5.17.2.2SL indirect path specific configuration
B5330: The L2 U2N Remote UE shall:
B5331: 1>if sl-IndirectPathAddChange is set to setup:
B5332: 2>if the sl-IndirectPathMaintain is included in reconfigurationWithSync:
B5333: 3>consider the source L2 U2N Relay UE to be the L2 U2N Relay UE on indirect path in MP operation;
B5334: 2>else:
B5335: 3>consider the UE indicated by the sl-IndirectPathRelayUE-Identity to be the (target) L2 U2N Relay UE and indicate to upper layer to trigger the PC5 unicast link establishment with the L2 U2N Relay UE;
B5336: 3>start timer T421 for the corresponding L2 U2N Relay UE with the timer value set to T421;
B5337: 3>if reconfigurationWithSync is not included in the same RRCReconfiguration message:
B5338: 4>indicate to upper layer (to trigger the PC5 unicast link release) with the source L2 U2N Relay UE in case of SL indirect path change (i.e. a new L2 U2N Relay UE is indicated via sl-IndirectPathRelayUE-Identity);
B5339: 1>else if sl-IndirectPathAddChange is set to release:
B5340: 2>consider the SL indirect path is released and release the corresponding configurations;
B5341: 2>indicate to upper layer (to trigger the PC5 unicast link release) with the L2 U2N Relay UE.
B5342: NOTE:The MP direct path addition is realized by indirect-to-direct path switch procedure (i.e. ReconfigurationWithSync included in RRCReconfiguration message), where sl-IndirectPathAddChange is set to setup in RRCReconfiguration message.
B5343: 5.3.5.17.2.3T421 expiry (Indirect path addition/change failure)
B5344: The L2 U2N Remote UE shall:
B5345: 1> if T421 expires; or
B5346: 1> if the (target) L2 U2N Relay UE (i.e., the UE indicated by sl-IndirectPathRelayUE-Identity in the received sl-IndirectPathAddChange) changes its serving cell to a different cell from the target cell (i.e. the cell indicated by sl-IndirectPathCellIdentity in the received sl-IndirectPathAddChange) during path addition or change:
B5347: 2>if MCG transmission is not suspended:
B5348: 3>initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in clause 5.7.3c to report SL indirect path addition/change failure;
B5349: 2>else:
B5350: 3>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7;
B5351: 5.3.5.17.3Configuration of N3C indirect path
B5352: 5.3.5.17.3.1General
B5353: For N3C indirect path,
B5354: -the N3C remote UE is provided with N3C indirect path configuration including relay UE identification as specified in 5.3.5.17.3.2;
B5355: -the N3C relay UE is provided with N3C indirect path configuration including bearer mapping configurations as specified in 5.3.5.17.3.4, as well as Uu Relay RLC channel configuration as specified in 5.3.5.5.12 and 5.3.5.5.13.
B5356: NOTE: The data transmission/reception between the N3C remote UE and the N3C relay UE via the non-3GPP connection is outside the scope of 3GPP.
B5357: 5.3.5.17.3.2N3C remote UE configuration
B5358: The N3C remote UE shall:
B5359: 1>if n3c-IndirectPathAddChange is set to setup:
B5360: 2>consider the non-3GPP connection with the relay UE indicated by the n3c-RelayIdentification to be used for the N3C indirect path;
B5361: 2>consider the source non-3GPP connection is not to be used in case of N3C indirect path change (i.e. a new relay UE is indicated by the n3c-RelayIdentification);
B5362: 1>else if n3c-IndirectPathAddChange is set to release:
B5363: 2>consider the indirect path is not to be used and release the corresponding configuration:
B5364: 1>if n3c-ExtIndirectPathAddChange is set to setup:
B5365: 2>consider the configured N3C relay UE(s) is(are) released;
B5366: 2>consider the relay UE(s) indicated by the n3c-ExtIndirectPathAddChange to be used for the N3C indirect path;
B5367: 1>if n3c-ExtIndirectPathAddChange is set to release:
B5368: 2>consider the indirect path is not to be used and release the corresponding configuration.
B5369: 5.3.5.17.3.2aN3C Indirect path addition/change failure
B5370: The N3C remote UE shall:
B5371: 1> if N3C Indirect path addition/change failure is detected:
B5372: 2>if MCG transmission is not suspended:
B5373: 3>initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in clause 5.7.3c to report N3C indirect path addition/change failure;
B5374: 2>else:
B5375: 3>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7;
B5376: NOTE:How to detect N3C Indirect path addition/change failure is up to UE implementation.
B5377: 5.3.5.17.3.3N3C relay UE configuration
B5378: The N3C relay UE shall:
B5379: 1>if n3c-IndirectPathConfigRelay is set to setup:
B5380: 2>if n3c-MappingToReleaseList is included:
B5381: 3>perform N3C bearer mapping release as specified in 5.3.5.17.3.4.1;
B5382: 2>if n3c-MappingToAddModList is included:
B5383: 3>perform N3C bearer mapping addition/modification as specified in 5.3.5.17.3.4.2;
B5384: 1>else if n3c-IndirectPathConfigRelay is set to release:
B5385: 2>consider the indirect path with the remote UE is released and release the corresponding configuration.
B5386: 5.3.5.17.3.4Bearer mapping management on N3C indirect path
B5387: 5.3.5.17.3.4.1Bearer mapping release
B5388: The UE shall:
B5389: 1>if the release is triggered by reception of n3c-IndirectPathConfigRelay set to release:
B5390: 2>for all configured SL-RemoteUE-RB-Identity value:
B5391: 3>release n3c-RLC-ChannelUu and n3c-RemoteUE-RB-Identity;
B5392: 1>else if the release is triggered by reception of the n3c-MappingToReleaseList:
B5393: 2>for each SL-RemoteUE-RB-Identity value included in n3c-MappingToReleaseList:
B5394: 3>release the corresponding n3c-RLC-ChannelUu and n3c-RemoteUE-RB-Identity;
B5395: 5.3.5.17.3.4.2Bearer mapping addition and modification
B5396: The UE shall:
B5397: 1>for each n3c-RemoteUE-RB-Identity value included in the n3c-MappingToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration:
B5398: 2>associate the remote UE's RB indicated in n3c-RemoteUE-RB-Identity to the Uu Relay RLC channel indicated in n3c-RLC-ChannelUu;
B5399: 1>for the n3c-RemoteUE-RB-Identity value included in the n3c-MappingToAddModList that is part of the current UE configuration:
B5400: 2>update the associated Uu Relay RLC channel to the one indicated in n3c-RLC-ChannelUu.
B5401: 5.3.5.18LTM configuration and execution
B5402: 5.3.5.18.1LTM configuration
B5403: The network configures the UE with one or more LTM candidate configurations within the LTM-Config IE.
B5404: An ltm-Config included within an RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1 is for LTM on the MCG. It may include an SCG configuration and/or ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID.
B5405: An ltm-Config included within an RRCReconfiguration message either received via SRB3, or embedded in an RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1 is for LTM on the SCG. It does not include any MCG configuration and does not include ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID.
B5406: An ltm-ConfigNRDC included within an RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1 is for LTM on the SCG. It includes the MCG configuration and may include ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID.
B5407: In NR-DC, the UE may be configured simultaneously with an ltm-Config for MCG LTM, and an ltm-Config for SCG LTM, or be configured simultaneously with an ltm-Config for MCG LTM, and an ltm-ConfigNRDC for SCG LTM.
B5408: In this case, the following principles apply:
B5409: -the UE maintains independently the two ltm-Config, or the ltm-Config and the ltm-ConfigNRDC;
B5410: -the UE maintains two independent VarLTM-ServingCellNoResetID, one associated with each ltm-Config, or one associated with the ltm-Config and one associated with the ltm-ConfigNRDC;
B5411: -the UE maintains two independent VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID, one associated with each ltm-Config, or one associated with the ltm-Config and one associated with the ltm-ConfigNRDC;
B5412: -the UE maintains two independent VarLTM-ServingCellNoSecurityChange, one associated with the ltm-Config and one associated with the ltm-ConfigNRDC (if both are configured);
B5413: -the UE independently performs all the procedures in clause 5.3.5.18 for each ltm-Config, or an ltm-Config and an ltm-ConfigNRDC, and the associated VarLTM-ServingCellNoResetID, VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID, and VarLTM-ServingCellNoSecurityChange, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
B5414: The UE shall perform the following actions based on the received LTM-Config IE:
B5415: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes ltm-ServingCellNoResetID:
B5416: 2>if the current VarLTM-ServingCellNoResetID includes an ltm-ServingCellNoResetID:
B5417: 3>replace the ltm-ServingCellNoResetID value within VarLTM-ServingCellNoResetID with the received ltm-ServingCellNoResetID;
B5418: 2>else:
B5419: 3>store the received ltm-ServingCellNoResetID in VarLTM-ServingCellNoResetID;
B5420: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID:
B5421: 2>if the current VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID includes an ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID:
B5422: 3>replace the ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID value within VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID with the received ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID;
B5423: 2>else:
B5424: 3>store the received ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID in VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID;
B5425: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID:
B5426: 2>if the current VarLTM-ServingCellNoSecurityChange includes an ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID:
B5427: 3>replace the ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID value within VarLTM-ServingCellNoSecurityChange with the received ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID;
B5428: 2>else:
B5429: 3>store the received ltm-ServingCellNoSecurityChangeID in VarLTM-ServingCellNoSecurityChange;
B5430: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes the ltm-CandidateToReleaseList:
B5431: 2>perform the LTM candidate configuration release as specified in 5.3.5.18.2;
B5432: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes the ltm-CandidateToAddModList:
B5433: 2>perform the LTM candidate configuration addition or modification as specified in 5.3.5.18.3;
B5434: 1>if the received LTM-Config includes the field ltm-ServingCellExecutionCondition:
B5435: 2>perform LTM cell switch execution conditions modification as specified in 5.3.5.18.1a;
B5436: 1>reconfigure the UE according to all other fields of the received LTM-Config IE.
B5437: 5.3.5.18.1aLTM cell switch execution conditions modification
B5438: The UE shall:
B5439: 1>clear the entry in VarLTM-ExecutionConditionList;
B5440: 1>if the UE is performing LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L1 measurements:
B5441: 2>request lower layers to stop the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L1 measurements for all the LTM candidate configurations;
B5442: 1>if the UE is performing LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L3 measurements:
B5443: 2>stop the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L3 measurements for all the LTM candidate configurations as specified in 5.3.5.18.8;
B5444: 1>if this procedure is triggered by reconfiguration with sync due to an LTM cell switch execution as specified in 5.3.5.5.2 and if ltm-ExecutionCondition is set to setup in the LTM-Candidate IE to which LTM cell switch is performed:
B5445: 2>store ltm-ExecutionCondition in VarLTM-ExecutionConditionList;
B5446: 1>else if this procedure is triggered by LTM configuration as specified in 5.3.5.18.1 and if ltm-ServingCellExecutionCondition is set to setup:
B5447: 2>store ltm-ServingCellExecutionCondition in VarLTM-ExecutionConditionList;
B5448: 1>for each LTM-ExecutionCondition in VarLTM-ExecutionConditions:
B5449: 2>if l3-Conditions is included in the LTM-ExecutionCondition:
B5450: 3>perform the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L3 measurements as specified in 5.3.5.18.8 according to the LTM-ExecutionCondition;
B5451: 2>else if l1-Conditions is included in the LTM-ExecutionCondition:
B5452: 3>request lower layers to initiate the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L1 measurements according to the received field ltm-ExecutionCondition;
B5453: 5.3.5.18.2LTM candidate configuration release
B5454: The UE shall:
B5455: 1>for each ltm-CandidateId value included in the ltm-CandidateToReleaseList that is part of the current UE configuration:
B5456: 2>remove the corresponding LTM-Candidate.
B5457: 5.3.5.18.3LTM candidate configuration addition/modification
B5458: The UE shall:
B5459: 1>for each ltm-CandidateId value included in the ltm-CandidateToAddModList:
B5460: 2>if the current UE configuration contains an LTM-Candidate with the ltm-CandidateId value:
B5461: 3>reconfigure the corresponding LTM-Candidate in accordance with the received LTM-Candidate;
B5462: 2>else:
B5463: 3>add the received LTM-Candidate;
B5464: 2>if the LTM-Candidate with the received ltm-CandidateId value includes ltm-UE-MeasuredTA-ID:
B5465: 3>if the value of ltm-UE-MeasuredTA-ID is equal to the value of ltm-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID within VarLTM-ServingCellUE-MeasuredTA-ID:
B5466: 4>inform lower layers that the UE is configured with UE-based TA measurements for this LTM-Candidate;
B5467: 3>else:
B5468: 4>inform lower layers that the UE is not configured with UE-based TA measurements for this LTM-Candidate;
B5469: 2>else:
B5470: 3>inform lower layers that the UE is not configured with UE-based TA measurements for this LTM-Candidate.

B5576: 2>consider ltm-ReferenceConfiguration in ltm-Config or ltm-ConfigNRDC, associated with the cell group for which the LTM cell switch procedure is triggered, to be the current UE configuration for the fields and configurations to be released by the actions above in this procedure;

B5578: 3>perform the measurement configuration procedure as specified in clause 5.5.2 by considering the measConfig within ltm-ReferenceConfiguration in ltm-Config or ltm-ConfigNRDC as the received measConfig:

B5580: 1>if the LTM cell switch is triggered by an indication from lower layers:
B5581: 2>apply the RRCReconfiguration message in ltm-CandidateConfig within LTM-Candidate IE in ltm-Config or ltm-ConfigNRDC identified by the LTM candidate configuration identity received from lower layers according to clause 5.3.5.3;

B5588: NOTE 2:When ltm-ConfigComplete is not included for an LTM candidate configuration, before an LTM cell switch is triggered a UE implementation may generate and store an RRCReconfiguration message by applying the received LTM candidate configuration on top of the LTM reference configuration, and the stored RRCReconfiguration message is applied when the LTM cell switch is triggered. It is up to the UE to ensure that the RRC reconfiguration applied at the time of LTM cell switch is in accordance with the latest LTM reference configuration and LTM candidate configuration.
B5589: NOTE 3:For the actions the UE should perform at the end of this procedure, the UE should first update the security (if necessary) and then proceed with the bearer handling (e.g., re-establish PDCP, re-establish RLC).
