B5626: 5.3.6Counter check
B5627: 5.3.6.1General
B5629: Figure 5.3.6.1-1: Counter check procedure
B5630: The counter check procedure is used by the network to request the UE to verify the amount of data sent/ received on each DRB. More specifically, the UE is requested to check if, for each DRB, the most significant bits of the COUNT match with the values indicated by the network.
B5631: NOTE:The procedure enables the network to detect packet insertion by an intruder (a 'man in the middle').
B5632: 5.3.6.2Initiation
B5633: The network initiates the procedure by sending a CounterCheck message.
B5634: NOTE:The network may initiate the procedure when any of the COUNT values reaches a specific value.
B5635: 5.3.6.3Reception of the CounterCheck message by the UE
B5636: Upon receiving the CounterCheck message, the UE shall:
B5637: 1>for each DRB that is established:
B5638: 2>if no COUNT exists for a given direction (uplink or downlink) because it is a uni-directional bearer configured only for the other direction:
B5639: 3>assume the COUNT value to be 0 for the unused direction;
B5640: 2>if the drb-Identity is not included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList:
B5641: 3>include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message by including the drb-Identity, the count-Uplink and the count-Downlink set to the value of TX_NEXT – 1 and RX_NEXT – 1 (specified in TS 38.323 [5]), respectively;
B5642: 2>else if, for at least one direction, the most significant bits of the COUNT are different from the value indicated in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList:
B5643: 3>include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message by including the drb-Identity, the count-Uplink and the count-Downlink set to the value of TX_NEXT – 1 and RX_NEXT – 1 (specified in TS 38.323 [5]), respectively;
B5644: 1>for each DRB that is included in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList in the CounterCheck message that is not established:
B5645: 2>include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message by including the drb-Identity, the count-Uplink and the count-Downlink with the most significant bits set identical to the corresponding values in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the least significant bits set to zero;
B5646: 1>submit the CounterCheckResponse message to lower layers for transmission upon which the procedure ends.
B5647: 5.3.7RRC connection re-establishment
B5648: 5.3.7.1General
B5650: Figure 5.3.7.1-1: RRC connection re-establishment, successful
B5653: Figure 5.3.7.1-2: RRC re-establishment, fallback to RRC establishment, successful
B5654: The purpose of this procedure is to re-establish the RRC connection. A UE in RRC_CONNECTED, for which AS security has been activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB/multicast MRB setup or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, may initiate the procedure in order to continue the RRC connection. The connection re-establishment succeeds if the network is able to find and verify a valid UE context or, if the UE context cannot be retrieved, and the network responds with an RRCSetup according to clause 5.3.3.4.
B5655: The network applies the procedure e.g as follows:
B5656: -When AS security has been activated and the network retrieves or verifies the UE context:
B5657: -to re-activate AS security without changing algorithms;
B5658: -to re-establish and resume the SRB1;
B5659: -When UE is re-establishing an RRC connection, and the network is not able to retrieve or verify the UE context:
B5660: -to discard the stored AS Context and release all RBs and BH RLC channels and Uu Relay RLC channels;
B5661: -to fallback to establish a new RRC connection.
B5662: If AS security has not been activated, the UE shall not initiate the procedure but instead moves to RRC_IDLE directly, with release cause 'other'. If AS security has been activated, but SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, are not setup, the UE does not initiate the procedure but instead moves to RRC_IDLE directly, with release cause 'RRC connection failure'.
B5663: 5.3.7.2Initiation
B5664: The UE initiates the procedure when one of the following conditions is met:
B5665: 1>upon detecting radio link failure of the MCG and t316 is not configured, in accordance with 5.3.10; or
B5666: 1>upon detecting radio link failure of the MCG while SCG transmission is suspended, in accordance with 5.3.10; or

B5672: 1>upon an RRC connection reconfiguration failure, in accordance with clause 5.3.5.8.2; or
B5673: 1>upon detecting radio link failure for the SCG while MCG transmission is suspended, in accordance with clause 5.3.10.3 in NR-DC or in accordance with TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.3.11.3 in NE-DC; or

B6008: 5.3.8RRC connection release
B6009: 5.3.8.1General
B6011: Figure 5.3.8.1-1: RRC connection release, successful
B6012: The purpose of this procedure is:
B6013: -to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers (except for broadcast MRBs), BH RLC channels, Uu Relay RLC channels, PC5 Relay RLC channels as well as all radio resources; or
B6014: -to suspend the RRC connection only if SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, are setup, which includes the suspension of the established radio bearers (except for broadcast MRBs).
B6015: 5.3.8.2Initiation
B6016: The network initiates the RRC connection release procedure to transit a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE; or to transit a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_INACTIVE only if SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, is setup in RRC_CONNECTED; or to transit a UE in RRC_INACTIVE back to RRC_INACTIVE when the UE tries to resume (for resuming a suspended RRC connection, for RNA Update or for initiating SDT); or to transit a UE in RRC_INACTIVE to RRC_IDLE when the UE tries to resume (for resuming of a suspended RRC connection, for RNA Update or for initiating SDT). The procedure can also be used to release and redirect a UE to another frequency.

B6109: 4>indicate to NCR-Fwd to cease forwarding;
B6110: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2N Remote UE and is not configured with MP:
B6111: 3>if the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE is determined to be released:
B6112: 4>indicate upper layers to trigger PC5 unicast link release;
B6113: 3>else (i.e., maintain the PC5 RRC connection):
B6114: 4>establish or re-establish (e.g. via release and add) SL RLC entity for SRB1;
B6115: 2>else:
B6116: 3>re-establish RLC entities for SRB1;
B6117: 2>for each application layer measurement configuration with appLayerIdleInactiveConfig configured:
B6118: 3>forward the measConfigAppLayerId and inform upper layers about the release of the RAN visible application layer measurement configuration;
B6119: 3>discard any RAN visible application layer measurement reports received from upper layers;
B6120: 3>initiate the procedure in 5.5b.1.2;
B6121: 2>if the RRCRelease message with suspendConfig was received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or an RRCResumeRequest1:
B6122: 3>stop the timer T319 if running;
B6123: 3>in the stored UE Inactive AS context:
B6124: 4>replace the KgNB and KRRCint keys with the current KgNB and KRRCint keys;
B6125: 4>replace the nextHopChainingCount with the value of nextHopChainingCount received in the RRCRelease message;
B6126: 4>replace the cellIdentity with the cellIdentity of the cell the UE has received the RRCRelease message;
B6127: 4>if the suspendConfig contains the sl-UEIdentityRemote (i.e. the UE is a L2 U2N Remote UE):
B6128: 5>replace the C-RNTI with the value of the sl-UEIdentityRemote;
B6129: 5>replace the physical cell identity with the value of the sl-PhysCellId in sl-ServingCellInfo contained in the discovery message received from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE;
B6130: 4> else:
B6131: 5>replace the C-RNTI with the C-RNTI used in the cell (see TS 38.321 [3]) the UE has received the RRCRelease message;
B6132: 5>replace the physical cell identity with the physical cell identity of the cell the UE has received the RRCRelease message;
B6133: 3>replace the nextHopChainingCount with the value associated with the current KgNB;
B6134: 3>stop the timer T319a if running and consider SDT procedure is not ongoing;
B6135: 2>else:
B6136: 3>release any CSI logged measurement configuration, if configured;
B6137: 3>release loggedDataCollectionAssistanceConfig, if configured;
B6138: 3>store in the UE Inactive AS Context the nextHopChainingCount received in the RRCRelease message, the current KgNB and KRRCint keys, the ROHC state, the EHC context(s), the UDC state, the stored QoS flow to DRB mapping rules, the application layer measurement configuration, the C-RNTI used in the source PCell, the cellIdentity and the physical cell identity of the source PCell, the ncr-FwdConfig (if configured), the spCellConfigCommon within ReconfigurationWithSync of the NR PSCell (if configured) and all other parameters configured except for:
B6139: -parameters within ReconfigurationWithSync of the PCell;
B6140: -parameters within ReconfigurationWithSync of the NR PSCell, if configured;
B6141: -parameters within MobilityControlInfoSCG of the E-UTRA PSCell, if configured;
B6142: -servingCellConfigCommonSIB;
B6143: -sl-L2RelayUE-Config, if configured;
B6144: -sl-L2RemoteUE-Config, if configured;
B6145: -aerial-Config, if configured;
B6146: -cellDTX-DRX-Config, if configured;
B6147: NOTE 1c:suspendConfig is not stored as part of UE Inactive AS Context, except for the fields explicitly specified.
B6148: 3>store any previously or subsequently received application layer measurement report containers for which the successful transmission of the message or at least one segment of the message has not been confirmed by lower layers;
B6149: NOTE 2:NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning related configurations and logged measurement configuration are not stored as UE Inactive AS Context, when UE enters RRC_INACTIVE.
B6150: 2>suspend all SRB(s) and DRB(s), except SRB0 and broadcast MRBs;
B6151: 2>suspend all multicast MRB(s) associated with multicast session(s) not configured for reception in RRC_INACTIVE;
B6152: 2>indicate PDCP suspend to lower layers of all DRBs and multicast MRBs associated with multicast session(s) not configured for reception in RRC_INACTIVE;
B6153: 2>release Uu Relay RLC channel(s), if configured;
B6154: 2>release PC5 Relay RLC channel(s), if configured;
B6155: 2>release the SRAP entity, if configured;
B6156: NOTE 2a:A L2 U2N Relay UE may re-establish the SL-RLC0, SL-RLC1 and SRAP entity after release.
B6157: 2>if SL indirect path is configured:
B6158: 3>release cell identity and relay UE ID configured in sl-IndirectPathAddChange;
B6159: 3>indicate upper layers to trigger PC5 unicast link release of the SL indirect path;
B6160: 2>if N3C indirect path is configured:
B6161: 3>release n3c-IndirectPathAddChange;
B6162: 3>consider the non-3GPP connection is not used;
B6163: 2>if the UE is acting as a N3C relay UE:
B6164: 3>release n3c-IndirectPathConfigRelay;
B6165: 3>consider the non-3GPP connection is not used;
B6166: 2>if the t380 is included:
B6167: 3>start timer T380, with the timer value set to t380;
B6168: 2>if the RRCRelease message is including the waitTime:
B6169: 3>start timer T302 with the value set to the waitTime;
B6170: 3>inform upper layers that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories '0' and '2';
B6171: 2>if T390 is running:
B6172: 3>stop timer T390 for all access categories;
B6173: 3>perform the actions as specified in 5.3.14.4;
B6174: 2>indicate the suspension of the RRC connection to upper layers;
B6175: 2>if the UE is capable of L2 U2N Remote UE:
B6176: 3>enter RRC_INACTIVE, and perform either cell selection as specified in TS 38.304 [20], or relay selection as specified in clause 5.8.15.3, or both;
B6177: 2>else:
B6178: 3>enter RRC_INACTIVE and perform cell selection as specified in TS 38.304 [20];
B6179: 2>if the suspendConfig includes resumeIndication:
B6180: 3> perform the actions as if the UE received Paging message with the ue-Identity included in the PagingRecord matching the UE's stored fullI-RNTI, as specified in clause 5.3.2.3;
B6181: 2>if the multicastConfigInactive is set to setup:
B6182: 3>if the multicast PTM configuration is provided for at least one multicast session for which the UE is not indicated to stop monitoring the G-RNTI and the UE selects the same cell as the one on which the multicast session was configured in RRC_CONNECTED:
B6183: 4>apply the multicast PTM configuration as specified in 5.10.3;
B6184: 4>if multicast MCCH is present:
B6185: 5>monitor the Multicast MCCH-RNTI as specified in 5.10.1.2;
B6186: 2>discard the logged measurement entries and entries associated with configuration and cell information included in VarCSI-LogMeasReport, if any;
B6187: 1>else:
B6188: 2>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with the release cause 'other'.
B6189: NOTE 3:Whether to release the PC5 unicast link is left to L2 U2N Remote UE's implementation.
B6190: NOTE 4:It is left to UE implementation whether to stop T430, if running, when going to RRC_INACTIVE.

B6194: 2>if stored, discard the cell reselection priority information provided by the cellReselectionPriorities or inherited from another RAT;

B6199: 5.3.8.6T346g expiry

B6203: 5.3.9RRC connection release requested by upper layers
B6204: 5.3.9.1General
B6205: The purpose of this procedure is to release the RRC connection. Access to the current PCell may be barred as a result of this procedure.
B6206: 5.3.9.2Initiation
B6207: The UE initiates the procedure when upper layers request the release of the RRC connection as specified in TS 24.501 [23]. The UE shall not initiate the procedure for power saving purposes.
B6208: The UE shall:
B6209: 1>if the upper layers indicate barring of the PCell:
B6210: 2>treat the PCell used prior to entering RRC_IDLE as barred according to TS 38.304 [20];
B6211: 1>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other'.
B6212: 5.3.10Radio link failure related actions
B6213: 5.3.10.1Detection of physical layer problems in RRC_CONNECTED
B6214: The UE shall:
B6215: 1>if any DAPS bearer is configured, upon receiving N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the source SpCell from lower layers and T304 is running:
B6216: 2>start timer T310 for the source SpCell.
B6217: 1>upon receiving N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers while neither T300, T301, T304, T311, T316 nor T319 are running:
B6218: 2>start timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell.
B6219: 5.3.10.2Recovery of physical layer problems
B6220: Upon receiving N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers while T310 is running, the UE shall:
B6221: 1>stop timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell.
B6222: 1>stop timer T312 for the corresponding SpCell, if running.
B6223: NOTE 1:In this case, the UE maintains the RRC connection without explicit signalling, i.e. the UE maintains the entire radio resource configuration.
B6224: NOTE 2:Periods in time where neither "in-sync" nor "out-of-sync" is reported by L1 do not affect the evaluation of the number of consecutive "in-sync" or "out-of-sync" indications.
B6225: 5.3.10.3Detection of radio link failure
B6226: The UE shall:
B6227: 1>if any DAPS bearer is configured and T304 is running:
B6228: 2>upon T310 expiry in source SpCell; or
B6229: 2>upon random access problem indication from source MCG MAC; or
B6230: 2>upon indication from source MCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached; or
B6231: 2>upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from source MCG MAC:
B6232: 3>consider radio link failure to be detected for the source MCG i.e. source RLF;
B6233: 3>suspend the transmission and reception of all DRBs and multicast MRBs in the source MCG;
B6234: 3>reset MAC for the source MCG;
B6235: 3>release the source connection.
B6236: 1>else:
B6237: 2>during a DAPS handover: the following only applies for the target PCell;
B6238: 2>upon T310 expiry in PCell; or
B6239: 2>upon T312 expiry in PCell; or
B6240: 2>upon random access problem indication from MCG MAC while neither T300, T301, T304, T311 nor T319 are running and SDT procedure is not ongoing; or
B6241: 2>upon indication from MCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached while SDT procedure is not ongoing; or
B6242: 2>if connected as an IAB-node, upon BH RLF indication received on BAP entity from the MCG; or
B6243: 2>upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from MCG MAC while T304 is not running:
B6244: 3>if the indication is from MCG RLC and CA duplication is configured and activated for MCG, and for the corresponding logical channel allowedServingCells only includes SCell(s):
B6245: 4>initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.5 to report RLC failure.
B6246: 3>else:
B6247: 4>consider radio link failure to be detected for the MCG, i.e. MCG RLF;
B6248: 4>discard any segments of segmented RRC messages stored according to 5.7.6.3;
B6249: NOTE 1:Void.
B6250: 4>if AS security has not been activated:
B6251: 5>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other';-
B6252: 4>else if AS security has been activated but SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB or, for IAB and NCR, SRB2, have not been setup:
B6253: 5>store the radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report as described in clause 5.3.10.5;
B6254: 5>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'RRC connection failure';
B6255: 4>else:
B6256: 5>store the radio link failure information in the VarRLF-Report as described in clause 5.3.10.5;
B6257: 5>if MP is configured:
B6258: 6>if T316 is configured, and MP indirect path transmission is not suspended; and
B6259: 6>if neither MP indirect path change nor MP indirect path addition is ongoing:
B6260: 7>initiate the MCG failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3b to report MCG radio link failure.
B6261: 6>else:
B6262: 7>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7.
B6263: 5>else:
B6264: 6>if the UE supports RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure and if T316 is configured:
B6265: 7>if the SCG is deactivated at the moment of detecting RLF in the MCG:
B6266: 8>set the mcg-RecoveryFailureCause in the VarRLF-Report to scg-Deactivated;
B6267: 8>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B6268: 7>else if SCG transmission is suspended at the moment of detecting RLF in the MCG:
B6269: 8>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B6270: 8>set the scg-FailureCause value in the VarRLF-Report according to 5.7.3.5;
B6271: 8>set the elapsedTimeSCG-Failure in the VarRLF-Report to the time elapsed between SCG failure and the MCG failure;
B6272: 6>if T316 is configured; and
B6273: 6>if SCG transmission is not suspended; and
B6274: 6>if the SCG is not deactivated; and
B6275: 6>if neither PSCell change nor PSCell addition is ongoing (i.e. timer T304 for the NR PSCell is not running in case of NR-DC or timer T307 of the E-UTRA PSCell is not running as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.3.10.10, in NE-DC):
B6276: 7>initiate the MCG failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3b to report MCG radio link failure.
B6277: 6>else:
B6278: 7>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7.
B6279: A L3 U2N Relay UE, L2 U2N Relay UE in case of single hop or the L2 Last U2N Relay UE shall:
B6280: 1>upon detecting radio link failure:
B6281: 2>either indicate to upper layers (to trigger PC5 unicast link release with the connected L2 U2N Remote UE(s) or with its child UE(s)) or send NotificationMessageSidelink to the connected L2/L3 U2N Remote UE(s) or to the child UE(s)) in accordance with 5.8.9.10.
B6282: A N3C Relay UE shall:
B6283: 1>upon detecting radio link failure:
B6284: 2>indicates to the associated N3C remote UE via the Non-3GPP Connection.
B6285: NOTE 2:How the N3C Relay UE indicates Uu RLF on the Non-3GPP Connection is left to implementation.
B6286: The UE shall:
B6287: 1>upon T310 expiry in PSCell; or
B6288: 1>upon T312 expiry in PSCell; or
B6289: 1>upon random access problem indication from SCG MAC; or
B6290: 1>upon indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached; or
B6291: 1>if connected as an IAB-node, upon BH RLF indication received on BAP entity from the SCG; or
B6292: 1>upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from SCG MAC:
B6293: 2>if the indication is from SCG RLC and CA duplication is configured and activated for SCG, and for the corresponding logical channel allowedServingCells only includes SCell(s):
B6294: 3>initiate the failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.5 to report RLC failure.
B6295: 2>else:
B6296: 3>consider radio link failure to be detected for the SCG, i.e. SCG RLF;
B6297: 3>if the SCG is deactivated:
B6298: 4>stop radio link monitoring on the SCG;
B6299: 4>indicate to lower layers to stop beam failure detection on the PSCell;
B6300: 3>if MCG transmission is not suspended:
B6301: 4>initiate the SCG failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3 to report SCG radio link failure.
B6302: 3>else:
B6303: 4>if the UE is in NR-DC:
B6304: 5>if the UE supports RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure and if the UE detected SCG failure while the timer T316 was running:
B6305: 6>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B6306: 6>set the scg-FailureCause in the VarRLF-Report value according to 5.7.3.5;
B6307: 6>set the elapsedTimeSCG-Failure in the VarRLF-Report to the time elapsed between MCG failure and the SCG failure;
B6308: 6>include scg-FailedAfterMCG;
B6309: 5>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7;
B6310: 4>else (the UE is in (NG)EN-DC):
B6311: 5>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.3.7;
B6312: 5.3.10.4RLF cause determination
B6313: The UE shall set the rlf-Cause in the VarRLF-Report as follows:
B6314: 1>if the UE declares radio link failure due to T310 expiry:
B6315: 2>set the rlf-Cause as t310-Expiry;
B6316: 1>else if the UE declares radio link failure due to the random access problem indication from MCG MAC:
B6317: 2>if the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery:
B6318: 3>set the rlf-Cause as beamFailureRecoveryFailure;
B6319: 2>else:
B6320: 3>set the rlf-Cause as randomAccessProblem;
B6321: 1>else if the UE declares radio link failure due to the reaching of maximum number of retransmissions from the MCG RLC:
B6322: 2>set the rlf-Cause as rlc-MaxNumRetx;
B6323: 1>else if the UE declares radio link failure due to consistent uplink LBT failures:
B6324: 2>set the rlf-Cause as lbtFailure;
B6325: 1>else if the IAB-MT declares radio link failure due to the reception of a BH RLF indication on BAP entity:
B6326: 2>set the rlf-Cause as bh-rlfRecoveryFailure.
B6327: 1>else if the UE declares radio link failure due to T312 expiry:
B6328: 2>set the rlf-Cause as t312-Expiry;
B6329: 5.3.10.5RLF report content determination
B6330: The UE shall determine the content in the VarRLF-Report as follows:
B6331: 1>clear the information included in VarRLF-Report, if any;
B6332: 1>if the UE is not in SNPN access mode, set the plmn-IdentityList to include the list of EPLMNs stored by the UE (i.e. including the RPLMN);
B6333: 1>else if the UE is in SNPN access mode, set the snpn-IdentityList to include the list of equivalent SNPNs stored by the UE (i.e., including the registered SNPN identity);
B6334: 1>set the measResultLastServCell to include the cell level RSRP, RSRQ and the available SINR, of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF) based on the available SSB and CSI-RS measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6335: 1>if the UE supports RLF-Report for CHO with candidate SCG(s) and if the UE was configured with condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell:
B6336: 2>set the measResultLastServPSCell to include the cell level RSRP, RSRQ and the available SINR, of the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (if available, in case of no PSCell change) based on the available SSB and CSI-RS measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure;
B6337: 2>if the UE does not support RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure or if T316 is not configured:
B6338: 3>set pSCellId to the global cell identity and tracking area code, if available, and otherwise the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (in case of no PSCell change);
B6339: 1>if measRSSI-ReportConfig is configured for the measObject indicated as the servingCellMO of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case of RLF), set the measResultLastServCellRSSI to the linear average of the available RSSI sample value(s) provided by lower layers for the frequency of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case of RLF) up to the moment the UE detected the failure;
B6340: 1>if the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available:
B6341: 2>set the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block RSRQ is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block SINR is listed first, based on the available SS/PBCH block based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6342: 2>if the UE supports RLF-Report for CHO with candidate SCG(s) and if the UE was configured with condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell:
B6343: 3>set the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServPSCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (in case of no PSCell change), ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block RSRQ is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the highest SS/PBCH block SINR is listed first, based on the available SS/PBCH block based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6344: 1>if the CSI-RS based measurement quantities are available:
B6345: 2>set the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), ordered such that the highest CSI-RS RSRP is listed first if CSI-RS RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the highest CSI-RS RSRQ is listed first if CSI-RS RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the highest CSI-RS SINR is listed first, based on the available CSI-RS based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6346: 2>if the UE supports RLF-Report for CHO with candidate SCG(s) and if the UE was configured with condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell:
B6347: 3>set the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServPSCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (in case of no PSCell change), ordered such that the highest CSI-RS RSRP is listed first if CSI-RS RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the highest CSI-RS RSRQ is listed first if CSI-RS RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the highest CSI-RS SINR is listed first, based on the available CSI-RS based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6348: 1>if the UE supports RLF-Report for MCG LTM cell switch and if the UE was configured with ltm-Config associated with the MCG when connected to the source PCell (in case of HO failure) or PCell (in case of RLF) and if the SS/PBCH block-based L1-RSRP measurements performed based on LTM-CSI-ReportConfig are available:
B6349: 2>set the resultsSSB-Indexes in measResultL1-LastServCell to include all the available SS/PBCH block-based L1-RSRP values of the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block L1-RSRP measurement is listed first, based on the available SS/PBCH block-based L1-RSRP collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6350: 1>for each of the configured measObjectNR in which measurements are available or in which the associated reportConfigNR is configured as conditional handover with time-based or location-based trigger condition:
B6351: 2>if the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available:
B6352: 3>set the measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells to include all the available measurement quantities of the best measured cells, other than the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF) and other than the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (in case of no PSCell change) if the UE was configured with condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell and if the UE supports RLF-Report for CHO with candidate SCG(s), ordered such that the cell with highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest SS/PBCH block RSRQ is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest SS/PBCH block SINR is listed first, based on the available SS/PBCH block based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected failure;
B6353: 3>for each neighbour cell included, include the optional fields that are available;
B6354: NOTE 0a:For the neighboring cells included in measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells ordered based on the SS/PBCH block measurement quantities, UE also includes the CSI-RS based measurement quantities, if available.
B6355: 2>if the CSI-RS based measurement quantities are available:
B6356: 3>set the measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells to include all the available measurement quantities of the best measured cells, other than the source PCell (in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), and other than the source PSCell (in case of PSCell change) or PSCell (in case of no PSCell change) if the UE was configured with condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell and if the UE supports RLF-Report for CHO with candidate SCG(s), ordered such that the cell with highest CSI-RS RSRP is listed first if CSI-RS RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest CSI-RS RSRQ is listed first if CSI-RS RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise the cell with highest CSI-RS SINR is listed first, based on the available CSI-RS based measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected radio link failure;
B6357: 3>for each neighbour cell included, include the optional fields that are available;
B6358: NOTE 0b:For ordering the neighboring cells based on the CSI-RS measurement quantities, UE includes measurements only for the cells not yet included in measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells to avoid overriding SS/PBCH block-based ordered measurements.
B6359: 2>if measurement quantities are not available and if the UE supports RLF-Report for conditional handover with time-based or location-based trigger condition in NTN:
B6360: 3>set physCellId in measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells to include the physical cell identity of the neighbour cells that are candidate cells for which the reconfigurationWithSync is included in the masterCellGroup in the MCG VarConditionalReconfig at the moment of the detected failure;
B6361: 3>for each neighbour cell included, include the optional fields that are available;
B6362: 2>for each neighbour cell, if any, included in measResultListNR in measResultNeighCells:

B6547: 5.3.13RRC connection resume
B6548: 5.3.13.1General
B6550: Figure 5.3.13.1-1: RRC connection resume, successful
B6552: Figure 5.3.13.1-2: RRC connection resume fallback to RRC connection establishment, successful
B6554: Figure 5.3.13.1-3: RRC connection resume followed by network release, successful
B6556: Figure 5.3.13.1-4: RRC connection resume followed by network suspend, successful
B6558: Figure 5.3.13.1-5: RRC connection resume, network reject
B6559: The purpose of this procedure is to resume a suspended RRC connection, including resuming SRB(s), DRB(s) and multicast MRB(s) or perform an RNA update. This procedure is also used to initiate SDT in RRC_INACTIVE.
B6560: 5.3.13.1aConditions for resuming RRC Connection for NR sidelink communication/positioning/discovery/V2X sidelink communication
B6561: For NR sidelink communication/positioning/discovery an RRC connection is resumed only in the following cases:
B6562: 1>if configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication and related data is available for transmission:
B6563: 2>if the frequency on which the UE is configured to transmit NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt within SIB12 provided by the cell on which the UE camps; and if the valid version of SIB12 does not include sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency;
B6564: 1>if configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink discovery and related data is available for transmission:
B6565: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink L2 U2U relay discovery messages and sl-L2-U2U-Relay-r18 is included in SIB12; or
B6566: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink L3 U2U relay discovery messages and sl-L3-U2U-RelayDiscovery is included in SIB12; or
B6567: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink single hop L2 U2N relay discovery messages and sl-L2U2N-Relay is included in SIB12; or
B6568: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink multi hop L2 U2N relay discovery messages and sl-L2U2N-MH-Relay is included in SIB12; or
B6569: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink L3 U2N relay discovery messages and sl-L3U2N-RelayDiscovery is included in SIB12; or
B6570: 2>if the UE is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink non-relay discovery messages and sl-NonRelayDiscovery is included in SIB12:
B6571: 3>if the frequency on which the UE is configured to transmit NR sidelink discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoList within SIB12 provided by the cell on which the UE camps; and if the valid version of SIB12 does not include sl-DiscTxPoolSelected or sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency;
B6572: 1>if configured by upper layers to perform NR sidelink positioning and indicated by upper layers to transmit SL-PRS:
B6573: 2>if the frequency on which the UE is configured to transmit SL-PRS is included in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt within SIB12 provided by the cell on which the UE camps; and if the valid version of SIB12 does not include sl-PRS-ResourcesSharedSL-PRS-RP-r18 in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency; or
B6574: 2>if the frequency on which the UE is configured to transmit SL-PRS is included in sl-PosFreqInfoList within SIB23 provided by the cell on which the UE camps; and if the valid version of SIB23 does not include sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency;
B6575: For L2 U2N Relay UE in RRC_INACTIVE, an RRC connection establishment is resumed in the following cases:
B6576: 1>if any message is received from the L2 U2N Remote UE or from a child UE via SL-RLC0 as specified in 9.1.1.4 or SL-RLC1 as specified in 9.2.4; or
B6577: 1>if RemoteUEInformationSidelink containing the connectionForMP is received from a L2 U2N Remote UE as specified in 5.8.9.8.3;
B6578: For V2X sidelink communication an RRC connection resume is initiated only when the conditions specified for V2X sidelink communication in clause 5.3.3.1a of TS 36.331 [10] are met.
B6579: NOTE:Upper layers initiate an RRC connection resume (except if the RRC connection resume is initiated at the L2 U2N Relay UE upon reception of a message from a L2 U2N Remote UE via SL-RLC0 or SL-RLC1, or upon reception of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message containing the connectionForMP). The interaction with NAS is left to UE implementation.
B6580: 5.3.13.1bConditions for initiating SDT
B6581: When requesting lower layers to check the conditions for initiating SDT, RRC indicates to lower layers whether the resume procedure is initiated for mobile originated or mobile terminated case.
B6582: A UE in RRC_INACTIVE initiates the resume procedure for SDT when all of the following conditions are fulfilled:
B6583: 1>for the resume procedure initiated by the upper layers (i.e. mobile originated case):
B6584: 2>SIB1 includes sdt-ConfigCommon; and
B6585: 2>sdt-Config is configured; and
B6586: 2>all the pending data in UL is mapped to the radio bearers configured for SDT; and

B7023: 5.3.13.5Handling of failure to resume RRC Connection
B7024: The UE shall:

B7031: 2>if the UE is not in SNPN access mode and if the UE has connection establishment failure information or connection resume failure information available in VarConnEstFailReport and if the RPLMN is not equal to plmn-identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport; or
B7032: 2>if the UE is in SNPN access mode and if the UE has connection establishment failure information or connection resume failure information available in VarConnEstFailReport and if the registered SNPN identity is not equal to snpn-identity in networkIdentity stored in VarConnEstFailReport; or

B7112: 1>if the UE is unable to comply with (part of) the configuration included in the RRCResume message;
B7113: 2>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11 with release cause ′RRC Resume failure′.
B7114: NOTE 1:The UE may apply above failure handling also in case the RRCResume message causes a protocol error for which the generic error handling as defined in 10 specifies that the UE shall ignore the message.
B7115: NOTE 2:If the UE is configured (i.e., via SIB1) to send MUSIM temporary capability restriction indication, and if the UE supports MUSIM temporary capability restriction, the UE does not apply above failure handling in case the UE is unable to apply (part of) the configuration resulting from RRCResume message due to UE temporary capability restriction for MUSIM operation. If UE does not go to RRC_IDLE in this case, UE still considers the configuration resulting from the RRCResume message as the current configuration as the baseline for delta configuration for future reconfigurations. It is up to UE implementation how to apply RRCResume message. For other cases, if the UE is unable to comply with part of the configuration, it does not apply any (part of) the configuration, i.e. there is no partial success/failure.
B7116: 5.3.13.12Inter RAT cell reselection
B7117: Upon reselecting to an inter-RAT cell, the UE shall:
B7118: 1>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'other'.
B7119: 5.3.14Unified Access Control
B7120: 5.3.14.1General
B7121: The purpose of this procedure is to perform access barring check for an access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers according to TS 24.501 [23] or the RRC layer. This procedure does not apply to IAB-MT and NCR-MT. This procedure does not apply to L2 U2N Relay UE initiating RRC connection establishment or RRC connection resume upon reception of any message from a L2 U2N remote UE or from a child UE via SL-RLC0 or SL-RLC1 in accordance to 5.3.3.1a or 5.3.13.1a.
B7122: After a PCell change in RRC_CONNECTED the UE shall defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1 (as specified in 5.2.2.2) from the target cell.
B7123: 5.3.14.2Initiation
B7124: Upon initiation of the procedure, the UE shall:
B7125: 1>if timer T390 is running for the Access Category:
B7126: 2>consider the access attempt as barred;
B7127: 1>else if timer T302 is running:
B7128: 2>if the Access Category is neither '2' nor '0'; or
B7129: 2>if the Access Category is '0' for RRC resumption triggered by multicast reception as specified in 5.3.13.2:
B7130: 3>consider the access attempt as barred;
B7131: 1>else:
B7132: 2>if the Access Category is '0':
B7133: 3>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7134: 2>else:
B7135: 3>if SIB1 includes uac-BarringPerPLMN-List that contains a UAC-BarringPerPLMN for the selected PLMN or SNPN:
B7136: 4>if the procedure in 5.2.2.4.2 for a selected PLMN resulted in use of information in npn-IdentityInfoList and UAC-BarringPerPLMN has an entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to used information in this list:
B7137: 5>select the UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to used information in the npn-IdentityInfoList;
B7138: 4>else:
B7139: 5>select the UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to the selected PLMN and the PLMN-IdentityInfo, if any, or the selected SNPN and the npn-IdentityInfoList;
B7140: 3>if any UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry is selected:
B7141: 4>in the remainder of this procedure, use the selected UAC-BarringPerPLMN entry (i.e. presence or absence of access barring parameters in this entry) irrespective of the uac-BarringForCommon included in SIB1;
B7142: 3>else if SIB1 includes uac-BarringForCommon:
B7143: 4>in the remainder of this procedure use the uac-BarringForCommon (i.e. presence or absence of these parameters) included in SIB1;
B7144: 3>else:
B7145: 4>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7146: 3>if uac-BarringForCommon is applicable or the uac-ACBarringListType indicates that uac-ExplicitACBarringList is used:
B7147: 4>if the corresponding UAC-BarringPerCatList contains a UAC-BarringPerCat entry corresponding to the Access Category:
B7148: 5>select the UAC-BarringPerCat entry;
B7149: 5>if the uac-BarringInfoSetList contains a UAC-BarringInfoSet entry corresponding to the selected uac-barringInfoSetIndex in the UAC-BarringPerCat:
B7150: 6>select the UAC-BarringInfoSet entry;
B7151: 6>perform access barring check for the Access Category as specified in 5.3.14.5, using the selected UAC-BarringInfoSet as "UAC barring parameter";
B7152: 5>else:
B7153: 6>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7154: 4>else:
B7155: 5>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7156: 3>else if the uac-ACBarringListType indicates that uac-ImplicitACBarringList is used:
B7157: 4>select the uac-BarringInfoSetIndex corresponding to the Access Category in the uac-ImplicitACBarringList;
B7158: 4>if the uac-BarringInfoSetList contains the UAC-BarringInfoSet entry corresponding to the selected uac-BarringInfoSetIndex:
B7159: 5>select the UAC-BarringInfoSet entry;
B7160: 5>perform access barring check for the Access Category as specified in 5.3.14.5, using the selected UAC-BarringInfoSet as "UAC barring parameter";
B7161: 4>else:
B7162: 5>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7163: 3>else:
B7164: 4>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7165: 1>if the access barring check was requested by upper layers:
B7166: 2>if the access attempt is considered as barred:
B7167: 3>if timer T302 is running:
B7168: 4>if timer T390 is running for Access Category '2':
B7169: 5>inform the upper layer that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories '0', upon which the procedure ends;
B7170: 4>else
B7171: 5>inform the upper layer that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories '0' and '2', upon which the procedure ends;
B7172: 3>else:
B7173: 4>inform upper layers that the access attempt for the Access Category is barred, upon which the procedure ends;
B7174: 2>else:
B7175: 3>inform upper layers that the access attempt for the Access Category is allowed, upon which the procedure ends;
B7176: 1>else:
B7177: 2>the procedure ends.
B7178: 5.3.14.3Void
B7179: 5.3.14.4T302, T390 expiry or stop (Barring alleviation)
B7180: The UE shall:
B7181: 1>if timer T302 expires or is stopped:
B7182: 2>for each Access Category for which T390 is not running:
B7183: 3>consider the barring for this Access Category to be alleviated:
B7184: 1>else if timer T390 corresponding to an Access Category other than '2' expires or is stopped, and if timer T302 is not running:
B7185: 2>consider the barring for this Access Category to be alleviated;
B7186: 1>else if timer T390 corresponding to the Access Category '2' expires or is stopped:
B7187: 2>consider the barring for this Access Category to be alleviated;
B7188: 1>when barring for an Access Category is considered being alleviated:
B7189: 2>if the Access Category was informed to upper layers as barred:
B7190: 3>inform upper layers about barring alleviation for the Access Category.
B7191: 2>else if the Access Category is Access Category '0' for RRC resumption triggered by multicast reception as specified in 5.3.13.2:
B7192: 3>perform actions specified in 5.3.13.1d;
B7193: 2>if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8'; or
B7194: 2>if barring is alleviated for Access Category '2':
B7195: 3>perform actions specified in 5.3.13.8;
B7196: 5.3.14.5Access barring check
B7197: The UE shall:
B7198: 1>if one or more Access Identities equal to 1, 2, 11, 12, 13, 14, or 15 are indicated according to TS 24.501 [23], and
B7199: 1>if for at least one of these Access Identities the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity contained in "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category is set to zero:
B7200: 2>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7201: 1>else:
B7202: 2>if the establishment of the RRC connection is the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication (either in NR or E-UTRAN); and
B7203: 2>if the bit corresponding to Access Identity 1 in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity contained in the "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category is set to zero:
B7204: 3>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7205: 2>else if Access Identity 3 is indicated:
B7206: 3>if uac-BarringFactorForAI3 is not included in "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category:
B7207: 4>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7208: 3>else:
B7209: 4>draw a random number 'rand' uniformly distributed in the range: 0 ≤ rand < 1;
B7210: 4>if 'rand' is lower than the value indicated by uac-BarringFactorForAI3 included in "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category:
B7211: 5>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7212: 4>else:
B7213: 5>consider the access attempt as barred;
B7214: 2>else:
B7215: 3>draw a random number 'rand' uniformly distributed in the range: 0 ≤ rand < 1;
B7216: 3>if 'rand' is lower than the value indicated by uac-BarringFactor included in "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category:
B7217: 4>consider the access attempt as allowed;
B7218: 3>else:
B7219: 4>consider the access attempt as barred;
B7220: 1>if the access attempt is considered as barred:
B7221: 2>draw a random number 'rand' that is uniformly distributed in the range 0 ≤ rand < 1;
B7222: 2>start timer T390 for the Access Category with the timer value calculated as follows, using the uac-BarringTime included in "UAC barring parameter" for the corresponding Access Category:
B7223: T390 = (0.7+ 0.6 * rand) * uac-BarringTime.
B7224: 5.3.15RRC connection reject
B7225: 5.3.15.1Initiation
B7226: The UE initiates the procedure upon the reception of RRCReject when the UE tries to establish or resume an RRC connection.
B7227: 5.3.15.2Reception of the RRCReject by the UE
B7228: The UE shall:
B7229: 1>stop timer T300, if running;
B7230: 1>stop timer T319, if running;
B7231: 1>stop timer T319a, if running and consider SDT procedure is not ongoing;
B7232: 1>stop timer T302, if running;
B7233: 1>reset MAC and release the default MAC Cell Group configuration (except if the RRCReject is received in response to resuming RRC connection for multicast reception);
B7234: 1>if waitTime is configured in the RRCReject:
B7235: 2>start timer T302, with the timer value set to the waitTime;
B7236: 1>if RRCReject is received in response to a request from upper layers:
B7237: 2>inform the upper layer that access barring is applicable for all access categories except categories '0' and '2';
B7238: 1>if RRCReject is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest:
B7239: 2>inform upper layers about the failure to setup the RRC connection, upon which the procedure ends;
B7240: 1>else if RRCReject is received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or an RRCResumeRequest1:
B7241: 2>if resume is triggered by upper layers:
B7242: 3>inform upper layers about the failure to resume the RRC connection;
B7243: 2>if resume is triggered due to an RNA update; or
B7244: 2>if resume is triggered for SDT and T380 has expired:
B7245: 3>set the variable pendingRNA-Update to true;
B7246: 2>discard the current KgNB key, the KRRCenc key, the KRRCint key, the KUPint key and the KUPenc key derived in accordance with 5.3.13.3;
B7247: 2>if resume is triggered for SDT:
B7248: 3>for SRB2, if it is resumed and for SRB1:
B7249: 4>trigger the PDCP entity to perform SDU discard as specified in TS 38.323 [5];
B7250: 4>re-establish the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 [4];
B7251: 3>for each DRB that is not suspended:
B7252: 4>indicate PDCP suspend to lower layers;
B7253: 4>re-establish the RLC entity as specified in TS 38.322 [4];
B7254: 2>suspend SRB1 and the radio bearers configured for SDT, if any;
B7255: 2>the procedure ends.
B7256: Upon L2 U2N Relay UE receives RRCReject, it either indicates to upper layers (to trigger PC5 unicast link release with the connected L2 U2N Remote UE(s) or with its child UE(s)) or sends NotificationMessageSidelink message to the connected L2 U2N Remote UE(s) or to the child UE(s) in accordance with 5.8.9.10.
B7257: The RRC_INACTIVE UE shall continue to monitor paging while the timer T302 is running.
B7258: NOTE:If timer T331 is running, the UE continues to perform idle/inactive measurements according to 5.7.8.
B7259: 5.4Inter-RAT mobility
B7260: 5.4.1Introduction
B7261: Network controlled inter-RAT mobility between NR and E-UTRA, where E-UTRA can be connected to either EPC or 5GC, and from NR to UTRA-FDD is supported.
B7262: 5.4.2Handover to NR
B7263: 5.4.2.1General
B7265: Figure 5.4.2.1-1: Handover to NR, successful
B7266: The purpose of this procedure is to, under the control of the network, transfer a connection between the UE and another Radio Access Network (e.g. E-UTRAN) to NR.
B7267: The handover to NR procedure applies when SRBs, possibly in combination with DRBs, are established in another RAT. Handover from E-UTRA to NR applies only after integrity has been activated in E-UTRA.
B7268: 5.4.2.2Initiation
B7269: The RAN using another RAT initiates the handover to NR procedure, in accordance with the specifications applicable for the other RAT, by sending the RRCReconfiguration message via the radio access technology from which the inter-RAT handover is performed.
B7270: The network applies the procedure as follows:
B7271: -to activate ciphering, possibly using NULL algorithm, if not yet activated in the other RAT;
B7272: -to re-establish SRBs and one or more DRBs;
B7273: 5.4.2.3Reception of the RRCReconfiguration by the UE
B7274: The UE shall:
B7275: 1>apply the default L1 parameter values as specified in corresponding physical layer specifications except for the parameters for which values are provided in SIB1;
B7276: 1>apply the default MAC Cell Group configuration as specified in 9.2.2;
B7277: 1>perform RRC reconfiguration procedure as specified in 5.3.5;
B7278: NOTE:If the UE is connected to 5GC of the source E-UTRA cell, the delta configuration for PDCP and SDAP can be used for intra-system inter-RAT handover. For other cases, source RAT configuration is not considered when the UE applies the reconfiguration message of target RAT.
B7279: 5.4.3Mobility from NR
B7280: 5.4.3.1General
B7282: Figure 5.4.3.1-1: Mobility from NR, successful
B7284: Figure 5.4.3.1-2: Mobility from NR, failure
B7285: The purpose of this procedure is to move a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to a cell using other RAT, e.g. E-UTRA, UTRA-FDD. The mobility from NR procedure covers the following type of mobility:
B7286: -handover, i.e. the MobilityFromNRCommand message includes radio resources that have been allocated for the UE in the target cell;
B7287: 5.4.3.2Initiation
B7288: The network initiates the mobility from NR procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED, possibly in response to a MeasurementReport or an MCGFailureInformation message, by sending a MobilityFromNRCommand message. The network applies the procedure as follows:
B7289: -the procedure is initiated only when AS security has been activated, and SRB2 with at least one DRB or multicast MRB have been setup and not suspended;
B7290: -the procedure is not initiated if any DAPS bearer is configured;
B7291: 5.4.3.3Reception of the MobilityFromNRCommand by the UE
B7292: The UE shall:
B7293: 1>stop timer T310, if running;
B7294: 1>stop timer T312, if running;
B7295: 1>if T316 is running:
B7296: 2>stop timer T316;
B7297: 2>if the UE supports RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure as specified in 38.306 [26]:
B7298: 3>set the elapsedTimeT316 in the VarRLF-Report to the value of the elapsed time of the timer T316;
B7299: 3>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B7300: 2>else:
B7301: 3>clear the information included in VarRLF-Report, if any;
B7302: 1>if T390 is running:
B7303: 2>stop timer T390 for all access categories;
B7304: 2>perform the actions as specified in 5.3.14.4;
B7305: 1>if the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra:
B7306: 2>consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards E-UTRA;
B7307: 2>forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included;
B7308: 1>else if the targetRAT-Type is set to utra-fdd:
B7309: 2>consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards UTRA-FDD;
B7310: 2>forward the nas-SecurityParamFromNR to the upper layers, if included;
B7311: 1>access the target cell indicated in the inter-RAT message in accordance with the specifications of the target RAT.
B7312: 5.4.3.4Successful completion of the mobility from NR
B7313: Upon successfully completing the handover, at the source side the UE shall:
B7314: 1>if T316 was not running at the time of receiving MobilityFromNRCommand and if the UE was configured with successHO-Config when connected to the source PCell and the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra:
B7315: 2>perform the actions for the successful handover report determination for inter-RAT handover as specified in clause 5.7.10.6.
B7316: 1>reset MAC;
B7317: 1>stop all timers that are running except T325, T330 and T400;
B7318: 1>release ran-NotificationAreaInfo, if stored;
B7319: 1>release the AS security context including the KRRCenc key, the KRRCint key, the KUPint key and the KUPenc key, if stored;
B7320: 1>release all radio resources, including release of the RLC entity and the MAC configuration;
B7321: 1>release the associated PDCP entity and SDAP entity for all established RBs;
B7322: NOTE :PDCP and SDAP configured by the source RAT prior to the handover that are reconfigured and re-used by target RAT when delta signalling (i.e., during inter-RAT intra-system handover when fullConfig is not present) is used, are not released as part of this procedure.
B7323: 1>if the UE is configured with any application layer measurement configuration:
B7324: 2>inform upper layers about the release of all application layer measurement configurations;
B7325: 2>release all application layer measurement configurations including their fields in UE variables VarAppLayerIdleConfig and VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig;
B7326: 2>discard any application layer measurement reports which were not yet fully submitted to lower layers for transmission;
B7327: 2>consider itself not to be configured to send application layer measurement reports;
B7328: 1>discard the logged measurement entries and entries associated with configuration and cell information included in VarCSI-LogMeasReport, if any;
B7329: 1>if the targetRAT-Type is set to eutra and the nas-SecurityParamFromNR is included: or
B7330: 1>if the targetRAT-Type is set to utra-fdd:
B7331: 2>indicate the release of the RRC connection to upper layers together with the release cause 'other'.
B7332: 5.4.3.5Mobility from NR failure
B7333: The UE shall:
B7334: 1>if the UE does not succeed in establishing the connection to the target radio access technology:
B7335: 2>if the targetRAT-Type in the received MobilityFromNRCommand is set to eutra and the UE supports Radio Link Failure Report for Inter-RAT MRO EUTRA:
B7336: 3>store handover failure information in VarRLF-Report according to 5.3.10.5;
B7337: 2>if voiceFallbackIndication is included in the MobilityFromNRCommand message; or
B7338: 2>if the mobility from NR procedure is for emergency services fallback as specified in TS 23.502 [43]:
B7339: 3>attempt to select an E-UTRA cell:
B7340: 4>if a suitable E-UTRA cell is selected; or
B7341: 4>if no suitable E-UTRA cell is available and an acceptable E-UTRA cell supporting emergency call is selected when the UE has an ongoing emergency call:
B7342: 5>perform the actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as specified in 5.3.11, with release cause 'RRC connection failure';
B7343: 4>else:
B7344: 5>revert back to the configuration used in the source PCell;
B7345: 5>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7;
B7346: NOTE:It is left to UE implementation to determine whether the mobility from NR procedure is for emergency services fallback as specified in TS 23.502 [43].
B7347: 2>else:
B7348: 3>revert back to the configuration used in the source PCell;
B7349: 3>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7;
B7350: 1>else if the UE is unable to comply with any part of the configuration included in the MobilityFromNRCommand message; or
B7351: 1>if there is a protocol error in the inter RAT information included in the MobilityFromNRCommand message, causing the UE to fail the procedure according to the specifications applicable for the target RAT:
B7352: 2>if the targetRAT-Type in the received MobilityFromNRCommand is set to eutra and the UE supports Radio Link Failure Report for Inter-RAT MRO EUTRA:
B7353: 3>store handover failure information in VarRLF-Report according to 5.3.10.5;
B7354: 2>revert back to the configuration used in the source PCell;
B7355: 2>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in clause 5.3.7.
B7356: 5.5Measurements
B7357: 5.5.1Introduction
B7358: The network may configure an RRC_CONNECTED UE to perform measurements. The network may configure the UE to report them in accordance with the measurement configuration or to perform conditional reconfiguration evaluation in accordance with the conditional reconfiguration or to perform LTM cell switch conditions evaluation in accordance with the configured LTM cell switch conditions. The measurement configuration is provided by means of dedicated signalling i.e. using the RRCReconfiguration or RRCResume.
B7359: The network may configure the UE to perform the following types of measurements:
B7360: -NR measurements;
B7361: -Inter-RAT measurements of E-UTRA frequencies;
B7362: -Inter-RAT measurements of UTRA-FDD frequencies;
B7363: -NR sidelink measurements of L2 U2N Relay UEs.
B7364: The network may configure the UE to report the following measurement information based on SS/PBCH block(s):
B7365: -Measurement results per SS/PBCH block;
B7366: -Measurement results per cell based on SS/PBCH block(s);
B7367: -SS/PBCH block(s) indexes.
B7368: The network may configure the UE to report the following measurement information based on CSI-RS resources:
B7369: -Measurement results per CSI-RS resource;
B7370: -Measurement results per cell based on CSI-RS resource(s);
B7371: -CSI-RS resource measurement identifiers.
B7372: The network may configure the UE to perform the following types of measurements for NR sidelink and V2X sidelink:
B7373: -CBR measurements.
B7374: The network may configure the UE to report the following CLI measurement information based on SRS resources:
B7375: -Measurement results per SRS resource;
B7376: -SRS resource(s) indexes.
B7377: The network may configure the UE to report the following CLI measurement information based on CLI-RSSI resources:
B7378: -Measurement results per CLI-RSSI resource;
B7379: -CLI-RSSI resource(s) indexes.
B7380: The network may configure the UE to report the following Rx-Tx time difference measurement information based on CSI-RS for tracking or PRS:
B7381: -UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement result.
B7382: The measurement configuration includes the following parameters:
B7383: 1.Measurement objects: A list of objects on which the UE shall perform the measurements.
B7384: -For intra-frequency and inter-frequency measurements a measurement object indicates the frequency/time location and subcarrier spacing of reference signals to be measured. Associated with this measurement object, the network may configure a list of cell specific offsets, a list of 'exclude-listed' cells and a list of 'allow-listed' cells. Exclude-listed cells are not applicable in event evaluation or measurement reporting. Allow-listed cells are the only ones applicable in event evaluation or measurement reporting.
B7385: -The measObjectId of the MO which corresponds to each serving cell is indicated by servingCellMO within the serving cell configuration.
B7386: -For inter-RAT E-UTRA measurements a measurement object is a single E-UTRA carrier frequency. Associated with this E-UTRA carrier frequency, the network can configure a list of cell specific offsets and a list of 'exclude-listed' cells. Exclude-listed cells are not applicable in event evaluation or measurement reporting.
B7387: -For inter-RAT UTRA-FDD measurements a measurement object is a set of cells on a single UTRA-FDD carrier frequency.
B7388: -For NR sidelink measurements of L2 U2N Relay UEs, a measurement object is a single NR sidelink frequency to be measured.
B7389: -For CBR measurement of NR sidelink communication, a measurement object is a set of transmission resource pool(s) on a single carrier frequency for NR sidelink communication.
B7390: -For CBR measurement of NR sidelink discovery, a measurement object is a set of discovery dedicated resource pool(s) or transmission resource pool(s) also used for NR sidelink discovery on a single carrier frequency for NR sidelink discovery.
B7391: -For CBR measurement of NR sidelink positioning, a measurement object is a set of positioning dedicated resource pool(s) or transmission resource pool(s) also used for NR sidelink positioning on a single carrier frequency for NR sidelink positioning.
B7392: -For CLI measurements a measurement object indicates the frequency/time location of SRS resources and/or CLI-RSSI resources, and subcarrier spacing of SRS resources to be measured.
B7393: 2.Reporting configurations: A list of reporting configurations where there can be one or multiple reporting configurations per measurement object. Each measurement reporting configuration consists of the following:
B7394: -Reporting criterion: The criterion that triggers the UE to send a measurement report. This can either be periodical or a single event description.
B7395: -RS type: The RS that the UE uses for beam and cell measurement results (SS/PBCH block or CSI-RS).
B7396: -Reporting format: The quantities per cell and per beam that the UE includes in the measurement report (e.g. RSRP) and other associated information such as the maximum number of cells and the maximum number beams per cell to report.
B7397: In case of conditional reconfiguration, each configuration consists of the following:
B7398: -Execution criteria: The criteria the UE uses for conditional reconfiguration execution.
B7399: -RS type: The RS that the UE uses for obtaining beam and cell measurement results (SS/PBCH block-based or CSI-RS-based), used for evaluating conditional reconfiguration execution condition.
B7400: 3.Measurement identities: For measurement reporting, a list of measurement identities where each measurement identity links one measurement object with one reporting configuration. By configuring multiple measurement identities, it is possible to link more than one measurement object to the same reporting configuration, as well as to link more than one reporting configuration to the same measurement object. The measurement identity is also included in the measurement report that triggered the reporting, serving as a reference to the network. For conditional reconfiguration triggering, one measurement identity links to exactly one conditional reconfiguration trigger configuration. And up to 2 measurement identities can be linked to one conditional reconfiguration execution condition.
B7401: 4.Quantity configurations: The quantity configuration defines the measurement filtering configuration used for all event evaluation and related reporting, and for periodical reporting of that measurement. For NR measurements, the network may configure up to 2 quantity configurations with a reference in the NR measurement object to the configuration that is to be used. In each configuration, different filter coefficients can be configured for different measurement quantities, for different RS types, and for measurements per cell and per beam.
B7402: 5.Measurement gaps: Periods that the UE may use to perform measurements.
B7403: 6.Effective measurement window: Periods that the UE may use to perform inter RAT measurements.
B7404: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED maintains a measurement object list, a reporting configuration list, and a measurement identities list according to signalling and procedures in this specification. The measurement object list possibly includes NR measurement object(s), CLI measurement object(s), inter-RAT objects, and L2 U2N Relay objects. Similarly, the reporting configuration list includes NR, inter-RAT, and L2 U2N Relay reporting configurations. Any measurement object can be linked to any reporting configuration of the same RAT type. Some reporting configurations may not be linked to a measurement object. Likewise, some measurement objects may not be linked to a reporting configuration.
B7405: The measurement procedures distinguish the following types of cells:
B7406: 1.The NR serving cell(s) – these are the SpCell and one or more SCells.
B7407: 2.Listed cells – these are cells listed within the measurement object(s).
B7408: 3.Detected cells – these are cells that are not listed within the measurement object(s) but are detected by the UE on the SSB frequency(ies) and subcarrier spacing(s) indicated by the measurement object(s).
B7409: For NR measurement object(s), the UE measures and reports on the serving cell(s)/serving Relay UE (for L2 U2N Remote UE), listed cells and/or detected cells. For inter-RAT measurements object(s) of E-UTRA, the UE measures and reports on listed cells and detected cells and, for RSSI and channel occupancy measurements, the UE measures and reports on the configured resources on the indicated frequency. For inter-RAT measurements object(s) of UTRA-FDD, the UE measures and reports on listed cells. For CLI measurement object(s), the UE measures and reports on configured measurement resources (i.e. SRS resources and/or CLI-RSSI resources). For L2 U2N Relay object(s), the UE measures and reports on the serving NR cell(s), as well as the discovered L2 U2N Relay UEs.
B7410: Whenever the procedural specification, other than contained in clause 5.5.2, refers to a field it concerns a field included in the VarMeasConfig unless explicitly stated otherwise i.e. only the measurement configuration procedure covers the direct UE action related to the received measConfig.
B7411: In NR-DC, the UE may receive two independent measConfig:
B7412: -a measConfig, associated with MCG, that is included in the RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1; and
B7413: -a measConfig, associated with SCG, that is included in the RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB3, or, alternatively, included within a RRCReconfiguration message embedded in a RRCReconfiguration message received via SRB1.
B7414: In this case, the UE maintains two independent VarMeasConfig and VarMeasReportList, one associated with each measConfig, and independently performs all the procedures in clause 5.5 for each measConfig and the associated VarMeasConfig and VarMeasReportList, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
B7415: The configurations related to CBR measurements are only included in the measConfig associated with MCG.
B7416: The configurations related to Rx-Tx time difference measurement are only included in the measConfig associated with MCG.
B7417: 5.5.2Measurement configuration
B7418: 5.5.2.1General
B7419: The network applies the procedure as follows:
B7420: -to ensure that, whenever the UE has a measConfig associated with a CG, it includes a measObject for the SpCell and for each NR SCell of the CG to be measured;
B7421: -to configure at most one measurement identity across all CGs using a reporting configuration with the reportType set to reportCGI;
B7422: -to configure at most one measurement identity per the node hosting PDCP entity using a reporting configuration with the ul-DelayValueConfig;
B7423: -to configure at most one measurement identity per the node hosting PDCP entity using a reporting configuration with the ul-ExcessDelayConfig;
B7424: -to ensure that, in the measConfig associated with a CG:
B7425: -for all SSB based measurements there is at most one measurement object with the same ssbFrequency;
B7426: -an smtc1 included in any measurement object with the same ssbFrequency has the same value and that an smtc2 included in any measurement object with the same ssbFrequency has the same value and that an smtc3list included in any measurement object with the same ssbFrequency has the same value and that an smtc4list included in any measurement object with the same ssbFrequency has the same value and that an smtc5list included in any measurement object with the same ssbFrequency has the same value;
B7427: -to ensure that all measurement objects configured in this specification and in TS 36.331 [10] with the same ssbFrequency have the same ssbSubcarrierSpacing;
B7428: -to ensure that, if a measurement object associated with the MCG has the same ssbFrequency as a measurement object associated with the SCG:
B7429: -for that ssbFrequency, the measurement window according to the smtc1 configured by the MCG includes the measurement window according to the smtc1 configured by the SCG, or vice-versa, with an accuracy of the maximum receive timing difference specified in TS 38.133 [14].
B7430: -if both measurement objects are used for RSSI measurements, bits in measurementSlots in both objects corresponding to the same slot are set to the same value. Also, the endSymbol is the same in both objects.
B7431: -to ensure that, if a measurement object has the same ssbFrequency as a measurement object configured in TS 36.331 [10]:
B7432: -for that ssbFrequency, the measurement window according to the smtc configured in TS 36.331 [10] includes the measurement window according to the smtc1 configured in TS 38.331, or vice-versa, with an accuracy of the maximum receive timing difference specified in TS 38.133 [14].
B7433: -if both measurement objects are used for RSSI measurements, bits in measurementSlots in both objects corresponding to the same slot are set to the same value. Also, the endSymbol is the same in both objects.
B7434: -when the UE is in NE-DC, NR-DC, or NR standalone, to configure at most one measurement identity across all CGs using a reporting configuration with the reportType set to reportSFTD;
B7435: For CSI-RS resources, the network applies the procedure as follows:
B7436: -to ensure that all CSI-RS resources configured in each measurement object have the same center frequency, (startPRB+floor(nrofPRBs/2))
B7437: -to ensure that the total number of CSI-RS resources configured in each measurement object does not exceed the maximum number specified in TS 38.214 [19].
