B7621: 5.5.2.9Measurement gap configuration
B7622: The UE shall:
B7623: 1>if gapFR1 is set to setup:
B7624: 2>if an FR1 measurement gap configuration configured by gapFR1 is already setup, release the FR1 measurement gap configuration;
B7625: 2>setup the FR1 measurement gap configuration indicated by the gapFR1 in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B7626: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10);
B7627: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B7628: with T = MGRP/10 as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7629: 2>apply the specified timing advance mgta to the gap occurrences calculated above (i.e. the UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences);
B7630: 1>else if gapFR1 is set to release:
B7631: 2>release the FR1 measurement gap configuration configured by gapFR1;
B7632: 1>if gapFR2 is set to setup:
B7633: 2>if an FR2 measurement gap configuration configured by gapFR2 is already setup, release the FR2 measurement gap configuration;
B7634: 2>setup the FR2 measurement gap configuration indicated by the gapFR2 in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B7635: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10);
B7636: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B7637: with T = MGRP/10 as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7638: 2>apply the specified timing advance mgta to the gap occurrences calculated above (i.e. the UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences);
B7639: 1>else if gapFR2 is set to release:
B7640: 2>release the FR2 measurement gap configuration configured by gapFR2;
B7641: 1>if gapUE is set to setup:
B7642: 2>if a per UE measurement gap configuration configured by gapUE is already setup, release the per UE measurement gap configuration;
B7643: 2>setup the per UE measurement gap configuration indicated by the gapUE in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B7644: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10);
B7645: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B7646: with T = MGRP/10 as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7647: 2>apply the specified timing advance mgta to the gap occurrences calculated above (i.e. the UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences);
B7648: 1>else if gapUE is set to release:
B7649: 2>release the per UE measurement gap configuration configured by gapUE.
B7650: 1>for each measGapId included in the received gapToReleaseList:
B7651: 2>release the measurement gap configuration associated with the measGapId;
B7652: 1>for each measPosPreConfigGapId included in the received posMeasGapPreConfigToReleaseList:
B7653: 2>release the measurement gap configuration associated with the measPosPreConfigGapId;
B7654: 1>for each GapConfig received in gapToAddModList:
B7655: 2>setup measurement gap configuration indicated by the GapConfig in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B7656: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10);
B7657: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B7658: with T = MGRP/10 as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7659: 2>apply the specified timing advance mgta to the gap occurrences calculated above (i.e. the UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences);
B7660: 2>apply the measurement gap as per UE measurement gap, FR1 measurement gap, or FR2 measurement gap according to the gapType indicated by the GapConfig;
B7661: 2>associate the measurement gap with the measGapId indicated by the GapConfig;
B7662: 2>if gapSharing in the GapConfig is present:
B7663: 3>setup the gap sharing configuration for the measurement gap in accordance with the received gapSharing as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7664: 2>else:
B7665: 3>release the gap sharing configuration (if configured) for the measurement gap;
B7666: 1>for each PosGapConfig received in PosMeasGapPreConfigToAddModList:
B7667: 2>if a measurement gap configuration associated with the measPosPreConfigGapId indicated by the PosGapConfig is already setup:
B7668: 3>release the measurement gap configuration;
B7669: 2>setup measurement gap configuration indicated by the PosGapConfig in accordance with the received gapOffset, i.e., the first subframe of each gap occurs at an SFN and subframe meeting the following condition:
B7670: SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10);
B7671: subframe = gapOffset mod 10;
B7672: with T = MGRP/10 as defined in TS 38.133 [14];
B7673: 2>apply the specified timing advance mgta to the gap occurrences calculated above (i.e. the UE starts the measurement mgta ms before the gap subframe occurrences);
B7674: 2>configure the measurement gap as indicated by gapType;
B7675: 1>for each FR1, FR2, and per UE measurement gap that is setup:
B7676: 2>if the measurement gap is configured by GapConfig and preConfigInd-r17 in the corresponding GapConfig is present:
B7677: 3>determine whether the measurement gap is activated or not according to TS 38.133 [14];
B7678: 2>else if the measurement gap is configured by PosGapConfig:
B7679: 3>consider the measurement gap to be deactivated;
B7680: 2>else:
B7681: 3>consider the measurement gap to be activated.
B7682: NOTE 1:For FR2 gap configuration with synchronous CA, for the UE in NE-DC or NR-DC, the SFN and subframe of the serving cell indicated by the refServCellIndicator is used in the gap calculation. Otherwise, the SFN and subframe of a serving cell on FR2 frequency is used in the gap calculation
B7683: NOTE 2:For FR1 gap or per UE gap configuration, for the UE in NE-DC or NR-DC, the SFN and subframe of the serving cell indicated by the refServCellIndicator in is used in the gap calculation. Otherwise, the SFN and subframe of the PCell is used in the gap calculation.
B7684: NOTE 3:For FR2 gap configuration with asynchronous CA, for the UE in NE-DC or NR-DC, the SFN and subframe of the serving cell indicated by the refServCellIndicator and refFR2ServCellAsyncCA is used in the gap calculation. Otherwise, the SFN and subframe of a serving cell on FR2 frequency indicated by the refFR2ServCellAsyncCA is used in the gap calculation
B7685: 5.5.2.10Reference signal measurement timing configuration
B7686: The UE shall setup the first SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the received periodicityAndOffset parameter (providing Periodicity and Offset value for the following condition) in the SSB-MTC configuration. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR SpCell meeting the following condition:
B7687: SFN mod T = (FLOOR (Offset/10));
B7688: if the Periodicity is larger than sf5:
B7689: subframe = Offset mod 10;
B7690: else:
B7691: subframe = Offset or (Offset +5);
B7692: with T = CEIL(Periodicity/10).
B7693: If smtc2 is present, for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in smtc2 in the same MeasObjectNR, the UE shall setup an additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the received periodicity parameter in the smtc2 configuration and use the Offset (derived from parameter periodicityAndOffset) and duration parameter from the smtc1 configuration. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR SpCell meeting the above condition.
B7694: If smtc2-LP is present, for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in smtc2-LP in the same frequency (for intra frequency cell reselection) or different frequency (for inter frequency cell reselection), the UE shall setup an additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the received periodicity parameter in the smtc2-LP configuration and use the Offset (derived from parameter periodicityAndOffset) and duration parameter from the smtc configuration for that frequency. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR SpCell or serving cell (for cell reselection) meeting the above condition.
B7695: If smtc3list is present, for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in each SSB-MTC3 element of the list in the same MeasObjectNR, the IAB-MT shall setup an additional SS block measurement timing configuration in accordance with the received periodicityAndOffset parameter (using same condition as smtc1 to identify the SFN and the subframe for SMTC occasion) in each SSB-MTC3 configuration and use the duration and ssb-ToMeasure parameters from each SSB-MTC3 configuration.
B7696: If smtc4list is present, for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in each SSB-MTC4 element of the list in the same MeasObjectNR, the UE shall setup an additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the received offset parameter in each SSB-MTC4 configuration and use the duration parameter and periodicity (derived from parameter periodicityAndOffset) from the smtc1 configuration. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR serving cell meeting the above condition.
B7697: If smtc5list is present, for cells indicated in the pci-List parameter in each SSB-MTC5 element of the list in the same MeasObjectNR, the UE shall setup an additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the received periodicity and offset parameter in each SSB-MTC5 configuration and use the duration parameter from the smtc1 configuration. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR serving cell meeting the above condition.
B7698: If smtc6list is present, when OD-SSB is activated and the serving cell is activated, the UE shall setup SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with the first configured field in smtc6list for serving cell measurements on the corresponding configured measurement object as specified in 5.5.3.1, if the first OD-SSB configuration (with OD-SSB-ConfigId = 0) is activated; the UE shall setup SMTC in accordance with the second configured field in smtc6list for serving cell measurements on the corresponding configured measurement object as specified in 5.5.3.1, if the second OD-SSB configuration (with OD-SSB-ConfigId = 1) is activated and so on. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR serving cell meeting the above condition.
B7699: If smtc7-SSBAdapt is present, the UE shall setup SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration (SMTC) in accordance with smtc1 or smtc2 (if the serving cell is indicated in the pci-List parameter in smtc2 in the same MeasObjectNR) for serving cell measurements on the corresponding configured measurement object as specified in 5.5.3.1, if lower layer indication for SSB adaptation as defined in 7.3.1.3.10 in TS 38.212 [17], is not received or the received lower layer indication for SSB adaptation indicates the SSB periodicity provided by ssb-periodicityServingCell; the UE shall setup SMTC according to the first configured field in smtc7-SSBAdapt for serving cell measurements on the corresponding configured measurement object as specified in 5.5.3.1, if the received lower layer indication for SSB adaptation indicates the first adaptive SSB periodicity in ssb-BurstPeriodicityList; the UE shall setup SMTC in accordance with the second configured field in smtc7-SSBAdapt for serving cell measurements on the corresponding configured measurement object as specified in 5.5.3.1, if the received lower layer indication for SSB adaptation indicates the second adaptive SSB periodicity in ssb-BurstPeriodicityList. The first subframe of each SMTC occasion occurs at an SFN and subframe of the NR serving cell meeting the above condition.
B7700: On the indicated ssbFrequency, the UE shall not consider SS/PBCH block transmission in subframes outside the SMTC occasion for RRM measurements based on SS/PBCH blocks and for RRM measurements based on CSI-RS except for SFTD measurement (see TS 38.133 [14], clause 9.3.8) and for OD-SSB measurements (see TS 38.133 [14], clause 9.17.1).
B7701: 5.5.2.10aRSSI measurement timing configuration
B7702: The UE shall setup the RSSI measurement timing configuration (RMTC) in accordance with the received rmtc-Periodicity and, if configured, with rmtc-SubframeOffset i.e. the first symbol of each RMTC occasion occurs at first symbol of an SFN and subframe of the NR SpCell meeting the following condition:
B7703: SFN mod T = FLOOR(rmtc-SubframeOffset/10);
B7704: subframe = rmtc-SubframeOffset mod 10;
B7705: with T = rmtc-Periodicity/10;
B7706: On the frequency configured by rmtc-Frequency, the UE shall not consider RSSI measurements outside the configured RMTC occasion which lasts for measDurationSymbols for RSSI and channel occupancy measurements.
B7707: The UE derives the RSSI measurement duration from a combination of measDurationSymbols and ref-SCS-CP. At least for RSSI measurement confined within the active DL BWP, the UE performs RSSI measurement using the numerology of the active DL BWP during the derived measurement duration. Otherwise, the numerology used by the UE for measurements is up to UE implementation. If configured, the UE performs RSSI measurements on a bandwidth in accordance with the received rmtc-Bandwidth. If configured, the UE performs RSSI measurements according to the TCI state configured by tci-StateId in the reference BWP configured by ref-BWPId of the reference serving cell configured by ref-ServCellId (see TS 38.133 [14], clause 9.2A.7 and clause 9.3A.8).If the UE has no serving cell in FR2-2 and configured with inter-frequency RSSI measurement in FR2-2, it is up to the UE implementation how to determine the spatial domain filter for the inter-frequency RSSI measurement in FR2-2.

B7740: 5.5.3Performing measurements
B7741: 5.5.3.1General
B7742: An RRC_CONNECTED UE shall derive cell measurement results by measuring one or multiple beams associated per cell as configured by the network, as described in 5.5.3.3. For all cell measurement results, except for RSSI, and CLI measurement results in RRC_CONNECTED, the UE applies the layer 3 filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2, before using the measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria, measurement reporting, the criteria to trigger conditional reconfiguration execution or event-triggered CSI measurement logging for network-side data collection. For cell measurements, the network can configure RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, RSCP or EcN0 as trigger quantity. For CLI measurements, the network can configure SRS-RSRP or CLI-RSSI as trigger quantity. For cell and beam measurements, reporting quantities can be any combination of quantities (i.e. only RSRP; only RSRQ; only SINR; RSRP and RSRQ; RSRP and SINR; RSRQ and SINR; RSRP, RSRQ and SINR; only RSCP; only EcN0; RSCP and EcN0), irrespective of the trigger quantity, and for CLI measurements, reporting quantities can be either SRS-RSRP or CLI-RSSI. For conditional reconfiguration execution, the network can configure up to 2 quantities, both using same RS type. The UE does not apply the layer 3 filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2 to derive the CBR measurements. The UE does not apply the layer 3 filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2 to derive the Rx-Tx time difference measurements. The UE does not apply the layer 3 filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2 to derive the altitude measurements.
B7743: The network may also configure the UE to report measurement information per beam (which can either be measurement results per beam with respective beam identifier(s) or only beam identifier(s)), derived as described in 5.5.3.3a. If beam measurement information is configured to be included in measurement reports, the UE applies the layer 3 beam filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2. On the other hand, the exact L1 filtering of beam measurements used to derive cell measurement results is implementation dependent.

B7882: 4>perform CBR measurement on pool(s) in sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-PRS-TxPoolExceptional, sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency;
B7883: 2>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B7884: 3>if tx-PoolMeasToAddModList is included in VarMeasConfig:
B7885: 4>perform CBR measurements on each transmission resource pool indicated in the tx-PoolMeasToAddModList;
B7886: 3>if sl-DiscTxPoolSelected, sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-TxPoolScheduling, sl-TxPoolExceptional, sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-PRS-TxPoolScheduling or sl-PRS-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for the concerned frequency within RRCReconfiguration:
B7887: 4>perform CBR measurement on pool(s) in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected, sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-TxPoolScheduling, sl-TxPoolExceptional, sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-PRS-TxPoolScheduling and sl-PRS-TxPoolExceptional if included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for the concerned frequency within RRCReconfiguration;
B7888: 3>else:
B7889: 4>if configured with NR sidelink communication and the cell chosen for NR sidelink communication provides SIB12 which includes sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency; or
B7890: 4>if configured with NR sidelink discovery and the cell chosen for NR sidelink discovery provides SIB12 which includes sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-TxPoolExceptional but does not provide sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for the concerned frequency:
B7891: 5>perform CBR measurement on pool(s) in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency in SIB12;
B7892: 4>if configured with NR sidelink discovery and the cell chosen for NR sidelink discovery provides SIB12 which includes sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for the concerned frequency:
B7893: 5>perform CBR measurement on pools in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected and sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency in SIB12;
B7894: 4>if configured with NR sidelink positioning and the cell chosen for NR sidelink positioning provides SIB23 which includes sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-PRS-TxPoolExceptional, or provides SIB12 which includes sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency:
B7895: 5>perform CBR measurement on pool(s) in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal, sl-TxPoolExceptional, sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-PRS-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency;
B7896: 1>else:

B7901: 3>perform CBR measurement on pools in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected if included in SidelinkPreconfigNR.
B7902: 2>if configured with NR sidelink positioning and sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal is included in SL-PreconfigurationNR for the concerned frequency:
B7903: 3>perform CBR measurement on pool(s) in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal or sl-PRS-TxPoolSelectedNormal in SidelinkPreconfigNR for the concerned frequency.
B7904: NOTE 2:In case the configurations for NR sidelink communication and CBR measurement are acquired via the E-UTRA, configurations for NR sidelink communication in SIB12, sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration used in this clause are provided by the configurations in SystemInformationBlockType28, sl-ConfigDedicatedForNR within RRCConnectionReconfiguration as specified in TS 36.331[10], respectively.

B7906: NOTE 4:For V2X sidelink communication, each of the CBR measurement results is associated with a resource pool, as indicated by the poolReportId (see TS 36.331 [10]), that refers to a pool as included in sl-ConfigDedicatedEUTRA-Info or SIB13.
B7907: 5.5.3.2Layer 3 filtering
B7908: The UE shall:
B7909: 1>for each cell measurement quantity, each beam measurement quantity, each sidelink measurement quantity as needed in clause 5.8.10, for each CLI measurement quantity that the UE performs measurements according to 5.5.3.1, for each L2 U2N Relay UE measurement quantity according to 5.5.3.4, for evaluating the selected or detected NR sidelink U2N Relay UEs according to 5.8.15.3, for evaluating the SyncRef UE according to 5.8.5 and 5.8.6, for evaluating the NR sidelink U2U Relay/Remote UE threshold conditions according to 5.8.16.2 and 5.8.17.2, for evaluating the conditions for selection and reselection of NR sidelink U2U Relay UE according to 5.8.17.3, and for evaluating the detected NR sidelink U2U Relay UEs according to 5.8.17.4:
B7910: 2>filter the measured result, before using for evaluation of reporting criteria, for measurement reporting, for U2N/U2U Relay (re)selection evaluation, for evaluating the SyncRef UE or for evaluation for event-triggered CSI measurement logging for network-side data collection, by the following formula:
B7911: Fn = (1 – a)*Fn-1 + a*Mn
B7912: where
B7913: Mn is the latest received measurement result from the physical layer;
B7914: Fn is the updated filtered measurement result, that is used for evaluation of reporting criteria, for measurement reporting, for U2N/U2U Relay (re)selection evaluation or for evaluating the SyncRef UE;
B7915: Fn-1 is the old filtered measurement result, where F0 is set to M1 when the first measurement result from the physical layer is received; and for MeasObjectNR, a = 1/2(ki/4), where ki is the filterCoefficient for the corresponding measurement quantity of the i:th QuantityConfigNR in quantityConfigNR-List, and i is indicated by quantityConfigIndex in MeasObjectNR; for other measurements, a = 1/2(k/4), where k is the filterCoefficient for the corresponding measurement quantity received by the quantityConfig; for UTRA-FDD, a = 1/2(k/4), where k is the filterCoefficient for the corresponding measurement quantity received by quantityConfigUTRA-FDD in the QuantityConfig;
B7916: 2>adapt the filter such that the time characteristics of the filter are preserved at different input rates, observing that the filterCoefficient k assumes a sample rate equal to X ms; The value of X is equivalent to one intra-frequency L1 measurement period as defined in TS 38.133 [14] assuming non-DRX operation, and depends on frequency range.
B7917: NOTE 1:If k is set to 0, no layer 3 filtering is applicable.
B7918: NOTE 2:The filtering is performed in the same domain as used for evaluation of reporting criteria, for measurement reporting, for U2N/U2U Relay (re)selection evaluation or for evaluating the SyncRef UE, i.e., logarithmic filtering for logarithmic measurements.
B7919: NOTE 3:The filter input rate is implementation dependent, to fulfil the performance requirements set in TS 38.133 [14]. For further details about the physical layer measurements, see TS 38.133 [14].
B7920: NOTE 4:For CLI-RSSI measurement, it is up to UE implementation whether to reset filtering upon BWP switch.
B7921: NOTE 5:For SSB measurements when multiple altitude range-based ssb-ToMeasure are configured, it is up to UE implementation whether to reset filtering upon entering a different altitude range.
B7922: NOTE 6:Upon satellite switch with resynchronization, it is up to UE implementation to reset filtering for the serving cell.
B7923: 5.5.3.3Derivation of cell measurement results
B7924: The network may configure the UE in RRC_CONNECTED to derive RSRP, RSRQ and SINR measurement results per cell associated to NR measurement objects based on parameters configured in the measObject (e.g. maximum number of beams to be averaged and beam consolidation thresholds) and in the reportConfig (rsType to be measured, SS/PBCH block or CSI-RS).
B7925: The network may configure the UE in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE to derive RSRP and RSRQ measurement results per cell associated to NR carriers based on parameters configured in measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig for measurements performed according to 5.7.8.2a.
B7926: The UE shall:
B7927: 1>for each cell measurement quantity to be derived based on SS/PBCH block:
B7928: 2>if nrofSS-BlocksToAverage is not configured in the associated measObject in RRC_CONNECTED or in the associated entry in measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE; or
B7929: 2>if absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation is not configured in the associated measObject in RRC_CONNECTED or in the associated entry in measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE; or
B7930: 2>if the highest beam measurement quantity value is below or equal to absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation:
B7931: 3>derive each cell measurement quantity based on SS/PBCH block as the highest beam measurement quantity value, where each beam measurement quantity is described in TS 38.215 [9];
B7932: 2>else:
B7933: 3>derive each cell measurement quantity based on SS/PBCH block as the linear power scale average of the highest beam measurement quantity values above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation where the total number of averaged beams shall not exceed nrofSS-BlocksToAverage, and where each beam measurement quantity is described in TS 38.215 [9];
B7934: 2>if in RRC_CONNECTED, apply layer 3 cell filtering as described in 5.5.3.2;
B7935: 1>for each cell measurement quantity to be derived based on CSI-RS:
B7936: 2>consider a CSI-RS resource to be applicable for deriving cell measurements when the concerned CSI-RS resource is included in the csi-rs-CellMobility including the physCellId of the cell in theCSI-RS-ResourceConfigMobility in the associated measObject;
B7937: 2>if nrofCSI-RS-ResourcesToAverage in the associated measObject is not configured; or
B7938: 2>if absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation in the associated measObject is not configured; or
B7939: 2>if the highest beam measurement quantity value is below or equal to absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation:
B7940: 3>derive each cell measurement quantity based on applicable CSI-RS resources for the cell as the highest beam measurement quantity value, where each beam measurement quantity is described in TS 38.215 [9];
B7941: 2>else:
B7942: 3>derive each cell measurement quantity based on CSI-RS as the linear power scale average of the highest beam measurement quantity values above absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation where the total number of averaged beams shall not exceed nrofCSI-RS-ResourcesToAverage;
B7943: 2>apply layer 3 cell filtering as described in 5.5.3.2.
B7944: 5.5.3.3aDerivation of layer 3 beam filtered measurement
B7945: The UE shall:
B7946: 1>for each layer 3 beam filtered measurement quantity to be derived based on SS/PBCH block;
B7947: 2>derive each configured beam measurement quantity based on SS/PBCH block as described in TS 38.215[9], and apply layer 3 beam filtering as described in 5.5.3.2;
B7948: 1>for each layer 3 beam filtered measurement quantity to be derived based on CSI-RS;
B7949: 2>derive each configured beam measurement quantity based on CSI-RS as described in TS 38.215 [9], and apply layer 3 beam filtering as described in 5.5.3.2.

B7955: 2>apply layer 3 filtering as described in 5.5.3.2;

B8169: 5.5.4.2Event A1 (Serving becomes better than threshold)
B8170: The UE shall:
B8171: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8172: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8173: 1>for this measurement, consider the NR serving cell corresponding to the associated measObjectNR or csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig associated with this event.
B8174: Inequality A1-1 (Entering condition)
B8175: Ms – Hys > Thresh
B8176: Inequality A1-2 (Leaving condition)
B8177: Ms + Hys < Thresh
B8178: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8179: Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8180: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event, or hysteresis as defined within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig for this event).
B8181: Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a1-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event, or as defined within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig for this event).
B8182: Ms is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8183: Hys is expressed in dB.
B8184: Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Ms.
B8185: 5.5.4.3Event A2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
B8186: The UE shall:
B8187: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8188: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A2-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8189: 1>for this measurement, consider the serving cell indicated by the measObjectNR or corresponding to the csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig associated to this event.
B8190: NOTE:If the SCell indicated by the measObjectNR or corresponding to the csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig associated to this event is not detectable, then the UE should consider for the value of Ms the lowest value of the value range of the measurement quantity as the SCell measurement.
B8191: Inequality A2-1 (Entering condition)
B8192: Ms + Hys < Thresh
B8193: Inequality A2-2 (Leaving condition)
B8194: Ms – Hys > Thresh
B8195: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8196: Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8197: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event, or hysteresis as defined within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig for this event).
B8198: Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a2-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event, or as defined within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig for this event).
B8199: Ms is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8200: Hys is expressed in dB.
B8201: Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Ms.
B8202: 5.5.4.4Event A3 (Neighbour becomes offset better than SpCell)
B8203: The UE shall:
B8204: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A3-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8205: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A3-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8206: 1>use the SpCell for Mp, Ofp and Ocp.
B8207: NOTE 1:The cell(s) that triggers the event has reference signals indicated in the measObjectNR associated to this event which may be different from the NR SpCell measObjectNR.
B8208: Inequality A3-1 (Entering condition)
B8209: Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off
B8210: Inequality A3-2 (Leaving condition)
B8211: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off
B8212: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8213: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8214: Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the reference signal of the neighbour cell (i.e. offsetMO as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell).
B8215: Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell, or cellIndividualOffset as defined within reportConfigNR), and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell.
B8216: Mp is the measurement result of the SpCell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8217: Ofp is the measurement object specific offset of the SpCell (i.e. offsetMO as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the SpCell).
B8218: Ocp is the cell specific offset of the SpCell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the SpCell), and is set to zero if not configured for the SpCell.
B8219: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8220: Off is the offset parameter for this event (i.e. a3-Offset as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8221: Mn, Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8222: Ofn, Ocn, Ofp, Ocp, Hys, Off are expressed in dB.
B8223: NOTE 2:The definition of Event A3 also applies to CondEvent A3.
B8224: 5.5.4.5Event A4 (Neighbour becomes better than threshold)

B8664: Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys1 > Thresh1
B8665: Inequality A4H2-2 (Entering condition 2)
B8666: Ms + Hys2 < Thresh2
B8667: Inequality A4H2-3 (Leaving condition 1)
B8668: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys1 < Thresh1
B8669: Inequality A4H2-4 (Leaving condition 2)
B8670: Ms – Hys2 > Thresh2
B8671: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8672: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8673: Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. offsetMO as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell).
B8674: Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell, or cellIndividualOffset as defined within reportConfigNR), and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell.
B8675: Hys1 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. a4-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8676: Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a4-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8677: Ms is the Aerial UE altitude relative to the sea level.
B8678: Hys2 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. h2-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8679: Thresh2 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. h2-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8680: Mn is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8681: Ofn, Ocn, Hys1 are expressed in dB.
B8682: Thresh1 is expressed in the same unit as Mn.
B8683: Ms, Hys2, Thresh2 are expressed in meters.
B8684: 5.5.4.27Event A5H1 (SpCell becomes worse than threshold1 and neighbour becomes better than threshold2 and the Aerial UE altitude becomes higher than a threshold3)
B8685: The UE shall:
B8686: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when all of condition A5H1-1 and condition A5H1-2 and condition A5H1-3, as specified below, are fulfilled;
B8687: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A5H1-4 or condition A5H1-5 or condition A5H1-6, i.e. at least one of the three, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8688: 1>use the SpCell for Mp.
B8689: NOTE 1:The parameters of the reference signal(s) of the cell(s) that triggers the event are indicated in the measObjectNR associated to the event which may be different from the measObjectNR of the NR SpCell.
B8690: Inequality A5H1-1 (Entering condition 1)
B8691: Mp + Hys1 < Thresh1
B8692: Inequality A5H1-2 (Entering condition 2)
B8693: Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys1 > Thresh2
B8694: Inequality A5H1-3 (Entering condition 3)
B8695: Ms – Hys2 > Thresh3
B8696: Inequality A5H1-4 (Leaving condition 1)
B8697: Mp – Hys1 > Thresh1
B8698: Inequality A5H1-5 (Leaving condition 2)
B8699: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys1 < Thresh2
B8700: Inequality A5H1-6 (Leaving condition 3)
B8701: Ms + Hys2 < Thresh3
B8702: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8703: Mp is the measurement result of the NR SpCell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8704: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8705: Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. offsetMO as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell).
B8706: Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell, or cellIndividualOffset as defined within reportConfigNR), and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell.
B8707: Hys1 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8708: Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Threshold1 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8709: Thresh2 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Threshold2 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8710: Ms is the Aerial UE altitude relative to the sea level.
B8711: Hys2 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. h1-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8712: Thresh3 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. h1-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8713: Mn, Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8714: Ofn, Ocn, Hys1 are expressed in dB.
B8715: Thresh1 is expressed in the same unit as Mp.
B8716: Thresh2 is expressed in the same unit as Mn.
B8717: Ms, Hys2, Thresh3 are expressed in meters.
B8718: NOTE 2:The definition of Event A5H1 also applies to CondEvent A5H1.
B8719: 5.5.4.28Event A5H2 (SpCell becomes worse than threshold1 and neighbour becomes better than threshold2 and the Aerial UE altitude becomes lower than a threshold3)
B8720: The UE shall:
B8721: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when all of condition A5H2-1 and condition A5H2-2 and condition A5H2-3, as specified below, are fulfilled;
B8722: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A5H2-4 or condition A5H2-5 or condition A5H2-6, i.e. at least one of the three, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B8723: 1>use the SpCell for Mp.
B8724: NOTE 1:The parameters of the reference signal(s) of the cell(s) that triggers the event are indicated in the measObjectNR associated to the event which may be different from the measObjectNR of the NR SpCell.
B8725: Inequality A5H2-1 (Entering condition 1)
B8726: Mp + Hys1 < Thresh1
B8727: Inequality A5H2-2 (Entering condition 2)
B8728: Mn + Ofn + Ocn – Hys1 > Thresh2
B8729: Inequality A5H2-3 (Entering condition 3)
B8730: Ms + Hys2 < Thresh3
B8731: Inequality A5H2-4 (Leaving condition 1)
B8732: Mp – Hys1 > Thresh1
B8733: Inequality A5H2-5 (Leaving condition 2)
B8734: Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys1 < Thresh2
B8735: Inequality A5H2-6 (Leaving condition 3)
B8736: Ms – Hys2 > Thresh3
B8737: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B8738: Mp is the measurement result of the NR SpCell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8739: Mn is the measurement result of the neighbouring cell, not taking into account any offsets.
B8740: Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the frequency of the neighbour cell (i.e. offsetMO as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the neighbour cell).
B8741: Ocn is the cell specific offset of the neighbour cell (i.e. cellIndividualOffset as defined within measObjectNR corresponding to the frequency of the neighbour cell, or cellIndividualOffset as defined within reportConfigNR), and set to zero if not configured for the neighbour cell.
B8742: Hys1 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8743: Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Threshold1 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8744: Thresh2 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. a5-Threshold2 as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8745: Ms is the Aerial UE altitude relative to the sea level.
B8746: Hys2 is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. h2-Hysteresis as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8747: Thresh3 is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. h2-Threshold as defined within reportConfigNR for this event).
B8748: Mn, Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.
B8749: Ofn, Ocn, Hys1 are expressed in dB.
B8750: Thresh1 is expressed in the same unit as Mp.
B8751: Thresh2 is expressed in the same unit as Mn.
B8752: Ms, Hys2, Thresh3 are expressed in meters.
B8753: NOTE 2:The definition of Event A5H2 also applies to CondEvent A5H2.
B8754: 5.5.5Measurement reporting
B8755: 5.5.5.1General
B8757: Figure 5.5.5.1-1: Measurement reporting
B8758: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network. The UE shall initiate this procedure only after successful AS security activation.
B8759: The UE shall, for each entry in the VarMeasReportList:
B8760: 1>if the eventH1 or eventH2 is configured in the corresponding reportConfig associated with the measId that triggered the measurement reporting:

B8762: 3>except for the entry corresponding to the event for which the difference between the configured altitude threshold and the altitude of the UE is the smallest, remove all other measurement reporting entries from the VarMeasReportList, if any, and stop the associated periodical reporting timer(s), if running;
B8763: 1>else if the eventA3H1 or eventA3H2 or eventA4H1 or eventA4H2 or eventA5H1 or eventA5H2 is configured in the corresponding reportConfig associated with the measId that triggered the measurement reporting:
B8764: 2>for all the entries in the VarMeasReportList associated with the same measObjectNR for which the measurement reporting procedure was triggered and the corresponding reportConfig is configured with the same eventID and simulMultiTriggerSingleMeasReport set to true:
B8765: 3>except for the entry corresponding to the event for which the difference between the configured altitude threshold and the altitude of the UE is the smallest, remove all other measurement reporting entries from the VarMeasReportList, if any, and stop the associated periodical reporting timer(s), if running;

B9048: 5.5.6Location measurement indication
B9049: 5.5.6.1General
B9051: Figure 5.5.6.1-1: Location measurement indication
B9052: The purpose of this procedure is to indicate to the network that the UE is going to start/stop location related measurements towards E-UTRA or NR which require measurement gaps or start/stop detection of subframe and slot timing towards E-UTRA (eutra-FineTimingDetection) which requires measurement gaps. UE shall initiate this procedure only after successful AS security activation.
B9053: NOTE:It is a network decision to configure the measurement gap.
B9054: 5.5.6.2Initiation
B9055: The UE shall:
B9056: 1>if and only if upper layers indicate to start performing location measurements towards E-UTRA or NR or start subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA, and the UE requires measurement gaps for these operations while measurement gaps are either not configured or not sufficient:
B9057: 2>if preconfigured measurement gaps for positioning and posMG-Request are configured and the UE considers that at least one of the preconfigured measurement gaps for positioning is sufficient for the location measurement when activated:
B9058: 3>trigger the lower layers to initiate the measurement gap activation request using UL MAC CE as specified in TS 38.321 [3];
B9059: 2> else:
B9060: 3>initiate the procedure to indicate start as specified in clause 5.5.6.3;
B9061: NOTE 1:The UE verifies the measurement gap situation only upon receiving the indication from upper layers. If at this point in time sufficient gaps are available, the UE does not initiate the procedure. Unless it receives a new indication from upper layers, the UE is only allowed to further repeat the procedure in the same PCell once per frequency of the target RAT if the provided measurement gaps are insufficient.
B9062: NOTE 1a:When indication is received from upper layers for performing location measurement and there is pre-configured measurement gap configured (not preconfigured measurement gap for positioning), the UE considers this preconfigured measurement gap to be not sufficient if the measurement gap is not considered to be always activated according to clause 9.1.7.2 of TS 38.133 [14].
B9063: 1>if and only if upper layers indicate to stop performing location measurements towards E-UTRA or NR or stop subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA:
B9064: 2>if there is no activated preconfigured measurement gap for positioning:
B9065: 3>if there is previously triggered UL MAC CE transmission for the measurement gap activation for positioning:
B9066: 4>indicate to the lower layers to cancel the triggered UL MAC CE transmission for the measurement gap activation as specified in TS 38.321 [3];
B9067: 2>else if there is activated preconfigured measurement gap for positioning:
B9068: 3>trigger the lower layers to deactivate all the activated measurement gap(s) for positioning as specified in TS 38.321 [3].
B9069: 2>if there is configured measurement gap used for positioning and the measurement gap is not the activated preconfigured measurement gap for positioning:
B9070: 3>initiate the procedure to indicate stop as specified in 5.5.6.3.
B9071: NOTE 2:The UE may initiate the procedure to indicate stop even if it did not previously initiate the procedure to indicate start.
B9072: 5.5.6.3Actions related to transmission of LocationMeasurementIndication message
B9073: The UE shall set the contents of LocationMeasurementIndication message as follows:
B9074: 1>if the procedure is initiated to indicate start of location related measurements:
B9075: 2>if the procedure is initiated for RSTD measurements towards E-UTRA:
B9076: 3>set the measurementIndication to the eutra-RSTD according to the information received from upper layers;
B9077: 2>else if the procedure is initiated for positioning measurement towards NR:
B9078: 3>set the measurementIndication to the nr-PRS-Measurement according to the information received from upper layers;
B9079: 1>else if the procedure is initiated to indicate stop of location related measurements:
B9080: 2>set the measurementIndication to the value release;
B9081: 1>if the procedure is initiated to indicate start of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA:
B9082: 2>set the measurementIndication to the value eutra-FineTimingDetection;
B9083: 1>else if the procedure is initiated to indicate stop of subframe and slot timing detection towards E-UTRA:
B9084: 2>set the measurementIndication to the value release;
B9085: 1>submit the LocationMeasurementIndication message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B9086: 5.5.7Measurement related actions
B9087: 5.5.7.1Speed dependant scaling of measurement related parameters
B9088: The UE shall adjust the value of the following parameter configured by the NR depending on the UE speed: timeToTrigger. The UE shall apply one of the three levels, which are selected as follows:
B9089: The UE shall:
B9090: 1>perform mobility state detection using the mobility state detection as specified in TS 38.304 [20] with the following modifications:
B9091: 2>counting handovers instead of cell reselections;
B9092: 2>applying the parameter applicable for RRC_CONNECTED as included in speedStatePars within VarMeasConfig;
B9093: 1>if high mobility state is detected:
B9094: 2>use the timeToTrigger value multiplied by sf-High within VarMeasConfig;
B9095: 1>else if medium mobility state is detected:
B9096: 2>use the timeToTrigger value multiplied by sf-Medium within VarMeasConfig;
B9097: 1>else:
B9098: 2>no scaling is applied;
B9099: 5.5aLogged Measurements
B9100: 5.5a.1Logged Measurement Configuration
B9101: 5.5a.1.1General
B9104: Figure 5.5a.1.1-1: Logged measurement configuration
B9105: The purpose of this procedure is to configure the UE to perform logging of measurement results while in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE. The procedure applies to logged measurements capable UEs that are in RRC_CONNECTED.
B9106: NOTE:NG-RAN may retrieve stored logged measurement information by means of the UE information procedure.
B9107: 5.5a.1.2Initiation
B9108: NG-RAN initiates the logged measurement configuration procedure to UE in RRC_CONNECTED by sending the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message.
B9109: 5.5a.1.3Reception of the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration by the UE
B9110: Upon receiving the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message the UE shall:
B9111: 1>discard the logged measurement configuration as well as the logged measurement information as specified in 5.5a.2;
B9112: 1>store the received loggingDuration, reportType and areaConfiguration, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9113: 1>If the UE is in SNPN access mode:
B9114: 2>if the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message includes snpn-ConfigList:
B9115: 3>set the snpn-ConfigID-List in VarLogMeasReport to include the current registered SNPN identity as well as SNPN identities in snpn-Config-List;
B9116: 2>else:
B9117: 3>set the snpn-ConfigID-List in VarLogMeasReport to include the current registered SNPN identity;
B9118: 1>else if the LoggedMeasurementConfiguration message includes plmn-IdentityList:
B9119: 2>set plmn-IdentityList in VarLogMeasReport to include the RPLMN as well as the PLMNs included in plmn-IdentityList;
B9120: 1>else:
B9121: 2>set plmn-IdentityList in VarLogMeasReport to include the RPLMN;
B9122: 1>store the received absoluteTimeInfo, traceReference, traceRecordingSessionRef, and tce-Id in VarLogMeasReport;
B9123: 1>store the received bt-NameList, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9124: 1>store the received wlan-NameList, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9125: 1>store the received sensor-NameList, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9126: 1>start timer T330 with the timer value set to the loggingDuration;
B9127: 1>store the received sigLoggedMeasType, if included, in VarLogMeasReport;
B9128: 1>store the received earlyMeasIndication, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9129: 1>store the received areaConfigurationNTN-List, if included, in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9130: 5.5a.1.4T330 expiry
B9131: Upon expiry of T330 the UE shall:
B9132: 1>release VarLogMeasConfig;
B9133: The UE is allowed to discard stored logged measurements, i.e. to release VarLogMeasReport, 48 hours after T330 expiry.
B9134: 5.5a.2Release of Logged Measurement Configuration
B9135: 5.5a.2.1General
B9136: The purpose of this procedure is to release the logged measurement configuration as well as the logged measurement information.
B9137: 5.5a.2.2Initiation
B9138: The UE shall initiate the procedure upon receiving a logged measurement configuration in same or another RAT. The UE shall also initiate the procedure upon power off or upon deregistration.
B9139: The UE shall:
B9140: 1>stop timer T330, if running;
B9141: 1>if stored, discard the logged measurement configuration as well as the logged measurement information, i.e. release the UE variables VarLogMeasConfig and VarLogMeasReport.
B9142: 5.5a.3Measurements logging
B9143: 5.5a.3.1General
B9145: This procedure specifies the logging of available measurements by a UE in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE that has a logged measurement configuration. The actual process of logging within the UE, takes place in RRC_IDLE state could continue in RRC_INACTIVE state or vice versa.

B9152: 2>if location information is not available:

B9156: 3>if the UE is in any cell selection state (as specified in TS 38.304 [20]):
B9157: 4>perform the logging at regular time intervals, as defined by the loggingInterval in the VarLogMeasConfig;
B9158: 3>if the UE is in camped normally state on an NR cell and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport; or

B9161: 4>if areaConfigurationNTN-List is included in VarLogMeasConfig and if the UE supports geographic area scope checking for logged MDT; or
B9162: 4>if the serving cell is part of the area indicated by areaConfig in areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig; or
B9163: 4>if the serving cell is part of the area indicated by cag-ConfigList in areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig; or
B9164: 4>if the serving cell is part of the area indicated by snpn-ConfigList in areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig:
B9165: 5>perform the logging at regular time intervals, as defined by the loggingInterval in the VarLogMeasConfig;
B9166: 2>else if the reportType is set to eventTriggered, and eventType is set to outOfCoverage:
B9167: 3>perform the logging at regular time intervals as defined by the loggingInterval in VarLogMeasConfig only when the UE is in any cell selection state;
B9168: 3>upon transition from any cell selection state to camped normally state in NR:
B9169: 4>if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport, or if the registered SNPN identity is included in snpn-ConfigID-List stored in VarLogMeasReport; and
B9170: 4>if areaConfiguration is not included in VarLogMeasConfig, or if areaConfigurationNTN-List is included in VarLogMeasConfig and if the UE supports geographic area scope checking for logged MDT, or if the current camping cell is part of the area indicated by areaConfig of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig, or if the current camping cell is part of the area indicated by cag-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig, or if the current camping cell is part of the area indicated by snpn-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig:
B9171: 5>perform the logging;
B9172: 2>else if the reportType is set to eventTriggered and eventType is set to eventL1:
B9173: 3>if the UE is in camped normally state on an NR cell and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport; or

B9175: 4>if areaConfiguration is not included in VarLogMeasConfig; or
B9176: 4>if areaConfigurationNTN-List is included in VarLogMeasConfig and if the UE supports geographic area scope checking for logged MDT; or
B9177: 4>if the serving cell is part of the area indicated by areaConfig in areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig; or
B9178: 4>if the current serving cell is part of the area indicated by cag-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig, or if the current camping cell is part of the area indicated by snpn-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9179: 5>perform the logging at regular time intervals as defined by the loggingInterval in VarLogMeasConfig only when the conditions indicated by the eventL1 are met;
B9180: 2>when performing the logging:
B9181: 3> if InterFreqTargetInfo is configured and if the UE detected IDC problems on at least one of the frequencies included in InterFreqTargetInfo or any inter-RAT frequency during the last logging interval, or
B9182: 3>if InterFreqTargetInfo is not configured and if the UE detected IDC problems during the last logging interval:
B9183: 4>if measResultServingCell in the VarLogMeasReport is not empty:
B9184: 5>include inDeviceCoexDetected;
B9185: 5>suspend measurement logging from the next logging interval;
B9186: 4>else:
B9187: 5>suspend measurement logging;
B9188: NOTE 0:If the UE detected and resolved IDC problem during the last logging interval, the UE does not suspend measurement logging from the next logging interval and does not suspend measurement logging for the last logging interval.
B9189: 3>set the relativeTimeStamp to indicate the elapsed time since the moment at which the logged measurement configuration was received;
B9190: 3>if location information became available during the last logging interval, set the content of the locationInfo as in 5.3.3.7:
B9191: 3>if the UE is in any cell selection state (as specified in TS 38.304 [20]):
B9192: 4>set anyCellSelectionDetected to indicate the detection of no suitable or no acceptable cell found;
B9193: 4>if the UE has performed cell reselection using reselection priorities for slice-based intra-NR cell reselection and was not able to camp on a suitable cell that supports the NSAG ID with the highest priority (as specified in TS 38.304 [20]) during the last logging interval:
B9194: 5>set the nsag-ID to the NSAG ID with the highest priority provided by upper layer (see TS 24.501 [23]) associated with the last failure in attempt to camp on a suitable cell that support the NSAG ID with the highest priority;
B9195: 5>set the reselectedCellId to the cell UE reselected after the last failure in attempt to camp on a suitable cell that support the NSAG ID with the highest priority before transition to any cell selection state;
B9196: 4>if the reportType is set to eventTriggered in the VarLogMeasConfig; and
B9197: 4>if the RPLMN at the time of entering the any cell selection state is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport or if the registered SNPN identity at the time of entering the any cell selection state is included in snpn-ConfigID-List stored in VarLogMeasReport; and
B9198: 4>if areaConfiguration is not included in VarLogMeasConfig, or if areaConfigurationNTN-List is included in VarLogMeasConfig and if the UE supports geographic area scope checking for logged MDT, or if the last suitable cell that the UE was camping on is part of the area indicated by areaConfig of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig, or if last suitable cell that the UE was camping on is part of the area indicated by cag-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig, or if last suitable cell that the UE was camping on is part of the area indicated by snpn-ConfigList of areaConfiguration in VarLogMeasConfig:
B9199: 5>set the servCellIdentity to indicate global cell identity of the last suitable cell that the UE was camping on;
B9200: 5>set the measResultServingCell to include the quantities of the last suitable cell the UE was camping on;
B9201: 4>else if the reportType is set to periodical in the VarLogMeasConfig:
B9202: 5>set the servCellIdentity to indicate global cell identity of the last logged cell that the UE was camping on;
B9203: 5>set the measResultServingCell to include the quantities of the last logged cell the UE was camping on;
B9204: 3>else:
B9205: 4>set the servCellIdentity to indicate global cell identity of the cell the UE is camping on;
B9206: 4>set the measResultServingCell to include the quantities of the cell the UE is camping on;
B9207: 4>if the UE has performed cell reselection using reselection priorities for slice-based intra-NR cell reselection and was not able to camp on a suitable cell that supports the NSAG ID with the highest priority (as specified in TS 38.304 [20]) during the last logging interval:
B9208: 5>set the nsag-ID to the NSAG ID with the highest priority provided by upper layer (see TS 24.501 [23]) associated with the last failure in attempt to camp on a suitable cell that support the NSAG ID with the highest priority;
B9209: 5>set the reselectedCellId to the cell UE reselected after the last failure in attempt to camp on a suitable cell that support the NSAG ID with the highest priority;
B9210: 3>if available, set the measResultNeighCells, in order of decreasing ranking-criterion as used for cell re-selection, to include measurements of neighbouring cell that became available during the last logging interval and according to the following:
B9211: 4>include measurement results for at most 6 neighbouring cells on the NR serving frequency and for at most 3 cells per NR neighbouring frequency and for the NR neighbouring frequencies in accordance with the following:
B9212: 5>if interFreqTargetInfo is included in VarLogMeasConfig:
B9213: 6>if earlyMeasIndication is included in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9214: 7>include measurement results for NR neighbouring frequencies that are included in both interFreqTargetInfo and either in measIdleCarrierListNR (within the VarMeasIdleConfig) or SIB4;
B9215: 6>else:
B9216: 7>include measurement results for NR neighbouring frequencies that are included in both interFreqTargetInfo and SIB4;
B9217: 5>else:
B9218: 6>if earlyMeasIndication is included in VarLogMeasConfig;
B9219: 7>include measurement results for NR neighbouring frequencies that are included in either measIdleCarrierListNR (within the VarMeasIdleConfig) or SIB4;
B9220: 6>else:
B9221: 7>include measurement results for NR neighbouring frequencies that are included in SIB4;
B9222: 4>include measurement results for at most 3 neighbours per inter-RAT frequency in accordance with the following:
B9223: 5>if earlyMeasIndication is included in VarLogMeasConfig:
B9224: 6>include measurement results for inter-RAT neighbouring frequencies that are included in either measIdleCarrierListEUTRA (within the VarMeasIdleConfig) or SIB5;
B9225: 5>else:
B9226: 6>include measurement results for inter-RAT frequencies that are included in SIB5;
B9227: 4>for each neighbour cell included, include the optional fields that are available;
B9228: NOTE 1:The UE includes the latest results of the available measurements as used for cell reselection evaluation in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, which are performed in accordance with the performance requirements as specified in TS 38.133 [14].
B9229: NOTE 2:For logging the measurements on frequencies (indicated in measIdleCarrierListNR/ measIdleCarrierListEUTRA) in the logged measurement, the qualityThreshold in measIdleConfig should not be applied, and how the UE logs the measurements on the frequencies is left to the UE implementation.
B9230: 2>when the memory reserved for the logged measurement information becomes full, stop timer T330 and perform the same actions as performed upon expiry of T330, as specified in 5.5a.1.4.
B9231: 5.5bApplication Layer Measurements in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE
B9232: 5.5b.1Handling of Application Layer Measurements in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE
B9233: 5.5b.1.1General
B9235: This procedure specifies the UE actions for a UE in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE that has an application layer measurement configuration with appLayerIdleInactiveConfig configured. The procedure includes area handling, storing of application layer measurement report containers and cell re-selection to LTE.
B9236: 5.5b.1.2Initiation
B9237: While in RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_IDLE state, the UE shall:
B9238: 1>store any previously or subsequently received application layer measurement report containers associated with the measConfigAppLayerId for which the successful transmission of the message or at least one segment of the message has not been confirmed by lower layers;
B9239: NOTE:The UE continues storing application layer measurement report containers for MBS broadcast service in RRC_CONNECTED as long as stored application layer measurement configurations/reports have not been retrieved.
B9240: 1>if the memory reserved for storing application layer measurement report containers becomes full:
B9241: 2>if the reports are associated with a configuration including appLayerMeasPriority:
B9242: 3>discard reports in priority order where reports with the lowest priority are discarded first, and among reports with equal associated priority, discard reports in the order they were received, where older reports are discarded first;
B9243: 2>else:
B9244: 3>discard reports in the order they were received, where older reports are discarded first;
B9245: 1>if qoe-AreaScope is configured:
B9246: 2>if the cell which the UE selects when the UE transits from RRC_CONNECTED state to RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state is part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope:
B9247: 3>inform upper layers of being inside the area;
B9248: 2>if the cell which the UE selects when the UE transits from RRC_CONNECTED state to RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_IDLE state is not part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope:
B9249: 3>inform upper layers of being outside the area.
B9250: 2>if the UE re-selects to a new cell which is part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope and the previous cell was not part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope:
B9251: 3>inform upper layers of being inside the area;
B9252: 2>if the UE re-selects to a new cell which is not part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope and the previous cell was part of the area indicated by qoe-AreaScope:
B9253: 3>inform upper layers of being outside the area.
B9254: 1>if the UE re-selects to an E-UTRA cell:
B9255: 2>inform upper layers about the release of all application layer measurement configurations;
B9256: 2>release all application layer measurement configurations including their fields in UE variables VarAppLayerIdleConfig and VarAppLayerPLMN-ListConfig;
B9257: 2>discard any application layer measurement reports which were not yet fully submitted to lower layers for transmission;
B9258: 2>consider itself not to be configured to send application layer measurement reports.
B9259: 5.5cLogged Measurements for Network-Side Data Collection
B9260: 5.5c.1Logged Measurement Configuration
B9261: 5.5c.1.1General
B9262: The purpose of this procedure is to configure the UE to perform logging of measurement results while in RRC_CONNECTED. This procedure applies to UEs in RRC_CONNECTED that are capable of logged measurements for network-side data collection.
B9263: 5.5c.1.2Initiation
B9264: NG-RAN initiates the logged measurement configuration procedure to UE in RRC_CONNECTED for a serving cell by sending csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList in the csi-MeasConfig of a serving cell.
B9265: 5.5c.1.3Reception of CSI-LoggedMeasurementConfig by the UE
B9266: Upon receiving csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList in the csi-MeasConfig of a serving cell, the UE shall:
B9267: 1>for each CSI logged measurement configuration included in csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList:
B9268: 2>if the current UE configuration for the serving cell includes the CSI logged measurement configuration associated with the given csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigId:
B9269: 3>modify the CSI logged measurement configuration according to the configuration received in csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList;
B9270: 3>reset the associated information (e.g. timeToTrigger) for the CSI logged measurement configuration with csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig;
B9271: NOTE:The UE keeps the logged data for a CSI logged measurement configuration when that configuration is modified.
B9272: 2>else:
B9273: 3>add the received CSI logged measurement configuration to the UE configuration;
B9274: 2>perform measurements logging as specified in 5.5c.3.2.
B9275: 5.5c.2Release of Network-Side Logged Measurement Configuration
B9276: 5.5c.2.1General
B9277: The purpose of this procedure is to release the logged measurement configuration for network-side data collection.
B9278: 5.5c.2.2Initiation
B9279: Upon receiving csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToReleaseList, the UE shall:
B9280: 1>for each CSI logged measurement configuration ID included in csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToReleaseList associated with a serving cell:
B9281: 2>if the current UE configuration for the associated serving cell includes a CSI logged measurement configuration with the associated CSI logged measurement configuration ID:
B9282: 3>release the CSI logged measurement configuration.
B9283: NOTE:The UE keeps the logged data for a CSI logged measurement configuration when that configuration is released.
B9284: 5.5c.3Measurements logging
B9285: 5.5c.3.1General
B9286: This procedure specifies the logging of available measurements by a UE in RRC_CONNECTED that has a logged measurement configuration for network-side data collection.
B9287: 5.5c.3.2Initiation
B9288: The UE shall:
B9289: 1>for each CSI logged measurement configuration, perform the logging of measurements for the serving cell where the CSI logged measurement configuration is configured, in accordance with the corresponding CSI logged measurement configuration:
B9290: 2>if the csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is not included and the memory for network-side data collection is not full:
B9291: 3>perform the logging at regular time intervals, according to loggingPeriodicity (if configured) or according to the periodicity of the resources indicated by csi-LoggedResourceConfig in the corresponding CSI logged measurement configuration, if loggingPeriodicity is not configured;
B9292: 2>if the csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is included and the memory for network-side data collection is not full:
B9293: 3>if eventId within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is set to eventA1 and the entering condition, as specified in 5.5.4.2, is fulfilled for the serving cell where the CSI logged measurement configuration is configured, for all measurements taken during timeToTrigger defined for this event; or
B9294: 3>if eventId within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is set to eventA2 and the entering condition, as specified in 5.5.4.3, is fulfilled for the serving cell where the CSI logged measurement configuration is configured, for all measurements taken during timeToTrigger defined for this event:
B9295: 4>perform the logging at regular time intervals, according to loggingPeriodicity (if configured) or according to the periodicity of the resources indicated by csi-LoggedResourceConfig in the corresponding CSI logged measurement configuration, if loggingPeriodicity is not configured;
B9296: 3>if eventId within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is set to eventA1 and the leaving condition, as specified in 5.5.4.2, is fulfilled for the serving cell where the CSI logged measurement configuration is configured, for all measurements taken during timeToTrigger defined for this event; or
B9297: 3>if eventId within csi-LoggedMeasurementEventTriggerConfig is set to eventA2 and the leaving condition, as specified in 5.5.4.3, is fulfilled for the serving cell where the CSI logged measurement configuration is configured, for all measurements taken during timeToTrigger defined for this event:
B9298: 4>stop performing the logging for the corresponding CSI logged measurement configuration;
B9299: 2>when performing the logging:
B9300: 3>if the cell identity of the serving cell for which the measurements shall be logged, i.e. the serving cell associated with the serving cell configuration for which csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList is included, is not included in an entry in csi-LogMeasInfoCellList in VarCSI-LogMeasReport:
B9301: 4>include an entry in csi-LogMeasInfoCellList within VarCSI-LogMeasReport;
B9302: 4>set cellId to the global cell identity, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the serving cell associated with the serving cell configuration for which csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigToAddModList is included;
B9303: 3>if not already present, include an entry in csi-LogMeasInfoConfigList within VarCSI-LogMeasReport and set refCSI-LoggedMeasurementConfigId to the csi-LoggedMeasurementConfigId associated to the CSI logged measurement configuration;
B9304: 3>for each CSI logged measurement configuration associated to refCSI-LoggedMeasurementConfigId in csi-LogMeasInfoConfigList in VarCSI-LogMeasReport:
B9305: 4>for each logging instance:
B9306: 5>include an entry in csi-LogMeasInfoList and set the csi-RS-MeasResultList and/or SSB-MeasResultList to include the quantities the UE is logging measurements for, upon receiving the quantities from the lower layers;
B9307: 5>if the time between the measurements that are logged and included in this instance of csi-LogMeasInfoList and the measurements for the previous instance of csi-LogMeasInfoList with the same refCSI-LoggedMeasurementConfigId, for the same serving cell, is longer than the loggingPeriodicity (if configured) or the periodicity of the measurement resources (if the loggingPeriodicity is not configured):
B9308: 6>set the timeGap to true;
B9309: 2>when the memory reserved for the logged measurement information for data collection becomes full, stop logging;
B9310: 2>when the memory reserved for the logged measurement information for data collection is no longer full, resume the procedures for logging.
B9311: 5.6UE capabilities
B9312: 5.6.1UE capability transfer
B9313: 5.6.1.1General
B9314: This clause describes how the UE compiles and transfers its UE capability information upon receiving a UECapabilityEnquiry from the network.
B9316: Figure 5.6.1.1-1: UE capability transfer
B9317: 5.6.1.2Initiation
B9318: The network initiates the procedure to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED when it needs (additional) UE radio access capability information. The network should retrieve UE capabilities only after AS security activation. Network does not forward UE capabilities that were retrieved before AS security activation to the CN.
B9319: 5.6.1.3Reception of the UECapabilityEnquiry by the UE
B9320: The UE shall set the contents of UECapabilityInformation message as follows:
B9321: 1>if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to nr:
B9322: 2>include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-NR-Capability and with the rat-Type set to nr;
B9323: 2>include the supportedBandCombinationList, featureSets and featureSetCombinations as specified in clause 5.6.1.4;
B9324: 1>if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to eutra-nr:
B9325: 2> if the UE supports (NG)EN-DC or NE-DC:
B9326: 3>include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-MRDC-Capability and with the rat-Type set to eutra-nr;
