B9329: 2>if the UE supports E-UTRA:
B9330: 3>include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a ue-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-EUTRA-Capability associated with the terrestrial network and with the rat-Type set to eutra as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.6.3.3, according to the capabilityRequestFilter, if received;
B9331: 1>if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to utra-fdd:
B9332: 2>if the UE supports UTRA-FDD:
B9333: 3>include the UE radio access capabilities for UTRA-FDD within a ue-CapabilityRAT-Container and with the rat-Type set to utra-fdd;
B9334: 1>if the RRC message segmentation is enabled based on the field rrc-SegAllowed received, and the encoded RRC message is larger than the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323 [5]:
B9335: 2>consider the maximum number of UL segments the UE is allowed to use when segmenting the UECapabilityInformation message is 16;
B9336: 2>initiate the UL message segment transfer procedure as specified in clause 5.7.7;
B9337: 1>else if the RRC message segmentation is enabled based on the field rrc-MaxCapaSegAllowed received, and the encoded RRC message is larger than the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323 [5]:
B9338: 2>consider the maximum number of UL segments the UE is allowed to use when segmenting the UECapabilityInformation message to be the value indicated by rrc-MaxCapaSegAllowed;
B9339: 2>initiate the UL message segment transfer procedure as specified in clause 5.7.7;
B9340: 1>else:
B9341: 2>submit the UECapabilityInformation message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B9342: 5.6.1.4Setting band combinations, feature set combinations and feature sets supported by the UE
B9343: The UE invokes the procedures in this clause if the NR or E-UTRA network requests UE capabilities for nr, eutra-nr or eutra. This procedure is invoked once per requested rat-Type (see clause 5.6.1.3 for capability enquiry by the NR network; see TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.6.3.3 for capability enquiry by the E-UTRA network). The UE shall ensure that the feature set IDs are consistent across feature sets, feature set combinations and band combinations in all three UE capability containers that the network queries with the same fields with the same values, i.e. UE-CapabilityRequestFilterNR, UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon, rrc-SegAllowed and fields in UECapabilityEnquiry message (i.e. requestedFreqBandsNR-MRDC, requestedCapabilityNR, eutra-nr-only flag, requestedCapabilityCommon, and rrc-SegAllowed) as defined in TS 36.331 [10], where applicable.
B9344: NOTE 1:Capability enquiry without frequencyBandListFilter is not supported.
B9345: NOTE 2:In (NG)EN-DC, the gNB needs the capabilities for RAT types nr and eutra-nr and it uses the featureSets in the UE-NR-Capability together with the featureSetCombinations in the UE-MRDC-Capability to determine the NR UE capabilities for the supported MRDC band combinations. Similarly, the eNB needs the capabilities for RAT types eutra and eutra-nr and it uses the featureSetsEUTRA in the UE-EUTRA-Capability together with the featureSetCombinations in the UE-MRDC-Capability to determine the E-UTRA UE capabilities for the supported MRDC band combinations. Hence, the IDs used in the featureSets must match the IDs referred to in featureSetCombinations across all three containers. The requirement on consistency implies that there are no undefined feature sets and feature set combinations.
B9346: NOTE 3:If the UE cannot include all feature sets and feature set combinations due to message size or list size constraints, it is up to UE implementation which feature sets and feature set combinations it prioritizes.
B9347: NOTE 3a:For the usage of rrc-MaxCapaSegAllowed, if the NR or E-UTRA network does not request UE capabilities for nr, eutra-nr and eutra in a single enquiry, the feature set IDs might not be consistent across feature sets, feature set combinations and band combinations in all three UE capability containers.
B9348: The UE shall:
B9349: 1>if the UE is an eRedCap UE and the UE supports eRedCapIgnoreCapabilityFiltering:
B9350: 2> ignore the value received in frequencyBandListFilter;
B9351: 2>in the remainder of this procedure assume frequencyBandListFilter indicates all the supported bands of the UE;
B9352: 1>compile a list of "candidate band combinations" according to the filter criteria in capabilityRequestFilterCommon (if included), only consisting of bands included in frequencyBandListFilter, and prioritized in the order of frequencyBandListFilter (i.e. first include band combinations containing the first-listed band, then include remaining band combinations containing the second-listed band, and so on), where for each band in the band combination, the parameters of the band do not exceed maxBandwidthRequestedDL, maxBandwidthRequestedUL, maxCarriersRequestedDL, maxCarriersRequestedUL, ca-BandwidthClassDL-EUTRA or ca-BandwidthClassUL-EUTRA, whichever are received;
B9353: 1>for each band combination included in the list of "candidate band combinations":
B9354: 2>if the network (E-UTRA) included the eutra-nr-only field, or
B9355: 2>if the requested rat-Type is eutra:
B9356: 3>remove the NR-only band combination from the list of "candidate band combinations";
B9357: NOTE 4:The (E-UTRA) network may request capabilities for nr but indicate with the eutra-nr-only flag that the UE shall not include any NR band combinations in the UE-NR-Capability. In this case the procedural text above removes all NR-only band combinations from the candidate list and thereby also avoids inclusion of corresponding feature set combinations and feature sets below.
B9358: 2>if it is regarded as a fallback band combination with the same capabilities of another band combination included in the list of "candidate band combinations", and
B9359: 2>if this fallback band combination is generated by releasing at least one SCell or uplink configuration of SCell or SUL according to TS 38.306 [26]:
B9360: 3>remove the band combination from the list of "candidate band combinations";
B9361: NOTE 5:Even if the network requests (only) capabilities for nr, it may include E-UTRA band numbers in the frequencyBandListFilter to ensure that the UE includes all necessary feature sets needed for subsequently requested eutra-nr capabilities. At this point of the procedure the list of "candidate band combinations" contains all NR- and/or E-UTRA-NR band combinations that match the filter (frequencyBandListFilter) provided by the NW and that match the eutra-nr-only flag (if RAT-Type nr is requested by E-UTRA). In the following, this candidate list is used to derive the band combinations, feature set combinations and feature sets to be reported in the requested capability container.
B9362: 1>if the requested rat-Type is nr:
B9363: 2>include into supportedBandCombinationList as many NR-only band combinations as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", starting from the first entry;
B9364: 3>if srs-SwitchingTimeRequest is received:
B9365: 4>if SRS carrier switching is supported;
B9366: 5>include srs-SwitchingTimesListNR and srs-SwitchingAffectedBandsListNR for each band combination;
B9367: 4>set srs-SwitchingTimeRequested to true;
B9368: 2>include, into featureSetCombinations, the feature set combinations referenced from the supported band combinations as included in supportedBandCombinationList according to the previous;
B9369: 2>compile a list of "candidate feature set combinations" referenced from the list of "candidate band combinations" excluding entries (rows in feature set combinations) with same or lower capabilities;
B9370: 2>if uplinkTxSwitchRequest is received:
B9371: 3>include into supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch as many NR-only band combinations that supported UL TX switching as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", starting from the first entry;
B9372: 4>if srs-SwitchingTimeRequest is received:
B9373: 5>if SRS carrier switching is supported;
B9374: 6>include srs-SwitchingTimesListNR and srs-SwitchingAffectedBandsListNR for each band combination;
B9375: 5>set srs-SwitchingTimeRequested to true;
B9376: 3>include, into featureSetCombinations, the feature set combinations referenced from the supported band combinations as included in supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch according to the previous;
B9377: NOTE 6:This list of "candidate feature set combinations" contains the feature set combinations used for NR-only as well as E-UTRA-NR band combinations. It is used to derive a list of NR feature sets referred to from the feature set combinations in the UE-NR-Capability and from the feature set combinations in a UE-MRDC-Capability container.
B9378: 2>if sidelinkRequest is received:
B9379: 3>for a sidelink band combination the UE included in supportedBandCombinationListSidelinkEUTRA-NR, supportedBandCombinationListSL-RelayDiscovery, supportedBandCombinationListSL-U2U-RelayDiscovery or supportedBandCombinationListSL-NonRelayDiscovery:
B9380: 4>if the UE supports partial sensing for a band of the sidelink band combination, include the partial sensing capabilities for the band using the sl-TransmissionMode2-PartialSensing-r17;
B9381: 3>set sidelinkRequested to true;
B9382: 2>include into featureSets the feature sets referenced from the "candidate feature set combinations" and may exclude the feature sets with the parameters that exceed any of maxBandwidthRequestedDL, maxBandwidthRequestedUL, maxCarriersRequestedDL or maxCarriersRequestedUL, whichever are received;
B9383: 1>else, if the requested rat-Type is eutra-nr:
B9384: 2>include into supportedBandCombinationList and/or supportedBandCombinationListNEDC-Only as many E-UTRA-NR band combinations as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", starting from the first entry;
B9385: 3>if srs-SwitchingTimeRequest is received:
B9386: 4>if SRS carrier switching is supported;
B9387: 5>include srs-SwitchingTimesListNR, srs-SwitchingTimesListEUTRA and srs-SwitchingAffectedBandsListNR for each band combination;
B9388: 4>set srs-SwitchingTimeRequested to true;
B9389: 2>include, into featureSetCombinations, the feature set combinations referenced from the supported band combinations as included in supportedBandCombinationList according to the previous;
B9390: 2>if uplinkTxSwitchRequest is received:
B9391: 3>include into supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch as many E-UTRA-NR band combinations that supported UL TX switching as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", starting from the first entry;
B9392: 4>if srs-SwitchingTimeRequest is received:
B9393: 5>if SRS carrier switching is supported;
B9394: 6>include srs-SwitchingTimesListNR, srs-SwitchingTimesListEUTRA and srs-SwitchingAffectedBandsListNR for each band combination;
B9395: 5>set srs-SwitchingTimeRequested to true;
B9396: 3>include, into featureSetCombinations, the feature set combinations referenced from the supported band combinations as included in supportedBandCombinationList-UplinkTxSwitch according to the previous;
B9397: 1>else (if the requested rat-Type is eutra):
B9398: 2>compile a list of "candidate feature set combinations" referenced from the list of "candidate band combinations" excluding entries (rows in feature set combinations) with same or lower capabilities;
B9399: NOTE 7:This list of "candidate feature set combinations" contains the feature set combinations used for E-UTRA-NR band combinations. It is used to derive a list of E-UTRA feature sets referred to from the feature set combinations in a UE-MRDC-Capability container.
B9400: 2>include into featureSetsEUTRA (in the UE-EUTRA-Capability) the feature sets referenced from the "candidate feature set combinations" and may exclude the feature sets with the parameters that exceed ca-BandwidthClassDL-EUTRA or ca-BandwidthClassUL-EUTRA, whichever are received;
B9401: 1>if the UE is an eRedCap UE and the UE supports eRedCapIgnoreCapabilityFiltering, i.e., it assumes frequencyBandListFilter to be the filter containing all the supported bands of the UE:
B9402: 2>include all the supported bands of the UE in the field appliedFreqBandListFilter, except if the requested rat-Type is nr and the network included the eutra-nr-only field;
B9403: 1>else:
B9404: 2>include the received frequencyBandListFilter in the field appliedFreqBandListFilter of the requested UE capability, except if the requested rat-Type is nr and the network included the eutra-nr-only field;
B9405: 1>if the network included ue-CapabilityEnquiryExt:
B9406: 2>include the received ue-CapabilityEnquiryExt in the field receivedFilters;
B9407: 5.6.1.5Void
B9408: 5.7Other
B9409: 5.7.1DL information transfer
B9410: 5.7.1.1General
B9412: Figure 5.7.1.1-1: DL information transfer
B9413: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer NAS dedicated information from NG-RAN to a UE in RRC_CONNECTED or to a UE in RRC_INACTIVE during SDT, or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB Donor-CU to IAB-DU via the collocated IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED.
B9414: 5.7.1.2Initiation
B9415: The network initiates the DL information transfer procedure whenever there is a need to transfer NAS dedicated information, or F1-C related information to an IAB-node. The network initiates the DL information transfer procedure by sending the DLInformationTransfer message.
B9416: 5.7.1.3Reception of the DLInformationTransfer by the UE
B9417: Upon receiving DLInformationTransfer message, the UE shall:
B9418: 1>if dedicatedNAS-Message is included:
B9419: 2>forward dedicatedNAS-Message to upper layers.
B9420: 1>if referenceTimeInfo is included:
B9421: 2>calculate the reference time based on the time, referenceSFN and timeInfoType if it is included;
B9422: 2>calculate the uncertainty of the reference time based on the uncertainty, if uncertainty is included;
B9423: 2>inform upper layers of the reference time and, if uncertainty is included, of the uncertainty;
B9424: 2>ignore all further referenceTimeInfo received in SIB9, if any.
B9425: 1>if sib9Fallback is included:
B9426: 2>apply referenceTimeInfo in SIB9.
B9427: 1>if rxTxTimeDiff-gNB is included:
B9428: 2>calculate the propagation delay based on the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement and the received Rx-Tx time difference measurement at the gNB;
B9429: 2>inform upper layers of the propagation delay.
B9430: 1>if ta-PDC is set to activate:
B9431: 2>inform upper layers of the propagation delay determined by the accumulated Timing Advance commands.
B9432: 1>if clockQualityDetailsLevel is included:
B9433: 2>store the eventID-TSS as the storedEventID within VarTSS-Info;
B9434: 2>if the UE is NPN capable and the cell is an NPN-only cell:
B9435: 3>derive a gNB identity from gNB-ID-Length and cellIdentity of the first NPN-IdentityInfo list entry of NPN-IdentityInfoList in SIB1, and derive the plmn-Identity of the first NPN-Identity list entry of NPN-IdentityList in SIB1 included in the first NPN-IdentityInfo list entry of NPN-IdentityInfoList in SIB1, as defined in TS 38.413 [42];
B9436: 2>else:
B9437: 3>derive a gNB identity from gNB-ID-Length and cellIdentity of the first PLMN-IdentityInfo list entry of PLMN-IdentityInfoList in SIB1, and derive the plmn-Identity of the first PLMN-IdentityInfo list entry of PLMN-IdentityInfoList in SIB1, as defined in TS 38.413 [42];
B9438: 2>store the global gNB identity derived from SIB1 as the storedGlobalGnbID within VarTSS-Info;
B9439: 2>forward clockQualityDetailsLevel to upper layers.
B9440: Upon receiving DLInformationTransfer message, the IAB-MT shall:
B9441: 1>if dedicatedInfoF1c is included:
B9442: 2>forward dedicatedInfoF1c to the collocated IAB-DU.
B9443: 5.7.1aDL information transfer for MR-DC
B9444: 5.7.1a.1General
B9446: Figure 5.7.1a.1-1: DL information transfer MR-DC
B9447: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer RRC messages from the network to the UE over SRB3 (e.g. an NR RRC reconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync, an E-UTRA RRC connection reconfiguration message including mobilityControlInfo, an RRC connection release message, a MobilityFromNRCommand message, or a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message) during fast MCG link recovery.
B9448: 5.7.1a.2Initiation
B9449: The network initiates this procedure whenever there is a need to transfer an RRC message during fast MCG link recovery.
B9450: 5.7.1a.3Actions related to reception of DLInformationTransferMRDC message
B9451: Upon receiving the DLInformationTransferMRDC, the UE shall:
B9452: 1>if the RRCReconfiguration message is included in dl-DCCH-MessageNR:
B9453: 2>perform the RRC reconfiguration procedure according to 5.3.5.3;
B9454: 1>else if the RRCRelease message is included in dl-DCCH-MessageNR:
B9455: 2>perform the RRC release procedure according to 5.3.8;
B9456: 1>else if the MobilityFromNRCommand message is included in the dl-DCCH-MessageNR:
B9457: 2>perform the mobility from NR procedure according to 5.4.3.3;
B9458: 1>else if the E-UTRA RRCConnectionReconfiguration message is included in dl-DCCH-MessageEUTRA:
B9459: 2>perform the RRC connection reconfiguration procedure as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.3.5.4;
B9460: 1>else if the E-UTRA RRCConnectionRelease message is included in dl-DCCH-MessageEUTRA:
B9461: 2>perform the RRC connection release as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.3.8;
B9462: 1>else if the MobilityFromEUTRACommand message is included in the dl-DCCH-MessageEUTRA:
B9463: 2>perform the mobility from E-UTRA procedure as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.4.3.3;
B9464: 5.7.2UL information transfer
B9465: 5.7.2.1General
B9467: Figure 5.7.2.1-1: UL information transfer
B9468: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer NAS dedicated information from the UE to the network in RRC_CONNECTED or in RRC_INACTIVE during SDT, or to transfer F1-C related information from IAB-DU to IAB Donor-CU via the collocated IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED.
B9469: 5.7.2.2Initiation
B9470: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED or a UE in RRC_INACTIVE during SDT initiates the UL information transfer procedure whenever there is a need to transfer NAS dedicated information. The UE initiates the UL information transfer procedure by sending the ULInformationTransfer message. In addition, an IAB-MT in RRC_CONNECTED initiates the UL information transfer procedure whenever there is a need to transfer F1-C related information. When F1-C related information has to be transferred, the IAB-MT shall initiate the procedure only if SRB2 or split SRB2 is established.
B9472: 5.7.2.3Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransfer message
B9473: The UE shall set the contents of the ULInformationTransfer message as follows:
B9474: 1>if the upper layer provides NAS PDU:
B9475: 2>set the dedicatedNAS-Message to include the information received from upper layers;
B9476: 1>for the IAB-MT, if there is a need to transfer F1-C related information:
B9477: 2>include the dedicatedInfoF1c;
B9478: 1>submit the ULInformationTransfer message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B9479: 5.7.2.4Failure to deliver ULInformationTransfer message
B9480: The UE shall:
B9481: 1>if AS security is not started and radio link failure occurs before the successful delivery of ULInformationTransfer messages has been confirmed by lower layers; or
B9482: 1>if PDCP re-establishment or release/addition (e.g due to key refresh upon PCell or PSCell change, or RRC connection re-establishment, or failure of resume procedure initiated for SDT) occurs on an SRB on which ULInformationTransfer messages were submitted for transmission but successful delivery of these messages was not confirmed by lower layers:
B9483: 2>inform upper layers about the possible failure to deliver the information contained in the concerned ULInformationTransfer messages, unless the messages only include dedicatedInfoF1c.
B9484: 5.7.2aUL information transfer for MR-DC
B9485: 5.7.2a.1General
B9487: Figure 5.7.2a.1-1: UL information transfer MR-DC
B9488: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer MR-DC dedicated information from the UE to the network e.g. the NR or E-UTRA RRC MeasurementReport, FailureInformation, UEAssistanceInformation, RRCReconfigurationComplete, MCGFailureInformation, or IABOtherInformation message.
B9489: 5.7.2a.2Initiation
B9490: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED initiates the UL information transfer for MR-DC procedure whenever there is a need to transfer MR-DC dedicated information. I.e. the procedure is not used during an RRC connection reconfiguration involving NR or E-UTRA connection reconfiguration, in which case the MR DC information is piggybacked to the RRCReconfigurationComplete message, except in the case the UE executes an intra-SN CPC.
B9491: 5.7.2a.3Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransferMRDC message
B9492: The UE shall set the contents of the ULInformationTransferMRDC message as follows:
B9493: 1>if there is a need to transfer MR-DC dedicated information related to NR:
B9494: 2>set the ul-DCCH-MessageNR to include the NR MR-DC dedicated information to be transferred (e.g., NR RRC MeasurementReport, UEAssistanceInformation, FailureInformation, RRCReconfigurationComplete, MCGFailureInformation, or IABOtherInformation message);
B9495: 1>else if there is a need to transfer MR-DC dedicated information related to E-UTRA:
B9496: 2>set the ul-DCCH-MessageEUTRA to include the E-UTRA MR-DC dedicated information to be transferred (e.g., E-UTRA RRC MeasurementReport, or MCGFailureInformation message);
B9497: 1>submit the ULInformationTransferMRDC message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B9498: 5.7.2bUL transfer of IRAT information
B9499: 5.7.2b.1General
B9501: Figure 5.7.2b.1-1: UL transfer of IRAT information
B9502: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer from the UE to NR MCG dedicated information terminated at the NR MCG but specified by another RAT e.g. the E-UTRA MeasurementReport message, the E-UTRA SidelinkUEInformation message or the E-UTRA UEAssistanceInformation message. The specific information transferred in this message is set in accordance with:
B9503: -the procedure specified in 5.6.10 of TS 36.331 [10] for E-UTRA UEAssistanceInformation message;
B9504: -the procedure specified in 5.10.2 of TS 36.331 [10] for E-UTRA SidelinkUEInformation message;
B9505: -the procedure specified in 5.5.5 of TS 36.331 [10] for E-UTRA MeasurementReport Message.
B9506: 5.7.2b.2Initiation
B9507: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED initiates the UL information transfer procedure whenever there is a need to transfer dedicated inter-RAT information as specified in TS 36.331 [10].
B9508: 5.7.2b.3Actions related to transmission of ULInformationTransferIRAT message
B9509: The UE shall set the contents of the ULInformationTransferIRAT message as follows:
B9510: 1>if there is a need to transfer dedicated LTE information related to V2X sidelink communications:
B9511: 2>set the ul-DCCH-MessageEUTRA to include the V2X sidelink communication information to be transferred (e.g. the E-UTRA RRC MeasurementReport message, the E-UTRA RRC SidelinkUEInformation message, or the E-UTRA RRC UEAssistanceInformation message);
B9512: 1>submit the ULInformationTransferIRAT message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends;
B9513: 5.7.3SCG failure information
B9514: 5.7.3.1General
B9516: Figure 5.7.3.1-1: SCG failure information
B9517: The purpose of this procedure is to inform E-UTRAN or NR MN about an SCG failure the UE has experienced i.e. SCG radio link failure, beam failure of the PSCell while the SCG is deactivated, failure of SCG reconfiguration with sync, SCG configuration failure for RRC message on SRB3, SCG integrity check failure, and consistent uplink LBT failures on PSCell for operation with shared spectrum channel access.
B9518: 5.7.3.2Initiation
B9519: A UE initiates the procedure to report SCG failures when neither MCG nor SCG transmission is suspended and when one of the following conditions is met:
B9520: 1>upon detecting radio link failure for the SCG, in accordance with clause 5.3.10.3;
B9521: 1>upon detecting beam failure of the PSCell while the SCG is deactivated, in accordance with TS 38.321[3];
B9522: 1>upon reconfiguration with sync failure of the SCG, in accordance with clause 5.3.5.8.3;
B9523: 1>upon SCG configuration failure, in accordance with clause 5.3.5.8.2;
B9524: 1>upon integrity check failure indication from SCG lower layers concerning SRB3.
B9525: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B9526: 1>if the procedure was not initiated due to beam failure of the PSCell while the SCG is deactivated:
B9527: 2>suspend SCG transmission for all SRBs, DRBs and, if any, BH RLC channels;
B9528: 2>reset SCG MAC;
B9529: 1>stop T304 for the SCG, if running;
B9530: 1>stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CPC, CPA, or subsequent CPAC, if configured;
B9531: 1>stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for each CHO configuration that includes condExecutionCondPSCell, if configured;
B9532: 1>if the UE is in (NG)EN-DC:
B9533: 2>initiate transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.6.13a.
B9534: 1>else:
B9535: 2>initiate transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message in accordance with 5.7.3.5.
B9536: 5.7.3.3Failure type determination for (NG)EN-DC
B9537: The UE shall set the SCG failure type as follows:
B9538: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to T310 expiry:
B9539: 2>set the failureType as t310-Expiry;
B9540: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to T312 expiry:
B9541: 2>set the failureType as any value and set the failureType-v1610 as t312-Expiry;
B9542: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message to provide reconfiguration with sync failure information for an SCG:
B9543: 2>set the failureType as synchReconfigFailureSCG;
B9544: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message to provide random access problem indication from SCG MAC:
B9545: 2>if the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery:
B9546: 3>set the failureType as randomAccessProblem and set the failureType-v1610 as beamFailureRecoveryFailure;
B9547: 2>else:
B9548: 3>set the failureType as randomAccessProblem;
B9549: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message to provide indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached:
B9550: 2>set the failureType as rlc-MaxNumRetx;
B9551: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to SRB3 integrity check failure:
B9552: 2>set the failureType as srb3-IntegrityFailure;
B9553: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to Reconfiguration failure of NR RRC reconfiguration message:
B9554: 2>set the failureType as scg-reconfigFailure;
B9555: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to consistent uplink LBT failures:
B9556: 2>set the failureType as any value and set the failureType-v1610 as scg-lbtFailure;
B9557: 1> else if connected as an IAB-node and the SCGFailureInformationNR is initiated due to the reception of a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the SCG:
B9558: 2>set the failureType as any value and set failureType-v1610 as bh-RLF.
B9559: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to beam failure of the PSCell while the SCG is deactivated:
B9560: 2>set the failureType as any value and set failureType-v1610 as beamFailure.
B9561: 5.7.3.4Setting the contents of MeasResultSCG-Failure
B9562: The UE shall set the contents of the MeasResultSCG-Failure as follows:
B9563: 1>for each MeasObjectNR configured on NR SCG for which a measId is configured and measurement results are available:
B9564: 2>include an entry in measResultPerMOList;
B9565: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to ssb:
B9566: 3>set ssbFrequency to the value indicated by ssbFrequency as included in the MeasObjectNR;
B9567: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to csi-rs:
B9568: 3>set refFreqCSI-RS to the value indicated by refFreqCSI-RS as included in the associated measurement object;
B9569: 2>if a serving cell is associated with the MeasObjectNR:
B9570: 3>set measResultServingCell to include the available quantities of the concerned cell and in accordance with the performance requirements in TS 38.133 [14];
B9571: 2>set the measResultNeighCellList to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first, and based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and set its fields as follows;
B9572: 3>ordering the cells with sorting as follows:
B9573: 4>based on SS/PBCH block if SS/PBCH block measurement results are available and otherwise based on CSI-RS;
B9574: 4>using RSRP if RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise using RSRQ if RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise using SINR;
B9575: 3>for each neighbour cell included:
B9576: 4>include the optional fields that are available.
B9577: 3>if the UE supports SCG failure information for mobility robustness optimization for conditional PSCell change, for each neighbour cell, if any, included in measResultSCG-Failure:
B9578: 4>if the neighbour cell is one of the candidate cells for which the reconfigurationWithSync is included in the secondaryCellGroup in the MCG VarConditionalReconfig (for inter-SN CPC in NR-DC) or SCG VarConditionalReconfig (for intra-SN CPC) at the moment of the detected SCG failure (radio link failure at PSCell or PSCell change failure):
B9579: 5>if the first entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure; or
B9580: 5>if the second entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell, if available, corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure:
B9581: 6>set firstTriggeredEvent to the execution condition condFirstEvent corresponding to the first entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell or to the execution condition condSecondEvent corresponding to the second entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell, whichever execution condition was fulfilled first in time;
B9582: 6>set timeBetweenEvents to the elapsed time between the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled first in time, and the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled second in time, if both the first execution condition corresponding to the first entry and the second execution condition corresponding to the second entry in the condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell were fulfilled;
B9583: NOTE:The measured quantities are filtered by the L3 filter as configured in the mobility measurement configuration. The measurements are based on the time domain measurement resource restriction, if configured. Exclude-listed cells are not required to be reported.
B9584: 1>if available, set the locationInfo as in 5.3.3.7 according to the otherConfig associated with the NR SCG.
B9585: 5.7.3.5Actions related to transmission of SCGFailureInformation message
B9586: The UE shall set the contents of the SCGFailureInformation message as follows:
B9587: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to T310 expiry:
B9588: 2>set the failureType as t310-Expiry;
B9589: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to T312 expiry:
B9590: 2>set the failureType as other and set the failureType-v1610 as t312-Expiry;
B9591: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message to provide reconfiguration with sync failure information for an SCG:
B9592: 2>set the failureType as synchReconfigFailureSCG;
B9593: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message to provide random access problem indication from SCG MAC:
B9594: 2>if the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery:
B9595: 3>set the failureType as other and set the failureType-v1610 as beamFailureRecoveryFailure;
B9596: 2>else:
B9597: 3>set the failureType as randomAccessProblem;
B9598: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message to provide indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached:
B9599: 2>set the failureType as rlc-MaxNumRetx;
B9600: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to SRB3 IP check failure:
B9601: 2>set the failureType as srb3-IntegrityFailure;
B9602: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to Reconfiguration failure of NR RRC reconfiguration message:
B9603: 2>set the failureType as scg-reconfigFailure;
B9604: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to consistent uplink LBT failures:
B9605: 2>set the failureType as other and set the failureType-v1610 as scg-lbtFailure;
B9606: 1>else if connected as an IAB-node and the SCGFailureInformation is initiated due to the reception of a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the SCG:
B9607: 2>set the failureType as other and set failureType-v1610 as bh-RLF;
B9608: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformation message due to beam failure of the PSCell while the SCG is deactivated:
B9609: 2>set the failureType as other and set failureType-v1610 as beamFailure;
B9610: 1> include and set MeasResultSCG-Failure in accordance with 5.7.3.4;
B9611: 1>for each MeasObjectNR configured by a MeasConfig associated with the MCG, and for which measurement results are available:
B9612: 2>include an entry in measResultFreqList;
B9613: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to ssb:
B9614: 3>set ssbFrequency in measResultFreqList to the value indicated by ssbFrequency as included in the MeasObjectNR;
B9615: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to csi-rs:
B9616: 3>set refFreqCSI-RS in measResultFreqList to the value indicated by refFreqCSI-RS as included in the associated measurement object;
B9617: 2>if a serving cell is associated with the MeasObjectNR:
B9618: 3>set measResultServingCell in measResultFreqList to include the available quantities of the concerned cell and in accordance with the performance requirements in TS 38.133 [14];
B9619: 2>set the measResultNeighCellList in measResultFreqList to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first, and based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and set its fields as follows;
B9620: 3>ordering the cells with sorting as follows:
B9621: 4>based on SS/PBCH block if SS/PBCH block measurement results are available and otherwise based on CSI-RS;
B9622: 4>using RSRP if RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise using RSRQ if RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise using SINR;
B9623: 3>if the UE supports SCG failure information for mobility robustness optimization for conditional PSCell change or addition or if the UE supports SCG failure information for mobility robustness optimization for CHO with candidate SCG(s), for each neighbour cell, if any, included in measResultListNR in measResultFreqList:
B9624: 4>if the neighbour cell is one of the candidate cells for which the reconfigurationWithSync is included in the secondaryCellGroup in the MCG VarConditionalReconfig (for CPA or inter-SN CPC in NR-DC) or SCG VarConditionalReconfig (for intra-SN CPC) at the moment of the detected SCG failure (radio link failure at PSCell or PSCell change or addition failure):
B9625: 5>if the first entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure; or
B9626: 5>if the second entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell, if available, corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure:
B9627: 6>set firstTriggeredEvent to the execution condition condFirstEvent corresponding to the first entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell or to the execution condition condSecondEvent corresponding to the second entry of condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell, whichever execution condition was fulfilled first in time;
B9628: 6>set timeBetweenEvents to the elapsed time between the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled first in time, and the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled second in time, if both the first execution condition corresponding to the first entry and the second execution condition corresponding to the second entry in the condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondSCG associated to the neighbour cell were fulfilled;
B9629: 3>if the UE supports SCG failure information for mobility robustness optimization for CHO with candidate SCG(s), for each neighbour cell, if any, included in measResultListNR in measResultFreqList:
B9630: 4>if the neighbour cell is one of the candidate cells for which the reconfigurationWithSync is associated with both condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell in the MCG VarConditionalReconfig at the moment of the detected SCG failure (radio link failure at PSCell or PSCell change or addition failure):
B9631: 5>if the first entry of condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure; or
B9632: 5>if the second entry of condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell, if available, corresponds to a fulfilled execution condition at the moment of SCG failure:
B9633: 6>set firstTriggeredEvent to the execution condition condFirstEvent corresponding to the first entry of condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell or to the execution condition condSecondEvent corresponding to the second entry of condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell, whichever execution condition was fulfilled first in time;
B9634: 6>set timeBetweenEvents to the elapsed time between the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled first in time, and the point in time of fulfilling the condition in condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell that was fulfilled second in time, if both the first execution condition corresponding to the first entry and the second execution condition corresponding to the second entry in the condExecutionCond associated to the neighbour cell were fulfilled;
B9635: 3>for each neighbour cell included:
B9636: 4>include the optional fields that are available.
B9637: NOTE 1:The measured quantities are filtered by the L3 filter as configured in the mobility measurement configuration. The measurements are based on the time domain measurement resource restriction, if configured. Exclude-listed cells are not required to be reported.
B9638: NOTE 2:Field measResultSCG-Failure is used to report available results for NR frequencies the UE is configured to measure by SCG RRC signalling.
B9639: 1>for each entry of condReconfigList in the MCG VarConditionalReconfig including both condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell, include an entry in cho-WithCandidateSCGInfoList and set the values as follows:
B9640: 2>if all triggering events of both condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell of the concerned entry of condReconfigList are fulfilled:
B9641: 3>set firstFulfilledConfig to cho if condExecutionCond was fulfilled first or cpac if condExecutionCondPSCell was fulfilled first;
B9642: 3>set timeBetweenFulfillment to the elapsed time between the fulfillments of the last triggering events of the two execution conditions;
B9643: 2>else if all triggering events of only one of the condExecutionCond or condExecutionCondPSCell of the concerned entry of condReconfigList is fulfilled:
B9644: 3>set firstFulfilledConfig to cho or cpac, whichever was fulfilled;
B9645: 3>set timeBetweenLastFulfillmentAndFailure to the elapsed time between the point in time of fulfilling the last triggering event of the fulfilled execution condition and the SCG radio link failure;
B9646: 2>if all triggering events of any of condExecutionCond and condExecutionCondPSCell are fulfilled:
B9647: 3>set the pCellId to the global cell identity and tracking area code, if available, and otherwise the physical cell identity and carrier frequency, of the target candidate PCell stored in the condRRCReconfig of the concerned entry of condReconfigList;
B9648: 3>set the psCellId to the global cell identity and tracking area code, if available, and otherwise the physical cell identity and carrier frequency, of the target candidate PSCell stored in the condRRCReconfig of the concerned entry of condReconfigList;
B9649: 1>if available, set the locationInfo as in 5.3.3.7 according to the otherConfig associated with the NR MCG.
B9650: 1>if the UE supports SCG failure report for mobility robustness optimization or SCG failure report for CPAC or if the UE supports SCG failure for mobility robustness optimization for subsequent CPAC:
B9651: 2>if the failureType is set to synchReconfigFailureSCG; or
B9652: 2>if the failureType is set to randomAccessProblem and the SCG failure was declared while T304 was running:
B9653: 3>set perRAInfoList to indicate the performed random access procedure related information as specified in 5.7.10.5.
B9654: 3>set the failedPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the target PSCell of the failed PSCell change or failed PSCell addition;
B9655: 3>set the timeSCGFailure to the elapsed time since the last execution of RRCReconfiguration message including the reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG until declaring the SCG failure;
B9656: 3>if the last RRCReconfiguration message including the reconfigurationWithSync for the PSCell change was received to enter the PSCell in which the SCG failure was declared:
B9657: 4>if the failure occurred during a subsequent CPC execution:
B9658: 5>set the previousPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the source PSCell associated to the last execution of RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG;
B9659: 4>else:
B9660: 5>set the previousPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the source PSCell associated to the last received RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG;
B9661: 2>else:
B9662: 3>set the failedPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell in which the SCG failure was declared;
B9663: 3>set the timeSCGFailure to the elapsed time since the last execution of RRCReconfiguration message including the reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG until declaring the SCG failure;
B9664: 3>if the last RRCReconfiguration message including the reconfigurationWithSync for the PSCell change was received to enter the PSCell in which the SCG failure was declared:
B9665: 4>if the failure occurred after a subsequent CPC execution and if the UE supports SCG failure for mobility robustness optimization for subsequent CPAC:
B9666: 5>set the previousPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the source PSCell associated to the last execution of RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG;
B9667: 4>else:
B9668: 5>set the previousPSCellId to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the source PSCell associated to the last received RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync for the SCG;
B9669: 1>release successPSCell-Config configured by the source PSCell, if available.
B9670: The UE shall submit the SCGFailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission.
B9671: 5.7.3aEUTRA SCG failure information
B9672: 5.7.3a.1General
B9674: Figure 5.7.3a.1-1: EUTRA SCG failure information
B9675: The purpose of this procedure is to inform NR MN about an SCG failure on E-UTRA SN the UE has experienced (e.g. SCG radio link failure, SCG change failure), as specified in TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.6.13.2.
B9676: 5.7.3a.2Initiation

Actions the UE shall perform upon initiating the procedure, other than related to the transmission of the SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message are specified in TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.6.13.2.
B9678: 5.7.3a.3Actions related to transmission of SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message

B9680: 1>include failureType within failureReportSCG-EUTRA and set it to indicate the SCG failure in accordance with TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.6.13.4;
B9681: 1>include and set measResultSCG-FailureMRDC in accordance with TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.6.13.5;
B9682: 1>for each EUTRA frequency the UE is configured to measure by measConfig for which measurement results are available:
B9683: 2>set the measResultFreqListMRDC to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first using RSRP to order if RSRP measurement results are available for cells on this frequency, otherwise using RSRQ to order if RSRQ measurement results are available for cells on this frequency, otherwise using SINR to order, and based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and for each cell that is included, include the optional fields that are available;
B9684: NOTE:Field measResultSCG-FailureMRDC is used to report available results for E-UTRAN frequencies the UE is configured to measure by E-UTRA RRC signalling.
B9685: 1>if available, set the locationInfo as in 5.3.3.7.:
B9686: The UE shall submit the SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message to lower layers for transmission.
B9687: 5.7.3bMCG failure information
B9688: 5.7.3b.1General
B9690: Figure 5.7.3b.1-1: MCG failure information
B9691: The purpose of this procedure is to inform the network about an MCG failure the UE has experienced i.e. MCG radio link failure. A UE in RRC_CONNECTED, for which AS security has been activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB setup or, for IAB, SRB2, may initiate the fast MCG link recovery procedure in order to continue the RRC connection without re-establishment.
B9692: 5.7.3b.2Initiation
B9693: In case of MR-DC, a UE configured with split SRB1 or SRB3 initiates the procedure to report MCG failures when neither MCG nor SCG transmission is suspended, the SCG is not deactivated, t316 is configured, and when the following condition is met; or
B9694: In case of MP, a MP remote UE configured with split SRB1 initiates the procedure to report direct path failures when neither MCG (i.e. direct path) nor indirect path transmission is suspended, t316 is configured, and when the following condition is met:
B9695: 1>upon detecting radio link failure of the MCG, in accordance with 5.3.10.3, while T316 is not running.
B9696: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B9698: 1>stop timer T310 for the PCell, if running;
B9699: 1>stop timer T312 for the PCell, if running;
B9700: 1>suspend MCG transmission for all SRBs, DRBs, multicast MRBs, except SRB0, and, if any, BH RLC channels;
B9701: 1>reset MCG MAC;
B9702: 1>stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CHO or CHO with candidate SCG(s), if configured;
B9703: 1>stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CPC or subsequent CPAC, if configured;
B9704: 1>stop the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L3 measurements for all the LTM candidate configurations associated with the MCG, if configured;
B9705: 1>if LTM cell switch conditions evaluation was done based on L1 measurements:
B9706: 2>request lower layers to stop the LTM cell switch conditions evaluation based on L1 measurements for all LTM candidate configurations;
B9707: 1>initiate transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message in accordance with 5.7.3b.4.
B9708: NOTE:The handling of any outstanding UL RRC messages during the initiation of the fast MCG link recovery is left to UE implementation.
B9709: 5.7.3b.3Failure type determination
B9710: The UE shall set the MCG failure type as follows:
B9711: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to T310 expiry:
B9712: 2>set the failureType as t310-Expiry;
B9713: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to T312 expiry:
B9714: 2>set the failureType as t312-Expiry;
B9715: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message to provide random access problem indication from MCG MAC:
B9716: 2>if the random access procedure was initiated for beam failure recovery:
B9717: 3>set the failureType as beamFailureRecoveryFailure;
B9718: 2>else:
B9719: 3>set the failureType as randomAccessProblem;
B9720: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message to provide indication from MCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached:
B9721: 2>set the failureType as rlc-MaxNumRetx:
B9722: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to consistent uplink LBT failures on the MCG:
B9723: 2>set the failureType as lbt-Failure;
B9724: 1>else if connected as an IAB-node and the MCGFailureInformation message is initiated due to the reception of a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the MCG:
B9725: 2>set the failureType as bh-RLF.
B9726: 5.7.3b.4Actions related to transmission of MCGFailureInformation message
B9727: The UE shall set the contents of the MCGFailureInformation message as follows:
B9728: 1>include and set failureType in accordance with 5.7.3b.3;
B9729: 1>for each MeasObjectNR configured by a measConfig associated with the MCG, and for which measurement results are available:
B9730: 2>include an entry in measResultFreqList;
B9731: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to ssb:
B9732: 3>set ssbFrequency in measResultFreqList to the value indicated by ssbFrequency as included in the MeasObjectNR;
B9733: 2>if there is a measId configured with the MeasObjectNR and a reportConfig which has rsType set to csi-rs:
B9734: 3>set refFreqCSI-RS in measResultFreqList to the value indicated by refFreqCSI-RS as included in the associated measurement object;
B9735: 2>if a serving cell is associated with the MeasObjectNR:
B9736: 3>set measResultServingCell in measResultFreqList to include the available quantities of the concerned cell and in accordance with the performance requirements in TS 38.133 [14];
B9737: 2>set the measResultNeighCellList in measResultFreqList to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first, and based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and set its fields as follows;
B9738: 3>ordering the cells with sorting as follows:
B9739: 4>based on SS/PBCH block if SS/PBCH block measurement results are available and otherwise based on CSI-RS;
B9740: 4>using RSRP if RSRP measurement results are available, otherwise using RSRQ if RSRQ measurement results are available, otherwise using SINR;
B9741: 3>for each neighbour cell included:
B9742: 4>include the optional fields that are available.
B9743: 1>for each EUTRA frequency the UE is configured to measure by measConfig for which measurement results are available:
B9744: 2>set the measResultFreqListEUTRA to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first using RSRP to order the cells if RSRP measurement results are available for cells on this frequency, otherwise using RSRQ to order the cells if RSRQ measurement results are available for cells on this frequency, otherwise using SINR to order the cells, based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and for each cell that is included, include the optional fields that are available;
B9745: 1>for each UTRA-FDD frequency the UE is configured to measure by measConfig for which measurement results are available:
B9746: 2>set the measResultFreqListUTRA-FDD to include the best measured cells, ordered such that the best cell is listed first using RSCP to order the cells if RSCP measurement results are available for cells on this frequency, otherwise using EcN0 to order the cells, based on measurements collected up to the moment the UE detected the failure, and for each cell that is included, include the optional fields that are available;
B9748: 1>if the UE is in NR-DC:
B9749: 2>include and set measResultSCG in accordance with 5.7.3.4;
B9750: 1>if the UE is in NE-DC:
B9751: 2>include and set measResultSCG-EUTRA in accordance with TS 36.331 [10] clause 5.6.13.5;
B9752: NOTE 1:The measured quantities are filtered by the L3 filter as configured in the mobility measurement configuration. The measurements are based on the time domain measurement resource restriction, if configured. Exclude-listed cells are not required to be reported.
B9753: NOTE 2:Field measResultSCG-Failure is used to report available results for NR frequencies the UE is configured to measure by SCG RRC signalling.
B9754: NOTE 3:Field measResultSCG-EUTRA is used to report available results for E-UTRAN frequencies the UE is configured to measure by E-UTRA RRC signalling.
B9755: 1>if SRB1 is configured as split SRB and pdcp-Duplication is not configured:
B9756: 2>if the primaryPath for the PDCP entity of SRB1 refers to the direct path when MP is configured:
B9757: 3>set the primaryPath to refer to the indirect path;
B9758: 2>else if the primaryPath for the PDCP entity of SRB1 refers to the MCG:
B9759: 3>set the primaryPath to refer to the SCG.
B9760: The UE shall:
B9761: 1>start timer T316;
B9762: 1>if SRB1 is configured as split SRB:
B9763: 2>submit the MCGFailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission via SRB1, upon which the procedure ends;
B9764: 1>else (i.e. SRB3 configured):
B9765: 2>submit the MCGFailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission embedded in NR RRC message ULInformationTransferMRDC via SRB3 as specified in 5.7.2a.3.
B9766: 5.7.3b.5T316 expiry
B9767: The UE shall:
B9768: 1>if T316 expires:
B9769: 2>if the UE supports RLF-Report for fast MCG recovery procedure:
B9770: 3>set the pSCellId in the VarRLF-Report to the global cell identity of the PSCell, if available, otherwise to the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of the PSCell;
B9771: 3>set the mcg-RecoveryFailureCause in VarRLF-Report to t316-Expiry;
B9772: 2>initiate the connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7.
B9773: 5.7.3cIndirect path failure information
B9774: 5.7.3c.1General
B9776: Figure 5.7.3c.1-1: Indirect path failure information
B9777: The purpose of this procedure is to inform the network about an indirect path failure the MP remote UE has experienced.
B9778: 5.7.3c.2Initiation
B9779: In case of MP, a MP remote UE initiates the procedure to report indirect path failures when neither MCG transmission nor indirect path transmission is suspended and when one of the following conditions is met:
B9780: 1>upon detecting a SL indirect path failure resulting from sidelink radio link failure on the PC5 unicast link or reception of NotificationMessageSidelink from the L2 U2N Relay UE (except indicating relayUE-HO), or SL indirect path addition/change failure in accordance with 5.3.5.17.2.3, or PC5-RRC connection release requested by upper layers in accordance with clause 5.8.9.5; or
B9781: 1>upon detecting a N3C indirect path failure, including N3C connection failure or Uu failure of the N3C relay UE with N3C indirect path, or N3C indirect path addition/change failure in accordance with 5.3.5.17.3.2a;
B9782: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B9783: 1>if the procedure was initiated to report SL indirect path failure:
B9784: 2>reset the sidelink specific MAC of the L2 U2N relay UE;
B9785: 2>stop T421 if running;
B9786: 1>suspend indirect path transmission for all SRBs and DRBs;
B9787: 1>initiate transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message in accordance with 5.7.3c.4;
B9788: 5.7.3c.3Failure type determination
B9789: The L2 U2N Remote UE configured with SL indirect path shall set the indirect path failure type as follows:
B9790: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to T421 expiry in accordance with clause 5.3.5.16.1.3:
B9791: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as t421-Expiry;
B9792: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to reception of the NotificationMessageSidelink including indicationType, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.10.4:
B9793: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as the value in indicationType received from NotificationMessageSidelink (except relayUE-CellReselection);
B9794: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to sidelink radio link failure in accordance with clause 5.8.9.3:
B9795: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as sl-Failure;
B9796: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to PC5-RRC connection release requested by upper layers in accordance with clause 5.8.9.5:
B9797: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as sl-PC5-Release;
B9798: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to that the (target) L2 U2N Relay UE (i.e., the UE indicated by sl-IndirectPathRelayUE-Identity in the received sl-IndirectPathAddChange) changes its serving cell to a different cell from the target cell (i.e. the cell indicated by sl-IndirectPathCellIdentity in the received sl-IndirectPathAddChange) during path addition or change:
B9799: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as indirectPathAddChangeFailure;
B9800: The N3C remote UE shall set the indirect path failure type as follows:
B9801: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to N3C connection failure:
B9802: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as n3c-Failure;
B9803: 1>else if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to Uu radio link failure on N3C indirect path in accordance with clause 5.3.10.3:
B9804: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as relayUE-Uu-RLF;
B9805: 1>if the UE initiates transmission of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message due to N3C Indirect path addition/change failure in accordance with clause 5.3.5.17.3.2a:
B9806: 2>set the failureTypeIndirectPath as indirectPathAddChangeFailure.
B9807: NOTE:It is out of 3GPP scope how the remote UE detects N3C connection failure, or how the relay UE indicates Uu RLF to the remote UE on the N3C connection.
B9808: 5.7.3c.4Actions related to transmission of IndirectPathFailureInformation message
B9809: The UE shall set the contents of the IndirectPathFailureInformation message as follows:
B9810: 1>set the failureTypeIndirectPath in accordance with 5.7.3c.3;
B9811: 1>if the procedure was initiated to report SL indirect path failure:
B9812: 2>set the sl-MeasResultServingRelay to include the measurement result for serving L2 U2N Relay UE if available;
B9813: 2>for each measObjectRelay included in MeasConfig, and for which measurement results are available:
B9814: 3>include an entry in sl-MeasResultsCandRelay;
B9815: 1>else if the procedure was initiated to report N3C indirect path failure;
B9816: 2>include n3c-relayUE-InfoList to report relay UE information with non-3GPP connection(s) if available;
B9817: 1>submit the IndirectPathFailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission.
B9818: 5.7.4UE Assistance Information
B9819: 5.7.4.1General
B9821: Figure 5.7.4.1-1: UE Assistance Information
B9822: The purpose of this procedure is for the UE to inform the network of:
B9823: -its delay budget report carrying desired increment/decrement in the connected mode DRX cycle length; or
B9824: -its overheating assistance information; or
B9825: -its IDC assistance information; or

B9834: -its preference for FR2 UL gap; or
B9835: -its preference to transition out of RRC_CONNECTED state for MUSIM operation; or
B9836: -its preference on the MUSIM gaps; or

B9841: -its relaxation state for BFD measurements; or

B9859: 5.7.4.2Initiation
B9860: A UE capable of providing delay budget report in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, including upon being configured to provide delay budget report and upon change of delay budget preference.
B9861: A UE capable of providing overheating assistance information in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon detecting internal overheating, or upon detecting that it is no longer experiencing an overheating condition.
B9862: A UE capable of providing IDC assistance information in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon detecting IDC problem if the UE did not transmit an IDC assistance information since it was configured to provide IDC indications, or upon change of IDC problem information.
B9863: A UE capable of providing its preference on DRX parameters of a cell group for power saving or its preference on cell DTX/DRX related parameters in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, if it was configured to do so, including upon having a preference on DRX parameters or cell DTX/DRX related parameters and upon change of its preference on DRX parameters or cell DTX/DRX related parameters.
B9864: A UE capable of providing its preference on the maximum aggregated bandwidth of a cell group for power saving in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, if it was configured to do so, including upon having a maximum aggregated bandwidth preference and upon change of its maximum aggregated bandwidth preference.
B9865: A UE capable of providing its preference on the maximum number of secondary component carriers of a cell group for power saving in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, if it was configured to do so, including upon having a maximum number of secondary component carriers preference and upon change of its maximum number of secondary component carriers preference.
B9866: A UE capable of providing its preference on the maximum number of MIMO layers of a cell group for power saving in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, if it was configured to do so, including upon having a maximum number of MIMO layers preference and upon change of its maximum number of MIMO layers preference.
B9867: A UE capable of providing its preference on the minimum scheduling offset for cross-slot scheduling of a cell group for power saving in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, if it was configured to do so, including upon having a minimum scheduling offset preference and upon change of its minimum scheduling offset preference.
B9868: A UE capable of providing assistance information to transition out of RRC_CONNECTED state may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining that it prefers to transition out of RRC_CONNECTED state, or upon change of its preferred RRC state.
B9869: A UE capable of providing configured grant assistance information for NR sidelink communication in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure in several cases, including upon being configured to provide traffic pattern information and upon change of traffic patterns.
B9870: A UE capable of providing an indication of its preference in being provisioned with reference time information may initiate the procedure upon being configured to provide this indication, or if it was configured to provide this indication and upon change of its preference.
B9871: A UE capable of providing an indication of its preference in FR2 UL gap may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon detecting the need of FR2 UL gap activation/deactivation.
B9872: A UE capable of providing MUSIM assistance information for gap preference may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining it needs the gaps, or upon change of the gap preference information.
B9873: A UE capable of providing MUSIM assistance information for gap priority preference and/or preference to keep the colliding MUSIM gaps may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining it has gap priority preference information and/or it has preference to keep the colliding MUSIM gaps.
B9874: A UE capable of providing MUSIM assistance information for leave indication may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so upon determining that it needs to leave RRC_CONNECTED state.
B9875: A UE capable of providing MUSIM assistance information for temporary capability restriction may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining it has temporary capability restriction or upon determining the removal of the capability restriction.
B9876: A UE capable of relaxing its RLM measurements of a cell group in RRC_CONNECTED state shall initiate the procedure for providing an indication of its relaxation state for RLM measurements upon being configured to do so, and upon change of its relaxation state for RLM measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state.
B9877: A UE capable of relaxing its BFD measurements in serving cells of a cell group in RRC_CONNECTED shall initiate the procedure for providing an indication of its relaxation state for BFD measurements upon being configured to do so, and upon change of its relaxation state for BFD measurements in RRC_CONNECTED state.
B9878: A UE capable of SDT initiates this procedure when data and/or signalling mapped to radio bearers that are not configured for SDT becomes available during SDT (i.e. while SDT procedure is ongoing).
B9879: A UE capable of providing its preference for SCG deactivation may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining that it prefers or does no more prefer the SCG to be deactivated.
B9880: A UE that has uplink data to transmit for a DRB for which there is no MCG RLC bearer while the SCG is deactivated shall initiate the procedure.
B9881: A UE capable of providing an indication of fulfilment of the RRM measurement relaxation criterion in connected mode may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon change of its fulfilment status for RRM measurement relaxation criterion for connected mode.
B9882: A UE capable of providing service link propagation delay difference between serving cell and neighbour cell(s) shall initiate the procedure upon being configured to do so, and upon determining that service link propagation delay difference between serving cell and a neighbour cell has changed more than threshPropDelayDiff compared with the last reported value.
B9883: A UE capable of providing an indication of its preference on multi-Rx operation for FR2 may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon detecting having a preference on multi-Rx operation for FR2 and upon change of its preference on multi-Rx operation for FR2.
B9884: A UE capable of indicating the availability of flight path information may initiate the procedure, if it was configured to do so, upon determining that an initial or updated flight path information is available.
B9885: A UE capable of providing UL traffic information shall initiate the procedure when this information is available upon being configured to do so, and upon change of UL traffic information.
B9886: A UE capable of N3C remote UE operation initiates the procedure upon being configured to report relay UE information on the available non-3GPP connection(s), and upon change of its available non-3GPP connection(s).
B9887: A UE capable of providing configured grant assistance information including SL-PRS transmission periodicity, priority, bandwidth and delay budget for NR sidelink positioning in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure.
B9888: A UE capable of providing UE's preference for gap occasion cancellation ratio initiates the procedure upon being configured to do so when the UE has a preference for gap occasion cancellation ratio, or upon change of its preference.
B9889: A UE capable of providing its preference on time offset for LP-WUS monitoring may initiate the procedure in several cases, including upon being configured to provide its preference on time offset for LP-WUS monitoring and upon change of its preference on time offset for LP-WUS monitoring.
B9890: A UE capable of applicability reporting based on inference configuration provided via CSI-ReportConfig or based on inference related parameter configuration provided via OtherConfig may initiate the procedure if it was configured with configurations subject to the applicability determination procedure (i.e. CSI report configurations including csi-InferencePrediction or, if disableApplicabilityCSI-ReportConfig in applicabilityReportConfig is not configured, including configurationForBM-PredictionAndDataCollection with reportQuantity-r19 set to p-CRI or p-SSB-Index or p-CRI-RSRP or p-SSB-Index-RSRP, or ApplicabilitySetConfigCSI configurations), upon determining that the applicability of a configuration subject to the applicability determination procedure changed from inapplicable to applicable. A UE capable of applicability reporting based on inference configuration provided via CSI-ReportConfig or based on inference related parameter configuration provided via OtherConfig shall initiate the procedure if it was configured with configurations subject to the applicability determination procedure, upon determining that the applicability of a configuration subject to the applicability determination procedure changed from applicable to inapplicable.
B9891: A UE capable of UE-side data collection and providing its preference to be configured with or stop being configured with radio resources to perform UE-side data collection may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining that it prefers to perform UE-side data collection, or upon determining a list of preferred radio resource configurations for UE-side data collection, or upon determining a list of radio resource configurations for which it prefers to stop UE-side data collection.
B9892: A UE capable of logging measurements for network-side data collection shall initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining that it has entered a low power state, or upon determining that the memory reserved for the logging of radio measurements for network-side data collection has become full.
B9893: A UE capable of logging measurements for network-side data collection and of providing a data availability indication based on a memory threshold shall initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining that the amount of logged data related to radio measurements for network-side data collection reached a configured memory threshold.
B9894: A UE capable of providing closest reference location information for assisted SMTC and measurement gap configuration in RRC_CONNECTED state shall initiate the procedure upon being configured to do so, and upon determining that the closest reference location(s) have changed compared with the last reported values.
B9895: A UE capable of providing its preference on L3 fast beam sweeping operation may initiate the procedure if it was configured to do so, upon determining it has a preference on L3 fast beam sweeping operation, or upon change of its preference on L3 fast beam sweeping operation.

B9929: NOTE 2:For the frequencies or frequency range(s) on which a serving cell or serving cells is configured that is activated, IDC problems consist of interference issues that the UE cannot solve by itself, during either active data exchange or upcoming data activity which is expected in up to a few hundred milliseconds.For frequencies or frequency range(s) on which a SCell or SCells is configured that is deactivated, reporting IDC problems indicates an anticipation that the activation of the SCell or SCells would result in interference issues that the UE would not be able to solve by itself.For a non-serving frequency or frequency range(s), reporting IDC problems indicates an anticipation that if the non-serving frequency or frequencies or frequency range(s) became a serving frequency or serving frequencies or frequency range(s) then this would result in interference issues that the UE would not be able to solve by itself.

B10491: 5.7.4.4Relaxed measurement criterion for a stationary (e)RedCap UE
B10492: The relaxed measurement criterion for a stationary UE is met when:
B10493: -(SS-RSRPRefStationaryConnected – SS-RSRP) < SSearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected,
B10494: Where:
B10495: -SS-RSRP = current L3 RSRP measurement of the PCell based on SSB (dB).
B10496: -SS-RSRPRefStationaryConnected = reference SS-RSRP value of the PCell (dB), set as follows:
B10497: -at the end of RRC reconfiguration procedure as specified in 5.3.5.3, when rrm-MeasRelaxationReportingConfig is included in the RRCReconfiguration message; or
B10498: -after MAC successfully completes a Random Access procedure after applying a reconfigurationWithSync in spCellConfig while stationary criterion is configured; or
B10499: -upon an indication from lower layers that a RACH-less handover or an LTM cell switch is successfully completed for the CG while stationary criterion is configured, or
B10500: -if (SS-RSRP – SS-RSRPRefStationaryConnected) > 0; or
B10501: -if the relaxed measurement criterion has not been met for TSearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected:
B10502: -UE shall set the value of SS-RSRPRefStationaryConnected to the current SS-RSRP value of the serving cell.
