B10504: 5.7.5Failure information
B10505: 5.7.5.1General
B10507: Figure 5.7.5.1-1: Failure information
B10508: The purpose of this procedure is to inform the network about a failure detected by the UE.
B10509: 5.7.5.2Initiation
B10510: A UE initiates the procedure when there is a need inform the network about a failure detected by the UE. In particular, the UE initiates the procedure when the following condition is met:
B10511: 1>upon detecting failure for an RLC bearer, in accordance with 5.3.10.3;
B10512: 1>upon detecting DAPS handover failure, in accordance with 5.3.5.8.3;
B10513: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B10514: 1>initiate transmission of the FailureInformation message as specified in 5.7.5.3;
B10515: 5.7.5.3Actions related to transmission of FailureInformation message
B10516: The UE shall:
B10517: 1>if initiated to provide RLC failure information, set FailureInfoRLC-Bearer as follows:
B10518: 2>set logicalChannelIdentity to the logical channel identity of the failing RLC bearer;
B10519: 2>set cellGroupId to the cell group identity of the failing RLC bearer;
B10520: 2>set the failureType as rlc-failure;
B10521: 1>if initiated to provide DAPS failure information, set FailureInfoDAPS as follows:
B10522: 2>set the failureType as daps-failure;
B10523: 1>if used to inform the network about a failure for an MCG RLC bearer or DAPS failure information:
B10524: 2>submit the FailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission via SRB1;
B10525: 1>else if used to inform the network about a failure for an SCG RLC bearer:
B10526: 2>if SRB3 is configured;
B10527: 3>submit the FailureInformation message to lower layers for transmission via SRB3;
B10528: 2>else;
B10529: 3>if the UE is in (NG)EN-DC:
B10530: 4>submit the FailureInformation message via E-UTRA SRB1 embedded in E-UTRA RRC message ULInformationTransferMRDC as specified in TS 36.331 [10].
B10531: 3>else if the UE is in NR-DC:
B10532: 4>submit the FailureInformation message via SRB1 embedded in NR RRC message ULInformationTransferMRDC as specified in clause 5.7.2a.3.
B10533: 5.7.6DL message segment transfer
B10534: 5.7.6.1General
B10536: Figure 5.7.6.1-1: DL message segment transfer
B10537: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer segments of DL DCCH messages from the network to the UE.
B10538: NOTE:The segmentation of DL DCCH message is only applicable to RRCReconfiguration and RRCResume messages in this release.
B10539: 5.7.6.2Initiation
B10540: The network initiates the DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure whenever the encoded RRC message PDU exceeds the maximum PDCP SDU size. The network initiates the DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure by sending the DLDedicatedMessageSegment message.
B10541: 5.7.6.3Reception of DLDedicatedMessageSegment by the UE
B10542: Upon receiving DLDedicatedMessageSegment message, the UE shall:
B10543: 1>store the segment included in rrc-MessageSegmentContainer;
B10544: 1>if all segments of the message have been received:
B10545: 2>assemble the message from the received segments and process the message according to 5.3.5.3 for the RRCReconfiguration message or 5.3.13.4 for the RRCResume message;
B10546: 2>discard all segments.
B10547: 5.7.7UL message segment transfer
B10548: 5.7.7.1General
B10550: Figure 5.7.7.1-1: UL message segment transfer
B10551: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer segments of UL DCCH messages from UE to a NG-RAN in RRC_CONNECTED.
B10552: NOTE:The segmentation of UL DCCH message is only applicable to UECapabilityInformation and MeasurementReportAppLayer in this release.
B10553: 5.7.7.2Initiation
B10554: A UE capable of UL RRC message segmentation in RRC_CONNECTED will initiate the procedure when the following conditions are met:
B10555: 1>if the RRC message segmentation is enabled based on the field rrc-SegAllowed, rrc-MaxCapaSegAllowed, rrc-SegAllowedSRB4 or rrc-SegAllowedSRB5 received, and
B10556: 1>if the encoded RRC message is larger than the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323 [5];
B10557: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B10558: 1>initiate transmission of the ULDedicatedMessageSegment message as specified in 5.7.7.3;
B10559: 5.7.7.3Actions related to transmission of ULDedicatedMessageSegment message
B10560: The UE shall segment the encoded RRC PDU based on the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323 [5] and the maximum number of UL segments according to rrc-SegAllowed or rrc-MaxCapaSegAllowed (for segmentation of UECapabilityInformation) and rrc-SegAllowedSRB4 or rrc-SegAllowedSRB5 (for segmentation of MeasurementReportAppLayer), if received. UE shall minimize the number of segments and set the contents of the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages as follows:
B10561: 1>For each new UL DCCH message, set the segmentNumber to 0 for the first message segment and increment the segmentNumber for each subsequent RRC message segment;
B10562: 1>set rrc-MessageSegmentContainer to include the segment of the UL DCCH message corresponding to the segmentNumber;
B10563: 1>if the segment included in the rrc-MessageSegmentContainer is the last segment of the UL DCCH message:
B10564: 2>set the rrc-MessageSegmentType to lastSegment;
B10565: 1>else:
B10566: 2>set the rrc-MessageSegmentType to notLastSegment;
B10567: 1>submit all the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages generated for the segmented RRC message to lower layers for transmission in ascending order based on the segmentNumber, upon which the procedure ends.
B10568: 5.7.8Idle/inactive Measurements
B10569: 5.7.8.1General
B10570: This procedure specifies the measurements to be performed and stored by a UE in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE when it has an idle/inactive measurement configuration.
B10571: 5.7.8.1aMeasurement configuration
B10572: The purpose of this procedure is to update the idle/inactive measurement configuration.
B10573: The UE initiates this procedure while T331 is running and SDT procedure is not ongoing and one of the following conditions is met:
B10574: 1>upon selecting a cell when entering RRC_IDLE or RRC-INACTIVE from RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE; or
B10575: 1>upon update of system information (SIB4, or SIB11), e.g. due to intra-RAT cell (re)selection;
B10576: While in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, and T331 is running, the UE shall:
B10577: 1>if VarMeasIdleConfig includes neither a measIdleCarrierListEUTRA nor a measIdleCarrierListNR received from the RRCRelease message:
B10578: 2>if the UE supports idleInactiveEUTRA-MeasReport:
B10579: 3>if the SIB11 includes the measIdleConfigSIB and contains measIdleCarrierListEUTRA:
B10580: 4>store or replace the measIdleCarrierListEUTRA of measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10581: 3>else:
B10582: 4>remove the measIdleCarrierListEUTRA in VarMeasIdleConfig, if stored;
B10583: 2>if the UE supports idleInactiveNR-MeasReport:
B10584: 3>if SIB11 includes the measIdleConfigSIB and contains measIdleCarrierListNR:
B10585: 4>store or replace the measIdleCarrierListNR of measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10586: 3>else:
B10587: 4>remove the measIdleCarrierListNR in VarMeasIdleConfig, if stored;
B10588: 1>if VarEnhMeasIdleConfig does not include measIdleValidityDuration received from the RRCRelease message:
B10589: 2>if the UE supports measValidationReportEMR:
B10590: 3>if SIB11 includes the measIdleConfigSIB and contains measIdleValidityDuration:
B10591: 4>store or replace the measIdleValidityDuration of measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 within VarEnhMeasIdleConfig;
B10592: 3>else:
B10593: 4>remove the measIdleValidityDuration in VarEnhMeasIdleConfig, if stored;
B10594: 1>for each entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig that does not contain an ssb-MeasConfig received from the RRCRelease message:
B10595: 2>if there is an entry in measIdleCarrierListNR in measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 that has the same carrier frequency and subcarrier spacing as the entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig and that contains ssb-MeasConfig:
B10596: 3>delete the ssb-MeasConfig of the corresponding entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10597: 3>store the SSB measurement configuration from SIB11 into nrofSS-BlocksToAverage, absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation, smtc, ssb-ToMeasure, deriveSSB-IndexFromCell, and ss-RSSI-Measurement within ssb-MeasConfig of the corresponding entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10598: 2>else if there is an entry in interFreqCarrierFreqList of SIB4 with the same carrier frequency and subcarrier spacing as the entry in measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig:
B10599: 3>delete the ssb-MeasConfig of the corresponding entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10600: 3>store the SSB measurement configuration from SIB4 into nrofSS-BlocksToAverage, absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation, smtc, ssb-ToMeasure, deriveSSB-IndexFromCell, and ss-RSSI-Measurement within ssb-MeasConfig of the corresponding entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig;
B10601: 2>else:
B10602: 3>remove the ssb-MeasConfig of the corresponding entry in the measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig, if stored;
B10603: 1>perform measurements according to 5.7.8.2a.
B10604: 5.7.8.1bMeasurement configuration (reselection measurements)
B10605: The purpose of this procedure is to update the reselection measurement configuration.
B10606: The UE initiates this procedure while SDT procedure is not ongoing and one of the following conditions is met:
B10607: 1>upon selecting a cell when entering RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE from RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE; or
B10608: 1>upon update of system information (SIB11), e.g., due to intra-RAT cell (re)selection;
B10609: While in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, the UE shall:
B10610: 1>if VarMeasReselectionConfig does not include measReselectionCarrierListNR received from the RRCRelease message:
B10611: 2>if the UE supports reselection measurement reporting:
B10612: 3>if SIB11 includes the measIdleConfigSIB and contains measReselectionCarrierListNR:
B10613: 4>store or replace the measReselectionCarrierListNR of measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 within VarMeasReselectionConfig;
B10614: 3>else:
B10615: 4>remove the measReselectionCarrierListNR in VarMeasReselectionConfig, if stored;
B10616: 1>if VarMeasReselectionConfig does not include measReselectionValidityDuration received from the RRCRelease message:
B10617: 2>if the UE supports reselection measurement reporting:
B10618: 3>if SIB11 includes the measIdleConfigSIB and contains measReselectionValidityDuration:
B10619: 4>store or replace the measReselectionValidityDuration of measIdleConfigSIB of SIB11 within VarMeasReselectionConfig;
B10620: 3>else:
B10621: 4>remove the measReselectionValidityDuration in VarMeasReselectionConfig, if stored.
B10622: 5.7.8.2Void
B10623: 5.7.8.2aPerforming measurements
B10624: When performing measurements on NR carriers according to this clause, the UE shall derive the cell quality as specified in 5.5.3.3 and consider the beam quality to be the value of the measurement results of the concerned beam, where each result is averaged as described in TS 38.215 [9].
B10625: While in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, and T331 is running and SDT procedure is not ongoing, the UE shall:
B10626: 1>perform the measurements in accordance with the following:
B10627: 2>if the VarMeasIdleConfig includes the measIdleCarrierListEUTRA and the SIB1 contains idleModeMeasurementsEUTRA:
B10628: 3>for each entry in measIdleCarrierListEUTRA within VarMeasIdleConfig:
B10629: 4>if UE supports NE-DC between the serving carrier and the carrier frequency indicated by carrierFreqEUTRA within the corresponding entry:
B10630: 5>perform measurements in the carrier frequency and bandwidth indicated by carrierFreqEUTRA and allowedMeasBandwidth within the corresponding entry;
B10631: 5>if the reportQuantitiesEUTRA is set to rsrq:
B10632: 6>consider RSRQ as the sorting quantity;
B10633: 5>else:
B10634: 6>consider RSRP as the sorting quantity;
B10635: 5>if the measCellListEUTRA is included:
B10636: 6>consider cells identified by each entry within the measCellListEUTRA to be applicable for idle/inactive mode measurement reporting;
B10637: 5>else:
B10638: 6>consider up to maxCellMeasIdle strongest identified cells, according to the sorting quantity, to be applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting;
B10639: 5>for all cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting, derive measurement results for the measurement quantities indicated by reportQuantitiesEUTRA;
B10640: 5>store the derived measurement results as indicated by reportQuantitiesEUTRA within the measReportIdleEUTRA in VarMeasIdleReport in decreasing order of the sorting quantity, i.e. the best cell is included first, as follows:
B10641: 6>if qualityThresholdEUTRA is configured:
B10642: 7>include the measurement results from the cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting whose RSRP/RSRQ measurement results are above the value(s) provided in qualityThresholdEUTRA;
B10643: 6>else:
B10644: 7>include the measurement results from all cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting;
B10645: 2>if the VarMeasIdleConfig includes the measIdleCarrierListNR and the SIB1 contains idleModeMeasurementsNR:
B10646: 3>for each entry in measIdleCarrierListNR within VarMeasIdleConfig that contains ssb-MeasConfig:
B10647: 4>if UE supports carrier aggregation or NR-DC between serving carrier and the carrier frequency and subcarrier spacing indicated by carrierFreq and ssbSubCarrierSpacing within the corresponding entry:
B10648: 5>perform measurements in the carrier frequency and subcarrier spacing indicated by carrierFreq and ssbSubCarrierSpacing within the corresponding entry;
B10649: 5>if the reportQuantities is set to rsrq:
B10650: 6>consider RSRQ as the cell sorting quantity;
B10651: 5>else:
B10652: 6>consider RSRP as the cell sorting quantity;
B10653: 5>if the measCellListNR is included:
B10654: 6>consider cells identified by each entry within the measCellListNR to be applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting;
B10655: 5>else:
B10656: 6>consider up to maxCellMeasIdle strongest identified cells, according to the sorting quantity, to be applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting;
B10657: 5>for all cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting, derive cell measurement results for the measurement quantities indicated by reportQuantities;
B10658: 5>store the derived cell measurement results as indicated by reportQuantities for cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting within measResultsPerCarrierListIdleNR in the measReportIdleNR in VarMeasIdleReport in decreasing order of the cell sorting quantity, i.e. the best cell is included first, as follows:
B10659: 6>if qualityThreshold is configured:
B10660: 7>include the measurement results from the cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting whose RSRP/RSRQ measurement results are above the value(s) provided in qualityThreshold;
B10661: 6>else:
B10662: 7>include the measurement results from all cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting;
B10663: 5>if beamMeasConfigIdle is included in the associated entry in measIdleCarrierListNR and if UE supports idleInactiveNR-MeasBeamReport for the FR of the carrier frequency indicated by carrierFreq within the associated entry, for each cell in the measurement results:
B10664: 6>derive beam measurements based on SS/PBCH block for each measurement quantity indicated in reportQuantityRS-Indexes, as described in TS 38.215 [9];
B10665: 6>if the reportQuantityRS-Indexes is set to rsrq:
B10666: 7>consider RSRQ as the beam sorting quantity;
B10667: 6>else:
B10668: 7>consider RSRP as the beam sorting quantity;
B10669: 6>set resultsSSB-Indexes to include up to maxNrofRS-IndexesToReport SS/PBCH block indexes in order of decreasing beam sorting quantity as follows:
B10670: 7>include the index associated to the best beam for the sorting quantity and if absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation is included, the remaining beams whose sorting quantity is above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation;
B10671: 6>if the includeBeamMeasurements is set to true:
B10672: 7>include the beam measurement results as indicated by reportQuantityRS-Indexes;
B10673: 2>if, as a result of the procedure in this clause, the UE performs measurements in one or more carrier frequency indicated by measIdleCarrierListNR or measIdleCarrierListEUTRA:
B10674: 3>store the cell measurement results for RSRP and RSRQ for the serving cell within measResultServingCell in the measReportIdleNR in VarMeasIdleReport.
B10675: 3>if the VarMeasIdleConfig includes the measIdleCarrierListNR and it contains an entry with carrierFreq set to the value of the serving frequency:
B10676: 4>if beamMeasConfigIdle is included in that entry, and if the UE supports idleInactiveNR- MeasBeamReport for the FR of the serving cell:
B10677: 5>derive beam measurements based on SS/PBCH block for each measurement quantity indicated in reportQuantityRS-Indexes, as described in TS 38.215 [9];
B10678: 5>if the reportQuantityRS-Indexes is set to rsrq:
B10679: 6>consider RSRQ as the beam sorting quantity;
B10680: 5>else:
B10681: 6>consider RSRP as the beam sorting quantity;
B10682: 5>set resultsSSB-Indexes to include up to maxNrofRS-IndexesToReport SS/PBCH block indexes in order of decreasing beam sorting quantity as follows:
B10683: 6>include the index associated to the best beam for the sorting quantity and if absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation is included in SIB2 of serving cell, the remaining beams whose sorting quantity is above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation;
B10684: 5>if the includeBeamMeasurements is set to true:
B10685: 6>include the beam measurement results as indicated by reportQuantityRS-Indexes;
B10686: NOTE 1:How the UE performs idle/inactive measurements is up to UE implementation as long as the requirements in TS 38.133 [14] are met for measurement reporting.
B10687: NOTE 2:The UE is not required to perform idle/inactive measurements on a given carrier if the SSB configuration of that carrier provided via dedicated signaling is different from the SSB configuration broadcasted in the serving cell, if any.
B10688: NOTE 3:How the UE prioritizes which frequencies to measure or report (in case it is configured with more frequencies than it can measure or report) is left to UE implementation.
B10689: NOTE 4:When idleModeMeasVoiceFallback is included in SIB5, UE may decide to measure and report idle/inactive measurements for EUTRA carrier frequencies included in SIB5 even if it does not support NE-DC between the serving carrier and the EUTRA carrier frequencies.
B10690: 5.7.8.3T331 expiry or stop
B10691: The UE shall:
B10692: 1>if T331 expires or is stopped:
B10693: 2>release the VarMeasIdleConfig.
B10694: NOTE:It is up to UE implementation whether to continue idle/inactive measurements according to SIB11 and SIB4 configurations or according to E-UTRA SIB5 and E-UTRA SIB24 configurations as specified in TS 36.331 [10] upon inter-RAT cell reselection to E-UTRA, after T331 has expired or stopped.
B10695: 5.7.8.4Cell re-selection or cell selection while T331 is running
B10696: The UE shall:
B10697: 1>if intra-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running:
B10698: 2>if validityAreaList is configured in VarMeasIdleConfig:
B10699: 3>if the serving frequency does not match with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList; or
B10700: 3>if the serving frequency matches with the carrierFreq of an entry in the validityAreaList, the validityCellList is included in that entry, and the physical cell identity of the serving cell does not match with any entry in validityCellList:
B10701: 4>stop timer T331;
B10702: 4>perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3, upon which the procedure ends.
B10703: 1>else if inter-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running:
B10704: 2>stop timer T331;
B10705: 2>perform the actions as specified in 5.7.8.3;
B10706: 5.7.9Mobility history information
B10707: 5.7.9.1General
B10708: This procedure specifies how the mobility history information is stored by the UE, covering RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE and RRC_CONNECTED and released by the UE upon deregistration as specified in TS 23.502 [43].
B10709: 5.7.9.2Initiation
B10710: If the UE supports storage of mobility history information, the UE shall:
B10711: 1>If the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and upon addition of a PSCell:
B10712: 2>include an entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport possibly after performing the following, if necessary:
B10713: 3>if visitedPSCellInfoListReport is available in the visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10714: 4>for the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10715: 5>remove the oldest entry in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10716: 3>else:
B10717: 4>remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10718: 2>for the included entry:
B10719: 3>set the field timeSpent of the entry according to following:
B10720: 4>if this is the first PSCell entry for the current PCell since entering the current PCell in RRC_CONNECTED:
B10721: 5>include the entry as the time spent with no PSCell since entering the current PCell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10722: 4>else:
B10723: 5>include the time spent with no PSCell since last PSCell release since entering the current PCell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10724: 1>If the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and upon change, or release of a PSCell while being connected to the current PCell, or upon release of a PSCell while entering 'camped normally' state or 'any cell selection' state or 'camped on any cell' state:
B10725: 2>include an entry in visitedPSCellInfoList of the variable VarMobilityHistoryReport possibly after performing the following, if necessary:
B10726: 3>if visitedPSCellInfoListReport is available in the visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10727: 4>for the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10728: 5>remove the oldest entry in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10729: 3>else:
B10730: 4>remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10731: 2>for the included entry:
B10732: 3>if the global cell identity of the previous PSCell is available:
B10733: 4>include the global cell identity of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10734: 3>else:
B10735: 4>include the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10736: 3>if the PSCell is changed or released while being connected to the current PCell, or if the PSCell is released while entering 'camped normally' state in the same serving cell which was previously the PCell:
B10737: 4>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time spent in the previous PSCell while being connected to the current PCell/serving cell;
B10738: 4>if the UE supports storing and reporting SCG activation information in mobility history information:
B10739: 5> set the field scgActiveDuration of the entry to the accumulated time spent in the previous PSCell with SCG state set to activated during the stay in the PSCell while being connected to the current PCell/serving cell, if available;
B10740: 3>if the PSCell is released while entering 'any cell selection' state or 'camped on any cell' state from a suitable cell in RRC_CONNECTED state in NR or LTE, or if the PSCell is released while entering 'camped normally' state while previously in RRC_CONNECTED state in a PCell different from the current serving cell:
B10741: 4>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time spent in the previous PSCell while being connected to the previous PCell;
B10742: 4>if the UE supports storing and reporting SCG activation information in mobility history information:
B10743: 5>set the field scgActiveDuration of the entry to the accumulated time spent in the previous PSCell with SCG state set to activated during the stay in the PSCell while being connected to the previous PCell, if available ;
B10744: 1>Upon change of suitable cell, consisting of PCell in RRC_CONNECTED (for NR or E-UTRA cell) or serving cell in RRC_INACTIVE (for NR cell) or in RRC_IDLE (for NR or E-UTRA cell), to another NR or E-UTRA cell, or when entering 'any cell selection' state from 'camped normally' state in NR or LTE or when entering 'any cell selection' state or 'camped on any cell' state from a suitable cell in RRC_CONNECTED state in NR or LTE:
B10745: NOTE:Change of suitable cell encompasses also simultaneous change of serving cell and RRC state change.
B10746: 2>include an entry in visitedCellInfoList of the variable VarMobilityHistoryReport possibly after removing the oldest entry, if necessary, according to following:
B10747: 3>if the global cell identity of the previous PCell/serving cell is available:
B10748: 4>include the global cell identity of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10749: 3>else:
B10750: 4>include the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10751: 3>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time spent in the previous PCell/serving cell;
B10752: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the UE continues to be connected to the same PSCell during the change of the PCell in RRC_CONNECTED; or
B10753: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the UE changes PSCell at the same time as the change of the PCell in RRC_CONNECTED; or
B10754: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the PSCell is released at the same time as the change of the PCell in RRC_CONNECTED:
B10755: 4>include an entry in visitedPSCellInfoList of the variable VarMobilityHistoryReport possibly after performing the following, if necessary:
B10756: 5>if visitedPSCellInfoListReport is available in the visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10757: 6>for the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10758: 7>remove the oldest entry in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10759: 5>else:
B10760: 6>remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10761: 4>for the included entry:
B10762: 5>if the global cell identity of the PSCell (in case the UE continues to be connected to the same PSCell) or the previous PSCell (in case the UE changes PSCell, or in case PSCell is released) is available:
B10763: 6>include the global cell identity of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10764: 5>else:
B10765: 6>include the physical cell identity and carrier frequency of that cell in the field visitedCellId of the entry;
B10766: 5>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time spent in the PSCell, while being connected to previous PCell;
B10767: 5>if the UE supports storing and reporting SCG activation information in mobility history information:
B10768: 6> set the field scgActiveDuration of the entry to the accumulated time spent in the PSCell with SCG state set to activated while being connected to the previous PCell, if available;
B10769: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the UE was not configured with a PSCell at the time of change of PCell in RRC_CONNECTED; or
B10770: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the UE was not configured with a PSCell at the time of entering 'camped normally' state while previously in RRC_CONNECTED state in a PCell different from the current serving cell; or
B10771: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if the UE was not configured with a PSCell at the time of entering 'any cell selection' state or 'camped on any cell' state from a suitable cell in RRC_CONNECTED state in NR or LTE:
B10772: 4>include an entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport after performing the following, if necessary;
B10773: 5>if visitedPSCellInfoListReport is available in the visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10774: 6>for the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10775: 7>remove the oldest entry in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10776: 5>else:
B10777: 6>remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10778: 4>for the included entry:
B10779: 5>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time without PSCell according to the following:
B10780: 6>if the UE experienced a PSCell release since entering the previous PCell in RRC_CONNECTED:
B10781: 7>include the time spent with no PSCell since last PSCell release since entering the previous PCell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10782: 6>else:
B10783: 7>include the time spent with no PSCell since entering the previous PCell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10784: 3>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and if visitedPSCellInfoList exists in VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10785: 4>include visitedPSCellInfoList in VarMobilityHistoryReport in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport within the entry of the visitedCellInfoList associated to the latest PCell entry;
B10786: 4>remove visitedPSCellInfoList from the variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10787: 1>if the UE supports PSCell mobility history information and upon entering 'camped normally' state in NR (in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE) or E-UTRA (in RRC_IDLE) while previously in RRC_CONNECTED state NR or LTE in the same serving cell which was previously the PCell while not connected to a PSCell:
B10788: 2>include an entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport after performing the following, if necessary;
B10789: 3>if visitedPSCellInfoListReport is available in the visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport:
B10790: 4>for the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10791: 5>remove the oldest entry in the visitedPSCellInfoListReport;
B10792: 3>else:
B10793: 4>remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport;
B10794: 2>for the included entry:
B10795: 3>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time without PSCell according to the following:
B10796: 4>if the UE experienced a PSCell release since entering the current serving cell in RRC_CONNECTED:
B10797: 5>include the time spent with no PSCell since last PSCell release after entering the current serving cell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10798: 4>else:
B10799: 5>include the time spent with no PSCell since entering the current serving cell in RRC_CONNECTED;
B10800: 1>upon entering 'camped normally' state in NR (in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE) or E-UTRA (in RRC_IDLE) while previously in 'any cell selection' state or 'camped on any cell' state in NR or LTE:
B10801: 2>include an entry in visitedCellInfoList in variable VarMobilityHistoryReport possibly after removing the oldest entry, if necessary, according to following:
B10802: 3>set the field timeSpent of the entry as the time spent in 'any cell selection' state and/or 'camped on any cell' state in NR or LTE.
B10803: 5.7.9.3Release of Mobility History Information
B10804: If the UE supports storage of mobility history information, the UE shall:
B10805: 1>if stored, discard the mobility history information, i.e. release the UE variable VarMobilityHistoryReport upon deregistration from the network as specified in TS 23.502 [43].
B10806: 5.7.10UE Information
B10807: 5.7.10.1General
B10809: Figure 5.7.10.1-1: UE information procedure
B10810: The UE information procedure is used by the network to request the UE to report information.
B10811: 5.7.10.2Initiation
B10812: The network initiates the procedure by sending the UEInformationRequest message. The network should initiate this procedure only after successful security activation.
B10813: 5.7.10.3Reception of the UEInformationRequest message
B10814: Upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message, the UE shall, only after successful security activation:
B10815: 1>if the idleModeMeasurementReq is included in the UEInformationRequest and the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell:

B11312: 5.7.13RLM/BFD relaxation
B11313: 5.7.13.0General
B11314: In case both low mobility criterion and good serving cell criterion are configured for RLM/BFD relaxation, the UE is allowed to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation according to requirements specified in TS 38.133 [14] when both relaxed measurement criterion for low mobility and relaxed measurement criterion for good serving cell quality are met.
B11315: In case only the good serving cell quality criterion is configured for RLM/BFD relaxation, the UE is allowed to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation according to requirements specified in TS 38.133 [14] when the relaxed measurement criterion for good serving cell quality is met.
B11316: When the short DRX cycle is smaller than or equal to 80 ms and the long DRX cycle is larger than 80 ms then the UE is allowed to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation while drx-ShortCycleTimer is running and the relaxed measurement criteria are met. In this case the UE does not report change of its relaxation state for RLM and/or BFD relaxation due to start or stop of drx-ShortCycleTimer, if configured.
B11317: 5.7.13.1Relaxed measurement criterion for low mobility
B11318: The relaxed measurement criterion for UE with low mobility in RRC_CONNECTED is fulfilled when:
B11319: -(SS-RSRPRef – SS-RSRP) < SSearchDeltaP-Connected,
B11320: Where:
B11321: -SS-RSRP = current L3 RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB (dB).
B11322: -SS-RSRPRef = reference L3 RSRP measurement of the SpCell based on SSB (dB), set as follows:
B11323: -After receiving low mobility criterion configuration, or
B11324: -After MAC of the CG successfully completes a Random Access procedure after applying a reconfigurationWithSync in spCellConfig of the CG while low mobility criterion is configured, or
B11325: -upon an indication from lower layers that a RACH-less handover or an LTM cell switch is successfully completed for the CG while low mobility criterion is configured, or
B11326: -If (SS-RSRP - SS-RSRPRef) > 0, or
B11327: -If the relaxed measurement criterion has not been met for TSearchDeltaP-Connected:
B11328: -The UE shall set the value of SS-RSRPRef to the current SS-RSRP value of the SpCell.
B11329: 5.7.13.2Relaxed measurement criterion for good serving cell quality
B11330: The relaxed measurement criterion of good serving cell quality for RLM is fulfilled when the downlink radio link quality on the configured RLM-RS resource is evaluated to be better than the threshold Qin+XdB, wherein
B11331: -Qin is specified in clause 8.1 of TS 38.133 [14].
B11332: -X is the parameter offset in goodServingCellEvaluationRLM for the evaluated serving cell.
B11333: The relaxed measurement criterion of good serving cell quality for BFD is fulfilled when the downlink radio link quality on the configured BFD-RS resource is evaluated to be better than the threshold Qin+XdB, wherein
B11334: -Q in is specified in clause 8.1 of TS 38.133 [14].
B11335: -X is the parameter offset in goodServingCellEvaluationBFD for the evaluated serving cell.

B11395: 2>if reportingSRB (or SRB4 if reportingSRB is absent) and ran-VisibleReportingSRB (or SRB4 if ran-VisibleReportingSRB is absent) indicates different SRBs for the measConfigAppLayerId:

B11397: 1>for each encoded MeasurementReportAppLayer message generated above:
B11398: 2>if the encoded RRC message is for transmission via SRB4 based on reportingSRB and/or ran-VisibleReportingSRB (including the case when reportingSRB and/or ran-VisibleReportingSRB is not configured):

B11416: 5.7.17Derivation of pathloss reference for TA validation of SRS for Positioning transmission and CG-SDT in RRC_INACTIVE
B11417: Upon request from lower layer for pathloss reference derivation for TA validation for SRS for Positioning transmission or CG-SDT in RRC_INACTIVE, the UE shall:
B11418: 1>acquire SIB2, if stored version is invalid;
B11419: 1>if nrofSS-BlocksToAverage or absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation is not present or if absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation is present and the highest beam measurement quantity value is below or equal to absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation:
B11420: 2>derive the downlink pathloss reference RSRP for TA validation as the highest beam measurement quantity value, where each beam measurement quantity is described in TS 38.215 [24];
B11421: 1>else:
B11422: 2>derive the downlink pathloss reference RSRP for TA validation as the linear average of the power values of up to nrofSS-BlocksToAverage of the highest beam measurement quantity values above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation, where each beam measurement quantity is described in TS 38.215 [24].
B11423: NOTE:If the UE is configured with multiple SSB configurations, the downlink pathloss reference RSRP for TA validation is derived from the SSB configured by SIB1.

B11425: 5.7.19Satellite switch with resynchronization
B11426: A UE capable of hard satellite switch with resynchronization in RRC_CONNECTED initiates the procedure when SatSwitchWithReSync and t-Service are included in SIB19.
B11427: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE shall:
B11428: 1>if t-ServiceStart is included in SIB19 and the UE supports soft satellite switch with resynchronization:
B11429: 2>start acquiring DL synchronization with the SpCell served by the satellite indicated by ntn-Config in SatSwitchWithReSync between the time indicated by t-ServiceStart and the time indicated by t-Service for the serving cell;
B11430: 1>upon the time indicated by t-Service:
B11431: 2>stop timer T430 if running;
B11432: 2>inform lower layers that UL synchronisation is lost due to satellite switch with resynchronization;
B11433: 2>synchronise to the DL of the SpCell served by the satellite indicated by ntn-Config in SatSwitchWithReSync, if the UE has not previously synchronized to the DL of the SpCell;
B11434: 2>start timer T430 with the timer value set to ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime in ntn-Config in SatSwitchWithReSync;
B11435: 2>inform lower layers when UL synchronisation is obtained.
B11436: NOTE:UE should attempt to re-acquire SIB19 after satellite switch with resynchronization. The exact time is left to UE implementation.
B11437: 5.7.20Actions related to Transmission of SRS for Positioning in a validity area in RRC_INACTIVE
B11438: When configured with srs-PosRRC-InactiveValidityAreaPreConfigList, the UE shall:
B11439: 1>upon receiving RRCRelease message after sending the RRCResumeRequest message with the resumeCause set to srs-PosConfigOrActivationReq:
B11440: 2>if the current camped cell is included in any srs-PosConfigValidityArea in the srs-PosRRC-InactiveValidityAreaPreConfigList:
B11441: 3>apply the corresponding preconfigured SRS for positioning available in srs-PosRRC-InactiveValidityAreaPreConfigList and instruct lower layers to initiate SRS for Positioning transmission.
B11442: 5.8Sidelink
B11443: 5.8.1General
B11444: NR sidelink communication consists of unicast, groupcast and broadcast. For unicast, the PC5-RRC connection is a logical connection between a pair of a Source Layer-2 ID and a Destination Layer-2 ID in the AS. The PC5-RRC signalling, as specified in clause 5.8.9, can be initiated after its corresponding PC5 unicast link establishment (TS 23.287 [55]). The PC5-RRC connection and the corresponding sidelink SRBs and sidelink DRB(s) are released when the PC5 unicast link is released as indicated by upper layers.
B11445: For each PC5-RRC connection of unicast, one sidelink SRB (i.e. SL-SRB0) is used to transmit the PC5-S message(s) before the PC5-S security has been established. One sidelink SRB (i.e. SL-SRB1) is used to transmit the PC5-S messages to establish the PC5-S security. One sidelink SRB (i.e. SL-SRB2) is used to transmit the PC5-S messages after the PC5-S security has been established, which is protected. One sidelink SRB (i.e. SL-SRB3) is used to transmit the PC5-RRC signalling, which is protected and only sent after the PC5-S security has been established. One sidelink SRB (i.e. SL-SRB4) is used to transmit/receive the NR sidelink discovery messages.
B11446: For unicast of NR sidelink communication, AS security comprises of integrity protection of PC5 signalling (SL-SRB1, SL-SRB2 and SL-SRB3) and user data (SL-DRBs), and it further comprises of ciphering of PC5 signaling (SL-SRB1 only for the Direct Link Security Mode Complete message as specified in TS 24.587 [57] for V2X service or TS 24.554 [72] for Proximity-services, SL-SRB2 and SL-SRB3) and user data (SL-DRBs). The ciphering and integrity protection algorithms and parameters for a PC5 unicast link are exchanged by PC5-S messages in the upper layers as specified in TS 33.536 [60], and applied to the corresponding PC5-RRC connection in the AS. Once AS security is activated for a PC5 unicast link in the upper layers as specified in TS 33.536 [60], all messages on SL-SRB2 and SL-SRB3 and/or user data on SL-DRBs of the corresponding PC5-RRC connection are integrity protected and/or ciphered by the PDCP.
B11447: For unicast of NR sidelink communication, if the change of the key is indicated by the upper layers as specified in TS 24.587 [57] or TS 24.554 [72], UE re-establishes the PDCP entity of the SL-SRB1, SL-SRB2, SL-SRB3 and SL-DRBs on the corresponding PC5-RRC connection.
B11448: NOTE 1:In case the configurations for NR sidelink communication are acquired via the E-UTRA, the configurations for NR sidelink communication in SIB12 and sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration used in clause 5.8 are provided by the configurations in SystemInformationBlockType28 and sl-ConfigDedicatedForNR within RRCConnectionReconfiguration as specified in TS 36.331 [10], respectively.
B11449: NOTE 2:In this release, there is one-to-one correspondence between the PC5-RRC connection and the PC5 unicast link as specified in TS 38.300[2].
B11450: NOTE 3:All SL-DRBs related to the same PC5-RRC connection have the same activation/deactivation setting for ciphering and the same activation/deactivation setting for integrity protection as specified in TS 33.536 [60].
B11451: NOTE 4:When integrity check failure concerning SL-SRB1 for a specific destination is detected, the UE sends an indication to the upper layers [57].
B11452: NOTE 5:The selection of NULL algorithms means that the PC5 messages are considered protected for the purposes of being allowed to be sent or received.
B11453: 5.8.2Conditions for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation
B11454: The UE shall perform NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation only if the conditions defined in this clause are met:
B11455: 1>if the UE's serving cell is suitable (RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or RRC_CONNECTED); and if either the selected cell on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation belongs to the registered or equivalent PLMN as specified in TS 24.587 [57] or TS 24.554 [72] or belongs to the Subscribed SNPN as specified in TS 24.554 [72] or the UE is out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation as defined in TS 38.304 [20] and TS 36.304 [27]; or
B11456: 1>if the UE's serving cell (RRC_IDLE or RRC_CONNECTED) fulfils the conditions to support NR sidelink communication/discovery in limited service state as specified in TS 23.287 [55]; and if either the serving cell is on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery operation or the UE is out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery operation as defined in TS 38.304 [20] and TS 36.304 [27]; or
B11457: 1>if the UE has no serving cell (RRC_IDLE).
B11458: 5.8.3Sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning
B11459: 5.8.3.1General
B11461: Figure 5.8.3.1-1: Sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning
B11462: The purpose of this procedure is to inform the network that the UE:
B11463: -is interested or no longer interested to receive or transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning,
B11464: -is requesting assignment or release of transmission resource for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning,
B11465: -is reporting QoS parameters and QoS profile(s) related to NR sidelink communication,
B11466: -is reporting mapped frequency(ies) for each QoS flow related to NR sidelink communication,
B11467: -is reporting associated Tx Profile for each QoS flow related to NR sidelink groupcast and broadcast communication,
B11468: -is reporting that a sidelink radio link failure, sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure or a sidelink carrier failure has been detected,
B11469: -is reporting the sidelink UE capability information of the associated peer UE for unicast communication,
B11470: -is reporting the RLC mode information of the sidelink data radio bearer(s) received from the associated peer UE for unicast communication,
B11471: -is reporting the accepted sidelink DRX configuration received from the associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast reception,
B11472: -is reporting the sidelink DRX assistance information received from the associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast transmission, when the UE is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig,
B11473: -is reporting, for NR sidelink groupcast transmission, the sidelink DRX on/off indication for the associated Destination Layer-2 ID, when the UE is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig,
B11474: -is reporting, for NR sidelink groupcast or broadcast reception, the Destination Layer-2 ID and QoS profile(s) associated with its interested services to which sidelink DRX is applied,
B11475: -is reporting DRX configuration reject information from its associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast transmission, when the UE is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig,
B11476: -is reporting parameters related to single hop or multi hop U2N relay operation,
B11477: -is reporting parameters related to U2U relay operation.
B11478: 5.8.3.2Initiation
B11479: A UE capable of NR sidelink communication or NR sidelink discovery or NR sidelink U2N relay operation including multi hop relay operation or NR sidelink U2U relay operation or NR sidelink positioning that is in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure to indicate it is (interested in) receiving or transmitting NR sidelink communication or NR sidelink discovery or NR sidelink U2N relay operation including multi hop relay operation or NR sidelink U2U relay operation or SL-PRS transmission/reception in several cases including upon successful connection establishment or resuming, upon change of interest, upon changing QoS profile(s), upon receiving UECapabilityInformationSidelink from the associated peer UE, upon RLC mode information updated from the associated peer UE or upon change to a PCell providing SIB12 including sl-ConfigCommonNR, or upon change to a PCell providing SIB23 including sl-PosConfigCommonNR. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication may initiate the procedure to request assignment of dedicated sidelink DRB configuration and transmission resources for NR sidelink communication transmission. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication may initiate the procedure to report to the network that a sidelink radio link failure, sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure or sidelink carrier failure has been declared. A UE capable of NR sidelink discovery may initiate the procedure to request assignment of dedicated resources for NR sidelink discovery transmission or NR sidelink discovery reception. A UE capable of U2N relay operation including multi hop relay operation may initiate the procedure to report/update parameters for acting as U2N Relay UE or U2N Remote UE (including L2 U2N Remote UE's source L2 ID). A UE capable of U2U relay operation may initiate the procedure to report/update parameters for acting as U2U Relay UE or U2U Remote UE. A UE capable of NR sidelink positioning may initiate the procedure to request it is interested or no longer interested in either transmitting SL-PRS or receiving SL-PRS.
B11480: A UE capable of NR sidelink operation that is in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure to report the sidelink DRX configuration received from the associated peer UE for NR sidelink unicast reception, upon accepting the sidelink DRX configuration from the associated peer UE. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig and is performing sidelink unicast transmission may initiate the procedure to report the sidelink DRX assistance information or the sidelink DRX configuration reject information received from the associated peer UE, upon receiving either of them from the associated peer UE. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig and is performing sidelink groupcast transmission may initiate the procedure to report the sidelink DRX on/off indication for the associated Destination Layer-2 ID. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure to report the frequency(ies) and Tx Profile associated with each QoS flow for NR sidelink groupcast or broadcast transmission. A UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure to report the frequency(ies) associated with each QoS flow for NR sidelink unicast transmission.
B11481: A UE capable of NR sidelink operation that is in RRC_CONNECTED may initiate the procedure to report the Destination Layer-2 ID and QoS profile(s) associated with its interested service(s) that sidelink DRX is applied, for NR sidelink groupcast or broadcast reception.

B11618: 5.8.3.3Actions related to transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message
B11619: The UE shall set the contents of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message as follows and shall include all concerned information, irrespective of what triggered the procedure:
B11620: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to indicate it is (no more) interested to receive NR sidelink communication/positioning; or
B11621: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to request (configuration/ release) of NR sidelink communication/positioning transmission resources or to report to the network that a sidelink radio link failure, sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure or sidelink carrier failure has been declared; or
B11622: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to report to the network the sidelink DRX configuration for NR sidelink unicast reception; or
B11623: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to report to the network the sidelink DRX assistance information or the sidelink DRX configuration reject information for NR sidelink unicast transmission; or
B11624: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to report to the network the Destination Layer-2 ID and QoS profile(s) associated with its interested service(s) that sidelink DRX is applied for NR sidelink groupcast or broadcast reception; or
B11625: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to report to the network the Destination Layer-2 ID and the sidelink DRX on/off indication for the corresponding destination for NR sidelink groupcast transmission; or
B11626: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to indicate it is (no more) interested to receive NR sidelink discovery messages; or
B11627: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to request (configuration/ release) of NR sidelink discovery messages transmission resources; or
B11628: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure to request (configuration/ release) of NR sidelink U2N or U2U relay communication transmission resources or report other parameters related to U2N or U2U relay operation:
B11629: 2>if SIB12 including sl-ConfigCommonNR is provided by the PCell:
B11630: 3>if configured by upper layers to receive NR sidelink communication:
B11631: 4>include sl-RxInterestedFreqList and set it to the frequency for NR sidelink communication reception;
B11632: 3>if configured by upper layers to transmit non-relay NR sidelink communication and/or to transmit NR sidelink relay communication; or
B11633: 3>if configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink L3 U2U relay communication and SIB12 includes sl-L3-U2U-RelayDiscovery:
B11634: 4>include sl-TxResourceReqList and set its fields (if needed) as follows for each destination for which it requests network to assign NR sidelink communication resource:
B11635: 5>set sl-DestinationIdentity to the destination identity configured by upper layer for NR sidelink communication transmission;
B11636: 5>set sl-CastType to the cast type of the associated destination identity configured by the upper layer for the NR sidelink communication transmission;
B11637: 5>set sl-RLC-ModeIndicationList to include the RLC mode(s) and optionally QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated RLC mode(s), if the associated bi-directional sidelink DRB(s) have been established due to the configuration by RRCReconfigurationSidelink;
B11638: 5>set sl-QoS-InfoList to include QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer for the NR sidelink communication transmission;
B11639: 5>set sl-TxInterestedFreqList to indicate the frequency of the associated destination for NR sidelink communication transmission;
B11640: 5>set sl-TypeTxSyncList to the current synchronization reference type used on the associated sl-TxInterestedFreqList for NR sidelink communication transmission;
B11641: 5>set sl-CapabilityInformationSidelink to include UECapabilityInformationSidelink message, if any, received from the associated peer UE;
B11642: 5>if sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt is included in SIB12-IEs:
B11643: 6>set sl-QoS-InfoList to include the frequency(ies), and Tx Profile, if any, mapped to the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated destination configured by the upper layer for the NR sidelink groupcast and broadcast communication transmission;
B11644: 4>if a sidelink radio link failure or a sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure has been declared, according to clauses 5.8.9.3 and 5.8.9.1.8, respectively;
B11645: 5>include sl-FailureList and set its fields as follows for each destination for which it reports the NR sidelink communication failure:
B11646: 6>set sl-DestinationIdentity to the destination identity configured by upper layer for NR sidelink communication transmission;

B11649: 6>else if RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink is received:

B11750: 6>set sl-PosDestinationIdentity to the destination identity configured by upper layer for NR sidelink positioning transmission;
B11751: 6>set sl-CapabilityInformationSidelink to include UECapabilityInformationSidelink message, if any, received from the associated peer UE;
B11752: 2>if SIB23 including sl-PosConfigCommonNR is provided by the PCell;
B11753: 3>if configured to transmit SL-PRS:
B11754: 4>include sl-PosTxResourceReqList and set its fields (if needed) as follows for each destination for which it requests network to assign SL-PRS resource:
B11755: 5>set sl-PosDestinationIdentity to the destination identity configured by upper layer for SL-PRS transmission;
B11756: 5>set sl-PosCastType to the cast type of the associated destination identity configured by the upper layer for the SL-PRS transmission;
B11757: 5>set sl-PosTxInterestedFreqList to indicate the frequency of the associated destination for SL-PRS transmission;
B11758: 5>set sl-PosTypeTxSyncList to the current synchronization reference type used on the associated sl-PosTxInterestedFreqList for SL-PRS transmission;
B11759: 5>set sl-PosQoS-InfoList to include the SL-PRS transmission QoS profile;
B11760: 5>set sl-CapabilityInformationSidelink to include UECapabilityInformationSidelink message, if any, received from the associated peer UE;
B11761: 3>if configured to perform SL-PRS measurements;
B11762: 4>include sl-PosRxInterestedFreqList and set it to the frequency for SL-PRS reception;
B11763: 1>if the UE initiates the procedure while connected to an E-UTRA PCell:
B11764: 2>submit the SidelinkUEInformationNR to lower layers via SRB1, embedded in E-UTRA RRC message ULInformationTransferIRAT as specified in TS 36.331 [10], clause 5.6.28;
B11765: 1>else:
B11766: 2>submit the SidelinkUEInformationNR message to lower layers for transmission.
B11767: NOTE 2:When multiple lists are reported in SidelinkUEInformationNR, a UE can report up to maxNrofSL-Dest-r16 SL destinations in sl-TxResourceReqList, sl-TxResourceReqListDisc and sl-TxResourceReqListCommRelay in total.

B11769: 5.8.5Sidelink synchronisation information transmission for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning

B11775: The purpose of this procedure is to provide synchronisation information to a UE. This procedure also applies to NR sidelink discovery.
B11776: 5.8.5.2Initiation
B11777: A UE capable of NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning and SLSS/PSBCH transmission shall, when transmitting NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, and if the conditions for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation are met and when the following conditions are met:
B11778: 1>if in coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, as defined in TS 38.304 [20]; and has selected GNSS or the cell as synchronization reference as defined in 5.8.6.3; or
B11779: 1>if out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, and the frequency used to transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt within SIB12; and has selected GNSS or the cell as synchronization reference as defined in 5.8.6.3:
B11780: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList is neither included in RRCReconfiguration nor in SIB12; or
B11781: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList is included in RRCReconfiguration or in SIB12; and if none of the frequency(ies) selected as specified in TS 38.321 [3] is included in the sl-SyncFreqList or the concerned frequency is selected as the synchronisation carrier frequency in accordance with 5.8.6.2; or
B11782: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList and sl-SyncTxMultiFreq are included in RRCReconfiguration or in SIB12; and if the concerned frequency has been selected for NR sidelink communication transmission as specified in TS 38.321 [3] and is included in sl-SyncFreqList; and if the UE has selected a frequency other than the concerned frequency as the synchronisation carrier frequency in accordance with 5.8.6.2; and if sl-SyncTxDisabled corresponding to the concerned frequency is not configured in RRCReconfiguration or in SIB12:
B11783: 3>if in RRC_CONNECTED; and if networkControlledSyncTx is configured and set to on; or
B11784: 3>if networkControlledSyncTx is not configured; and for the concerned frequency syncTxThreshIC is configured; and the RSRP measurement of the reference cell, selected as defined in 5.8.6.3, for NR sidelink communication/discovery transmission is below the value of syncTxThreshIC:
B11785: 4>transmit sidelink SSB on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery in accordance with 5.8.5.3 and TS 38.211 [16], including the transmission of SLSS as specified in 5.8.5.3 and transmission of MasterInformationBlockSidelink as specified in 5.8.9.4.3;
B11786: 1>else:
B11787: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList is not included in SL-PreconfigurationNR; or
B11788: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList is included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, and if none of the frequency(ies) selected as specified in TS 38.321 [3] is included in the sl-SyncFreqList or the concerned frequency is selected as the synchronisation carrier frequency in accordance with 5.8.6.2; or
B11789: 2>if sl-SyncFreqList and sl-SyncTxMultiFreq are included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, and if the concerned frequency has been selected for NR sidelink communication transmission as specified in TS 38.321 [3] and included in sl-SyncFreqList; and if the UE has selected a frequency other than the concerned frequency as the synchronisation carrier frequency in accordance with 5.8.6.2; and if sl-SyncTxDisabled corresponding to the concerned frequency is not configured in SL-PreconfigurationNR:
B11790: 3>for the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery, if syncTxThreshOoC is included in SidelinkPreconfigNR; and the UE is not directly synchronized to GNSS, and the UE has no selected SyncRef UE or the PSBCH-RSRP measurement result of the selected SyncRef UE is below the value of syncTxThreshOoC; or
B11791: 3>for the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery, if the UE selects GNSS as the synchronization reference source:
B11792: 4>transmit sidelink SSB on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery in accordance with 5.8.5.3 and TS 38.211 [16], including the transmission of SLSS as specified in 5.8.5.3 and transmission of MasterInformationBlockSidelink as specified in 5.8.9.4.3;
B11793: 5.8.5.3Transmission of SLSS
B11794: The UE shall select the SLSSID and the slot in which to transmit SLSS as follows:
B11795: 1>if triggered by NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning and in coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, as defined in TS 38.304 [20]; or
B11796: 1>if triggered by NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, and out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning, and the concerned frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt within SIB12 or SIB23 for NR sidelink positioning:
B11797: 2>if the UE has selected GNSS as synchronization reference in accordance with 5.8.6.2:
B11798: 3>select SLSSID 0;
B11799: 3>use sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1 included in the entry of configured sl-SyncConfigList corresponding to the concerned frequency, that includes txParameters and gnss-Sync;
B11800: 3>select the slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1;
B11801: 2>if the UE has selected a cell as synchronization reference in accordance with 5.8.6.2:
B11802: 3>select the SLSSID included in the entry of configured sl-SyncConfigList corresponding to the concerned frequency, that includes txParameters and does not include gnss-Sync;
B11803: 3>select the slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1;
B11804: 1>else if triggered by NR sidelink communication/discovery and the UE has GNSS as the synchronization reference:
B11805: 2>select SLSSID 0;
B11806: 2>if sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3 is configured for the frequency used in SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B11807: 3>select the slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3;
B11808: 2>else:
B11809: 3>select the slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1;
B11810: 1>else:
B11811: 2>select the synchronisation reference UE (i.e. SyncRef UE) as defined in 5.8.6;
B11812: 2>if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE and inCoverage in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE is set to true; or
B11813: 2>if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE and inCoverage in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE is set to false while the SLSS from this UE is part of the set defined for out of coverage, see TS 38.211 [16]:
B11814: 3>select the same SLSSID as the SLSSID of the selected SyncRef UE;
B11815: 3>select the slot in which to transmit the SLSS according to the sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1 or sl-SSB-TimeAllocation2 included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters corresponding to the concerned frequency, such that the timing is different from the SLSS of the selected SyncRef UE;
B11816: 2>else if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE and the SLSS from this UE was transmitted on the slot(s) indicated sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, which is configured for the frequency used in SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B11817: 3>select SLSSID 337;
B11818: 3>select the slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation2;
B11819: 2>else if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE:
B11820: 3>select the SLSSID from the set defined for out of coverage having an index that is 336 more than the index of the SLSSID of the selected SyncRef UE, see TS 38.211 [16];
B11821: 3>select the slot in which to transmit the SLSS according to sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1 or sl-SSB-TimeAllocation2 included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters corresponding to the concerned frequency, such that the timing is different from the SLSS of the selected SyncRef UE;
B11822: 2>else (i.e. no SyncRef UE selected):
B11823: 3>if the UE has not randomly selected an SLSSID:
B11824: 4>randomly select, using a uniform distribution, an SLSSID from the set of sequences defined for out of coverage except SLSSID 336 and 337, see TS 38.211 [16];
B11825: 4>select the slot in which to transmit the SLSS according to the sl-SSB-TimeAllocation1 or sl-SSB-TimeAllocation2 (arbitrary selection between these) included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters in SidelinkPreconfigNR corresponding to the concerned frequency;

B11839: 5.8.6.2Selection and reselection of synchronisation reference
B11840: The UE shall for frequency(ies) which have been selected for NR sidelink communication/discovery as specified in TS 38.321 [3]:
B11841: 1>if sl-SyncFreqList is not included in RRCReconfiguration nor in SIB12; or
B11842: 1>if sl-SyncFreqList is included in RRCReconfiguration or in SIB12, and none of the frequency(ies) selected as specified in TS 38.321 [3] is included in the syncFreqList:

B11844: 3>select a cell as the synchronization reference source as defined in 5.8.6.3:
B11845: NOTE 1:When an out of coverage L2 U2N Remote UE receives SIB12 with sl-SyncPriority set to gnbEnb, the L2 U2N Remote UE continues using the current synchronization source until higher priority synchronization source is found or the current synchronization source becomes unreliable.
B11846: 2>else if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12, and sl-SyncPriority for the concerned frequency is not configured or is set to gnss, and GNSS is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14]:
B11847: 3>select GNSS as the synchronization reference source;
B11848: 2>else if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/discovery is included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, and sl-SyncPriority in SidelinkPreconfigNR is set to gnss and GNSS is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14]:
B11849: 3>select GNSS as the synchronization reference source;
B11850: 2>else:
B11851: 3>perform synchronization reference search procedure as defined in 5.8.6.2b on each frequency which is used for NR sidelink communication/discovery;
B11852: 3>if the UE has not selected any synchronization reference:
B11853: 4>for each frequency which is used for NR sidelink communication/discovery:
B11854: 5>if the UE detects one or more SLSSIDs for which the PSBCH-RSRP exceeds the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and for which the UE received the corresponding MasterInformationBlockSidelink message (candidate SyncRef UEs), or if the UE detects GNSS that is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14], or if the UE detects a cell, select a synchronization reference according to the priority group order as defined in 5.8.6.2a:
B11855: 1>if sl-SyncFreqList is included in RRCReconfiguration or in SIB12, and includes at least one of the concerned frequency(ies)
B11856: 2>if the concerned frequency(ies) are included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12, and sl-SyncPriority is configured for the concerned frequency(ies) and set to gnbEnb:
B11857: 3>select one frequency from the concerned frequency(ies) which are included in sl-SyncFreqList as the synchronisation carrier frequency;
B11858: 3>select a cell in accordance with the synchronisation carrier frequency as the synchronization reference source as defined in 5.8.6.3:
B11859: 2>else if the concerned frequency(ies) are included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12, and sl-SyncPriority for concerned frequency(ies) are not configured or are set to gnss, and GNSS is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14]; or if the concerned frequency(ies) are included in SL-PreconfigurationNR, and sl-SyncPriority in SidelinkPreconfigNR is set to gnss and GNSS is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14]:
B11860: 3>select one frequency from the concerned frequency(ies) which are included in sl-SyncFreqList as the synchronisation carrier frequency;
B11861: 3>select GNSS in accordance with the synchronisation carrier frequency as the synchronization reference source;
B11862: 2>else:
B11863: 3>perform a synchronization reference search procedure as defined in 5.8.6.2b on each concerned frequency which is included in sl-SyncFreqList;
B11864: 3>if the UE has not selected any synchronization reference:
B11865: 4>for each concerned frequency which is included in sl-SyncFreqList:
B11866: 5>if the UE detects one or more SLSSIDs for which the PSBCH-RSRP exceeds the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and for which the UE received the corresponding MasterInformationBlockSidelink message (candidate SyncRef UEs), or if the UE detects GNSS that is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14], or if the UE detects a cell,
B11867: 6>select the synchronisation reference source(s) according to the following priority group order as defined in 5.8.6.2a;
B11868: 6>select the frequency with the highest synchronisation reference source priority as the synchronisation carrier frequency, according to the following priority group order as defined in 5.8.6.2a, and consider the synchornization reference source (i.e. eNB/gNB, GNSS or SyncRef UE) that selected on the synchronisation carrier frequency as the synchronization reference:
B11869: NOTE 2:How the UE achieves subframe boundary alignment between V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication/discovery (if both are performed by the UE) is as specified in TS 38.213, clause 16.7.
B11870: 5.8.6.2aSidelink synchronization reference priority group order
B11871: 1>if sl-SyncPriority corresponding to the concerned frequency is set to gnbEnb:
B11872: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to true, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 1);
B11873: 2>UE of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 2);
B11874: 2>GNSS that is reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14] (priority group 3);
B11875: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to true, or of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 4);
B11876: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is not transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 5);
B11877: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 337 and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 5);
B11878: 2>Other UEs, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 6);
B11879: 1>if sl-SyncPriority corresponding to the concerned frequency is set to gnss, and sl-NbAsSync is set to true:
B11880: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to true, or of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 1);
B11881: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is not transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCHS-RSRP result (priority group 2);
B11882: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 337 and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 2);
B11883: 2>the cell detected by the UE as defined in 5.8.6.3 (priority group 3);
B11884: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to true, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 4);
B11885: 2>UE of which SLSSID is part of the set defined for in coverage, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 5);
B11886: 2>Other UEs, starting with the UE with the highest S-RSRP result (priority group 6);
B11887: 1>if sl-SyncPriority corresponding to the concerned frequency is set to gnss, and sl-NbAsSync is set to false:
B11888: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to true, or of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 1);
B11889: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 0 and SLSS is not transmitted on slot(s) indicated by sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3, and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCHS-RSRP result (priority group 2);
B11890: 2>UEs of which SLSSID is 337 and inCoverage, included in the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message received from this UE, is set to false, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 2);
B11891: 2>Other UEs, starting with the UE with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result (priority group 3);
B11892: 5.8.6.2bSidelink synchronization reference search
B11893: The UE shall for the indicated frequency(ies)
B11894: 1>perform a full search (i.e. covering all subframes and all possible SLSSIDs) on each indicated frequency to detect candidate SLSS, in accordance with TS 38.133 [14];
B11895: 1>when evaluating the one or more detected SLSSIDs, apply layer 3 filtering as specified in 5.5.3.2 using the preconfigured sl-filterCoefficient, before using the PSBCH-RSRP measurement results;
B11896: 1>if the UE has selected a SyncRef UE:
B11897: 2>if the PSBCH-RSRP of the strongest candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the minimum requirement TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and the strongest candidate SyncRef UE belongs to the same priority group as the current SyncRef UE and the PSBCH-RSRP of the strongest candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the PSBCH-RSRP of the current SyncRef UE by syncRefDiffHyst; or
B11898: 2>if the PSBCH-RSRP of the candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the minimum requirement TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and the candidate SyncRef UE belongs to a higher priority group than the current SyncRef UE; or
B11899: 2>if GNSS becomes reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14], and GNSS belongs to a higher priority group than the current SyncRef UE; or
B11900: 2>if a cell is detected and gNB/eNB (if sl-NbAsSync is set to true) belongs to a higher priority group than the current SyncRef UE; or
B11901: 2>if the PSBCH-RSRP of the current SyncRef UE is less than the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 [14]:
B11902: 3>consider no SyncRef UE to be selected;
B11903: 1>if the UE has selected GNSS as the synchronization reference for NR sidelink communication/discovery:
B11904: 2>if the PSBCH-RSRP of the candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and the candidate SyncRef UE belongs to a higher priority group than GNSS; or
B11905: 2>if GNSS becomes not reliable in accordance with TS 38.101-1 [15] and TS 38.133 [14]:
B11906: 3>consider GNSS not to be selected;
B11907: 1>if the UE has selected cell as the synchronization reference for NR sidelink communication/discovery:
B11908: 2>if the PSBCH-RSRP of the candidate SyncRef UE exceeds the minimum requirement defined in TS 38.133 [14] by sl-SyncRefMinHyst and the candidate SyncRef UE belongs to a higher priority group than gNB/eNB; or
B11909: 2>if the selected cell is not detected:
B11910: 3>consider the cell not to be selected;
B11911: 5.8.6.3Sidelink communication transmission reference cell selection
B11912: A UE capable of NR sidelink communication/discovery that is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery shall:
B11913: 1>for the frequency used to transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery, select a cell to be used as reference for synchronization in accordance with the following:
B11914: 2>if the frequency concerns the primary frequency:
B11915: 3>use the PCell or the serving cell as reference;
B11916: 2>else if the frequency concerns a secondary frequency:
B11917: 3>use the concerned SCell as reference;
B11918: 2>else if the UE is in coverage of the concerned frequency:
B11919: 3>use the DL frequency paired with the one used to transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery as reference;
B11920: 2>else (i.e., out of coverage on the concerned frequency):
B11921: 3>use the PCell or the serving cell as reference, if needed;
B11922: 5.8.7Sidelink communication reception
