B11924: 1>if the conditions for NR sidelink communication operation as defined in 5.8.2 are met:
B11925: 2>if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in RRCReconfiguration message or sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt included in SIB12:
B11926: 3>if the UE is configured with sl-RxPool included in RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync (i.e. handover):
B11927: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the pool(s) of resources indicated by sl-RxPool;
B11928: 3>else if the cell chosen for NR sidelink communication provides SIB12:
B11929: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the pool(s) of resources indicated by sl-RxPool in SIB12;
B11930: 2>else:
B11931: 3>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the pool(s) of resources that were preconfigured by sl-RxPool in SL-PreconfigurationNR, as defined in clause 9.3.
B11932: 5.8.8Sidelink communication transmission
B11933: A UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication and has related data to be transmitted shall:
B11934: 1>if the conditions for NR sidelink communication operation as defined in 5.8.2 are met:
B11935: 2>if the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12:
B11936: 3>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and uses the frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message:
B11937: 4>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigU2U; or
B11938: 4>if the UE capable of U2U Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigU2U; or
B11939: 4>if the UE is performing NR sidelink communication other than U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery:
B11940: NOTE 0:For U2U Relay UE, it can be up to UE implementation on cross-layer interaction for the AS layer condition check for Direct Communication Request message with integrated discovery forwarding.
B11941: 5>if the UE is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig:
B11942: 6>if T310 for MCG or T311 is running; and if sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt for the concerned frequency in SIB12 or included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR in RRCReconfiguration; or
B11943: 6>if T301 is running and the cell on which the UE initiated RRC connection re-establishment provides SIB12 including sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency; or
B11944: 6>if T304 for MCG is running and the UE is configured with sl-TxPoolExceptional included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for the concerned frequency in RRCReconfiguration:
B11945: 7>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection using the pool of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B11946: 6>else:
B11947: 7>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 1 for NR sidelink communication;
B11948: 6>if T311 is running, configure the lower layers to release the resources indicated by rrc-ConfiguredSidelinkGrant (if any);
B11949: 5>if the UE is configured with sl-UE-SelectedConfig:
B11950: 6>if a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19];
B11951: 7>if sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency is included in RRCReconfiguration; or
B11952: 7>if the PCell provides SIB12 including sl-TxPoolExceptional in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt for the concerned frequency:
B11953: 8>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection using the pool of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B11954: 6>else, if the sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency is included in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration:
B11955: 7>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig (as defined in TS 38.321 [3] and TS 38.214 [19]) using the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency;
B11956: 3>else:
B11957: 4>if the cell chosen for NR sidelink communication transmission provides SIB12:
B11958: 5>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65], and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommonU2U in SIB12; or
B11959: 5>if the UE capable of U2U Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65], and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommonU2U in SIB12; or
B11960: 5>if the UE is performing NR sidelink communication other than U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery:
B11961: 6>if SIB12 includes sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency, and a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in the sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal is available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19] or random selection, if allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, is selected:
B11962: 7>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig using the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B11963: 6>else if SIB12 includes sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency:
B11964: 7>from the moment the UE initiates RRC connection establishment or RRC connection resume, until receiving an RRCReconfiguration including sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, or receiving an RRCRelease or an RRCReject; or
B11965: 7>if a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for the concerned frequency in SIB12 is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19]:
B11966: 8>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection (as defined in TS 38.321 [3]) using the pool of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency;
B11967: 2>else:
B11968: 3>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65], and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-PreconfigU2U in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B11969: 3>if the UE capable of U2U Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery as specified in TS 23.304[65], and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions for integrated Discovery as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-PreconfigU2U in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B11970: 3>if the UE is performing NR sidelink communication other than U2U Relay Communication with integrated Discovery:
B11971: 4>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig (as defined in TS 38.321 [3] and TS 38.214 [19]) using the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal in SidelinkPreconfigNR for the concerned frequency.
B11972: NOTE 1:The UE continues to use resources configured in rrc-ConfiguredSidelinkGrant (while T310 is running) until it is released (i.e. until T310 has expired). The UE does not use sidelink configured grant type 2 resources while T310 is running.
B11973: NOTE 2:In case of RRC reconfiguration with sync, the UE uses resources configured in rrc-ConfiguredSidelinkGrant (while T304 on the MCG is running) if provided by the target cell.
B11974: NOTE 3:It is up to UE implementation to determine, in accordance with TS 38.321[3], which resource pool to use if multiple resource pools are configured, and which resource allocation scheme is used in the AS based on UE capability (for a UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE) and the allowed resource schemes sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig in the resource pool configuration.
B11975: NOTE 4:In case that the network does not provide resource pools in SIB12, a UE which is out of coverage, will be unable to obtain sidelink resources to send the first UL RRC message.
B11976: If configured to perform sidelink resource allocation mode 2, the UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink communication shall perform resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig on all pools of resources which may be used for transmission of the sidelink control information and the corresponding data. The pools of resources are indicated by SidelinkPreconfigNR, sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, or sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal in SIB12 for the concerned frequency, as configured above.
B11977: 5.8.9Sidelink RRC procedure
B11978: 5.8.9.1Sidelink RRC reconfiguration
B11979: 5.8.9.1.1General
B11982: Figure 5.8.9.1.1-1: Sidelink RRC reconfiguration, successful
B11984: Figure 5.8.9.1.1-2: Sidelink RRC reconfiguration, failure
B11985: The purpose of this procedure is to modify a PC5-RRC connection, e.g. to establish/modify/release sidelink DRBs or additional sidelink RLC bearer or PC5 Relay RLC channels, to add/release sidelink carrier, to (re-)configure NR sidelink measurement and reporting, to (re-)configure sidelink CSI reference signal resources, to (re)configure CSI reporting latency bound, to (re)configure sidelink DRX, to (re-)configure the latency bound of SL Inter-UE coordination report, and to indicate the SFN-DFN offset in case of single hop.
B11986: The UE may initiate the sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure and perform the operation in clause 5.8.9.1.2 on the corresponding PC5-RRC connection in following cases:
B11987: -the release of sidelink DRBs associated with the peer UE, or peer L2 U2U Remote UE in case of L2 U2U Relay operation, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B11988: -the establishment of sidelink DRBs associated with the peer UE, or peer L2 U2U Remote UE in case of L2 U2U Relay operation, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.2;
B11989: -the modification for the parameters included in SLRB-Config of sidelink DRBs associated with the peer UE, or peer L2 U2U Remote UE in case of L2 U2U Relay operation, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.2;
B11990: -the release of additional sidelink RLC bearer associated with the peer UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.5;
B11991: -the establishment of additional sidelink RLC bearer associated with the peer UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.6;
B11992: -the modification for the parameters included in SL-RLC-BearerConfig of additional sidelink RLC bearer associated with the peer UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1a.6;
B11993: -the release of PC5 Relay RLC channels for L2 U2N/U2U Relay UE and Remote UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.7.1;
B11994: -the establishment of PC5 Relay RLC channels for L2 U2N/U2U Relay UE and Remote UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.7.2;
B11995: -the modification for the parameters included in SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 of PC5 Relay RLC channels for L2 U2N/U2U Relay UE and Remote UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.7.2;
B11996: -the release of sidelink carrier associated with the peer UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1b.1;
B11997: -the addition of sidelink carrier associated with the peer UE, as specified in clause 5.8.9.1b.2;
B11998: -the (re-)configuration of the peer UE to perform NR sidelink measurement and report.
B11999: -the (re-)configuration of the sidelink CSI reference signal resources and CSI reporting latency bound;
B12000: -the (re-)configuration of the peer UE to perform sidelink DRX;
B12001: -the (re-)configuration of the latency bound of SL Inter-UE coordination report;
B12002: -the (re-)configuration of the local UE ID pair for L2 U2U Remote UE and its peer L2 U2U Remote UE by L2 U2U Relay UE.
B12003: -the response to the request in a RemoteUEInformationSidelink message for the SFN-DFN offset from the L2 U2N Remote UE in case of single hop;
B12004: -the change in the value of the SFN-DFN offset at the L2 U2N Relay UE.
B12005: NOTE:It is up to L2 U2N Relay UE implementation to determine when the SFN-DFN offset has changed in value to a degree requiring an update to be sent to the L2 U2N Remote UE.
B12006: In RRC_CONNECTED, the UE applies the NR sidelink communications parameters provided in RRCReconfiguration (if any). In RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, the UE applies the NR sidelink communications parameters provided in system information (if any). For other cases, UEs apply the NR sidelink communications parameters provided in SidelinkPreconfigNR (if any). When UE performs state transition between above three cases, the UE applies the NR sidelink communications parameters provided in the new state, after acquisition of the new configurations. Before acquisition of the new configurations, UE continues applying the NR sidelink communications parameters provided in the old state.
B12007: 5.8.9.1.2Actions related to transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message
B12008: The UE shall set the contents of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message as follows:
B12009: 1>for each sidelink DRB that is to be released, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1.1, due to configuration by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, by upper layers, or due to end-to-end sidelink DRB release:
B12010: 2>set the entry included in the slrb-ConfigToReleaseList corresponding to the sidelink DRB;
B12011: 1>for each sidelink DRB that is to be established or modified, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.2.1, due to receiving sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12012: 2>if the sidelink DRB is a per-hop sidelink DRB (i.e. the UE is performing NR sidelink communication with a peer UE without via a L2 U2U Relay UE):
B12013: 3>if a sidelink DRB is to be established:
B12014: 4>assign a new logical channel identity for the logical channel to be associated with the sidelink DRB and set sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 in the SLRB-Config to include the new logical channel identity;
B12015: 3>set the SLRB-Config included in the slrb-ConfigToAddModList, according to the received sl-RadioBearerConfig and sl-RLC-BearerConfig corresponding to the sidelink DRB;
B12016: 2>else if the sidelink DRB is an end-to-end sidelink DRB (i.e. the UE is acting as a L2 U2U Remote UE, and configure peer L2 U2U Remote UE with end-to-end SDAP and PDCP):
B12017: 3>set the SLRB-Config (excluding sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 and sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5) included in the slrb-ConfigToAddModList, according to the received sl-RadioBearerConfig corresponding to the sidelink DRB;
B12018: 1>for each additional sidelink RLC bearer that is to be released, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.5.1, due to configuration by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or by upper layers:
B12019: 2>set the entry included in the sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseList corresponding to the additional sidelink RLC bearer;
B12020: 1>for each additional sidelink RLC bearer that is to be established or modified, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.6.1, due to receiving sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12021: 2>if an additional sidelink RLC bearer is to be established:
B12022: 3>assign a new logical channel identity for the logical channel to be associated with the additional sidelink RLC bearer and set sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 in the SL-RLC-BearerConfig to include the new logical channel identity;
B12023: 2>set the SL-RLC-BearerConfig included in the sl-RLC-BearerToAddModList, according to the received sl-RadioBearerConfig and sl-RLC-BearerConfig corresponding to the additional sidelink RLC bearer;
B12024: 1>for each carrier that is to be released, according to clause 5.8.9.1b.1.1:
B12025: 2>include the corresponding sidelink carrier in the sl-CarrierToReleaseList;
B12026: 1>for each carrier that is to be added, according to clause 5.8.9.1b.2.1:
B12027: 2>include the corresponding sidelink carrier in the sl-CarrierToAddModList;
B12028: 1>set the sl-MeasConfig as follows:
B12029: 2>If the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12:
B12030: 3>if UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12031: 4>set the sl-MeasConfig according to stored NR sidelink measurement configuration information for this destination;
B12032: 3>if UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE:
B12033: 4>set the sl-MeasConfig according to stored NR sidelink measurement configuration received from SIB12;
B12034: 2>else:
B12035: 3>set the sl-MeasConfig according to the sl-MeasPreConfig in SidelinkPreconfigNR;
B12036: 1>set the sl-LatencyBoundIUC-Report;
B12037: 1>start timer T400 for the destination;
B12038: 1>set the sl-CSI-RS-Config;
B12039: 1>set the sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report;
B12040: 1>set the sl-ResetConfig;
B12041: NOTE 1:Whether/how to set the parameters included in sl-LatencyBoundIUC-Report, sl-CSI-RS-Config, sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report and sl-ResetConfig is up to UE implementation.
B12042: 1>set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 as follows:
B12043: 2>If the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message or included in sl-ConfigCommonNR within SIB12:
B12044: 3>if UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and if sl-ScheduledConfig is included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration:
B12045: 4>set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 according to stored NR sidelink DRX configuration information for this destination;
B12046: NOTE 2:If UE is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, or in RRC_CONNECTED and sl-UE-SelectedConfig is included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration, it is up to UE implementation to set the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5.
B12047: 1>for each PC5 Relay RLC channel that is to be released due to configuration by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR:
B12048: 2>set the SL-RLC-ChannelID corresponding to the PC5 Relay RLC channel in the sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseListPC5;
B12049: 1>for each PC5 Relay RLC channel that is to be established or modified due to receiving sl-ConfigDedicatedNR:
B12050: 2>if a PC5 Relay RLC channel is to be established:
B12051: 3>assign a new logical channel identity for the logical channel to be associated with the PC5 Relay RLC channel and set sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 in the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 to include the new logical channel identity;
B12052: 2>set the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5 according to the received SL-RLC-ChannelConfig corresponding to the PC5 Relay RLC channel, including setting sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 to the same value of sl-RLC-ChannelID received in SL-RLC-ChannelConfig;
B12053: 1>if the UE is operating as a L2 U2N Relay UE:
B12054: 2>if the destination UE is a L2 U2N Remote UE that requested the SFN-DFN offset in a previous RemoteUEInformationSidelink message:
B12055: 3>if the SFN-DFN offset has changed since a previous transmission of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message, or no previous transmission of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message has occurred since the reception of the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message:
B12056: 4>set the sl-SFN-DFN-Offset according to the relation between the SFN timeline of the PCell and the DFN timeline;
B12057: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE, and if the procedure is initiated to configure local ID pair to a connected L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12058: 2>if the local ID pair is to be assigned or modified for an end-to-end PC5 connection, and if the per-hop PC5-RRC connection with this L2 U2U Remote UE and the per-hop PC5-RRC connection with its peer L2 U2U Remote UE are successfully established:
B12059: 3>include an entry in sl-LocalID-PairList, and set the fields as below:
B12060: 4>set sl-RemoteUE-L2Identity to the source L2 ID of this L2 U2U Remote UE, and set sl-RemoteUE-LocalIdentity to include the new local UE ID assigned to this L2 U2U Remote UE, in the SL-SRAP-ConfigPC5;
B12061: 4>set sl-PeerRemoteUE-L2Identity to the source L2 ID of the peer L2 U2U Remote UE, and set sl-PeerRemoteUE-LocalIdentity to include the new local UE ID assigned to the peer L2 U2U Remote UE, in the SL-SRAP-ConfigPC5;
B12062: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE (i.e. Tx UE) and is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, and the procedure is initiated to release the first hop PC5 Relay RLC channel of an end-to-end sidelink DRB to the connected L2 U2U Relay UE (i.e. Rx UE) according to clause 5.8.9.7.1; or
B12063: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE (i.e. Tx UE) and is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, and the procedure is initiated to release the second hop PC5 Relay RLC channel of an end-to-end sidelink DRB to the connected L2 U2U Remote UE (i.e. Rx UE) according to clause 5.8.9.7.1:
B12064: 2>set the SL-RLC-ChannelID corresponding to the PC5 Relay RLC channel in the sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseListPC5;
B12065: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE (i.e. Tx UE) and is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, and if the procedure is initiated to add/modify the first hop PC5 Relay RLC channel of an end-to-end sidelink DRB to the connected L2 U2U Relay UE (i.e. Rx UE), based on configuration in SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B12066: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE (i.e. Tx UE) and is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, and if the procedure is initiated to add/modify the second hop PC5 Relay RLC channel to the connected L2 U2U Remote UE (i.e. Rx UE) based on configuration in SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12067: 2>if a PC5 Relay RLC channel is to be established:
B12068: 3>assign a new RLC channel ID and set sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 in the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 to include the new RLC channel ID;
B12069: 3>assign a new logical channel identity for the logical channel to be associated with the PC5 Relay RLC channel and set sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 in the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 to include the new logical channel identity;
B12070: 2>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE:
B12071: 3>set the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5 according to the SL-RLC-BearerConfig derived based on the per-hop QoS of the end-to-end SLRB according to sl-RLC-BearerConfigList in SIB12;
B12072: 2>else if the UE is out of coverage:
B12073: 3>set the SL-RLC-ChannelConfigPC5 included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5 according to the SL-RLC-BearerConfig derived based on the per-hop QoS of the end-to-end SLRB according to sl-RLC-BearerPreConfigList in SidelinkPreconfigNR.
B12074: NOTE 3:Void.
B12075: The UE shall submit the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12076: 5.8.9.1.3Reception of an RRCReconfigurationSidelink by the UE
B12077: The UE shall perform the following actions upon reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12078: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-ResetConfig:
B12079: 2>perform the sidelink reset configuration procedure as specified in 5.8.9.1.10;
B12080: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the slrb-ConfigToReleaseList:
B12081: 2>for each entry value included in the slrb-ConfigToReleaseList that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration;
B12082: 3>perform the sidelink DRB release procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12083: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the slrb-ConfigToAddModList:
B12084: 2>for each slrb-PC5-ConfigIndex value included in the slrb-ConfigToAddModList that is not part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12085: 3>if sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToAddList is included:
B12086: 4>apply the SL-PQFI included in sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToAddList;
B12087: 3>perform the sidelink DRB addition procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.2;
B12088: 2>for each slrb-PC5-ConfigIndex value included in the slrb-ConfigToAddModList that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12089: 3>if sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToAddList is included:
B12090: 4>add the SL-PQFI included in sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToAddList to the corresponding sidelink DRB;
B12091: 3>if sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToReleaseList is included:
B12092: 4>remove the SL-PQFI included in sl-MappedQoS-FlowsToReleaseList from the corresponding sidelink DRB;
B12093: 3>if the sidelink DRB release conditions as described in clause 5.8.9.1a.1.1 are met:
B12094: 4>perform the sidelink DRB release procedure according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1.2;
B12095: 3>else if the sidelink DRB modification conditions as described in clause 5.8.9.1a.2.1 are met:
B12096: 4>perform the sidelink DRB modification procedure according to clause 5.8.9.1a.2.2;
B12097: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseList:
B12098: 2>for each entry value included in the sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseList that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration;
B12099: 3>perform the additional sidelink RLC bearer release procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.5;
B12100: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-RLC-BearerToAddModList:
B12101: 2>for each SL-RLC-BearerConfigIndex value included in the sl-RLC-BearerToAddModList that is not part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12102: 3>perform the additional sidelink RLC bearer addition procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.6;
B12103: 2>for each SL-RLC-BearerConfigIndex value included in the sl-RLC-BearerToAddModList that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12104: 3>perform the additional sidelink RLC bearer modification procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.6;
B12105: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-CarrierToReleaseList:
B12106: 2>for each entry value included in the sl-CarrierToReleaseList that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration;
B12107: 3>perform the sidelink carrier release procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1b.1;
B12108: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-CarrierToAddModList:
B12109: 2>for each sl-CarrierId value included in the sl-CarrierToAddModList that is not part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12110: 3>perform the sidelink carrier addition procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.1b.2;
B12111: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-MeasConfig:
B12112: 2>perform the sidelink measurement configuration procedure as specified in 5.8.10;
B12113: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-CSI-RS-Config:
B12114: 2>apply the sidelink CSI-RS configuration;
B12115: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report:
B12116: 2>apply the configured sidelink CSI report latency bound;
B12117: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseListPC5:
B12118: 2>for each SL-RLC-ChannelID value included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseListPC5 that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration;
B12119: 3>perform the PC5 Relay RLC channel release procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.7.1;
B12120: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink includes the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5:
B12121: 2>for each sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 value included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5 that is not part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12122: 3>perform the PC5 Relay RLC channel addition procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.7.2;
B12123: 2>for each sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 value included in the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModListPC5 that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12124: 3>perform the PC5 Relay RLC channel modification procedure according to clause 5.8.9.7.2;
B12125: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5; and
B12126: 1>if the UE accepts the sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5:
B12127: 2>configure lower layers to perform sidelink DRX operation according to sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 for the associated destination as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B12128: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-LatencyBoundIUC-Report:
B12129: 2>apply the configured sidelink IUC report latency bound;
B12130: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-LocalID-PairList:
B12131: 2>configure SRAP entity to perform NR sidelink L2 U2U relay operation accordingly for the end-to-end PC5 connection with the peer L2 U2U Remote UE as defined in TS 38.351 [65];
B12132: 1>if the UE is unable to comply with (part of) the configuration included in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink (i.e. sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure):
B12133: 2>continue using the configuration used prior to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message;
B12134: 2>set the content of the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message;
B12135: 3>submit the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12136: 1>if the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message includes the sl-SFN-DFN-Offset:
B12137: 2>if the sl-SFN-DFN-Offset is set to setup:
B12138: 3>apply the configured SFN-DFN time offset;
B12139: 2>if the sl-SFN-DFN-Offset is set to release:
B12140: 3>release the received sl-SFN-DFN-Offset;
B12141: 1>else:
B12142: 2>set the content of the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message;
B12143: 3>if the UE rejects the sidelink DRX configuration sl-DRX-ConfigUC-PC5 received from the peer UE:
B12144: 4>include the sl-DRX-ConfigReject in the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message;
B12145: 4>consider no sidelink DRX to be applied for the corresponding sidelink unicast communication;
B12146: 3>submit the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12147: NOTE 1:When the same logical channel is configured with different RLC mode by another UE, the UE handles the case as sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure.
B12148: NOTE 2:It is up to the UE implementation whether or not to indicate the rejection to the peer UE for a received sidelink DRX configuration.
B12149: NOTE 3:When UE transmits SL-PRS in dedicated SL-PRS resource pool, the sidelink DRX configuration is not applied.
B12150: 5.8.9.1.4Void
B12151: 5.8.9.1.5Void
B12152: 5.8.9.1.6Void
B12153: 5.8.9.1.7Void
B12154: 5.8.9.1.8Reception of an RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink by the UE
B12155: The UE shall perform the following actions upon reception of the RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink:
B12156: 1>stop timer T400 for the destination, if running;
B12157: 1>continue using the configuration used prior to corresponding RRCReconfigurationSidelink message;
B12158: 1>if UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12159: 2>perform the sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure, as specified in 5.8.3.3 or clause 5.10.15 in TS 36.331 [10];
B12160: 5.8.9.1.9Reception of an RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink by the UE
B12161: The UE shall perform the following actions upon reception of the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink:
B12162: 1>stop timer T400 for the destination, if running;
B12163: 1>consider the configurations in the corresponding RRCReconfigurationSidelink message to be applied.
B12164: 2>if the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message includes the sl-DRX-ConfigReject:
B12165: 3>consider no sidelink DRX to be applied for the corresponding sidelink unicast communication.
B12166: 5.8.9.1.10Sidelink reset configuration
B12167: The UE shall:
B12168: 1>release/clear current sidelink radio configuration of this destination received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink;
B12169: 1>release the sidelink DRBs of this destination, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12170: 1>release the additional sidelink RLC bearer of this destination, if configured, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.5;
B12171: 1>reset the sidelink specific MAC of this destination, except for end-to-end PC5 connection in L2 U2U Relay operation.
B12172: NOTE 1:Sidelink radio configuration is not just the resource configuration but may include other configurations included in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message except the sidelink DRBs of this destination.
B12173: NOTE 2:After the sidelink DRB release procedure, UE may perform the sidelink DRB addition according to the current sidelink configuration of this destination, received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 and SidelinkPreconfigNR, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.2.
B12174: 5.8.9.1aSidelink radio bearer management
B12175: 5.8.9.1a.1Sidelink DRB release
B12176: 5.8.9.1a.1.1Sidelink DRB release conditions
B12177: For NR sidelink communication, a sidelink DRB release is initiated in the following cases:
B12178: 1>for groupcast, broadcast and unicast, if slrb-Uu-ConfigIndex (if any) of the sidelink DRB is included in sl-RadioBearerToReleaseList in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR; or
B12179: 1>for groupcast and broadcast, if no sidelink QoS flow with data indicated by upper layers is mapped to the sidelink DRB for transmission, which is (re)configured by receiving SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B12180: 1>for groupcast, broadcast and unicast, if SL-RLC-BearerConfigIndex (if any) of the sidelink DRB is included in sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseList/sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseListSizeExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR; or
B12181: 1>for unicast, if no sidelink QoS flow with data indicated by upper layers is mapped to the sidelink DRB for transmission, which is (re)configured by receiving SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR, and if no sidelink QoS flow mapped to the sidelink DRB, which is (re)configured by receiving RRCReconfigurationSidelink, has data; or
B12182: 1>for unicast, if SLRB-PC5-ConfigIndex (if any) of the sidelink DRB is included in slrb-ConfigToReleaseList in RRCReconfigurationSidelink or if sl-ResetConfig is included in RRCReconfigurationSidelink; or
B12183: 1>for unicast, when the corresponding PC5-RRC connection is released due to sidelink RLF being detected, according to clause 5.8.9.3; or
B12184: 1>for unicast, when the corresponding PC5-RRC connection is released due to upper layer request according to clause 5.8.9.5; or
B12185: 1>for L2 U2U relay operation, when the corresponding end-to-end PC5 connection failure is detected according to clause 5.8.9.3a; or
B12186: 1>for L2 U2U relay operation, when the corresponding end-to-end PC5-RRC connection is released due to upper layer request according to clause 5.8.9.5a.
B12187: 5.8.9.1a.1.2Sidelink DRB release operations
B12188: For each sidelink DRB, whose sidelink DRB release conditions are met as in clause 5.8.9.1a.1.1, the UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to perform NR sidelink communication shall:
B12189: 1>for groupcast and broadcast; or
B12190: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink DRB release was triggered after the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12191: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink DRB release was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or indicated by upper layers:
B12192: 2>release the PDCP entity for NR sidelink communication associated with the sidelink DRB;
B12193: 2>if SDAP entity for NR sidelink communication associated with this sidelink DRB is configured:
B12194: 3>indicate the release of the sidelink DRB to the SDAP entity associated with this sidelink DRB (TS 37.324 [24], clause 5.3.3);
B12195: 2>release SDAP entities for NR sidelink communication, if any, that have no associated sidelink DRB as specified in TS 37.324 [24] clause 5.1.2;
B12196: 1>for groupcast and broadcast; or
B12197: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink DRB release was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR:
B12198: 2>for each sl-RLC-BearerConfigIndex included in the received sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseList/sl-RLC-BearerToReleaseListSizeExt that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12199: 3>release the RLC entity and the corresponding logical channel for NR sidelink communication, associated with the sl-RLC-BearerConfigIndex.
B12200: 1>if the sidelink DRB is a per-hop sidelink DRB (i.e. the UE is performing NR sidelink communication with a peer UE without via a L2 U2U Relay UE):
B12201: 2>for unicast, if the sidelink DRB release was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12202: 2>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink DRB release was triggered due to the configuration received within the SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or indicated by upper layers:
B12203: 3>release the RLC entity and the corresponding logical channel for NR sidelink communication associated with the sidelink DRB;
B12204: 3>perform the sidelink UE information procedure in clause 5.8.3 for unicast if needed.
B12205: 1>if the sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination:
B12206: 2>release the PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of the sidelink DRB for the specific destination.
B12207: 1>if the UE is acting as a L2 U2U Remote UE, and if the end-to-end sidelink DRB release is triggered by end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to per-hop PC5 link failure, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.3a:
B12208: 2>release the PDCP entity(ies) of the end-to-end sidelink DRB(s) for the specific end-to-end PC5 connection;
B12209: 1>if the sidelink DRB is an end-to-end sidelink DRB in L2 U2U relay operation and the UE is acting as a L2 U2U remote UE:
B12210: 2>trigger the UE information transfer procedure on sidelink as specified in 5.8.9.11.2;
B12211: 5.8.9.1a.2Sidelink DRB addition/modification
B12212: 5.8.9.1a.2.1Sidelink DRB addition/modification conditions
B12213: For NR sidelink communication, a sidelink DRB addition is initiated only in the following cases:
B12214: 1>if any sidelink QoS flow is (re)configured by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR and is to be mapped to one sidelink DRB, which is not established; or
B12215: 1>if any sidelink QoS flow is (re)configured by RRCReconfigurationSidelink and is to be mapped to a sidelink DRB, which is not established;
B12216: 1>if any sidelink QoS flow is (re)configured by source L2 U2U Remote UE and is mapped to an end-to-end sidelink DRB for transmission when the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE;
B12217: The above conditions also apply to L2 U2U Remote UE for end-to-end sidelink DRB addition.
B12218: For NR sidelink communication, a sidelink DRB modification is initiated only in the following cases:
B12219: 1>if any of the sidelink DRB related parameters is changed by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or RRCReconfigurationSidelink for one sidelink DRB, which is established;
B12220: The above conditions also apply to L2 U2U Remote UE for end-to-end sidelink DRB modification.
B12221: 5.8.9.1a.2.2Sidelink DRB addition/modification operations
B12222: For the sidelink DRB, whose sidelink DRB addition conditions are met as in clause 5.8.9.1a.2.1, the UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to perform NR sidelink communication shall:
B12223: 1>for groupcast and broadcast; or
B12224: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink DRB addition was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12225: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink DRB addition was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or indicated by upper layers:
B12226: 2>if an SDAP entity for NR sidelink communication associated with the destination and the cast type of the sidelink DRB does not exist:
B12227: 3>establish an SDAP entity for NR sidelink communication as specified in TS 37.324 [24] clause 5.1.1;
B12228: 2>(re)configure the SDAP entity in accordance with the sl-SDAP-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-SDAP-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, associated with the sidelink DRB;
B12229: 2>establish a PDCP entity for NR sidelink communication and configure it in accordance with the sl-PDCP-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-PDCP-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, associated with the sidelink DRB;
B12230: 2>for a per-hop sidelink DRB (i.e. the UE is performing NR sidelink communication with a peer UE without via a L2 U2U Relay UE):
B12231: 3>establish a RLC entity for NR sidelink communication and configure it in accordance with the sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-RLC-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, associated with sidelink DRB;
B12232: 3>if this procedure was due to the reception of a RRCReconfigurationSidelink message:
B12233: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink associated with the sidelink DRB, and perform the sidelink UE information procedure in clause 5.8.3 for unicast if needed;
B12234: 3>else if this procedure was due to the reception of a RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message:
B12235: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel associated with the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR;
B12236: 3>else (i.e. for groupcast/broadcast):
B12237: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel associated with the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR and assign a new LCID to this logical channel.
B12238: 1>if the DRB is an end-to-end sidelink DRB and the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12239: 2>trigger the UE information transfer procedure on sidelink as specified in 5.8.9.11.2;
B12240: NOTE 1:When a sidelink DRB addition is due to the configuration by RRCReconfigurationSidelink, it is up to UE implementation to select the sidelink DRB configuration as necessary transmitting parameters for the sidelink DRB, from the received sl-ConfigDedicatedNR (if in RRC_CONNECTED), SIB12 (if in RRC_IDLE/INACTIVE), SidelinkPreconfigNR (if out of coverage) with the same RLC mode as the one configured in RRCReconfigurationSidelink.
B12241: For the sidelink DRB, whose sidelink DRB modification conditions are met as in clause 5.8.9.1a.2.1, the UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to perform NR sidelink communication shall:
B12242: 1>for groupcast and broadcast; or
B12243: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink DRB modification was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12244: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink DRB modification was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12245: 2>reconfigure the SDAP entity of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-SDAP-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-SDAP-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included;
B12246: 2>reconfigure the PDCP entity of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-PDCP-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-PDCP-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included;
B12247: 2>reconfigure the RLC entity of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-RLC-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included;
B12248: 2>reconfigure the logical channel of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included;
B12249: 1>if the DRB is an end-to-end sidelink DRB and the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12250: 2>trigger the UE information transfer procedure on sidelink as specified in 5.8.9.11.2.
B12251: 5.8.9.1a.3Sidelink SRB release
B12252: The UE shall:
B12253: 1>if a PC5-RRC connection release for a specific destination is requested by upper layers or AS layer; or
B12254: 1>if the sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination:
B12255: 2>release the PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB for PC5-RRC message of the specific destination;
B12256: 2>consider the PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination.
B12257: 1>if PC5-S transmission for a specific destination is terminated in upper layers:
B12258: 2>release the PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB(s) for PC5-S message of the specific destination if any;
B12259: 1>if discovery transmission for a specific destination is terminated in upper layers:
B12260: 2>release the PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of the sidelink SRB4 for discovery message of the specific destination;
B12261: 1>if an end-to-end PC5-RRC connection release/failure is detected:
B12262: 2>if the UE is acting L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12263: 3>release the PDCP entity of the end-to-end sidelink SRB for the end-to-end PC5 connection;
B12264: 2>release the association between the end-to-end sidelink SRB and the egress PC5 Relay RLC channel, and reconfigure SRAP configuration.
B12265: 5.8.9.1a.4Sidelink SRB addition
B12266: The UE shall:
B12267: 1>if transmission of PC5-S message for a specific destination is requested by upper layers for sidelink SRB:
B12268: 2>establish PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of a sidelink SRB for PC5-S message if needed, as specified in clause 9.1.1.4;
B12269: 2>if in coverage on the frequency used for the NR sidelink communication as defined in TS 38.304 [20]:
B12270: 3>indicate the allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB before the reception of initial RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message which confirms SL CA carrier(s) addition as indicated in sl-FreqInfoList, to lower layer;
B12271: 2>else:
B12272: 3>indicate the allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB before the reception of initial RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message which confirms SL CA carrier(s) addition as indicated in sl-PreconfigFreqInfoList, to lower layer;
B12273: 1>if transmission of discovery message for a specific destination is requested by upper layers for sidelink SRB:
B12274: 2>establish PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of a sidelink SRB4 for discovery message, as specified in clause 9.1.1.4;
B12275: 1>if a PC5-RRC connection establishment for a specific destination is indicated by upper layers:
B12276: 2>establish PDCP entity, RLC entity and the logical channel of a sidelink SRB for PC5-RRC message of the specific destination if needed, as specified in clause 9.1.1.4;
B12277: 2>consider the PC5-RRC connection is established for the destination;
B12278: 2>if in coverage on the frequency used for the NR sidelink communication as defined in TS 38.304 [20]:
B12279: 3>indicate the allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB before the reception of initial RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message which confirms SL CA carrier(s) addition, as indicated in sl-FreqInfoList, to lower layer;
B12280: 2>else:
B12281: 3>indicate the allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB before the reception of initial RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message which confirms SL CA carrier(s) addition as specified in clause 5.8.9.1.9, as indicated in sl-PreconfigFreqInfoList, to lower layer;
B12282: 1>for end-to-end SRB0/1/2/3:
B12283: 2>if the UE is acting L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12284: 3>consider the SL-U2U-RLC as specified in clause 9.1.1.4 as the egress PC5 Relay RLC channel;
B12285: 4>associate this end-to-end sidelink SRB with the SL-U2U-RLC and configure the mapping between the end-to-end sidelink SRB and the egress PC5 Relay RLC channel to SRAP.

B12305: 5.8.9.1a.6Additional Sidelink RLC Bearer addition/modification
B12306: 5.8.9.1a.6.1Additional Sidelink RLC Bearer addition/modification conditions

B12309: 1>for groupcast and broadcast, for sidelink DRB, if SL-RLC-BearerConfig is received in sl-RLC-BearerToAddModListSizeExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for a sl-ServedRadioBearer; or
B12310: 1>for unicast, for sidelink DRB, if SL-RLC-BearerConfig is received in sl-RLC-BearerToAddModListSizeExt in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for a sl-ServedRadioBearer; or
B12311: 1>for groupcast and broadcast, for sidelink DRB, if SL-RLC-BearerConfig is received in sl-RLC-BearerConfigListSizeExt in SIB12 or in SidelinkPreconfigNR for a sl-ServedRadioBearer, if the sidelink DRB has been established as in clause 5.8.9.1a.2 and has not been released as in clause 5.8.9.1a.1, and if the SL-TxProfile of all associated QoS flow(s) for the sl-ServedRadioBearer indicates backwardsIncompatible; or
B12312: 1>for groupcast and broadcast, for sidelink DRB, if SL-RLC-BearerConfig is received in sl-RLC-BearerConfigListSizeExt in SIB12 or in SidelinkPreconfigNR for a sl-ServedRadioBearer, if the sidelink DRB has been established as in clause 5.8.9.1a.2 and has not been released as in clause 5.8.9.1a.1, and if the SL-TxProfile of at least one QoS flow for the sl-ServedRadioBearer indicates backwardsCompatible and UE decides to use PDCP duplication; or
B12313: 1>for unicast, for sidelink DRB, if SL-RLC-BearerConfig is received in sl-RLC-BearerConfigListSizeExt in SIB12 or in SidelinkPreconfigNR for a sl-ServedRadioBearer, and if both UEs support PDCP duplication; or
B12314: 1>for unicast, for sidelink SRB 1/2/3, if both UEs support PDCP duplication and UE decides to use PDCP duplication;
B12315: For NR sidelink communication, additional sidelink RLC bearer modification is initiated only in the following cases:
B12316: 1>if any of the additional sidelink RLC bearer related parameters is changed by sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or RRCReconfigurationSidelink for one additional sidelink RLC bearer, which is established;
B12317: 5.8.9.1a.6.2Additional Sidelink RLC Bearer addition/modification operation

B12320: 1>for unicast, if the additional Sidelink RLC bearer addition was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or

B12323: 2>establish an additional RLC entity for NR sidelink communication and configure it in accordance with each sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-RLC-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR for SL DRB, or as specified in clause 9.1.1.4 for SL SRB;
B12324: 2>if this procedure was for Sidelink DRB:
B12325: 3>if this procedure was due to the reception of a RRCReconfigurationSidelink message:
B12326: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink associated with the sidelink RLC entity;
B12327: 3>else if this procedure was due to the reception of a RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message:
B12328: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel associated with the sidelink RLC entity, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR;
B12329: 3>else (i.e. for groupcast/broadcast):
B12330: 4>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel associated with the sidelink RLC entity, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR and assign a new LCID to this logical channel.
B12331: 3>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12332: 4>indicate the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers of the DRB, as indicated in sl-AllowedCarriers, to lower layer;
B12333: 3>else:
B12334: 4>indicate the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers of the DRB, decided by UE implementation, from the sidelink carrier(s) mapped to the sidelink QoS flow(s) configured by the upper layer which is allowed carrier as indicated in sl-FregInfoList as specified in 5.8.9.1a.4 or is additional allowed carrier(s) as specified in 5.8.9.1b.1.2 and 5.8.9.1b.2.2, to lower layer, where the carrier indicated in sl-FreqInfoList is used for the RLC bearer if the SL-TxProfile of at least one associated QoS flow for the sl-ServedRadioBearer indicates backwardsCompatible, and the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers are not overlapping with each other;
B12335: 2>else (i.e., if this procedure was for Sidelink SRB):
B12336: 3>configure the MAC entity with a logical channel associated with the sidelink RLC entity, as specified in clause 9.1.1.4.
B12337: 3>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and if sl-AllowedCarrierFreqSet1/sl-AllowedCarrierFreqSet2 are configured:
B12338: 4>indicate the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers of the SRB, as indicated in sl-AllowedCarrierFreqSet1/sl-AllowedCarrierFreqSet2, to lower layer;
B12339: 3>else:
B12340: 4>indicate the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers of the SRB, decided by UE implementation, from the allowed carrier as indicated in sl-FregInfoList as specified in 5.8.9.1a.4 and additional allowed carrier(s) as specified in 5.8.9.1b.1.2 and 5.8.9.1b.2.2, to lower layer, where the allowed carriers for the two RLC bearers are not overlapping with each other;
B12341: For the additional Sidelink RLC bearer, whose modification conditions are met as in clause 5.8.9.1a.6.1, the UE capable of NR sidelink communication that is configured by upper layers to perform NR sidelink communication shall:
B12342: 1>for groupcast and broadcast; or
B12343: 1>for unicast, if the additional Sidelink RLC bearer modification was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12344: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the additional Sidelink RLC bearer modification was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12345: 2>reconfigure the RLC entity of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-RLC-Config received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included;
B12346: 2>reconfigure the logical channel of the sidelink DRB, in accordance with the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 received in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink or sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR, if included.
B12347: 5.8.9.1bSidelink Carrier Configuration
B12348: 5.8.9.1b.1Sidelink Carrier Release
B12349: 5.8.9.1b.1.1Sidelink Carrier Release Condition
B12350: For NR sidelink communication, sidelink carrier release is initiated in the following cases:
B12351: 1>for unicast, if sl-CarrierId of the sidelink carrier is received in sl-CarrierToReleaseList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink; or
B12352: 1>for unicast, if a sidelink carrier failure has been indicated by MAC layer; or
B12353: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink carrier release was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or upper layer; or
B12354: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink SRB(s), DRB(s) or additional sidelink RLC bearer(s), which was associated with the sidelink carrier(s), are released according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3.1, 5.8.9.1a.1.1 or 5.8.9.1a.5.1;
B12355: 5.8.9.1b.1.2Sidelink Carrier Release Operation
B12356: The UE shall:
B12357: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink carrier release was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message:
B12358: 2>for each sl-CarrierId value included in the sl-CarrierToReleaseList:
B12359: 3>if the current UE configuration includes a sidelink carrier with value sl-CarrierId:
B12360: 4>release the sidelink carrier for reception.
B12361: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink carrier release was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or indicated by upper layers:
B12362: 2>for each sl-CarrierId value included in the sl-CarrierToReleaseList:
B12363: 3>if the current UE configuration includes a sidelink carrier with value sl-CarrierId:
B12364: 4>release the sidelink carrier for transmission;
B12365: 4>indicate the sidelink carrier not as allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB to lower layer;
B12366: 4>indicate the sidelink carrier not as additional allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the DRB(s), to lower layer.
B12367: 5.8.9.1b.2Sidelink Carrier Addition
B12368: 5.8.9.1b.2.1Sidelink Carrier Addition Condition
B12369: For NR sidelink communication, sidelink carrier addition is initiated in the following cases:
B12370: 1>for unicast, if sl-CarrierId of the sidelink carrier is received in sl-CarrierToAddModList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink; or
B12371: 1>for unicast, if a sidelink SRB(s), DRB(s) or additional sidelink RLC bearer(s), which is associated with the sidelink carrier(s) (taking into account at least carrier(s) mapped to the sidelink QoS flow(s) configured by the upper layer, carriers configured in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12 or SidelinkPreconfigNR, and carrier(s) supported by both UEs), are established according to clause 5.8.9.1a.4, 5.8.9.1a.2.1 or 5.8.9.1a.6.1;
B12372: 5.8.9.1b.2.2Sidelink Carrier Addition Operation
B12373: The UE shall:
B12374: 1>for unicast, if the sidelink carrier addition was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message:
B12375: 2>for each sl-CarrierId value included in the sl-CarrierToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration (sidelink carrier addition):
B12376: 3>add the sidelink carrier, corresponding to the sl-CarrierId, in accordance with the sl-OffsetToCarrier, subcarrierSpacing, carrierBandwidth and sl-AbsoluteFrequencyPointA for reception;
B12377: 1>for unicast, after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the sidelink carrier addition was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, SIB12, SidelinkPreconfigNR or indicated by upper layers:
B12378: 2>for each sl-CarrierId value included in the sl-CarrierToAddModList that is not part of the current UE configuration (sidelink carrier addition):
B12379: 3>add the sidelink carrier, corresponding to the sl-CarrierId, in accordance with the sl-AbsoluteFrequencyPointA for transmission;
B12380: 3>indicate the sidelink carrier as additional allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the SRB, in addition to carrier as indicated in sl-FreqInfoList, from carrier(s) mapped to the sidelink QoS flow(s) configured by the upper layer, to lower layer;
B12381: 3>indicate the sidelink carrier as additional allowed carrier for the RLC bearer of the DRB(s), for which the sidelink carrier is mapped to the sidelink QoS flow(s) configured by the upper layer, to lower layer;
B12382: 5.8.9.2Sidelink UE capability transfer
B12383: 5.8.9.2.1General
B12384: This clause describes how the UE compiles and transfers its sidelink UE capability information for unicast to the initiating UE.
B12386: Figure 5.8.9.2.1-1: Sidelink UE capability transfer
B12387: 5.8.9.2.2Initiation
B12388: The UE may initiate the sidelink UE capability transfer procedure upon indication from upper layer when it needs (additional) UE radio access capability information.
B12389: 5.8.9.2.3Actions related to transmission of the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink by the UE
B12390: The initiating UE shall set the contents of UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message as follows:
B12391: 1>include in UE radio access capabilities for sidelink within ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink, if needed;
B12392: NOTE 1:It is up to initiating UE to decide whether ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink should be included.
B12393: 1>set frequencyBandListFilterSidelink to include frequency bands for which the peer UE is requested to provide supported bands and band combinations;
B12394: NOTE 2:The initiating UE is not allowed to send the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message without including the field frequencyBandListFilterSidelink except for end-to-end L2 U2U relay NR sidelink communication.
B12395: 1>submit the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12396: 5.8.9.2.4Actions related to reception of the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink by the UE
B12397: The peer UE shall set the contents of UECapabilityInformationSidelink message as follows:
B12398: 1>include UE radio access capabilities for sidelink within ue-CapabilityInformationSidelink;
B12399: 1>compile a list of "candidate band combinations" only consisting of bands included in frequencyBandListFilterSidelink, and prioritized in the order of frequencyBandListFilterSidelink (i.e. first include band combinations containing the first-listed band, then include remaining band combinations containing the second-listed band, and so on).
B12400: 1>include into supportedBandCombinationListSidelinkNR as many band combinations as possible from the list of "candidate band combinations", starting from the first entry;
B12401: 1>include the received frequencyBandListFilterSidelink in the field appliedFreqBandListFilter of the requested UE capability;
B12402: 1>submit the UECapabilityInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12403: NOTE 1:If the UE cannot include all band combinations due to message size or list size constraints, it is up to UE implementation which band combinations it prioritizes.
B12404: NOTE 2:It is up to UE implementation whether to include fields other than pdcp-ParametersSidelink in the UECapabilityInformationSidelink message for end-to-end L2 U2U relay NR sidelink communication.
B12405: 5.8.9.3Sidelink radio link failure related actions
B12406: The UE shall:
B12407: 1>upon indication from sidelink RLC entity that the maximum number of retransmissions for a specific destination has been reached; or
B12408: 1>upon T400 expiry for a specific destination; or
B12409: 1>upon indication from MAC entity that HARQ-based Sidelink RLF for a specific destination has been detected; or
B12410: 1>upon integrity check failure indication from sidelink PDCP entity concerning SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3 for a specific destination; or
B12411: 1>upon indication of consistent sidelink LBT failures for all RB sets for a specific destination from MAC entity:
B12412: 2>consider sidelink radio link failure to be detected for this destination;
B12413: 2>release the DRBs (if any) of this destination, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12414: 2>release the SRBs of this destination, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3;
B12415: 2>release the PC5 Relay RLC channels of this destination if configured, in according to clause 5.8.9.7.1;
B12416: 2>discard the NR sidelink communication related configuration of this destination;
B12417: 2>reset the sidelink specific MAC of this destination, except for end-to-end PC5 connection in L2 U2U Relay operation;
B12418: 2>consider the PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination;
B12419: 2>indicate the release of the PC5-RRC connection to the upper layers for this destination (i.e. PC5 is unavailable);
B12420: 2>if UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12421: 3>if the UE is acting as L2 U2N Remote UE for the destination:
B12422: 4>if MP is configured, and neither MCG transmission nor indirect path transmission is suspended:
B12423: 5>initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3c;
B12424: 4>else (i.e., MP is not configured, or MP is configured and MCG transmission or indirect path transmission is suspended):
B12425: 5>initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7;
B12426: 3>else:
B12427: 4>perform the sidelink UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure, as specified in 5.8.3.3;
B12428: 2>else (i.e. the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE):
B12429: 3>if the UE is acting as L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE for a destination and the destination is a child UE:
B12430: 4>perform the Remote UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure with its parent UE, as specified in 5.8.9.8;
B12431: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE for the destination which identifies a connected L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12432: 3>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection failure for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) over the per-hop PC5 link established with the L2 U2U Remote UE;
B12433: 3>send NotificationMessageSidelink to the peer L2 U2U Remote UE(s) of the end-to-end PC5 connection(s), in accordance with 5.8.9.10.
B12434: 3>initiate the end-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3b;
B12435: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE for the destination which identifies a connected L2 U2U Relay UE:
B12436: 3>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection failure for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) over the per-hop PC5 link established with the L2 U2U Relay UE;
B12437: 3>initiate the end-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3a;
B12438: NOTE:It is up to UE implementation on whether and how to indicate to upper layers to maintain the keep-alive procedure [55].
B12439: 5.8.9.3aEnd-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions performed by L2 U2U Remote UE
B12440: The UE acting as NR sidelink L2 U2U Remote UE shall:
B12441: 1>upon detection of end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to per-hop PC5 link failure, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.3; or
B12442: 1>upon detection of end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to per-hop PC5 link release, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.5; or
B12443: 1>upon T400 expiry for an end-to-end PC5 connection; or
B12444: 1>upon integrity check failure indication from sidelink PDCP entity concerning SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3 for an end-to-end PC5 connection; or
B12445: 1>upon detection end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink indicating PC5 RLF from the L2 U2U Relay UE for a specific destination based on the received sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.10.4:
B12446: 2>release the end-to-end DRBs for this end-to-end PC5 connection, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12447: 2>release the end-to-end SRBs for this end-to-end PC5 connection, according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3;
B12448: 2>discard the end-to-end NR sidelink communication related radio resources and configuration for this end-to-end PC5 connection, including local ID pair in SRAP configuration;
B12449: 2>consider the end-to-end PC5-RRC connection is released for this end-to-end PC5 connection;
B12450: 2>indicate the release of the end-to-end PC5-RRC connection to the upper layers;
B12451: 2>if the end-to-end PC5 connection failure is due to T400 expiry or integrity check failure of SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3:
B12452: 3>send RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to the L2 U2U Relay UE of the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) in accordance with 5.8.9.8.2;
B12453: 1>if the PC5 link between the UE and L2 U2U relay UE is not needed for U2U relay operation, but not released:
B12454: 2>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage:
B12455: 3>trigger the PC5 Relay RLC channel derivation procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.7.0.
B12456: 5.8.9.3bEnd-to-end PC5 connection failure/release related actions performed by L2 U2U Relay UE
B12457: The UE acting as NR sidelink L2 U2U Relay UE shall:
B12458: 1>upon detection end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to per-hop PC5 link failure, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.3; or
B12459: 1>upon detection end-to-end PC5 connection failure due to per-hop PC5 link release, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.5; or
B12460: 1>upon reception of RemoteUEInfomationSidelink indicating end-to-end connection release or failure for a specific destination based on the received sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE, in accordance with clause 5.8.9.8.3:
B12461: 2>discard the end-to-end NR sidelink communication related radio resources and configuration for this end-to-end PC5 connection, including end-to-end SRB/DRB related configuration, QoS related configuration, SRAP configuration;
B12462: 2>if the PC5 link between L2 U2U relay UE and the peer L2 U2U remote UE is still available:
B12463: 3>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage:
B12464: 4>trigger the PC5 Relay RLC channel deriviation procedure, according to clause 5.8.9.7.0;
B12465: 3>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12466: 4>initiate sidelink UE information procedure according to clause 5.8.3.2.
B12467: 5.8.9.4Sidelink common control information
B12468: 5.8.9.4.1General
B12469: The sidelink common control information is carried by MasterInformationBlockSidelink. The sidelink common control information may change at any transmission, i.e. neither a modification period nor a change notification mechanism is used. This procedure also applies to NR sidelink discovery.
B12470: A UE configured to receive or transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning shall:
B12471: 1>if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE, as specified in 5.8.6:
B12472: 2>ensure having a valid version of the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message of that SyncRef UE;
B12473: 5.8.9.4.2Actions related to reception of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
B12474: Upon receiving MasterInformationBlockSidelink, the UE shall:
B12475: 1>apply the values included in the received MasterInformationBlockSidelink message.
B12476: 5.8.9.4.3Transmission of MasterInformationBlockSidelink message
B12477: The UE shall set the contents of the MasterInformationBlockSidelink message as follows:
B12478: 1>if in coverage on the frequency used for the NR sidelink communication/positioning as defined in TS 38.304 [20].
B12479: 2>set inCoverage to true;
B12480: 2>if tdd-UL-DL-ConfigurationCommon is included in the received SIB1:
B12481: 3>set sl-TDD-Config to the value representing the same meaning as that is included in tdd-UL-DL-ConfigurationCommon, as described in TS 38.213, clause 16.1 [13];
B12482: 2>else:
B12483: 3>set sl-TDD-Config to the value as specified in TS 38.213 [13], clause 16.1;
B12484: 2>if syncInfoReserved is included in an entry of configured sl-SyncConfigList corresponding to the concerned frequency from the received SIB12:
B12485: 3>set reservedBits to the value of syncInfoReserved in the received SIB12;
B12486: 2>else:
B12487: 3>set all bits in reservedBits to 0;
B12488: 1>else if out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/positioning as defined in TS 38.304 [20]; and the concerned frequency is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList/sl-FreqInfoToAddModListExt in RRCReconfiguration or in sl-FreqInfoList/sl-FreqInfoListSizeExt within SIB12:
B12489: 2>set inCoverage to true;
B12490: 2>set reservedBits to the value of the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SidelinkPreconfigNR defined in 9.3);
B12491: 2>set sl-TDD-Config to the value representing the same meaning as that is included in the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SL-PreconfigurationNR defined in 9.3) as described in TS 38.213, clause 16.1 [13];
B12492: 1>else if out of coverage on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication/positioning as defined in TS 38.304 [20]; and the UE selects GNSS as the synchronization reference and sl-SSB-TimeAllocation3 is not configured for the frequency used in SidelinkPreconfigNR:
B12493: 2>set inCoverage to true;
B12494: 2>set reservedBits to the value of the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SidelinkPreconfigNR defined in 9.3);
B12496: 2>set sl-TDD-Config to the value representing the same meaning as that is included in the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SL-PreconfigurationNR defined in 9.3) as described in TS 38.213, clause 16.1 [13];
B12497: 1>else if the UE has a selected SyncRef UE (as defined in 5.8.6):
B12498: 2>set inCoverage to false;
B12499: 2>set sl-TDD-Config and reservedBits to the value of the corresponding field included in the received MasterInformationBlockSidelink;
B12500: 1>else:
B12501: 2>set inCoverage to false;
B12502: 2>set reservedBits to the value of the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SidelinkPreconfigNR defined in 9.3);
B12503: 2> set sl-TDD-Config to the value representing the same meaning as that is included in the corresponding field included in the preconfigured sidelink parameters (i.e. sl-PreconfigGeneral in SL-PreconfigurationNR defined in 9.3) as described in TS 38.213, clause 16.1 [13];
B12504: 1>set directFrameNumber and slotIndex according to the slot used to transmit the SLSS, as specified in 5.8.5.3;
B12505: 1>submit the MasterInformationBlockSidelink to lower layers for transmission upon which the procedure ends;
B12506: 5.8.9.5Actions related to PC5-RRC connection release requested by upper layers
B12507: The UE initiates the procedure when upper layers request the release of the PC5-RRC connection as specified in TS 24.587 [57] or TS 24.554 [72]. The UE shall not initiate the procedure for power saving purposes.
B12508: The UE shall:
B12509: 1>if the PC5-RRC connection release for the specific destination is requested by upper layers:
B12510: 2>discard the NR sidelink communication related configuration of this destination;
B12511: 2>release the DRBs of this destination if configured, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12512: 2>release the SRBs of this destination, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3;
B12513: 2>release the PC5 Relay RLC channels if configured, in according to clause 5.8.9.7.1;
B12514: 2>reset the sidelink specific MAC of this destination except for end-to-end PC5-RRC connection in L2 U2U relay operation.
B12515: 2>consider the PC5-RRC connection is released for the destination;
B12516: 2>if the UE is acting as MP remote UE, and this destination identifies a connected MP relay UE:
B12517: 3>if neither MCG transmission nor indirect path transmission is suspended:
B12518: 4>initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3c to report indirect path failure;
B12519: 3>else if T301 is not running:
B12520: 4>initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7;
B12521: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE, and this destination identifies a connected L2 U2U Relay UE:
B12522: 3>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection failure for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) over the per-hop PC5 link established with the L2 U2U Relay UE;
B12523: 3>initiate the end-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3a;
B12524: 2>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE, and this destination identifies a connected L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12525: 3>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection failure for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) over the per-hop PC5 link established with the L2 U2U Remote UE;
B12526: 3>send NotificationMessageSidelink message to the peer L2 U2U Remote UE(s) for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) in accordance with 5.8.9.10;
B12527: 3>initiate the end-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3b;
B12528: 5.8.9.5aActions related to end-to-end PC5-RRC connection release performed by L2 U2U Remote UE
B12529: The UE acting as sidelink L2 U2U Remote UE shall:
B12530: 1>if the end-to-end PC5-RRC connection release is requested by upper layers as specified in TS 23.304 [65]:
B12531: 2>release the end-to-end DRBs for this end-to-end PC5-RRC connection if configured, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.1;
B12532: 2>release the end-to-end SRBs for this end-to-end PC5-RRC connection, in according to clause 5.8.9.1a.3;
B12533: 2>discard all the radio resources and configuration for this end-to-end PC5-RRC connection, including local ID pair in SRAP configuration;
B12534: 2>consider the end-to-end PC5-RRC connection is released for this end-to-end PC5-RRC connection;
B12535: 2>send RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to the L2 U2U Relay UE of the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) in accordance with 5.8.9.8.2;
B12536: 5.8.9.6Sidelink UE assistance information
B12537: 5.8.9.6.1General
B12539: Figure 5.8.9.6.1-1: Sidelink UE assistance information
B12540: The purpose of this procedure is for a UE to inform its peer UE of the sidelink DRX assistance information used to determine the sidelink DRX configuration for unicast communication.
B12541: For sidelink unicast, a UE may include its desired sidelink DRX configurations in the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink as the sidelink DRX assistance information which is transmitted to its peer UE.
B12542: NOTE:It is up to UE implementation to determine its desired sidelink DRX configurations for unicast communication.
B12543: 5.8.9.6.2Initiation
B12544: For sidelink unicast, if both a RX UE and its peer TX UE for a direction of sidelink communication are capable of sidelink DRX, the RX UE that is interested in sending the sidelink DRX assistance information may send the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink as the sidelink DRX assistance information to its peer UE when the sidelink DRX assistance information has not been sent previously or when the previously transmitted sidelink DRX assistance information has changed.
B12545: 5.8.9.6.3Actions related to reception of UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message
B12546: For sidelink unicast, when a UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and is performing sidelink operation with resource allocation mode 1, it may report the sidelink DRX assistance information received within the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink from its peer UE to the network as specified in 5.8.3. For sidelink unicast, when a UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and is performing sidelink operation with resource allocation mode 2 or is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, regardless of whether the UE has obtained the sidelink DRX assistance information from the UEAssistanceInformationSidelink transmitted from its peer UE or not, it may determine the sidelink DRX configuration SL-DRX-ConfigUC for its peer UE.
B12547: NOTE:When UE determines the sidelink DRX configuration for its peer UE, it may take the sidelink DRX assistance information received from its peer UE into account.
B12548: 5.8.9.7PC5 Relay RLC channel management for L2 U2N or U2U relay
B12549: 5.8.9.7.0Deriviation of PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration
B12550: An L2 U2U Remote UE/L2 U2U Relay UE in RRC_IDLE or in RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage shall derive PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration based on the per-hop QoS requirements.
