The update of the PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration can be triggered upon reception of the UEInformationRequestSidelink or UEInformationResponseSidelink due to the update of the per-hop QoS requirements, as described in clause 5.8.9.11.3 and 5.8.9.11.4, or upon detection of end-to-end PC5 connection failure/release, as described in clause 5.8.9.3a and 5.8.9.3b. The UE shall perform PC5 Relay RLC channel release/addition/modification procedure when the corresponding PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration is released/added/modified.
B12551: The source L2 U2U Remote UE and L2 U2U Relay UE derive the configuration for the corresponding PC5 Relay RLC channel based on SIB12/Preconfiguration, as follows:
B12552: -The source L2 U2U Remote UE derives the configuration for the PC5 Relay RLC channel(s) between the source L2 U2U Remote UE and L2 U2U Relay UE (i.e. the first hop PC5 Relay RLC channel(s)), by aggregating the QoS profile(s) of the QoS flow(s) with split QoS information on the first hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile for each end-to-end sidelink DRB as described in clause 5.8.9.11.4, and considering the SL-RLC-BearerConfig in either sl-RLC-BearerConfigList or sl-RLC-BearerPreConfigList (linked to the SL-RadioBearerConfig which matches the per-SLRB level QoS profile) as the first hop PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration.
B12553: -The L2 U2U Relay UE derives the configuration for the PC5 Relay RLC channel(s) between L2 U2U Relay UE and the target L2 U2U Remote UE (i.e. the second hop PC5 Relay RLC channel(s)), by aggregating the QoS profile(s) of the QoS flow(s) with split QoS information on the second hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile for each end-to-end sidelink DRB as described in clause 5.8.9.11.3, and considering the SL-RLC-BearerConfig in either sl-RLC-BearerConfigList or sl-RLC-BearerPreConfigList (linked to the SL-RadioBearerConfig which matches the per-SLRB level QoS profile) as the second hop PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration.
B12554: 5.8.9.7.1PC5 Relay RLC channel release
B12555: The UE shall:
B12556: 1>if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered after the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12557: 1>after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR:
B12558: 2>for each SL-RLC-ChannelID in sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration, or for each SL-RLC-ChannelID included in the received sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseListPC5 that is part of the current UE sidelink configuration:
B12559: 3>release the RLC entity and the corresponding logical channel associated with the SL-RLC-ChannelID;
B12560: 1>after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered based on the derivation of PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration for end-to-end sidelink DRB(s) as specified in 5.8.9.7.0:
B12561: 2>release the RLC entity and the corresponding logical channel;
B12562: 1>if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered for a specific destination by upper layers as specified in 5.8.9.5, or due to sidelink RLF as specified in 5.8.9.3:
B12563: 2>release the RLC entity and the corresponding logical channel associated with the SL-RLC-ChannelID of the specific destination.
B12564: 5.8.9.7.2PC5 Relay RLC channel addition/modification
B12565: Upon PC5-RRC connection establishment between the L2 U2N Relay UE and L2 U2N Remote UE, the L2 U2N Relay UE shall:
B12566: 1>establish a SRAP entity as specified in TS 38.351 [66], if no SRAP entity has been established;
B12567: 1>apply RLC specified configuration of SL-RLC0 as specified in clause 9.1.1.4:
B12568: 1>apply RLC default configuration of SL-RLC1 as defined in clause 9.2.4 if the L2 U2N Relay UE is in RRC_IDLE/INACTIVE state;
B12569: Upon PC5-RRC connection establishment between two UEs for L2 U2U relay operation, the L2 U2U Relay UE and the L2 U2U Remote UE shall:
B12570: 1>establish a SRAP entity as specified in TS 38.351 [66], if no SRAP entity has been established;
B12571: 1>apply RLC specified configuration of SL-U2U-RLC as specified in clause 9.1.1.4;
B12572: A L2 U2N relay UE initiates a PC5 Relay RLC channel addition towards a L2 U2N Remote UE if the sl-RLC-ChannelID received in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR is indicated for this L2 U2N Remote UE in accordance with sl-SRAP-ConfigRelay, and a PC5 Relay RLC channel with the received sl-RLC-ChannelID was not configured before.
B12573: The UE shall:
B12574: 1>if the PC5 Relay RLC channel addition/modification was triggered due to the reception of the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message; or
B12575: 1>after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the PC5 Relay RLC channel addition/modification was triggered due to the configuration received within the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR; or
B12576: 1>after receiving the RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message, if the PC5 Relay RLC channel addition/modification was triggered based on the derivation of PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration(s) for end-to-end sidelink DRB(s) as specified in 5.8.9.7.0:
B12577: 2>if the current configuration contains a PC5 Relay RLC channel with the received sl-RLC-ChannelID or sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5:
B12578: 3>reconfigure the sidelink RLC entity in accordance with the received sl-RLC-Config or sl-RLC-ConfigPC5;
B12579: 3>reconfigure the sidelink MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance with the received sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig or sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5;
B12580: 2>else (a PC5 Relay RLC channel with the received sl-RLC-ChannelID or sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 was not configured before):
B12581: 3>establish a sidelink RLC entity in accordance with the received sl-RLC-Config (in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, or SIB12, or SidelinkPreconfigNR) or sl-RLC-ConfigPC5;
B12582: 3>configure the sidelink MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance with the received sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfig or sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5.
B12583: 5.8.9.8Remote UE information
B12584: 5.8.9.8.1General
B12586: Figure 5.8.9.8.1-1: Remote UE information
B12587: This procedure is used by the L2 U2N Remote UE or L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE to inform about the required SIB(s) /posSIB(s), provide Paging related information to the connected parent L2 U2N Relay UE, request the SFN-DFN offset from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE in case of single hop, and trigger L2 U2N Relay UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE to enter RRC_CONNECTED during indirect path addition/change in MP operation. This procedure is also used by the L2 U2U Remote UE to send end-to-end PC5 connection release/failure related information to L2 U2U Relay UE.
B12588: This procedure is used by the L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED to request the SFN-DFN offset from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE in case of single hop.
B12589: NOTE:MIB is not required by a L2 U2N Remote UE.
B12590: 5.8.9.8.2Actions related to transmission of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message
B12591: When L2 U2N remote UE entering RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, or upon change in any of the information in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink for L2 U2N Remote UE’s own SIB/posSIB/Paging or SFN-DFN offset request while in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall:
B12592: 1>if the UE has SIB request information to provide (e.g. the UE has not stored a valid version of a SIB, in accordance with clause 5.2.2.2.1, of one or several required SIB(s) in accordance with clause 5.2.2.1 and the requested SIB has not been indicated in RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to the L2 U2N Relay UE before):
B12593: 2>include sl-RequestedSIB-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink to indicate the requested SIB(s);
B12594: 1>if the UE has not stored a valid version, in accordance with clause 5.2.2.2.1, of one or several posSIB(s) that the UE requires for a positioning operation, and the requested posSIB has not been indicated in RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to the L2 U2N Relay UE before, and the connected L2 U2N relay UE set posSIB-ForwardingSupported to supported:
B12595: 2>include sl-RequestedPosSIB-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink to indicate the requested posSIB(s);
B12596: 1>if the UE needs the SFN-DFN offset based on the request from upper layers and the connected L2 U2N relay UE set sfn-DFN-OffsetSupported to supported:
B12597: 2>set sl-SFN-DFN-OffsetRequested to true;
B12598: 1>if the UE has paging related information to provide (e.g. the UE has not sent sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to the L2 U2N Relay UE before), set sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE as follows:
B12599: 2>if the L2 U2N Remote UE is in RRC_IDLE:
B12600: 3>include ng-5G-S-TMSI in the sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUE;
B12601: 3>if the UE specific DRX cycle is configured by upper layer, set sl-PagingCycleRemoteUE to the value of UE specific Uu DRX cycle configured by upper layer;
B12602: 2>else if the L2 U2N Remote UE is in RRC_INACTIVE:
B12603: 3>include ng-5G-S-TMSI and fullI-RNTI in the sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUE;
B12604: 3>if the UE specific DRX cycle is configured by upper layer,
B12605: 4>set sl-PagingCycleRemoteUE to the minimum value of UE specific Uu DRX cycles (configured by upper layer and configured by RRC);
B12606: 3>else:
B12607: 4>set sl-PagingCycleRemoteUE to the value of UE specific DRX cycle configured by RRC;
B12608: 1>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12609: When L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE receives new or updated SIB/Paging request from one or more child UE(s) according to 5.8.9.8.3, or PC5 link to a Child UE is no longer available (e.g., due to SL RLF), the UE shall:
B12610: 1>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE and there needs to be any variation of the requested SIB list:
B12611: 2>include sl-RequestedSIB-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink to indicate the requested SIB(s);
B12612: 1>if the UE has received paging related information from Child UE as specified in 5.8.9.8.3:
B12613: 2>include the updated paging information for Child UE(s) in the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List;
B12614: 1>if a Child UE is no longer connected to the L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE (e.g. due to SL RLF):
B12615: 2>update sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List to exclude this Child UE;
B12616: 1>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12617: When entering RRC_CONNECTED, if L2 U2N remote UE or L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE had sent sl-RequestedSIB-List, sl-RequestedPosSIB-List, and/or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE, the L2 U2N Remote UE or L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE shall:
B12618: 1>set the sl-RequestedSIB-List to the value release if requested before;
B12619: 1>set the sl-RequestedPosSIB-List to the value release if requested before;
B12620: 1>set the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE to the value release if sent before;
B12621: 1>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12622: Upon any change in the need of SFN-DFN offset while in RRC_CONNECTED, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall:
B12623: 1>if the UE needs the SFN-DFN offset based on the request from upper layers and the connected L2 U2N relay UE set sfn-DFN-OffsetSupported to supported:
B12624: 2>set sl-SFN-DFN-OffsetRequested to true;
B12625: 1>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12626: The L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED shall:
B12627: 1>if the UE is configured with sl-IndirectPathAddChange set to setup, and not configured with split SRB1 with duplication:
B12628: 2>include connectionForMP;
B12629: 2>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12630: The L2 U2U Remote UE shall:
B12631: 1>upon end-to-end PC5-RRC connection release; or
B12632: 1>upon end-to-end PC5-RRC connection failure due to T400 expiry or integrity check failure of SL-SRB2 or SL-SRB3:
B12633: 2>include sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE;
B12634: 2>submit the RemoteUEInformationSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12635: 5.8.9.8.3Reception of RemoteUEInformationSidelink message by the L2 U2N/U2U Relay UE
B12636: The L2 U2N Relay UE in single-hop or the L2 Last U2N Relay UE in multi-hop shall:
B12637: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE/sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List:
B12638: 2>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED on an active BWP with common search space configured including pagingSearchSpace; or
B12639: 2>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE:
B12640: 3>if the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List is set to setup:
B12641: 4>monitor the Paging message at the L2 U2N Remote UE's paging occasion calculated according to sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUE and sl-PagingCycleRemoteUE included in sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE;
B12642: 3>else (the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List is set to release):
B12643: 4>stop monitoring the Paging message at the L2 U2N Remote UE's paging occasion;
B12644: 4>release the received paging information in sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE;
B12645: 2>else:
B12646: 3>if the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List is set to setup:
B12647: 4>include the received sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUE or sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUEList in SidelinkUEInformationNR message and perform Sidelink UE information transmission in accordance with 5.8.3;
B12648: 3>else (the sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List is set to release):
B12649: 4>initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message to release the sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUE or sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUEList in SidelinkUEInformationNR message in accordance with 5.8.3;
B12650: 4>release the received paging information in sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingIdentityRemoteUEList;
B12651: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the sl-RequestedSIB-List:
B12652: 2>if the sl-RequestedSIB-List is set to setup:
B12653: 3> if the L2 U2N Relay UE has not stored a valid version of SIB(s) indicated in sl-RequestedSIB-List:
B12654: 4>perform acquisition of the system information indicated in sl-RequestedSIB-List in accordance with 5.2.2 or 5.8.9.8.2;
B12655: 3>perform the Uu message transfer procedure in accordance with 5.8.9.9;
B12656: 2>if the sl-RequestedSIB-List is set to release:
B12657: 3>release received SIB request in sl-RequestedSIB-List;
B12658: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the sl-RequestedPosSIB-List:
B12659: 2>if the sl-RequestedPosSIB-List is set to setup:
B12660: 3> if the L2 U2N Relay UE has not stored a valid version of posSIB(s) indicated in sl-RequestedPosSIB-List:
B12661: 4>perform acquisition of the positioning system information indicated in sl-RequestedPosSIB-List in accordance with 5.2.2 or 5.8.9.8.2;
B12662: 3>perform the Uu message transfer procedure in accordance with 5.8.9.9;
B12663: 2>if the sl-RequestedPosSIB-List is set to release:
B12664: 3>release received posSIB request in sl-RequestedPosSIB-List.
B12665: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the connectionForMP:
B12666: 2>if the L2 U2N Relay UE is in RRC_IDLE:
B12667: 3>initiate an RRC connection establishment as specified in 5.3.3;
B12668: 2>else if the L2 U2N Relay UE is in RRC_INACTIVE:
B12669: 3>initiate an RRC connection resume as specified in 5.3.13;
B12670: If the L2 U2N Relay UE is a L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE, the UE shall:
B12671: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the sl-RequestedSIB-List and the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE:
B12672: 2>update the list of SIB requests;
B12673: 2>if the updated SIB request list is different from the one shared with its parent relay UE;
B12674: 3>trigger the Remote UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure with its parent UE, as specified in 5.8.9.8.2;
B12675: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE or sl-PagingInfo-RemoteUE-List:
B12676: 2>trigger the Remote UE information for NR sidelink communication procedure with its parent UE, as specified in 5.8.9.8.2.
B12677: The L2 U2U Relay UE shall:
B12678: 1>if the RemoteUEInformationSidelink includes the sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE:
B12679: 2>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection release for the end-to-end PC5 connection between the L2 U2U Remote UE and the peer L2 U2U Remote UE identified by sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE;
B12680: 2>initiate the end-to-end PC5 connection failure/release related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3b;
B12681: 5.8.9.9Uu message transfer in sidelink
B12682: 5.8.9.9.1General
B12684: Figure 5.8.9.9.1-1: Uu message transfer in sidelink
B12685: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer Paging message and System Information from the L2 U2N Relay UE to the L2 U2N Remote UE (in case of single hop) or to the Child UE (in case of multi hop) in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE.
B12686: 5.8.9.9.2Actions related to transmission of UuMessageTransferSidelink message
B12687: The L2 U2N Relay UE initiates the Uu message transfer procedure when at least one of the following conditions is met:
B12688: 1>upon receiving Paging message related to the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or the Child UE from network or Parent relay UE (including Paging message within RRCReconfiguration message);
B12689: 1>upon acquisition of the SIB(s) requested by the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or by the Child UE (as indicated in sl-RequestedSIB-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink) or upon receiving the updated SIB(s) from network or Parent relay UE which has been requested by the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or by the Child UE;
B12690: 1>upon acquisition of the posSIB(s) requested by the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or by the Child UE (as indicated in sl-RequestedPosSIB-List in the RemoteUEInformationSidelink) or upon receiving the updated posSIB(s) from network or Parent relay UE which have been requested by the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or by the Child UE;
B12691: 1>upon unsolicited SIB1 forwarding to the connected L2 U2N Remote UE or by the Child UE or upon receiving the updated SIB1 from network or Parent relay UE;
B12692: For each associated L2 U2N Remote UE or for each associated Child UE, the L2 U2N Relay UE shall set the contents of UuMessageTransferSidelink message as follows:
B12693: 1>include sl-PagingDelivery if the Paging message received from network or Parent relay UE containing the ue-Identity of the L2 U2N Remote UE or Child UE;
B12694: 1>include sl-SIB1-Delivery if any of the conditions for initiating Uu message transfer procedure related to SIB1 are met;
B12695: 1>include sl-SystemInformationDelivery if any of the conditions for initiating Uu message transfer procedure related to System Information are met;
B12696: 1>submit the UuMessageTransferSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12697: NOTE:The L2 U2N Relay UE may perform unsolicited forwarding of SIB1 to the L2 U2N Remote UE or to the Child UE based on UE implementation. A L2 U2N Remote UE configured with MP does not apply the SIB1 received from the L2 U2N Relay UE on the indirect path, if any.
B12698: 5.8.9.9.3Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink by the L2 U2N Remote UE
B12699: Upon receiving the UuMessageTransferSidelink message, the L2 U2N Remote UE shall:
B12700: 1>if sl-PagingDelivery is included:
B12701: 2>perform the paging reception procedure as specified in clause 5.3.2.3;
B12702: 1>if sl-SystemInformationDelivery and/or sl-SIB1-Delivery is included:
B12704: 2>perform the actions specified in clause 5.2.2.4.
B12705: 5.8.9.9.4Reception of the UuMessageTransferSidelink by the L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE
B12706: Upon receiving the UuMessageTransferSidelink message from the connected L2 U2N Parent Relay UE, the L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE shall:
B12707: 1>if sl-PagingDelivery contains the ue-Identity of the child UEs:
B12708: 2>consider the paging message of the child UE is received;
B12709: 2>perform the actions specified in clause 5.8.9.9.2;
B12710: 1>if sl-SystemInformationDelivery requested by the child UEs and/or sl-SIB1-Delivery is included:
B12711: 2>consider the SIBs (other than SIB1) requested by the child UE is acquired;
B12712: 2>perform the actions specified in clause 5.8.9.9.2;
B12713: 5.8.9.10Notification Message
B12714: 5.8.9.10.1General
B12716: Figure 5.8.9.10.1-1: Notification message in sidelink
B12717: This procedure is used by a U2N Relay UE to send notification to the connected U2N Remote UE or to the child UE, or used by a L2 U2U Relay UE to send notification to the L2 U2U Remote UE for an end-to-end PC5 connection when condition(s) as specified in 5.8.9.10.2 is met for the hop between the L2 U2U Relay UE and the peer L2 U2U Remote UE.
B12718: 5.8.9.10.2Initiation
B12719: The Relay UE may initiate the procedure when one of the following conditions is met:
B12720: 1>if the UE is acting as U2N Relay UE in case of single hop or Last U2N Relay UE:
B12721: 2>upon Uu RLF as specified in 5.3.10;
B12722: 2>upon reception of an RRCReconfiguration including the reconfigurationWithSync;
B12723: 2>upon cell reselection;
B12724: 2>upon L2 U2N Relay UE's or Last U2N Relay UE’s RRC connection failure including RRC connection reject as specified in 5.3.3.5 and 5.3.13.10, and T300 expiry as specified in 5.3.3.7, and RRC resume failure as specified in 5.3.13.5;
B12725: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE:
B12726: 2>upon relay reselection;
B12727: 2>upon cell selection;
B12728: 2>upon PC5 RLF with its parent relay UE;
B12729: 2>upon reception of an RRCReconfiguration including the reconfigurationWithSync;
B12730: 2>upon reception of a NotificationMessageSidelink from the parent relay UE while in RRC_CONNECTED;
B12731: 2> upon indication from the upper layer at Intermediate U2N Relay of a PC5 unicast link release with the parent Relay UE;
B12732: 2>upon L2 Intermediate U2N Relay UE's RRC connection failure including RRC connection reject as specified in 5.3.3.5 and 5.3.13.10, and T300 expiry as specified in 5.3.3.7, and RRC resume failure as specified in 5.3.13.5;
B12733: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE:
B12734: 2>upon detection of PC5 RLF for the hop between the L2 U2U Relay UE and L2 U2U Remote UE as specified in 5.8.9.3;
B12735: 2>upon PC5-RRC connection release for the per-hop link between the L2 U2U Relay UE and L2 U2U Remote UE as specified in 5.8.9.5;
B12736: NOTE 1:The Notification Message may be omitted by an L2 Intermediate U2N relay UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE to its child UEs if the relay reselection or cell selection does not cause the change of the serving cell.
B12737: NOTE 2:If reception of a Notification Message and relay/cell reselection both cause initiation of Notification message, Relay UE can initiate Notification message for either relay/cell reselection or reception of a Notification Message.
B12738: 5.8.9.10.3Actions related to transmission of NotificationMessageSidelink message
B12739: The Relay UE shall set the indication type as follows:
B12740: 1>if the UE is acting as U2N Relay UE in case of single hop or Last U2N Relay UE:
B12741: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to Uu RLF:
B12742: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-Uu-RLF;
B12743: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to reconfiguration with sync:
B12744: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-HO;
B12745: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to cell reselection:
B12746: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-CellReselection;
B12747: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to Uu RRC connection establishment/Resume failure:
B12748: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-Uu-RRC-Failure;
B12749: 2>submit the NotificationMessageSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12750: 1>if the UE is acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE:
B12751: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to relay reselection:
B12752: 3>set the mh-indicationType as relayUE-RelayReselection;
B12753: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to cell selection:
B12754: 3>set the mh-indicationType as relayUE-CellSelection;
B12755: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to PC5 RLF with its parent Relay UE:
B12756: 3>set the sl-IndicationType as relayUE-PC5-RLF;
B12757: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to reconfiguration with sync:
B12758: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-HO;
B12759: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message upon reception of the NotificationMessageSidelink message from the parent relay UE:
B12760: 3>set the indicationType as received from the parent relay UE;
B12761: 2>else if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message upon reception of PC5 unicast link release for the parent relay UE:
B12762: 3>set the mh-indicationType as relayUE-Parent-PC5LinkRelease;
B12763: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to Uu RRC connection establishment/Resume failure:
B12764: 3>set the indicationType as relayUE-Uu-RRC-Failure;
B12765: 2>submit the NotificationMessageSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12766: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE:
B12767: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to PC5 RLF with L2 U2U Remote UE; or
B12768: 2>if the UE initiates transmission of the NotificationMessageSidelink message due to PC5-RRC connection release for the per-hop link between the L2 U2U Relay UE and L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12769: 3>set the sl-IndicationType as relayUE-PC5-RLF;
B12770: 3>set the sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE as the associated destination for L2 U2U Remote UE;
B12771: 3>submit the NotificationMessageSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12772: 5.8.9.10.4Actions related to reception of NotificationMessageSidelink message
B12773: Upon receiving the NotificationMessageSidelink, the Remote UE shall:
B12774: 1>if the UE is acting as U2N Remote UE:
B12775: 2>if the indicationType/mh-indicationType/sl-IndicationType is included:
B12776: 3>if the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12777: 4>if MP is configured and MCG transmission (i.e. direct path) is not suspended;
B12778: 5>if the indicationType is relayUE-HO;
B12779: 6>suspend indirect path transmission;
B12780: 5>else:
B12781: 6>initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3c to report indirect path failure;
B12782: 4>else if T301 is not running, initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure as specified in 5.3.7;
B12783: 3>else (the UE is L3 U2N Remote UE, or L2 U2N Remote UE or child UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE):
B12784: 4>if the PC5-RRC connection with the U2N Relay UE or with the U2N Parent Relay UE is determined to be released:
B12785: 5>indicate upper layers to trigger PC5 unicast link release;
B12786: 4>else (i.e., maintain the PC5 RRC connection):
B12787: 5>if the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE or child UE and the indicationType is relayUE-HO or relayUE-CellReselection:
B12788: 6>consider cell re-selection occurs;
B12789: 5>if the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE or child UE and mh-indicationType is relayUE-RelayReselection:
B12790: 6>consider its parent U2N relay UE’s relay reselection occurs;
B12791: 5>if the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE or child UE and mh-indicationType is relayUE-CellSelection:
B12792: 6>consider its parent U2N Relay UE’s cell selection occurs;
B12793: 5>if the UE is L2 U2N Remote UE or child UE and sl-IndicationType is relayUE-PC5-RLF:
B12794: 6>consider its parent U2N Relay UE’s PC5 RLF with its upstream Relay UE occurs;
B12796: NOTE 1:For L3 U2N Remote UE, or L2 U2N Remote UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE, it is up to Remote UE implementation whether to release or keep the PC5 unicast link.
B12797: NOTE 2:The L2 U2N Remote UE may ignore the NotificationMessageSidelink if it does not release the PC5 unicast link in source side yet during an indirect-to-direct path switch, i.e. T304 is running.
B12798: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12799: 2>if sl-IndicationType is relayUE-PC5-RLF:
B12800: 3>indicate PC5 RLF received from L2 U2U Relay UE to the upper layers for the indicated L2 U2U Remote UE based on the received sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE;
B12801: 3>consider the end-to-end PC5 connection failure for the end-to-end PC5 connection(s) over the per-hop PC5 link between the L2 U2U Relay UE and the L2 U2U Remote UE identified by sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE;
B12802: 3>perform the end-to-end PC5 connection failure related actions as specified in 5.8.9.3a;
B12803: NOTE 3:It is up to the upper layers on whether to trigger U2U Relay reselection and whether to keep or release the PC5 link with the U2U Relay UE after the PC5 RLF indication received from U2U Relay UE.
B12804: 5.8.9.11UE information transfer on sidelink
B12805: 5.8.9.11.1General
B12807: Figure 5.8.9.11.1-1: Sidelink UE information procedure
B12808: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer the UE information between a Remote UE and a Relay UE in sidelink. The L2 U2U Remote UE informs its end-to-end QoS information to its connected L2 U2U Relay UE in the UEInformationRequestSidelink message, and the L2 U2U Relay UE delivers the split QoS information of the first-hop to the Remote UE in the UEInformationResponseSidelink message.
B12809: 5.8.9.11.2Actions related to transmission of the UEInformationRequestSidelink by the UE
B12810: For initial information transfer (e.g. for QoS split) or upon change in any of the information in the UEInformationRequestSidelink, the UE shall set the contents of UEInformationRequestSidelink message as follows and include all concerned information, irrespective of trigger condition:
B12811: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Remote UE:
B12812: 2>set sl-E2E-QoS-InfoListPC5 to include the end-to-end QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) towards the peer L2 U2U Remote UE if configured by the upper layer, and for each entry:
B12813: 3>set sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE to include the associated identity for peer L2 U2U Remote UE;
B12814: 3>set sl-E2E-SLRB-Index to include the associated end-to-end SLRB configuration index;
B12815: 3>set sl-QoS-InfoList to include the end-to-end QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s);
B12816: 2>submit the UEInformationRequestSidelink message to lower layers for transmission.
B12817: 5.8.9.11.3Actions related to reception of the UEInformationRequestSidelink by the UE
B12818: The UE shall perform the following actions upon reception of the UEInformationRequestSidelink:
B12819: 1>if the UE is acting as L2 U2U Relay UE:
B12820: 2>perform QoS split based on the sl-QoS-InfoList for each QoS flow to decide the split PDB value for each PC5 hop;
B12821: 2>set the contents of UEInformationResponseSidelink message as follows:
B12822: 3>set sl-SplitQoS-InfoListPC5 to include the split PDB value for each QoS flow on the first PC5 hop between L2 U2U Relay UE and L2 U2U Remote UE;
B12823: 2>submit the UEInformationResponseSidelink message to lower layers for transmission;
B12824: 2>for each sl-E2E-SLRB-Index value included in the sl-E2E-QoS-InfoListPC5:
B12825: 3>merge the split per-flow QoS on the second PC5 hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile;
B12826: 2>if the UE is in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage:
B12827: 3>derive the PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration on the second PC5 hop based on the per-SLRB level QoS profile of this end-to-end sidelink DRB, as specified in 5.8.9.7.0;
B12828: 3>(re)configure the SRAP entity to map the end-to-end DRB with PC5 Relay RLC channel, if needed;
B12829: 2>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12830: 3>initiate sidelink UE information procedure according to clause 5.8.3.2 to report per-SLRB level QoS.
B12831: NOTE 1:It is left to Relay UE implementation on how to split the PDB.
B12832: NOTE 2:For a L2 U2U Relay UE, how to merge the split per-flow QoS on the second PC5 hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile is up to UE implementation.
B12833: 5.8.9.11.4Actions related to reception of the UEInformationResponseSidelink by the UE
B12834: The UE shall perform the following actions upon reception of the UEInformationResponseSidelink:
B12835: 1>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED:
B12836: 2>initiate sidelink UE information procedure according to clause 5.8.3.2 to report the split QoS profile for the first PC5 hop;
B12837: 1>else (UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage):
B12838: 2>for each sl-E2E-SLRB-Index value included in the sl-E2E-QoS-InfoListPC5 in UEInformationRequestSidelink:
B12839: 3>merge the split per-flow QoS on the first PC5 hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile;
B12840: 3>derive the PC5 Relay RLC channel configuration for the first PC5 hop based on the per-SLRB level QoS profile of this end-to-end sidelink DRB, as specifed in 5.8.9.7.0;
B12841: 3>(re)configure the SRAP entity to map the end-to-end DRB with PC5 Relay RLC channel, if needed.
B12842: NOTE:For a L2 U2U Remote UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE or out of coverage, how to merge the split per-flow QoS on the first PC5 hop into a per-SLRB level QoS profile is up to UE implementation.
B12843: 5.8.10Sidelink measurement
B12844: 5.8.10.1Introduction
B12845: The UE may configure the associated peer UE to perform NR sidelink measurement and report on the corresponding PC5-RRC connection in accordance with the NR sidelink measurement configuration for unicast by RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.
B12846: The NR sidelink measurement configuration includes the following parameters for a PC5-RRC connection:
B12847: 1.NR sidelink measurement objects: Object(s) on which the associated peer UE shall perform the NR sidelink measurements.
B12848: -For NR sidelink measurement, a NR sidelink measurement object indicates the NR sidelink frequency of reference signals to be measured.
B12849: 2.NR sidelink reporting configurations: NR sidelink measurement reporting configuration(s) where there can be one or multiple NR sidelink reporting configurations per NR sidelink measurement object. Each NR sidelink reporting configuration consists of the following:
B12850: -Reporting criterion: The criterion that triggers the UE to send a NR sidelink measurement report. This can either be periodical or a single event description.
B12851: -RS type: The RS that the UE uses for NR sidelink measurement results. In this release, both DMRS and SL-PRS are supported for NR sidelink measurement.
B12852: -Reporting format: The quantities that the UE includes in the measurement report. In this release, only RSRP measurement is supported.
B12853: 3.NR sidelink measurement identities: A list of NR sidelink measurement identities where each NR sidelink measurement identity links one NR sidelink measurement object with one NR sidelink reporting configuration. By configuring multiple NR sidelink measurement identities, it is possible to link more than one NR sidelink measurement object to the same NR sidelink reporting configuration, as well as to link more than one NR sidelink reporting configuration to the same NR sidelink measurement object. The NR sidelink measurement identity is also included in the NR sidelink measurement report that triggered the reporting, serving as a reference to the network.
B12854: 4.NR sidelink quantity configurations: The NR sidelink quantity configuration defines the NR sidelink measurement filtering configuration used for all event evaluation and related reporting, and for periodical reporting of that NR sidelink measurement. In each configuration, different filter coefficients can be configured for different NR sidelink measurement quantities.
B12855: Both UEs of the PC5-RRC connection maintains a NR sidelink measurement object list, a NR sidelink reporting configuration list, and a NR sidelink measurement identities list according to signalling and procedures in this specification.
B12856: 5.8.10.2Sidelink measurement configuration
B12857: 5.8.10.2.1General
B12858: The UE shall:
B12859: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12860: 2>perform the sidelink measurement object removal procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.4;
B12861: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-MeasObjectToAddModList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12862: 2>perform the sidelink measurement object addition/modification procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.5;
B12863: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-ReportConfigToRemoveList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12864: 2>perform the sidelink reporting configuration removal procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.6;
B12865: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-ReportConfigToAddModList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12866: 2>perform the sidelink reporting configuration addition/modification procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.7;
B12867: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-QuantityConfig in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12868: 2>perform the sidelink quantity configuration procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.8;
B12869: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-MeasIdToRemoveList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12870: 2>perform the sidelink measurement identity removal procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.2;
B12871: 1>if the received sl-MeasConfig includes the sl-MeasIdToAddModList in the RRCReconfigurationSidelink:
B12872: 2>perform the sidelink measurement identity addition/modification procedure as specified in 5.8.10.2.3;
B12873: 5.8.10.2.2Sidelink measurement identity removal
B12874: The UE shall:
B12875: 1>for each sl-MeasId included in the received sl-MeasIdToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfigSL:
B12876: 2>remove the entry with the matching sl-MeasId from the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL;
B12877: 2>remove the NR sidelink measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12878: 2>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId.
B12879: NOTE:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the sl-MeasIdToRemoveList includes any sl-MeasId value that is not part of the current UE configuration.
B12880: 5.8.10.2.3Sidelink measurement identity addition/modification
B12881: The UE shall:
B12882: 1>for each sl-MeasId included in the received sl-MeasIdToAddModList:
B12883: 2>if an entry with the matching sl-MeasId exists in the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL:
B12884: 3>replace the entry with the value received for this sl-MeasId;
B12885: 2>else:
B12886: 3>add a new entry for this sl-MeasId within the VarMeasConfigSL;
B12887: 2>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12888: 2>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId;
B12889: 5.8.10.2.4Sidelink measurement object removal
B12890: The UE shall:
B12891: 1>for each sl-MeasObjectId included in the received sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList that is part of sl-MeasObjectList in VarMeasConfigSL:
B12892: 2>remove the entry with the matching sl-MeasObjectId from the sl-MeasObjectList within the VarMeasConfigSL;
B12893: 2>remove all sl-MeasId associated with this sl-MeasObjectId from the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL, if any;
B12894: 2>if a sl-MeasId is removed from the sl-MeasIdList:
B12895: 3>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12896: 3>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId.
B12897: NOTE:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the sl-MeasObjectToRemoveList includes any sl-MeasObjectId value that is not part of the current UE configuration.
B12898: 5.8.10.2.5Sidelink measurement object addition/modification
B12899: The UE shall:
B12900: 1>for each sl-MeasObjectId included in the received sl-MeasObjectToAddModList:
B12901: 2>if an entry with the matching sl-MeasObjectId exists in the sl-MeasObjectList within the VarMeasConfigSL, for this entry:
B12902: 3>for each sl-MeasId associated with this sl-MeasObjectId included in the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL, if any:
B12903: 4>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12904: 4>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId;
B12905: 3>reconfigure the entry with the value received for this sl-MeasObject;
B12906: 2>else:
B12907: 3>add a new entry for the received sl-MeasObject to the sl-MeasObjectList within VarMeasConfigSL.
B12908: 5.8.10.2.6Sidelink reporting configuration removal
B12909: The UE shall:
B12910: 1>for each sl-ReportConfigId included in the received sl-ReportConfigToRemoveList that is part of the current UE configuration in VarMeasConfigSL:
B12911: 2>remove the entry with the matching sl-ReportConfigId from the sl-ReportConfigList within the VarMeasConfigSL;
B12912: 2>remove all sl-MeasId associated with the sl-ReportConfigId from the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL, if any;
B12913: 2>if a sl-MeasId is removed from the sl-MeasIdList:
B12914: 3>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12915: 3>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId.
B12916: NOTE:The UE does not consider the message as erroneous if the sl-ReportConfigToRemoveList includes any sl-ReportConfigId value that is not part of the current UE configuration.
B12917: 5.8.10.2.7Sidelink reporting configuration addition/modification
B12918: The UE shall:
B12919: 1>for each sl-ReportConfigId included in the received sl-ReportConfigToAddModList:
B12920: 2>if an entry with the matching sl-ReportConfigId exists in the sl-ReportConfigList within the VarMeasConfigSL, for this entry:
B12921: 3>reconfigure the entry with the value received for this sl-ReportConfig;
B12922: 3>for each sl-MeasId associated with this sl-ReportConfigId included in the sl-MeasIdList within the VarMeasConfigSL, if any:
B12923: 4>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12924: 4>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId;
B12925: 2>else:
B12926: 3>add a new entry for the received sl-ReportConfig to the sl-ReportConfigList within the VarMeasConfigSL.
B12927: 5.8.10.2.8Sidelink quantity configuration
B12928: The UE shall:
B12929: 1>for each received sl-QuantityConfig:
B12930: 2>set the corresponding parameter(s) in sl-QuantityConfig within VarMeasConfigSL to the value of the received sl-QuantityConfig parameter(s);
B12931: 1>for each sl-MeasId included in the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL:
B12932: 2>remove the measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId from the VarMeasReportListSL, if included;
B12933: 2>stop the periodical reporting timer and reset the associated information (e.g. sl-TimeToTrigger) for this sl-MeasId.
B12934: 5.8.10.3Performing NR sidelink measurements
B12935: 5.8.10.3.1General
B12936: A UE shall derive NR sidelink measurement results by measuring one or multiple DMRS/SL-PRS associated per PC5-RRC connection as configured by the peer UE associated, as described in 5.8.10.3.2. For all NR sidelink measurement results the UE applies the layer 3 filtering as specified in clause 5.5.3.2, before using the measured results for evaluation of reporting criteria and measurement reporting. In this release, only NR sidelink RSRP can be configured as trigger quantity and reporting quantity.
B12937: The UE shall:
B12938: 1>for each sl-MeasId included in the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL:
B12939: 2>if the sl-MeasObject is associated to NR sidelink and the sl-RS-Type is set to dmrs:
B12940: 3>derive the layer 3 filtered NR sidelink measurement result based on PSSCH DMRS for the trigger quantity and each measurement quantity indicated in sl-ReportQuantity using parameters from the associated sl-MeasObject, as described in 5.8.10.3.2.
B12941: 2>if the sl-MeasObject is associated to NR sidelink and the sl-RS-Type is set to sl-prs:
B12942: 3>derive the layer 3 filtered NR sidelink measurement result based on SL-PRS for the trigger quantity and each measurement quantity indicated in sl-ReportQuantity using parameters from the associated sl-MeasObject, as described in 5.8.10.3.2.
B12943: 2>perform the evaluation of reporting criteria as specified in 5.8.10.4.
B12944: 5.8.10.3.2Derivation of NR sidelink measurement results
B12945: The UE may be configured by the peer UE associated to derive NR sidelink RSRP measurement results per PC5-RRC connection associated to the NR sidelink measurement objects based on parameters configured in the sl-MeasObject and in the sl-ReportConfig.
B12946: The UE shall:
B12947: 1>for each NR sidelink measurement quantity to be derived based on NR sidelink DMRS/SL-PRS:
B12948: 2>derive the corresponding measurement of NR sidelink frequency indicated quantity based on PSSCH DMRS/SL-PRS as described in TS 38.215 [9] in the concerned sl-MeasObject;
B12949: 2>apply layer 3 filtering as described in 5.5.3.2.
B12950: 5.8.10.4Sidelink measurement report triggering
B12951: 5.8.10.4.1General
B12952: The UE shall:
B12953: 1>for each sl-MeasId included in the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL:
B12954: 2>if the sl-ReportType is set to sl-EventTriggered and if the entry condition applicable for this event, i.e. the event corresponding with the sl-EventId of the corresponding sl-ReportConfig within VarMeasConfigSL, is fulfilled for NR sidelink frequency for all NR sidelink measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during sl-TimeToTrigger defined for this event within the VarMeasConfigSL, while the VarMeasReportListSL does not include a NR sidelink measurement reporting entry for this sl-MeasId (a first NR sidelink frequency triggers the event):
B12955: 3>include a NR sidelink measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12956: 3>set the sl-NumberOfReportsSent defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId to 0;
B12957: 3>include the concerned NR sidelink frequency in the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12958: 3>initiate the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.8.10.5;
B12959: 2>else if the sl-ReportType is set to sl-EventTriggered and if the entry condition applicable for this event, i.e. the event corresponding with the sl-EventId of the corresponding sl-ReportConfig within VarMeasConfigSL, is fulfilled for NR sidelink frequency not included in the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList for all NR sidelink measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during sl-TimeToTrigger defined for this event within the VarMeasConfigSL (a subsequent NR sidelink frequency triggers the event):
B12960: 3>set the sl-NumberOfReportsSent defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId to 0;
B12961: 3>include the concerned NR sidelink frequency in the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12962: 3>initiate the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.8.10.5;
B12963: 2>else if the sl-ReportType is set to sl-EventTriggered and if the leaving condition applicable for this event is fulfilled for NR sidelink frequency included in the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId for all NR sidelink measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during sl-TimeToTrigger defined within the VarMeasConfigSL for this event:
B12964: 3>remove the concerned NR sidelink frequency in the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12965: 3>if sl-ReportOnLeave is set to true for the corresponding reporting configuration:
B12966: 4>initiate the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.8.10.5;
B12967: 3>if the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId is empty:
B12968: 4>remove the NR sidelink measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12969: 4>stop the periodical reporting timer for this sl-MeasId, if running;
B12970: 2>if sl-ReportType is set to sl-Periodical and if a (first) NR sidelink measurement result is available:
B12971: 3>include a NR sidelink measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B12972: 3>set the sl-NumberOfReportsSent defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId to 0;
B12973: 3>initiate the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.8.10.5, immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for the NR sidelink frequency:
B12974: 2>upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for this sl-MeasId:
B12975: 3>initiate the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.8.10.5.
B12976: 5.8.10.4.2Event S1 (Serving becomes better than threshold)
B12977: The UE shall:
B12978: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B12979: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S1-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B12980: 1>for this NR sidelink measurement, consider the NR sidelink frequency corresponding to the associated sl-MeasObject associated with this event.
B12981: Inequality S1-1 (Entering condition)
B12982: Ms – Hys > Thresh
B12983: Inequality S1-2 (Leaving condition)
B12984: Ms + Hys < Thresh
B12985: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B12986: Ms is the NR sidelink measurement result of the NR sidelink frequency, not taking into account any offsets.
B12987: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. sl-Hysteresis as defined within sl-ReportConfig for this event).
B12988: Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. s1-Threshold as defined within sl-ReportConfig for this event).
B12989: Ms is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP.
B12990: Hys is expressed in dB.
B12991: Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Ms.
B12992: 5.8.10.4.3Event S2 (Serving becomes worse than threshold)
B12993: The UE shall:
B12994: 1>consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S2-1, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B12995: 1>consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition S2-2, as specified below, is fulfilled;
B12996: 1>for this NR sidelink measurement, consider the NR sidelink frequency indicated by the sl-MeasObject associated to this event.
B12997: Inequality S2-1 (Entering condition)
B12998: Ms + Hys < Thresh
B12999: Inequality S2-2 (Leaving condition)
B13000: Ms – Hys > Thresh
B13001: The variables in the formula are defined as follows:
B13002: Ms is the NR sidelink measurement result of the NR sidelink frequency, not taking into account any offsets.
B13003: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event (i.e. sl-Hysteresis as defined within sl-ReportConfig for this event).
B13004: Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event (i.e. s2-Threshold as defined within sl-ReportConfig for this event).
B13005: Ms is expressed in dBm in case of RSRP.
B13006: Hys is expressed in dB.
B13007: Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Ms.
B13008: 5.8.10.5Sidelink measurement reporting
B13009: 5.8.10.5.1General
B13011: Figure 5.8.10.5.1-1: NR sidelink measurement reporting
B13012: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer measurement results from the UE to the peer UE associated.
B13013: For the sl-MeasId for which the NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure was triggered, the UE shall set the sl-MeasResults within the MeasurementReportSidelink message as follows:
B13014: 1>set the sl-MeasId to the measurement identity that triggered the NR sidelink measurement reporting;
B13015: 1>if the sl-ReportConfig associated with the sl-MeasId that triggered the NR sidelink measurement reporting is set to sl-EventTriggered or sl-Periodical:
B13016: 2>if the sl-RS-Type within sl-ReportConfig is set to dmrs:
B13017: 3>set sl-ResultDMRS within sl-MeasResult to include the NR sidelink DMRS based quantity indicated in the sl-ReportQuantity within the concerned sl-ReportConfig;
B13018: 2>if the sl-RS-Type within sl-ReportConfig is set to sl-prs:
B13019: 3>set sl-Result-SL-PRS within sl-MeasResult to include the NR SL-PRS based quantity indicated in the sl-ReportQuantity within the concerned sl-ReportConfig;
B13020: 1>increment the sl-NumberOfReportsSent as defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId by 1;
B13021: 1>stop the periodical reporting timer, if running;
B13022: 1>if the sl-NumberOfReportsSent as defined within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId is less than the sl-ReportAmount as defined within the corresponding sl-ReportConfig for this sl-MeasId:
B13023: 2>start the periodical reporting timer with the value of sl-ReportInterval as defined within the corresponding sl-ReportConfig for this sl-MeasId;
B13024: 1>else:
B13025: 2>if the sl-ReportType is set to sl-Periodical:
B13026: 3>remove the entry within the VarMeasReportListSL for this sl-MeasId;
B13027: 3>remove this sl-MeasId from the sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL;
B13028: 1>submit the MeasurementReportSidelink message to lower layers for transmission, upon which the procedure ends.
B13029: 5.8.11Zone identity calculation
B13030: The UE shall determine an identity of the zone (i.e. Zone_id) in which it is located using the following formulae, if sl-ZoneConfig is configured:
B13031: x1= Floor (x / L) Mod 64;
B13032: y1= Floor (y / L) Mod 64;
B13033: Zone_id = y1 * 64 + x1.
B13035: The parameters in the formulae are defined as follows:
B13036: L is the value of sl-ZoneLength included in sl-ZoneConfig;
B13037: x is the geodesic distance in longitude between UE's current location and geographical coordinates (0, 0) according to WGS84 model [58] and it is expressed in meters;
B13038: y is the geodesic distance in latitude between UE's current location and geographical coordinates (0, 0) according to WGS84 model [58] and it is expressed in meters.
B13039: NOTE:How the calculated zone_id is used is specified in TS 38.321 [3].
B13040: 5.8.12DFN derivation from GNSS
B13041: When the UE selects GNSS as the synchronization reference source, the DFN, the subframe number within a frame and slot number within a frame used for NR sidelink communication/discovery are derived from the current UTC time, by the following formulae:
B13042: DFN= Floor (0.1*(Tcurrent –Tref–OffsetDFN)) mod 1024
B13043: SubframeNumber= Floor (Tcurrent –Tref–OffsetDFN) mod 10
B13044: SlotNumber= Floor ((Tcurrent –Tref–OffsetDFN)*2μ) mod (10*2μ)
B13046: Where:
B13047: Tcurrent is the current UTC time obtained from GNSS. This value is expressed in milliseconds;
B13048: Tref is the reference UTC time 00:00:00 on Gregorian calendar date 1 January, 1900 (midnight between Thursday, December 31, 1899 and Friday, January 1, 1900). This value is expressed in milliseconds;
B13049: OffsetDFN is the value sl-OffsetDFN if configured, otherwise it is zero. This value is expressed in milliseconds.
B13050: μ=0/1/2/3 corresponding to the 15/30/60/120 kHz of SCS for SL, respectively.
B13051: NOTE 1:In case of leap second change event, how UE obtains the scheduled time of leap second change to adjust Tcurrent correspondingly is left to UE implementation. How UE handles to avoid the sudden discontinuity of DFN is left to UE implementation.
B13052: NOTE 2:Void.
B13053: 5.8.13NR sidelink discovery
B13054: 5.8.13.1General
B13055: The purpose of this procedure is to perform NR sidelink discovery as specified in TS 23.304 [65].
B13056: 5.8.13.2NR sidelink discovery monitoring
B13057: A UE capable of NR sidelink discovery that is configured by upper layers to monitor NR sidelink discovery messages shall:
B13058: 1>if the frequency used for NR sidelink discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList in RRCReconfiguration message and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration; or if the frequency used for NR sidelink discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoList included in SIB12 and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12:
B13059: 2>if the UE is configured with sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception included in RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync (i.e. handover):
B13060: 3>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool indicated by sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in RRCReconfiguration;
B13061: 2>else if the UE is configured with sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception included in RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync (i.e. handover):
B13062: 3>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool indicated by sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in RRCReconfiguration;
B13063: 2>else if the cell chosen for NR sidelink discovery reception provides SIB12:
B13064: 3>if sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception is included in SIB12:
B13065: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool indicated by sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in SIB12;
B13066: 3>else if sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception is included in SIB12:
B13067: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool indicated by sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in SIB12;
B13068: 1>else:
B13069: 2>if out of coverage on the concerned frequency for NR sidelink discovery:
B13070: 3>if sl-DiscRxPool was preconfigured:
B13071: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool that was preconfigured by sl-DiscRxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in SL-PreconfigurationNR, as defined in clause 9.3;
B13072: 3>else:
B13073: 4>configure lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool that was preconfigured by sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception in SL-PreconfigurationNR, as defined in clause 9.3;
B13074: NOTE:If sl-DiscRxPool and sl-RxPool are both included in SIB12 or preconfigured, it is up to UE implementation whether to monitor sidelink control information and the corresponding data using the resource pool indicated by sl-RxPool for NR sidelink discovery reception.
B13075: 5.8.13.3NR sidelink discovery transmission
B13076: A UE capable of NR sidelink discovery that is configured by upper layer to transmit NR sidelink discovery message shall:
B13077: 1>if the frequency used for NR sidelink discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message; or if the frequency used for NR sidelink discovery is included in sl-FreqInfoList within SIB12:
B13078: 2>if the UE is in RRC_CONNECTED and uses the frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration message:
B13079: 3>if the UE is acting as NR sidelink U2N Relay UE and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-Config; or
B13080: 3>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2N Relay UE/ configured with measurement object associated to L2 U2N Relay UEs in both single hop or multi hop case and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-Config; or
B13081: 3>if the UE is acting as Last U2N Relay UE performing Model A relay disocvery as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the Last U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-Config; or
B13082: 3>if the UE acting as Last U2N Relay UE is sending Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and if sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the Last U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 and 5.8.19.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-Config and sl-RelayUE-ConfigMH when the UE is not having the PC5 connection with the Candidate Child UE; or
B13083: 3>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE is performing Model A relay disocvery as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-Config; or
B13084: 3>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message or Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-Config and if the NR sidelink Intermediate U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.19.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigMH; or
B13085: 3>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2U Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2U Relay UE and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the peer NR Sidelink U2U Remote UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigU2U; or
B13086: 3>if the UE acting as Target Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model B and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigU2U; or
B13087: 3>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model A as specified in TS 23.304[65], and neighbour UEs in discovery message to be transmitted meet the threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.3; or
B13088: 3> if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65]; or
B13089: 3>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65] and sl-DiscConfig is included in RRCReconfiguration, and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigU2U; or
B13090: NOTE 1:For U2U Relay UE and Target Remote UE, it can be up to UE implementation on cross-layer interaction for the AS layer condition check for discovery message forwarding.
B13091: 3>if the UE is performing NR sidelink non-relay discovery:
B13092: 4>if the UE is configured with sl-ScheduledConfig:
B13093: 5>if T310 for MCG or T311 is running; and if sl-TxPoolExceptional is included in sl-FreqInfoList for the concerned frequency in SIB12 or included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR in RRCReconfiguration; or
B13094: 5>if T301 is running and the cell on which the UE initiated RRC connection re-establishment provides SIB12 including sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency; or
B13095: 5>if T304 for MCG is running and the UE is configured with sl-TxPoolExceptional included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR for the concerned frequency in RRCReconfiguration:
B13096: 6>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection using the resource pool indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional as defined in TS 38.321 [3] for NR sidelink discovery transmission;
B13097: 5>else:
B13098: 6>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 1 using the resource pool indicated by sl-DiscTxPoolScheduling or sl-TxPoolScheduling for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in RRCReconfiguration;
B13099: 5>if T311 is running, configure the lower layers to release the resources indicated by rrc-ConfiguredSidelinkGrant (if any);
B13100: 4>if the UE is configured with sl-UE-SelectedConfig:
B13101: 5>if the sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency is included in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration, and if a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19]; or
B13102: 5>if the sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency is not included in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration, and a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency included in sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19];
B13103: 6>if sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency is included in RRCReconfiguration; or
B13104: 6>if the PCell provides SIB12 including sl-TxPoolExceptional in sl-FreqInfoList for the concerned frequency:
B13105: 7>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection using the resource pool indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional as defined in TS 38.321 [3] for NR sidelink discovery transmission;
B13106: 5>else, if the sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency is included in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration:
B13107: 6>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig (as defined in TS 38.321 [3] and TS 38.214 [19]) using the pools of resources indicated by sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in RRCReconfiguration;
B13108: 5>else, if the sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency is included in the sl-ConfigDedicatedNR within RRCReconfiguration:
B13109: 6>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig (as defined in TS 38.321 [3] and TS 38.214 [19]) using the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in RRCReconfiguration;
B13110: 2>else if the cell chosen for NR sidelink discovery transmission provides SIB12:
B13111: 3>if the UE is acting as NR sidelink U2N Relay UE and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon in SIB12; or
B13112: 3>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2N Relay UE in both single hop or multi hop case and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommon in SIB12; or
B13113: 3>if the UE is acting as NR sidelink Last U2N Relay UE performing Model A relay discovery and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the NR sidelink Last U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon in SIB12; or
B13114: 3>if the UE acting as Last U2N Relay UE is sending Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and if sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the NR sidelink Last U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.14.2 and 5.8.19.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommon and sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommonMH when the UE is not having the PC5 connection with the Candidate Child UE; or
B13115: 3>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE has an established PC5 link with the selected parent U2N Relay UE and is performing Model A relay discovery as specified in TS 23.304 [65], and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommon in SIB12; or
B13116: 3>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message or Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommon and if the NR sidelink Intermediate U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.19.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommonMH; or
B13117: 3>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2U Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2U Relay UE and sl-DiscConfigCommon is included in SIB12, and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the peer NR Sidelink U2U Remote UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommonU2U in SIB12; or
B13118: 3>if the UE acting as Target Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model B and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-ConfigCommonU2U in SIB12; or
B13119: 3>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model A as specified in TS 23.304[65], and neighbor UEs in discovery message to be transmitted meet the threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.3; or
B13120: 3> if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65]; or
B13121: 3>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65] and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-ConfigCommonU2U in SIB12; or
B13122: 3>if the UE is performing NR sidelink non-relay discovery:
B13123: 4>if SIB12 includes sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency, and a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in the sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission is available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19] or random selection, if allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, is selected:
B13124: 5>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig using the pools of resources indicated by sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in SIB12 as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B13125: 4>else if SIB12 includes sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency, and a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in the sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission is available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19] or random selection, if allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, is selected:
B13126: 5>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig using the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in SIB12 as defined in TS 38.321 [3];
B13127: 4>else if SIB12 includes sl-TxPoolExceptional for the concerned frequency:
B13128: 5>from the moment the UE initiates RRC connection establishment or RRC connection resume, until receiving an RRCReconfiguration including sl-ConfigDedicatedNR, or receiving an RRCRelease or an RRCReject; or
B13129: 5>if a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in SIB12 is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19]; or
B13130: 5>if sl-DiscTxPoolSelected for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency is not included in SIB12 and if a result of full/partial sensing, if selected and is allowed by sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig, on the resources configured in sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in SIB12 is not available in accordance with TS 38.214 [19]:
B13131: 6>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on random selection (as defined in TS 38.321 [3]) using one of the pools of resources indicated by sl-TxPoolExceptional for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency;
B13132: 1>else if out of coverage on the concerned frequency for NR sidelink discovery:
B13133: 2>if the UE is acting as L3 U2N Relay UE; or
B13134: 2>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2N Relay UE in both single hop or multi hop case and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-PreconfigDiscConfig in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13135: 2>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE has an established PC5 link with the selected parent U2N Relay UE and is performing Model A relay discovery as specified in TS 23.304 [65], and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-PreconfigDiscConfig in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13136: 2>if the UE acting as Intermediate U2N Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message or Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304 [65] and if the NR sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.15.2 are met based on sl-PreconfigDiscConfig in SidelinkPreconfigNR and if the NR sidelink Intermediate U2N Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.19.2 are met based on sl-PreconfigDiscConfig in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13137: 2>if the UE is selecting NR sidelink U2U Relay UE / has a selected NR sidelink U2U Relay UE and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the peer NR sidelink U2U Remote UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-PreconfigU2U in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13138: 2>if the UE acting as Target Remote UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model B and if the NR sidelink U2U Remote UE threshold conditions associated with the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE as specified in 5.8.17.2 are met based on sl-RemoteUE-PreconfigU2U in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13139: 2>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is performing U2U Relay Discovery with Model A as specified in TS 23.304[65], and neighbor UEs in discovery message to be transmitted meet the threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.3; or
B13140: 2>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Response message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65]; or
B13141: 2>if the UE acting as U2U Relay UE is sending Discovery Solicitation message with Model B as specified in TS 23.304[65] and if the NR sidelink U2U Relay UE threshold conditions as specified in 5.8.16.2 are met based on sl-RelayUE-PreconfigU2U in SidelinkPreconfigNR; or
B13142: 2>if the UE is performing NR sidelink non-relay discovery:
B13143: 3>configure lower layers to perform the sidelink resource allocation mode 2 based on resource selection operation according to sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig (as defined in TS 38.321 [3] and TS 38.214 [19]) using the pools of resources indicated in sl-DiscTxPoolSelected or sl-TxPoolSelectedNormal for NR sidelink discovery transmission on the concerned frequency in SidelinkPreconfigNR.
B13144: NOTE 2:It is up to UE implementation to determine, in accordance with TS 38.321[3], which resource pool to use if multiple resource pools are configured, and which resource allocation scheme is used in the AS based on UE capability (for a UE in RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE) and the allowed resource schemes sl-AllowedResourceSelectionConfig in the resource pool configuration.
B13145: 5.8.14NR sidelink U2N Relay UE operation
B13146: 5.8.14.1General
B13147: This procedure is used by a UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE operation in case of single hop or by a UE supporting NR sidelink Last U2N Relay UE operation in case of multi hop configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink discovery messages to evaluate AS layer conditions.
B13148: 5.8.14.2NR sidelink U2N Relay UE threshold conditions
B13149: A UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Relay UE in case of single hop or Last U2N Relay UE operation shall:
B13150: 1>if the threshold conditions specified in this clause were previously not met:
B13151: 2>if threshHighRelay is not configured; or the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is below threshHighRelay by hystMaxRelay if configured; and
B13152: 2>if threshLowRelay is not configured; or the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is above threshLowRelay by hystMinRelay if configured:
B13153: 3>consider the threshold conditions to be met (entry);
B13154: 1>else:
B13155: 2>if the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is above threshHighRelay if configured; or
B13156: 2>if the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is below threshLowRelay if configured;
B13157: 3>consider the threshold conditions not to be met (leave);
B13158: 5.8.15NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation
B13159: 5.8.15.1General
B13160: This procedure is used by a UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation configured by upper layers to transmit NR sidelink discovery message to evaluate AS layer conditions. The procedure is also used to perform selection and reselection of NR sidelink U2N Relay UE.
B13161: 5.8.15.2NR Sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions
B13162: A UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation shall:
B13163: 1>if the threshold conditions specified in this clause were previously not met:
B13164: 2>if threshHighRemote is not configured; or the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is below threshHighRemote by hystMaxRemote if configured, or
B13165: 2> if the UE has no serving cell:
B13166: 3>consider the threshold conditions to be met (entry);
B13167: 1>else:
B13168: 2>if the RSRP measurement of the PCell, or the cell on which the UE camps, is above threshHighRemote if configured:
B13169: 3>consider the threshold conditions not to be met (leave);
B13170: The L2 U2N Remote UE not configured with MP considers the cell indicated by sl-ServingCellInfo in the SL-AccessInfo-L2U2N-r17 received from the connected L2 U2N Relay UE as the PCell/camping cell.
B13171: NOTE:First U2N Relay UE and Intermediate U2N Relay UE first connects to the network via the parent U2N Relay UE(s) acting as a U2N Remote UE after checking the Remote UE threshold conditions above.
B13172: 5.8.15.3Selection and reselection of NR sidelink U2N Relay UE
B13173: A UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation that is configured by upper layers to search for a NR sidelink U2N Relay UE shall:
B13174: 1>if the UE has no serving cell; or
